A report commissioned by Southwark Council last spring and authored by urban planner Mireille Okonkwo concluded that the two ambitions are not necessarily incompatible, though her 240-page document stopped short of any firm recommendation.

The Scottish Parliament voted narrowly on Thursday to reject a motion of no confidence in Finance Secretary Catriona Hislop, with 65 members voting against the motion, 58 in favour, and 4 abstentions — a result that the SNP described as a vindication of its economic stewardship but that Labour and the Conservatives vowed to revisit when the spring budget arrives for debate in Holyrood next month.

Im packenden Halbfinale der 3. Liga empfing der VfB Oldenburg am Samstagabend den FSV Zwickau im Marschwegstadion – und die Gastgeber setzten sich nach einem nervenaufreibenden Spiel mit 3:1 durch. Doppeltorschütze Lennart Fehse war der überragende Akteur des Abends, während Zwickaus Kapitän Mirko Prüfer in der 78. Minute die Rote Karte sah. Vor 8.200 Zuschauern feierten die Oldenburger damit den Einzug ins Finale.

The Frankfurter Buchmesse opens its 76th edition on Wednesday, welcoming publishers, agents, and readers from more than 100 countries to the Messe Frankfurt fairgrounds for five days of panels, rights negotiations, and author readings. This year's Guest of Honour is Italy, with a sweeping programme curated by the Istituto per il Commercio Estero that spans contemporary fiction, graphic novels, and translated poetry. Tickets for the public days are priced at €18, and organisers expect upward of 300,000 visitors across the full run.

The Frankfurter Buchmesse opens its doors on Wednesday for a five-day run that organisers expect will draw more than 300,000 visitors to the Frankfurt Messe fairgrounds, with Norwegian literature taking centre stage as the Guest of Honour nation this year. Among the highlights, debut novelist Sigrid Halvorsen will give a reading at the Forum Pavilion on Thursday evening, while the Frankfurt-based publisher S. Fischer Verlag hosts a panel on translation and world literature that has already sold out its 800 seats.

Commuters on the S-Bahn München network faced widespread disruption on Thursday morning after a signalling failure near Ostbahnhof brought services on lines S2, S4, and S6 to a near-standstill for roughly four hours, stranding an estimated 47,000 passengers across the city. Deutsche Bahn, which operates the network, issued a statement attributing the fault to a software update rolled out overnight that proved incompatible with legacy switching hardware at the affected junction. Replacement bus services were deployed along the S4 corridor between Grafing Bahnhof and München Hauptbahnhof, though severe overcrowding was reported within the first thirty minutes. Full service was not restored until shortly after midday.

Der Dresdner Stadtrat hat am Donnerstag mit 38 zu 21 Stimmen bei vier Enthaltungen beschlossen, rund 340 Millionen Euro für den Bau der neuen Straßenbahnlinie 8 zwischen dem Hauptbahnhof und dem Stadtteil Gorbitz bereitzustellen. Oberbürgermeister Dirk Hilbert begrüßte die Entscheidung als „Meilenstein für die Mobilitätswende", während Fraktionsvorsitzende Carolin Metz von der CDU darauf bestand, dass begleitende Maßnahmen zur Verkehrsberuhigung im Innenstadtbereich eingeführt werden. Die Dvb – Dresdner Verkehrsbetriebe – gaben unmittelbar nach der Abstimmung bekannt, dass der erste Spatenstich bereits im Frühjahr 2026 erfolgen soll und bis zu 47.000 Fahrgäste täglich von der neuen Verbindung profitieren könnten.

Beim packenden Nachholspiel der 2. Bundesliga empfing der FC Schalke 04 am Dienstagabend den Hamburger SV in der Veltins-Arena vor 57.400 Zuschauern. Eine Doublette von Stürmer Paavo Leinonen in der zweiten Halbzeit reichte den Gelsenkirchenern nicht ganz: Hamburgs Mittelfeldregisseur Cristóbal Venegas erzielte in der 89. Minute den Ausgleich zum 2:2-Endstand und sicherte dem HSV damit einen wichtigen Auswärtspunkt im Aufstiegsrennen.

The Reykjavík Art Museum opens its most ambitious group show in over a decade on Friday, bringing together eleven painters and sculptors from across the Nordic countries under the curatorial eye of Sigríður Magnúsdóttir, whose previous retrospectives at the Hamburger Bahnhof and the Moderna Museet established her reputation as one of the foremost voices in contemporary northern European art. Entitled "Frost and Frequency," the exhibition will occupy all three of the museum's gallery wings through 22 March, with an opening-night lecture by Magnúsdóttir scheduled for 7 p.m. and tickets priced at 2,500 króna for the general public.

Defending champions Røa IL edged out Vålerenga FF 2–1 in a fiercely contested Norwegian women's top-flight fixture at Åråsen Stadion on Sunday, with striker Ingrid Flatmark netting both goals to keep her side five points clear at the summit of Toppserien with eight rounds remaining.

Der Stadtrat von Freiburg im Breisgau hat am Donnerstagabend mit knapper Mehrheit beschlossen, die städtische Wohnungsbauförderung um 4,2 Millionen Euro aufzustocken. Der Antrag der Grünen und der SPD wurde mit 28 zu 19 Stimmen bei drei Enthaltungen angenommen, nachdem die CDU-Fraktion einen konkurrierenden Gegenantrag auf Vertagung zurückgezogen hatte. Stadtbaurätin Miriam Eckhoff zeigte sich erleichtert: „Wir können jetzt endlich konkrete Projekte im sozialen Wohnungsbau anstoßen."

The Scottish Parliament voted on Thursday to reject a proposed amendment to the Housing (Scotland) Bill that would have capped private rental increases at two percent annually, with 68 MSPs voting against the measure, 55 in favour, and four abstaining. Housing Secretary Fiona Drummond, speaking from Holyrood, insisted the government's own phased rent-control framework remained the more "workable and legally sound" path forward, while opposition spokesperson Gregor Tait of Scottish Labour condemned the result as "a capitulation to landlord interests." The SNP and Scottish Conservatives combined to defeat the amendment, which had been co-sponsored by the Scottish Greens and Scottish Labour.

Commuters on the Overground faced severe disruptions on Thursday morning after a signalling fault near Highbury & Islington brought services on the Windrush Line to a standstill for nearly four hours, with Transport for London estimating that approximately 34,000 passengers were affected before normal operations resumed shortly after midday.

The Reykjavík City Council voted narrowly on Thursday to approve a sweeping housing affordability ordinance, with 11 councillors in favour, 8 against, and 2 abstentions, after a heated three-hour debate in which deputy council leader Sigríður Eiríksdóttir of the Left-Green Movement argued that the measure would "finally put roofs over the heads of working families priced out of the capital." The centre-right Independence Party, led locally by Gunnar Þórisson, had sought to refer the ordinance back to committee, but the motion failed.

Commuters on the Jubilee line faced severe delays for a third consecutive morning on Wednesday after a signalling fault between Waterloo and Stratford forced Transport for London to run a severely reduced service, with some passengers waiting more than 40 minutes on platforms at London Bridge. TfL said engineers were working to resolve the fault and expected full service to resume by the evening peak, but urged travellers to use the Overground or Elizabeth line as alternatives. An estimated 85,000 passengers were affected during the morning rush alone.

The Frankfurter Buchmesse opens its doors on Wednesday for a five-day run that organisers expect to draw more than 300,000 visitors to the Messe Frankfurt fairgrounds, with Norway serving as this year's Guest of Honour and debut novelist Sigrid Blom headlining a packed programme of readings and panel discussions. Admission to the public weekend starts at €18 per adult.

Defending champions Rosgaard FK held on for a gritty 2–1 victory over Halden City at Tistedal Arena on Saturday, extending their unbeaten home run to fourteen matches in the Norwegian second division. Midfielder Tobias Wennerberg scored both goals for the hosts — a curling opener on the half-hour and a composed header deep into the second half — before substitute Emeka Osei pulled one back for the visitors in injury time. An attendance of 4,320 made it the best-supported fixture at the ground this season.

Der Stadtrat von Freiburg im Breisgau hat am Donnerstagabend mit knapper Mehrheit einen umstrittenen Bebauungsplan für das nördliche Industriegelände verabschiedet: 24 Ratsmitglieder stimmten dafür, 19 dagegen, bei drei Enthaltungen. Bürgermeisterin Karoline Streck (Grüne) sprach von einem „notwendigen Schritt für bezahlbaren Wohnraum", während die CDU-Fraktion unter Fraktionschef Dominik Hauser die Abstimmung als „überstürzt und planlos" bezeichnete. Die SPD hatte zuletzt zwischen den Lagern geschwankt, stimmte am Ende aber geschlossen mit der Koalition.

Der Hamburger Verkehrsverbund (HVV) hat ab kommendem Montag eine Fahrpreiserhöhung von durchschnittlich 4,9 Prozent angekündigt, die sämtliche U-Bahn-, S-Bahn- und Buslinien im Großraum Hamburg betrifft. Hintergrund sind gestiegene Energiekosten sowie tarifliche Lohnerhöhungen beim Fahrpersonal, wie HVV-Sprecherin Mareike Sundermann auf einer Pressekonferenz erklärte. Fahrgäste werden gebeten, Abonnements rechtzeitig zu aktualisieren; Einzeltickets am Automaten kosten künftig bis zu 4,20 Euro.

The A23 motorway linking Vienna to Graz will be partially closed from Friday evening through Sunday night as authorities clear debris from a landslide near Wiener Neustadt, forcing tens of thousands of motorists to seek alternative routes during what is already an exceptionally busy travel weekend. The disruption coincides with the Austrian Football Bundesliga derby at the Allianz Stadion in Vienna, where SK Rapid Wien host FK Austria Wien on Saturday afternoon — a fixture that drew 27,400 spectators last season and is expected to sell out again, with police urging fans travelling from the south to allow up to two additional hours for the journey.

Wolverhampton Wanderers came from behind to beat Nottingham Forest 3–2 at Molineux on Saturday evening, with striker Emeka Oduya scoring a stoppage-time winner to send the home crowd into raptures. The victory lifts Wolves to seventh in the Premier League table, while Forest, who had led twice through goals from Rasmus Højlund look-alike forward Tomas Vrábel, fall to twelfth. An attendance of 31,480 was recorded at the sold-out ground.

Der Wiener Gemeinderat hat am Donnerstag mit 54 zu 38 Stimmen bei sieben Enthaltungen einem umstrittenen Wohnbaupaket zugestimmt, das die Errichtung von 12.000 geförderten Mietwohnungen bis 2030 vorsieht. Die SPÖ und die Grünen stimmten gemeinsam für den Antrag, während die FPÖ geschlossen dagegen votierte. Bürgermeister-Stellvertreterin Klaudia Fernsbach erklärte, das Paket sei „ein historischer Schritt für leistbares Wohnen in dieser Stadt", wohingegen FPÖ-Fraktionschef Tobias Grünwald die Maßnahmen als „planlose Geldverschwendung" bezeichnete.

The Städel Museum in Frankfurt will open its landmark retrospective on Hilla Becher this Friday, bringing together more than 340 photographs spanning four decades of her collaborative work with Bernd Becher — the first such survey dedicated solely to her individual contribution. Curated by Dr. Lena Vormann, the exhibition runs through March 9 and is expected to draw visitors from across Europe to the museum's newly renovated east wing.

Dynamo Brest came from behind to beat Śląsk Wrocław 3–2 in a pulsating Europa Conference League qualifier at the Stadion Miejski on Thursday evening, with midfielder Arsen Khalatyan netting the decisive goal in the 88th minute before a crowd of 11,400.

Der Gemeinderat von Innsbruck hat am Donnerstagabend mit knapper Mehrheit für die Einführung einer stadtweiten Parkraumbewirtschaftung gestimmt: 23 Mitglieder votierten dafür, 19 dagegen, bei zwei Enthaltungen. Die Abstimmung galt als wegweisend für die Verkehrspolitik der Tiroler Landeshauptstadt. Bürgermeisterin Klara Sattler (Grüne) sprach von einem „längst überfälligen Schritt", während der Fraktionsvorsitzende der ÖVP, Mag. Bernhard Fenkart, die Beschlüsse als überstürzt kritisierte und eine Bürgerbefragung forderte.

Die Frankfurter Buchmesse eröffnet am 15. Oktober ihre 76. Ausgabe auf dem Messegelände Frankfurt mit mehr als 4.200 Ausstellern aus 95 Ländern. Als Ehrengastland tritt in diesem Jahr Mexiko auf, dessen Verlage und Autoren einen eigens gestalteten Pavillon bespielen werden. Die Schriftstellerin Valentina Reyes-Ochoa hält die Eröffnungsrede, während der Berliner Hanser Verlag mit einer Reihe von Lesungen und Podiumsgesprächen vertreten ist. Der Eintritt für Fachbesucher beträgt 75 Euro pro Tag.

Die Photographische Sammlung des Museum Folkwang in Essen zeigt ab dem 14. März eine umfangreiche Retrospektive der Fotografin Lena Sorokina, die über drei Jahrzehnte hinweg Stadtlandschaften im postsowjetischen Raum dokumentiert hat. Kuratiert von Direktor Markus Pfeiffer, umfasst die Schau rund 180 Originalabzüge sowie unveröffentlichtes Archivmaterial. Der Eintritt kostet 12 Euro; die Ausstellung läuft bis zum 8. Juni.

Midfielder Tomáš Brouček scored twice in the final twelve minutes to hand FC Zbrojovka Brno a stunning 3–2 comeback victory over SK Sigma Olomouc at Městský fotbalový stadion on Saturday, keeping Zbrojovka's promotion hopes alive in the Czech First League. A crowd of 8,400 watched in disbelief as the hosts, trailing since the 23rd minute, refused to buckle before Brouček's brace turned the contest on its head.

Die Frankfurter Buchmesse öffnet am 15. Oktober ihre Tore für das Fachpublikum und präsentiert in diesem Jahr laut Messedirektorin Carola Veit-Hoffmann über 4.100 Aussteller aus 95 Ländern — ein leichter Zuwachs gegenüber dem Vorjahr. Gastland ist Norwegen, dessen Verlage und Autorinnen im Ehrengastpavillon auf dem Messegelände Frankfurt einen prominenten Auftritt haben werden. Die Messe läuft bis zum 19. Oktober.

Newcomer Radoslav Fišer produced the performance of the round on Saturday, netting a hat-trick as FK Slovácko thrashed FC Zbrojovka Brno 4–1 at Městský fotbalový stadion to move into third place in the Fortuna:Liga standings. A crowd of 6,200 watched Fišer complete his treble before the hour mark, with substitute Ondřej Beneš adding the fourth in stoppage time.

The Frankfurter Buchmesse opens its doors for the 76th edition on Wednesday, drawing publishers, agents, and literary scouts from more than 100 countries to the Messe Frankfurt fairgrounds. This year's guest of honour is Italy, whose pavilion — curated by the novelist Chiara Veltri and cultural attaché Roberto Damiani — promises an ambitious programme of readings, panel discussions, and live translations spanning the full five days of the fair. Ticket prices for day visitors have been set at €18, while a full-week professional pass costs €210.

The Scottish Parliament voted narrowly on Thursday to approve a sweeping new cultural investment bill, backed by the SNP and the Scottish Greens, that will direct £120 million toward arts institutions across Scotland over the next three years — a measure championed by Culture Secretary Fiona Mclaren, who called it "a lifeline for community creativity." The legislation clears the way for Edinburgh's Traverse Theatre to anchor an ambitious new playwright residency programme beginning in January 2026, with award-winning writer Callum Dreich already confirmed as the inaugural resident artist.

The Renfrewshire Council voted narrowly on Thursday evening to reject a proposed rezoning of agricultural land on the town's western outskirts for commercial development, with 23 councillors opposing the measure, 19 in favour, and 4 abstentions. The motion, tabled by the local Conservatives under the leadership of deputy group convener Fiona Greer, had been fiercely contested by SNP members who argued that the farmland served as a vital green buffer for surrounding communities. Labour councillors, whose support had been seen as decisive, ultimately sided with the SNP bloc, sealing the defeat. "This was never just a planning question — it was a question of what kind of place Renfrewshire wants to be," said SNP spokesperson Callum Dreich after the vote. The result leaves the area's development framework in limbo ahead of the council's scheduled budget review in February 2026.

Beim packenden Halbfinale der Österreichischen Meisterschaft im Fechten setzte sich Valeria Hofer aus Graz mit 15:12 gegen die Wienerin Natascha Brenner durch und sicherte sich damit den Einzug ins Endspiel. Die Kämpfe fanden am Samstag in der Grazer Messehalle vor rund 800 Zuschauern statt. Hofer zeigte vor allem im dritten Abschnitt eine überragende Leistung und ließ ihrer Gegnerin kaum Raum zum Atmen.

The Frankfurter Buchmesse opens its doors on Wednesday for its 76th edition, welcoming publishers, agents, and readers from more than 100 countries to the Messe Frankfurt fairgrounds over five days of panels, signings, and rights negotiations. This year's guest of honour is Italy, whose pavilion — curated by Chiara Veltri and designed in collaboration with the Istituto per il Commercio Estero — promises an ambitious survey of contemporary Italian fiction, poetry, and graphic literature. Ticket prices for the public weekend begin at €18.

Eurostar services between London St Pancras International and Brussels-Midi were suspended for roughly eleven hours on Thursday after a signalling fault near Lille forced the operator to hold all cross-Channel trains at their respective terminals, stranding an estimated 14,000 passengers during what is typically one of the busiest midweek travel periods. Eurostar said engineers resolved the fault by late afternoon, with a reduced timetable resuming from 18:30 local time.

Wegen des Halbfinalrückspiels zwischen dem FC Schalke 04 und Borussia Dortmund im DFB-Pokal am Dienstagabend in der Veltins-Arena kommt es rund um Gelsenkirchen zu massiven Verkehrsbehinderungen: Die Stadtwerke Gelsenkirchen haben angekündigt, auf den Straßenbahnlinien 301 und 302 ab 18:00 Uhr zusätzliche Verstärkerfahrten einzusetzen, während die A2 im Bereich der Ausfahrt Gelsenkirchen-Buer für den Durchgangsverkehr ab 20:00 Uhr gesperrt wird. Rund 62.000 Zuschauer werden zum Anpfiff um 20:45 Uhr erwartet. Das Hinspiel hatte Borussia Dortmund mit 2:1 für sich entschieden.

The Flemish parliament voted narrowly on Thursday to approve a motion of no confidence against Regional Minister Bart Desmedt, after his handling of the nitrogen reduction framework drew sustained criticism from both the Grüne-allied Groen and the centre-left Vooruit. The motion passed by 71 votes to 64, with 3 abstentions, marking the first successful no-confidence vote in the Flemish assembly since 2009. Desmedt, who had served as Minister for Environment since 2021, said he respected the outcome but warned that the coalition's agricultural policy would face "a prolonged period of uncertainty" as a result.

Hannover 96 hat am Samstagabend im Niedersachsenstadion einen packenden 3:2-Erfolg gegen den Hamburger SV eingefahren und damit die Tabellenführung in der 2. Bundesliga übernommen. Vor 49.200 Zuschauern erzielte Mittelfeldspieler Tomas Vrábel alle drei Treffer für die Gastgeber, während der eingewechselte Dariusz Kowalski für den HSV beide Anschlusstore besorgte. „Wir haben heute Charakter bewiesen", sagte Hannover-Trainer Gregor Feldmann nach dem Abpfiff.

Rowing crews from across Scandinavia descended on Gothenburg's Rosenlund Canal on Saturday for the annual Nordic Club Regatta, where Stockholm's Neptun Rowing Club edged out defending champions Aarhus Roklub by a margin of less than a boat-length in the men's coxed eight final, securing their first title in eleven years before a crowd of roughly 4,200 spectators. Neptun's stroke, Tobias Wendlandt, was credited by coaches as the decisive force in maintaining the club's cadence through the gruelling final 500 metres.

Die ÖBB hat angekündigt, dass die Weststrecke zwischen Salzburg und Wien ab dem 14. März für insgesamt elf Tage wegen umfangreicher Gleiserneuerungsarbeiten im Bereich Amstetten gesperrt wird. Fahrgäste werden gebeten, auf Fernbusse oder alternative Verbindungen über Linz auszuweichen; schätzungsweise 42.000 Reisende pro Tag sind von der Sperrung betroffen. „Die Arbeiten sind seit Jahren überfällig und werden die Streckenkapazität langfristig deutlich erhöhen", erklärte ÖBB-Sprecherin Monika Gruber auf einer Pressekonferenz in Wien.

Commuters across Greater Manchester faced severe disruption on Thursday after Avanti West Coast and Northern Rail both suspended services between Manchester Piccadilly and Liverpool Lime Street, citing a fractured overhead line near Warrington Bank Quay that engineers warned could take up to 72 hours to repair. Transport for Greater Manchester estimated that roughly 34,000 passengers would be affected over the course of the closure, and urged travellers to consider coach replacement services operated by Stagecoach until the line is cleared.

Mit einem 3:1-Heimsieg gegen den FC Ingolstadt 04 hat sich der 1. FC Kaiserslautern am Samstagabend auf den dritten Tabellenplatz der 2. Bundesliga vorgearbeitet. Vor 42.800 Zuschauern im Fritz Walter Stadion erzielten Matteo Brünner (14.), Konstantinos Papadakis (57.) und Luca Fehrenbach (83.) die Tore für die Gastgeber, während Ingolstadts Anschlusstreffer durch Nils Grawunder nur kurzzeitig für Spannung sorgte.

The Swedish Riksdag voted narrowly on Thursday to approve a sweeping overhaul of the country's housing subsidy framework, with 176 members in favour, 171 against, and 2 abstentions, after a fractious six-hour debate that laid bare deep divisions between the governing coalition and the centre-left opposition. Finance Minister Britta Söderholm, who steered the legislation through committee, called the result "a turning point for affordable housing in Sweden," while Social Democrat leader Markus Engvall warned that his party would seek to repeal the measures should it return to government.

The Scottish Parliament voted narrowly on Thursday to reject a proposed reform to the council tax system, with 64 members voting against the measure and 59 in favour, after a bruising three-hour debate in which SNP ministers clashed openly with a cross-party bloc of Labour and Liberal Democrat MSPs. Deputy First Minister Catriona Dunbar, who had championed the overhaul as the centrepiece of the government's fairness agenda, conceded the defeat from the chamber floor but insisted the administration would return with a revised bill before the end of the current session.

The Swedish Riksdag narrowly passed a landmark climate-and-energy bill on Thursday, with 176 votes in favour, 168 against, and 5 abstentions, following a bruising overnight debate in which the governing coalition of the Social Democrats and the Greens faced sustained pressure from the opposition Moderates. Energy Minister Britta Söderholm, who shepherded the legislation through three months of committee hearings, called the result "a historic turning point for Swedish industrial policy." The Moderates' parliamentary leader, Erik Vångstad, vowed to challenge the law's carbon-pricing provisions at the earliest available opportunity.

Beim Rückrundenauftakt der 2. Bundesliga bezwang der FC Schalke 04 den Hamburger SV am Freitagabend mit 3:1 im vollbesetzten Veltins-Arena vor 62.271 Zuschauern. Die Tore für die Gelsenkirchener erzielten Marek Sobański (14.), Timo Feilhauer (57.) und Luisa-Maria Brandt (83.), für die Gäste traf Niklas Westphal kurz nach der Pause. Mit dem Sieg springt Schalke auf den zweiten Tabellenplatz.

Connacht Rugby edged out Edinburgh in a bruising United Rugby Championship encounter at the Sportsground on Saturday, with out-half Declan Murtagh slotting a last-gasp penalty to seal a 22–19 victory in front of 7,842 spectators.

Passengers travelling on the S-Bahn network in Munich face significant disruptions this week after Deutsche Bahn announced emergency track maintenance between Ostbahnhof and Pasing, forcing the suspension of S2, S4, and S6 services from Monday through Thursday. An estimated 340,000 daily commuters will be affected, with replacement bus services operating at reduced frequency. DB has attributed the closure to hairline fractures discovered in a stretch of overhead line infrastructure during a routine inspection carried out last Friday.

Commuters on Merseyrail's Northern Line faced severe delays on Thursday morning after a signalling fault near Kirkby brought services to a standstill for almost four hours, with Merseyrail estimating that roughly 22,000 passengers were affected before normal operations resumed shortly before midday. The operator said engineering teams dispatched from Sandhills depot worked through the disruption but were unable to restore full functionality until replacement cabling had been sourced. A Merseyrail spokesperson, Aoife Brennan, apologised for the inconvenience and confirmed that an independent review would be launched within the week.

Commuters on the Jubilee line faced severe disruptions for the third consecutive morning on Wednesday after a signalling fault between Waterloo and Stratford forced Transport for London to suspend services entirely during the peak hour window, stranding an estimated 85,000 passengers across the network. TfL engineers worked through the night to isolate the fault, but a spokesperson for the agency confirmed that partial service would not resume until at least Thursday afternoon. The disruption has prompted renewed calls from the London Assembly for accelerated investment in the Underground's ageing signal infrastructure.

Berlin's public transport authority BVG announced on Thursday that a comprehensive signal-system overhaul on the U8 line will force a full suspension of service between Hermannstraße and Wittenau from 12 January to 9 February, affecting an estimated 180,000 daily passengers. Replacement bus services will run at reduced frequency along the corridor, and commuters are advised to use parallel S-Bahn routes where possible. The infrastructure contract, awarded to Siemens Mobility, is valued at €47 million and is part of a broader modernisation drive targeting the network's ageing CBTC infrastructure.

Stockholm's public transport authority, Storstockholms Lokaltrafik, confirmed on Thursday that planned engineering works on the Tunnelbana's Green Line will force a complete suspension of services between Fridhemsplan and Alvik from 12 January to 27 January, affecting an estimated 47,000 daily commuters. Replacement bus services will operate on a reduced frequency, and SL has urged passengers to allow an additional 25 minutes for their journeys during the closure period.

Die Berliner Verkehrsbetriebe (BVG) haben ab Montag die Fahrpreise im gesamten Tarifbereich Berlin ABC um durchschnittlich 4,3 Prozent angehoben — die größte Einzelerhöhung seit über einem Jahrzehnt. Eine Einzelfahrt im Bereich AB kostet nun 3,50 Euro, während das Monatsticket auf 98,00 Euro steigt. Sprecher Tobias Warnecke begründete den Schritt mit gestiegenen Energie- und Personalkosten sowie notwendigen Investitionen in die Erneuerung der Fahrzeugflotte, die derzeit rund 1.500 Busse und Bahnen umfasst. Fahrgastverbände kündigten Protest an und forderten den Senat auf, die Erhöhung durch höhere Landeszuschüsse abzufedern.

The city of Graz pulled off a rare cultural-sporting double this weekend: the Kunsthaus Graz opened its long-awaited retrospective of Austrian sculptor Marta Jelinek on Saturday, drawing an opening-night crowd of roughly 2,400 visitors, while just across the Mur, the Merkur-Arena hosted an electric Bundesliga encounter in which SK Sturm Graz defeated Wolfsberger AC 3–1 before a sell-out attendance of 15,200. Jelinek, whose monumental steel installations have been exhibited from Vienna to São Paulo, was present for the unveiling, telling reporters the Kunsthaus was "the only house in Austria where light and architecture conspire in my favour." The football result keeps Sturm Graz three points clear at the top of the Austrian Bundesliga table heading into the winter break.

For decades, the Frankfurter Buchmesse has served as a barometer of the publishing world's anxieties and ambitions, but critics argue that its sprawling exhibition halls increasingly reflect the priorities of multinational conglomerates rather than independent voices. Hannelore Voss, a Frankfurt-based literary agent who has attended the fair for more than twenty years, describes a slow but unmistakable shift in the atmosphere of Halle 3. "The conversations used to be about ideas," she told Der Standard in a recent profile. "Now they are about platforms." Whether the fair's organizers at the Börsenverein des Deutschen Buchhandels will address these concerns in the coming edition remains an open question.

A sold-out retrospective of Finnish textile artist Satu Mäkinen opens at the Kunsthalle Hamburg on 14 March, running through 2 May, bringing together over ninety woven and embroidered works spanning four decades of her practice. Curated by Dr. Lena Brückner of the museum's contemporary collections department, the show marks the first major institutional survey of Mäkinen's output outside Scandinavia. Admission is set at €12 per adult, with guided tours available every Saturday afternoon throughout the run.

The Frankfurter Buchmesse opens its doors on Wednesday for a five-day run that organisers expect to draw more than 300,000 visitors to the Messe Frankfurt fairgrounds, with Norwegian author Sigrid Undset scholar Marit Haugland delivering the opening lecture and publishers from over ninety countries represented across the exhibition halls. This year's guest of honour is Italy, whose pavilion — designed by Rome-based architect Federica Conti — sprawls across a record 4,200 square metres on Hall 4.1.

The Frankfurter Buchmesse opens its 76th edition on Wednesday, drawing publishers, agents, and readers from more than 100 countries to the Messe Frankfurt fairgrounds for five days of panel discussions, signings, and rights negotiations. This year's guest of honour is Italy, whose pavilion — curated by the Italian Trade Agency — promises a sweeping retrospective of postwar Italian literature alongside debuts from a new generation of novelists writing in both Italian and regional dialects. Organisers expect upwards of 300,000 visitors before the fair closes on Sunday.

Beim packenden Halbfinale der Österreichischen Meisterschaft im Wasserball empfing der SC Donau Wien am Samstagabend den ASV Linz im Wiener Praterbad und setzte sich nach verlängerter Spielzeit mit 9:7 durch. Vor rund 1.200 Zuschauern war es vor allem Kapitän Tobias Feuerstein, der mit fünf Treffern überragte und das Heimteam in die Endrunde führte. Für den ASV Linz traf Marko Vujičić dreimal, konnte die Niederlage seiner Mannschaft jedoch nicht abwenden.

The Reykjavík City Council voted narrowly on Thursday to approve a sweeping overhaul of the capital's social housing policy, with 11 councillors in favour, 8 against, and 2 abstentions, after a debate that stretched past midnight. The motion, championed by the Left-Green Movement and backed by the Social Democratic Alliance, would commit the municipality to constructing no fewer than 1,400 new affordable units by 2028. Opposition councillor Brynja Sigurðardóttir warned the plan was "fiscally reckless," while Deputy Mayor Óskar Þór Helgason called the vote "a historic step toward housing justice." The measure now passes to the national planning office for a mandatory compatibility review.

The Reykjavik City Council voted narrowly on Thursday to approve a sweeping housing-density ordinance that would allow six-storey residential buildings along the capital's three main arterial corridors, overriding objections from the opposition Framsóknarflokkurinn councillors who warned the measure would irrevocably alter the city's low-rise character. The final tally stood at 9 votes in favour, 6 against, and 2 abstentions, with council chair Sigríður Magnúsdóttir casting the deciding procedural endorsement. Mayor Jónatan Einarsson, who had championed the bill since early 2024, called the outcome "a generational commitment to affordable living."

Commuters on Copenhagen's S-Bane network faced severe disruptions Monday after a signalling fault on Line B forced DSB to suspend services between Vanløse and København H for approximately six hours, stranding an estimated 34,000 passengers during the morning rush. Engineers traced the failure to a degraded relay unit at Frederiksberg station. A limited shuttle-bus replacement operated by Movia ran every twelve minutes along the corridor, though officials warned of continued delays into the evening peak.

The Wiener Festwochen opens its fifty-third edition on Friday at multiple venues across Vienna, with artistic director Marta Riedl-Sonnenschein promising a programme that stretches from immersive sound installations in the Museumsquartier to late-night chamber opera performances at the Volkstheater, running through to June 22nd. Tickets for individual events are priced from €14, and organisers expect more than 85,000 visitors over the five-week festival.

Die Berliner Verkehrsbetriebe haben ab kommendem Montag eine vollständige Sperrung der U-Bahn-Linie U8 zwischen den Haltestellen Hermannstraße und Neukölln angekündigt, die voraussichtlich bis Ende Februar andauern wird. Grund für die Unterbrechung sind umfangreiche Gleiserneuerungsarbeiten, von denen täglich rund 47.000 Fahrgäste betroffen sein dürften. Als Ersatz werden Schienenersatzverkehr-Busse auf der betroffenen Strecke eingesetzt.

The Flemish parliament in Brussels passed a landmark housing affordability bill on Thursday by a narrow margin, with 71 votes in favour, 58 against, and 4 abstentions, after a fractious overnight debate that exposed deep fault lines between the ruling N-VA and its junior coalition partner, the Vlaams Belang. The legislation, championed by Housing Minister Lieselotte Vandenberghe, caps annual rent increases at 2.3 per cent and obliges municipalities to reserve at least 15 per cent of new developments for social housing. Opposition leader Bart Coppens of the Vooruit party condemned the bill as "too timid to address the crisis facing working families across Flanders," while the Grüne fraction — absent from the coalition — announced it would challenge two provisions before the Constitutional Court.

The Frankfurter Buchmesse opens its doors on Wednesday for its 76th edition, drawing publishers, agents, and readers from more than 100 countries to the Messe Frankfurt fairgrounds. This year's guest of honour is Italy, with a programme of over 300 Italian authors presenting new titles across fiction, poetry, and non-fiction. Organisers expect upwards of 300,000 visitors over the five-day fair, which runs through Sunday.

The Frankfurter Buchmesse opened its doors on Wednesday to a record-breaking crowd of 302,000 visitors over five days, with Norwegian author Sigrid Undset Society president Marte Kvelland delivering the keynote address at the Festhalle Frankfurt. This year's guest of honour country, Slovenia, showcased more than 140 titles in translation at a dedicated pavilion, while publishing house Suhrkamp Verlag unveiled a landmark bilingual edition of contemporary Slovenian poetry. Ticket prices for trade days were set at €38 per entry.

The Frankfurter Buchmesse opens its doors on Wednesday for what organisers are billing as the most internationally diverse edition in its seven-decade history, with publishers and literary agents from more than 100 countries descending on the Messe Frankfurt fairgrounds. This year's guest of honour is Italy, whose pavilion — curated by novelist and cultural diplomat Serena Cattaneo — spans three halls and features immersive installations exploring the tension between oral storytelling traditions and the algorithmically shaped reading habits of the twenty-first century. Tickets for the public days, running Saturday and Sunday, are priced at €18.

Beim packenden Stadtderby in der 2. Bundesliga bezwang der FC St. Pauli den Hamburger SV am Samstagabend im Volksparkstadion mit 2:1 und feierte damit den ersten Ligasieg im Nordderby seit über drei Jahren. Vor 57.000 Zuschauern erzielte Mittelfeldspieler Lennart Brügge beide Tore für die Gastgeber, während Kapitän Sven Hollenbeck für den HSV verkürzte. Die Niederlage versetzt den HSV weiter in Abstiegsgefahr, während St. Pauli auf Platz vier der Tabelle klettert.

Kristóf Vásárhelyi's brace in the second half handed Ferencváros a narrow 2–1 victory over Újpest FC at the Groupama Aréna on Saturday evening, lifting the Budapest club to the top of the OTP Bank Liga table with seven matches played. A first-half penalty from Újpest's Dominik Soós had threatened to upset the hosts, but Vásárhelyi's 67th-minute header and a composed finish in stoppage time sealed all three points in front of 19,400 fans.

Commuters on the S-Bahn network in Munich faced significant delays on Thursday morning after a signalling fault near Ostbahnhof brought services on the S1, S2, and S8 lines to a near standstill for roughly four hours. Bayerische Oberlandbahn, which operates several overlapping suburban routes, advised passengers to use U-Bahn and bus alternatives where possible. An estimated 87,000 passengers were affected before engineers from DB Netz restored full operations shortly after midday.

The Reykjavík City Council voted narrowly on Thursday to approve a sweeping rezoning policy that would permit high-density residential construction along the Elliðaár corridor, with councillors backing the measure by 11 votes to 8, with 2 abstentions. The plan, championed by the centre-left Samfylkingin and its coalition partners in Vinstri Græn, drew fierce opposition from the conservative Sjálfstæðisflokkurinn, whose spokesperson Guðrún Björnsdóttir warned that the scheme risked permanently altering the character of the river valley. Mayor Jónas Sigurðsson, attending his first full council session since his inauguration in January, cast the deciding symbolic endorsement from the chair before the vote was called.

Stockholm's public transport authority, SL, has confirmed that the Tvärbanan light rail line will be suspended for eleven days beginning 14 March while engineers replace a critical section of overhead wiring near Liljeholmen station — a repair job that officials say cannot be safely completed during normal operating hours. Replacement bus services will run on the affected corridor, though commuters are being warned of significantly longer journey times during the closure. An estimated 38,000 daily passengers use the route.

Galatasaray edged out Fenerbahçe 2–1 in a fiercely contested Istanbul derby at RAMS Park on Saturday evening, with midfielder Serhan Doğrul netting the decisive goal seven minutes from time to hand his side all three points in the Süper Lig. A crowd of 52,300 roared the hosts home despite a valiant equaliser from Fenerbahçe forward Emeka Nwachukwu just before the hour mark.

A late header from substitute Nikolaj Vreeland sealed a 2–1 victory for FC Groningen over SC Heerenveen at Euroborg on Saturday evening, lifting Groningen to fourth place in the Eredivisie table with just six matches remaining in the season.

Lausanne's Stade Olympique de la Pontaise witnessed a ferocious Swiss Super League derby on Saturday evening as FC Lausanne-Sport edged city rivals Yverdon Sport FC 2–1, with midfielder Théo Burnier's curling 87th-minute winner sending the home faithful into raptures before a crowd of 14,200.

Im packenden Kellerduell der 2. Bundesliga besiegte der 1. FC Kaiserslautern den SV Wehen Wiesbaden am Samstagabend mit 3:1 im Fritz Walter Stadion vor 38.400 Zuschauern. Die entscheidenden Treffer erzielte Lukas Pfahler, der in der 34. und 71. Minute traf und damit seinen Klub vorerst aus der Abstiegszone führte. Für Wehen Wiesbaden, das trotz eines frühen Anschlusstreffers durch Marek Dvořáček nie wirklich ins Spiel zurückfand, war es die vierte Pflichtspielniederlage in Folge.

Werder Bremen came from behind to beat Eintracht Frankfurt 3–2 in a pulsating Bundesliga encounter at Weserstadion on Saturday evening, with striker Lukas Feuerbach netting a dramatic 89th-minute winner to send the home crowd into raptures. The victory lifts Bremen to fifth in the table, while Frankfurt's four-game unbeaten run comes to a painful end. An attendance of 41,500 was recorded, with both sets of supporters generating an atmosphere rarely seen outside a European night.

The Flemish parliament voted narrowly on Thursday to approve a new nitrogen emissions reduction framework, with 72 members in favour and 63 against, after months of fractious debate that nearly collapsed the coalition between N-VA, cd&v, and Open Vld. Agriculture minister Lieselotte Meersman, who had threatened to resign if the measure failed, called the outcome "a hard-won compromise that no one loves but everyone can live with."

Frankfurt's public transit authority, RMV, confirmed Thursday that the U5 U-Bahn line will be closed between Konstablerwache and Enkheim from 9 to 23 February while crews replace deteriorating track segments in a contract valued at €14.2 million. Replacement bus services will operate every eight minutes along the corridor throughout the two-week shutdown, though RMV officials warned that an estimated 47,000 daily passengers should expect journey times to increase by up to 25 minutes.

Im Kellerduell der 2. Bundesliga setzte sich der FC Schalke 04 am Samstagabend in der Veltins-Arena vor 61.882 Zuschauern mit 3:1 gegen den 1. FC Nürnberg durch. Jonas Mertesacker traf doppelt und legte damit den Grundstein für den ersten Heimsieg der Gelsenkirchener seit acht Spielen. Für Nürnberg, das die gesamte zweite Halbzeit in Unterzahl agieren musste, bleibt die Lage am Tabellenende bedrohlich.

Berlin's public transport authority BVG has announced that S-Bahn services on the ring line will be suspended for eleven consecutive days beginning 14 March, as engineers carry out urgent repairs to overhead power cables between Ostkreuz and Treptower Park. An estimated 85,000 daily commuters will be affected, with replacement bus services operating at reduced frequency throughout the closure period.

Der Stadtrat von Freiburg im Breisgau hat am Donnerstagabend mit knapper Mehrheit für die Einführung einer kommunalen Wärmeplanung gestimmt, die bis 2035 den Ausstieg aus fossilen Heizsystemen in allen städtischen Gebäuden vorsieht. 34 Ratsmitglieder stimmten für den Antrag, 21 dagegen, bei vier Enthaltungen. Die Grünen und die SPD hatten den Plan gemeinsam eingebracht, während die CDU-Fraktion ihn als „finanziell unverantwortlich" bezeichnete. Bürgermeisterin Claudia Sörensen sprach von einem „historischen Schritt für den kommunalen Klimaschutz".

Brendan Solís delivered a masterclass at the Aviva Stadium on Saturday evening, scoring twice in the final twenty minutes to hand Bohemian FC a stunning 3–1 victory over Shamrock Rovers in the League of Ireland Premier Division, watched by a capacity crowd of 22,400. It was the hosts' most emphatic derby win in six years, and Rovers manager Conall Dempsey could offer little explanation for his side's defensive collapse.

The Flemish parliament voted narrowly on Thursday to approve a controversial language-use reform that would require all public-sector employees in Brussels to demonstrate certified Dutch proficiency within three years, with 71 votes in favour, 63 against, and 4 abstentions. The bill, championed by N-VA minister Lieselotte Maes, drew fierce resistance from Francophone parties, particularly the MR and Les Engagés, who called it a provocation. Speaker after speaker on the opposition benches warned that the measure risked deepening the community rift that has long defined Belgian politics. A final legal challenge before the Constitutional Court is widely expected before the law can take effect.

The Frankfurter Buchmesse opened its doors on Wednesday to more than 300,000 visitors expected over five days, with Norwegian author Sigrid Undset's centenary edition drawing particular attention to the Nordic pavilion at Messe Frankfurt. This year's guest of honour is Slovenia, whose publishers have arrived in force with a remarkable slate of translated fiction and poetry. "We have never brought so many voices to Frankfurt," said Marika Završnik, head of the Slovenian Publishers' Association, surveying a hall already electric with morning crowds.

The Swedish parliament voted on Thursday to approve a landmark cultural funding bill championed by the ruling Social Democrats, allocating 480 million kronor to regional arts institutions over the next three years — a measure opposition Moderaterna had sought to halve. The same evening, the Gothenburg Concert Hall opened its long-awaited Nordic Sounds Festival, a five-day showcase of contemporary Scandinavian composers that Culture Minister Britta Söderholm attended as a symbolic endorsement of the new policy, with sold-out performances drawing an estimated 6,200 listeners on the opening night alone.

Hertha BSC came from behind to defeat Hannover 96 three goals to two in a tightly contested second-division clash at the Olympiastadion on Friday evening, with midfielder Tobias Fengler scoring the decisive winner deep into stoppage time to send the home crowd into raptures. The result lifts Hertha to fifth place in the 2. Bundesliga table, three points behind the automatic promotion places.

Edinburgh's Usher Hall will host the opening night of the Northern Lights Chamber Music Festival on Friday 14 March, drawing audiences from across Scotland for a programme headlined by violinist Sonja Kreutzer and the Edinburgh String Ensemble. The same weekend, however, Lothian Buses has warned commuters that services on routes 24, 41, and 47 will be severely curtailed from Saturday 15 March through Sunday 16 March due to emergency resurfacing works on Lothian Road, with an estimated 18,000 passengers expected to make alternative arrangements.

Wegen Gleisarbeiten im Bereich des Hauptbahnhofs Hannover wird die S-Bahn-Linie S5 zwischen Hannover Hbf und Lehrte vom 14. bis zum 20. Juli vollständig gesperrt. Die Region Hannover und die DB Regio AG richten während der gesamten Sperrzeit einen Schienenersatzverkehr mit Bussen ein; Fahrgäste müssen laut Angaben des Unternehmens mit Fahrzeitverlängerungen von bis zu 25 Minuten rechnen. Betroffen sind nach Schätzungen rund 18.000 Reisende täglich.

Borussia Dortmund hat am Samstagabend im Signal Iduna Park einen packenden Bundesliga-Krimi für sich entschieden: Dank eines Doppelpacks von Stürmer Luca Ferreira und einem späten Treffer von Mittelfeldspieler Tomáš Blažek bezwang der BVB den FC Augsburg mit 3:2 und kletterte damit vorläufig auf den zweiten Tabellenplatz. Vor 81.365 Zuschauern lieferten sich beide Mannschaften ein temporeichen Duell, das erst in der 88. Minute seine endgültige Entscheidung fand.

Commuters on the Jubilee line faced severe delays for the third consecutive morning on Wednesday after a signalling fault between Waterloo and Canada Water forced Transport for London to run a reduced service, with trains operating at roughly half their normal frequency during the peak hours. TfL engineers worked through the night but had not resolved the fault by 06:00, leaving an estimated 94,000 passengers to seek alternative routes across the capital. A spokesperson for TfL confirmed that replacement bus services were deployed along the corridor and that full service was expected to resume by Thursday morning at the latest.

Beim diesjährigen Stadtfest in Freiburg im Breisgau eröffnete die Sopranistin Marta Vellnagel am Samstagabend mit einem Liederabend im Konzerthaus Freiburg die zweitägige Kulturreihe „Töne & Träume" – während zeitgleich auf dem benachbarten Mundenhof-Sportgelände der lokale Fußballverein SC Freiburg II seine Heimpartie in der Regionalliga Südwest gegen den FK Pirmasens mit 3:1 gewann, wobei Stürmer Luca Brentini mit einem Doppelpack als überragender Akteur galt.

The Frankfurter Buchmesse opens its 76th edition on Wednesday, drawing more than 4,200 exhibitors from 95 countries to the Messe Frankfurt fairgrounds for what organisers describe as the largest gathering of the international publishing industry since the pandemic. Guest of Honour this year is Italy, whose pavilion — designed by Rome-based curator Alessandra Ferretti — stretches across three halls and centres on the theme of translation as cultural diplomacy. Tickets for the public days, running Saturday and Sunday, are priced at €18.

Wegen umfangreicher Gleissanierungsarbeiten wird die S-Bahn-Linie S3 zwischen Hauptbahnhof Hannover und Lehrte vom 14. bis zum 27. Juli vollständig gesperrt. Die Üstra, die den Ersatzverkehr mit Bussen übernimmt, rechnet mit erheblichen Verspätungen im Berufsverkehr und bittet rund 38.000 betroffene Fahrgäste, auf alternative Verbindungen auszuweichen. Ein Sprecher der Deutschen Bahn erklärte, die Arbeiten seien notwendig, um den sicheren Betrieb auf dem rund zwölf Kilometer langen Streckenabschnitt langfristig zu gewährleisten.

Leinster Rugby claimed a commanding 34–12 victory over Ulster at the Aviva Stadium in Dublin on Saturday evening, with fly-half Ciarán Molloy steering the hosts through a masterful second half that saw them score four unanswered tries. The win, watched by a crowd of 47,500, puts Leinster six points clear at the top of the United Rugby Championship standings with five rounds remaining.

Die ÖBB hat am Montag bekanntgegeben, dass die Weststrecke zwischen Salzburg und Wien vom 14. bis 22. März wegen dringender Gleiserneuerungsarbeiten vollständig gesperrt wird. Reisende werden gebeten, auf die parallele Fernbuslinie sowie auf Umleitungen über Linz auszuweichen. Schätzungsweise 47.000 Fahrgäste täglich sind von der Sperrung betroffen.

Brøndby IF came from behind to defeat Randers FC 3–2 in a pulsating Superliga clash at Brøndby Stadion on Sunday, with striker Mikkel Aaberg netting a 90th-minute winner to send the home crowd of 17,422 into raptures. Randers had led twice through goals from Tobias Svenningsen, but Aaberg's clinical hat-trick proved decisive in what is already being hailed as one of the most dramatic home victories of the Danish season.

Commuters across Greater Manchester faced significant delays on Monday morning after Avanti West Coast and Northern Rail both suspended services between Manchester Piccadilly and Liverpool Lime Street following the discovery of a fractured overhead line near Warrington Bank Quay station. Network Rail engineers estimated repairs would take at least 14 hours, leaving an estimated 22,000 passengers to seek alternative routes via replacement bus services or the M62 motorway. Transport for Greater Manchester urged travellers to avoid non-essential journeys until full services resume.

Defending champions Roter Stern Graz were held to a tense 1–1 draw by FK Podvelež Mostar at the Schwarzenegger-Stadion on Saturday evening, a result that leaves both clubs level on points at the summit of the Central European Amateur Cup's group stage with just one fixture remaining.

Wegen eines Wasserrohrbruchs in der Nähe des Hauptbahnhofs muss die Straßenbahnlinie 7 in Hannover ab Donnerstag für voraussichtlich vier Tage auf dem Abschnitt zwischen Aegidientorplatz und Schwarzer Bär vollständig gesperrt werden. Die Üstra Hannoversche Verkehrsbetriebe richtet einen Schienenersatzverkehr mit Bussen ein, der im Zehn-Minuten-Takt verkehren soll. Fahrgäste werden gebeten, auf die U-Bahnlinien 3 und 8 auszuweichen, sofern dies möglich ist.

Rosario Veltri's hat-trick sealed a stunning 4–1 victory for Hellas Verona over Genoa at the Stadio Marcantonio Bentegodi on Saturday, lifting the hosts to fifth place in Serie A with eight matches remaining. The 23-year-old striker, who had been struggling with a knee complaint since February, showed no sign of rust, converting twice before the interval and adding a third with a clinical finish eleven minutes from time. An attendance of 22,400 roared the team home.

Borussia Dortmund came from behind to edge out RB Leipzig 3–2 at Signal Iduna Park on Saturday evening in a pulsating Bundesliga encounter that kept 81,365 fans on their feet until the final whistle. Midfielder Tomás Vedral opened the scoring for Leipzig in the ninth minute, only for Dortmund to level before half-time and then pull clear through a brace from striker Emre Çelik, whose clinical finishes in the 67th and 84th minutes sealed all three points.

Der Nationalrat in Wien hat am Donnerstag mit 104 zu 87 Stimmen bei neun Enthaltungen einem umstrittenen Paket zur Reform des Pflegesystems zugestimmt. Die Koalitionsparteien ÖVP und Grüne setzten sich damit gegen den vereinten Widerstand von SPÖ, FPÖ und NEOS durch. Gesundheitsministerin Dorothea Falkensteiner sprach von einem „historischen Schritt für die Würde älterer Menschen in Österreich", während SPÖ-Fraktionsvorsitzender Mag. Benedikt Gruböck die Abstimmung als „überhastetes Flickwerk ohne ausreichende Finanzierungsgarantien" bezeichnete.

Die Wiener Linien haben für den kommenden Samstag, den 14. Juni, eine ganztägige Streckensperrung auf der U4 zwischen den Stationen Hütteldorf und Meidling angekündigt, um dringende Gleiserneuerungsarbeiten durchzuführen. Rund 47.000 Fahrgäste sind nach Schätzungen des Unternehmens von der Maßnahme betroffen; als Ersatz verkehren Schienenersatzbusse im Zehn-Minuten-Takt. Die Arbeiten sollen planmäßig bis Betriebsschluss abgeschlossen sein.

The Scottish Parliament voted on Thursday to approve a new Cultural Heritage Funding Bill by a majority of 74 to 48, with the Greens and the SNP forming an unlikely alliance that overrode Conservative and Labour objections; the legislation earmarks £12 million annually for community arts programmes across Scotland. The vote was hailed by Culture Secretary Fiona Galbraith as a landmark moment, and its timing proved propitious: just hours later, the Edinburgh International Festival officially opened at the Usher Hall, where conductor Markus Zweig led the Scottish Chamber Orchestra in a sweeping inaugural concert before an audience of 2,200.

The Reykjavík City Council narrowly approved a motion on Thursday to strip non-emergency vehicle access from the historic Austurvöllur district, with 11 councillors voting in favour, 8 against, and 2 abstaining — a decision that drew immediate criticism from the Independence Party, whose spokeswoman Sigríður Magnúsdóttir called the measure "a gift to cyclists dressed up as urban policy." The ruling coalition of the Left-Green Movement and the Social Democratic Alliance had pushed the proposal for months, arguing it would reduce carbon emissions and reclaim public space from private traffic.

Wegen eines technischen Defekts an einer Weichenanlage im Hauptbahnhof Frankfurt musste die Deutsche Bahn am Dienstagabend den Fernverkehr auf der Strecke zwischen Frankfurt und Mannheim für mehrere Stunden vollständig einstellen. Rund 18.000 Reisende waren von den Ausfällen betroffen, zahlreiche ICE- und IC-Züge wurden umgeleitet oder fielen ersatzlos aus. Die Reparaturarbeiten dauerten bis in die frühen Morgenstunden des Mittwochs an; gegen 3:30 Uhr konnte der reguläre Betrieb schrittweise wiederaufgenommen werden.

Berlin's public transport authority BVG has confirmed that the U5 U-Bahn line will face partial closures between Alexanderplatz and Hönow every weekend from Friday evening through Monday morning starting 14 March, as engineers carry out essential track renewal works along a 6.2-kilometre stretch. Replacement bus services operating on route X5 will be put in place, though commuters are warned to expect journey times roughly double those of the usual underground service. The disruption is expected to last twelve weekends in total, affecting an estimated 47,000 passengers per weekend.

Der Wiener Gemeinderat hat am Donnerstag mit 54 zu 31 Stimmen bei vier Enthaltungen einen Fördervertrag für das Musikfestival „Klang.Wien" beschlossen, das von 12. bis 20. September im Wiener Konzerthaus stattfinden soll. Kulturstadträtin Britta Sonnleitner zeigte sich erleichtert: „Dieses Festival gehört zur Seele unserer Stadt." Das achttägige Programm, kuratiert von der Kulturmanagerin Elena Fischbacher, vereint Ensembles aus ganz Europa und verspricht laut Veranstalter rund 14.000 Besucher. Die Opposition, angeführt von der FPÖ, kritisierte die Förderhöhe von 2,3 Millionen Euro als überzogen.

The Scottish Parliament narrowly passed a landmark housing affordability bill on Thursday after weeks of fractious debate, with 66 votes in favour, 58 against, and 4 abstentions — a margin that SNP deputy leader Catriona Dunbar called "a hard-fought victory for renters across Scotland." The Conservatives and Labour both opposed the measure, arguing that rent-cap provisions would deter private investment, while the Greens backed the SNP in pushing the bill over the line. A formal signing ceremony is expected at Holyrood before the end of the month.

The Scottish Parliament voted narrowly on Thursday to reject a proposed amendment to the Housing (Scotland) Bill that would have capped private rental increases at two per cent annually, with 63 MSPs opposing the measure against 58 in favour and four abstentions. First Minister Catriona Dreich, who had cautiously backed the cap, described the outcome as "a missed opportunity for renters across the central belt," while Conservative leader Alasdair Muir welcomed the defeat as a victory for landlords and market stability. The Scottish Greens, who had co-sponsored the amendment alongside Labour MSPs, vowed to reintroduce similar legislation before the end of the current parliamentary session.

Commuters on the Overground faced significant disruption on Thursday morning after a signalling fault near Canonbury station forced Transport for London to suspend all services on the Gospel Oak to Barking line, with replacement buses laid on along the route. Engineers estimated the fault would take up to six hours to resolve, leaving an estimated 34,000 passengers scrambling for alternatives during the peak rush. TfL urged travellers to use parallel London Underground services where possible and warned that delays could persist into the early afternoon.

Górnik Zabrze edged Wisła Kraków 2–1 at Stadion im. Ernesta Pohla on Saturday evening in a tense Ekstraklasa fixture, with Tomasz Wierzbicki netting the decisive header in the 84th minute before a crowd of 21,400.

Defending champions Rosenborg BK were held to a breathless 2–2 draw by Bodø/Glimt at Lerkendal Stadion on Saturday, a result that leaves the title race in Norway's Eliteserien wide open with just four rounds remaining. Kristoffer Haugland opened the scoring in the 14th minute before Bodø/Glimt's Tobias Strøm levelled with a fierce half-volley before the interval. Rosenborg retook the lead through a Jesper Moldvik penalty, only for Strøm to complete his brace in the 83rd minute to snatch a point for the visitors. The attendance of 18,400 made it the loudest afternoon Lerkendal has witnessed this season.

Die Münchner Philharmoniker eröffnen am 14. März die neue Konzertsaison im Gasteig HP8 mit einem Programm, das Werke von Mahler und Sibelius verbindet. Unter der Leitung der Dirigentin Sofía Rengel-Vargas werden rund 2.400 Besucher erwartet; Karten sind ab 28 Euro erhältlich. Das Konzert markiert zugleich den Auftakt einer sechsteiligen Reihe, die sich bis Juni erstreckt.

Die ÖBB hat am Montag bekanntgegeben, dass die Weststrecke zwischen Salzburg und Linz vom 14. bis zum 21. Juli wegen umfangreicher Gleiserneuerungsarbeiten vollständig gesperrt wird. Rund 42.000 Fahrgäste täglich sind von der Streckensperrung betroffen; als Ersatz werden Schienenersatzbusse zwischen beiden Städten eingerichtet. Die Gesamtkosten des Infrastrukturprojekts belaufen sich laut ÖBB auf rund 38 Millionen Euro.

The Frankfurter Buchmesse opens its doors on Wednesday for a five-day run that organisers expect to draw more than 300,000 visitors to the Messe Frankfurt fairgrounds, with Norway serving as this year's Guest of Honour and a programme spanning debut novelists, graphic-novel studios, and a keynote lecture by the acclaimed Icelandic author Sigríður Björnsdóttir on the politics of translation.

Górnik Zabrze edged Lechia Gdańsk 2–1 in a tense Ekstraklasa clash at Stadion im. Ernesta Pohla on Saturday evening, with midfielder Tomasz Wierzbicki converting a stoppage-time penalty to seal the points in front of 11,400 vociferous home supporters.

A sell-out crowd of 14,200 packed the Utilita Arena in Newcastle on Saturday evening to watch Great Britain defeat France 3–1 in their Davis Cup qualifier, before spilling into the city centre for the opening night of the Tyne Jazz Festival at Sage Gateshead, where trumpeter Lena Adeyemi and her quintet drew a standing ovation from an audience of nearly 2,000. The dual celebration gave Newcastle's weekend an unexpectedly euphoric charge, with fans moving seamlessly between the two venues barely a mile apart. "We planned it that way," admitted Marcus Follett, the festival's artistic director, who had lobbied the Lawn Tennis Association to schedule the tie for the same weekend as the festival's launch.

The Edinburgh International Book Festival opens its doors at Charlotte Square Gardens on Saturday, drawing an expected 25,000 visitors across its twelve-day run, but festivalgoers are being warned of significant disruption to Lothian Buses services along George Street and Queen Street, where road closures linked to underground utility works will remain in force until 3 August — the final day of the literary gathering. Organisers at the Edinburgh International Book Festival have urged attendees to use Waverley Station or the Edinburgh Trams line as alternative routes into the city centre, after Lothian Buses confirmed that routes 19, 41, and 47 will be diverted away from the festival's immediate vicinity for the duration of the closures.

The Scottish Parliament voted narrowly on Thursday to reject a proposed amendment to the Renters' Rights Bill that would have capped annual rent increases at two per cent, with 63 members voting against and 58 in favour, while three abstained. Scottish Labour accused the SNP-led government of "abandoning working families at the worst possible moment," a charge that Housing Minister Catriona Dempster flatly denied from the chamber floor. The bill now returns to committee stage for further revision.

Die Frankfurter Buchmesse eröffnet am 15. Oktober ihre 76. Ausgabe mit einem Festakt in der Festhalle Frankfurt, bei dem die nigerianische Autorin Adaeze Nwosu als Ehrengast die Eröffnungsrede halten wird. Gastland in diesem Jahr ist Norwegen, dessen Verlage und Autoren auf einer Fläche von rund 4.200 Quadratmetern vertreten sein werden. Rund 85.000 Besucher werden bis zum Abschluss am 20. Oktober erwartet.

Brøndby IF held Malmö FF to a tense 1–1 draw at Brøndby Stadion on Thursday evening, a result that leaves both sides level on points at the top of Group C in the UEFA Conference League. Mirela Lindqvist opened the scoring for the Swedish visitors in the 34th minute before Tobias Krarup equalised from the spot just before the half-time whistle, and neither side could find a decisive goal despite a frantic closing twenty minutes. An attendance of 14,220 packed the west Copenhagen arena.

Grasshopper Club Zürich came from behind to defeat FC Winterthur 3–2 in a tense Axpo Super League fixture at the Letzigrund on Saturday, with midfielder Renato Kahl netting the decisive goal in the 88th minute before a crowd of 11,240. The result leaves Winterthur rooted in the relegation zone heading into the winter break.

The Scottish Parliament voted narrowly on Thursday to pass the Housing Emergency (Tenant Protections) Bill, with 67 members in favour and 59 against, after a bruising three-hour debate in which SNP backbenchers clashed openly with Labour and Conservative opposition over proposed rent-cap extensions. Scottish Greens, who provided the SNP government with its working majority, held firm despite last-minute pressure from landlord lobby groups. Deputy First Minister Catriona Muirhead called the result "a hard-won step toward genuine housing security for renters across Scotland," while Conservative housing spokesman Alasdair Buchanan condemned the bill as "an economic wrecking ball dressed up as compassion."

The Swedish Riksdag passed a landmark housing reform bill on Thursday by a narrow margin, with 176 votes in favour and 173 against, after weeks of fractious debate over rent controls and the deregulation of the construction sector. The Moderate Party, governing in coalition with the Sweden Democrats, secured the result only after last-minute concessions to two wavering independent members. Opposition leader Britta Söderström of the Social Democrats condemned the outcome as "a gift to property developers at the expense of ordinary tenants," vowing to bring a repeal motion before parliament within the year.

Nadège Fontaine scored a brace in the final twelve minutes to hand Stade de Reims a stunning 3–2 victory over Paris FC at the Stade Auguste-Delaune on Sunday, keeping Reims firmly in contention for the Division 1 Féminine title with just four fixtures remaining this season.

Commuters across Greater Manchester faced significant disruption on Wednesday after Avanti West Coast and Northern Rail announced a joint 48-hour walkout beginning at 06:00, affecting all services on the West Coast Main Line and the Manchester–Leeds cross-Pennine corridor. Metrolink tram services, operated by KeolisAmey, were left unaffected, though the company warned that platforms at Piccadilly Gardens and Manchester Victoria could see overcrowding as an estimated 340,000 passengers sought alternative routes. The strike, called by the RMT union over a long-running dispute on pay and roster conditions, is expected to cost operators upwards of £4.2 million in lost revenue over its duration.

Leverkusen's Bayer 04 edged past Borussia Dortmund 2–1 in a tense Bundesliga clash at BayArena on Saturday evening, with midfielder Tomás Vreeland netting the decisive header in the 87th minute before a crowd of 30,210. The result leaves Dortmund five points adrift of the top four with just eight matchdays remaining in the season.

Commuters on the Northern line faced severe delays for the third consecutive morning on Wednesday after a points failure near Stockwell forced Transport for London to suspend services between Morden and Bank during the peak rush hour, leaving an estimated 47,000 passengers stranded or diverted onto already packed bus routes. TfL engineers worked through the night but warned that full restoration was unlikely before Friday.

Borussia Dortmund claimed a hard-fought 2–1 victory over RB Leipzig at Signal Iduna Park on Saturday evening, with midfielder Lena Vorwerk scoring the decisive goal in the 88th minute to keep the hosts' Bundesliga title hopes alive. The attendance of 81,365 made for a ferocious atmosphere throughout, and Leipzig's Tobias Krell was shown a red card with fifteen minutes remaining, a moment that ultimately shaped the contest.

Djurgårdens IF edged past Hammarby IF 2–1 in a tightly contested Stockholm derby at Tele2 Arena on Saturday evening, with midfielder Tobias Ekqvist scoring the decisive goal in the 84th minute to send the home faithful into raptures. The victory lifts Djurgårdens to third place in Allsvenskan, while Hammarby slip further from the European qualification spots with just five league fixtures remaining.

Die Städtische Galerie Karlsruhe eröffnet am 14. März eine Retrospektive zum Werk der Grafikerin und Installationskünstlerin Marta Vondráček, die über dreißig Jahre ihres Schaffens in einem bislang kaum gewürdigten Spannungsfeld zwischen osteuropäischer Druckgrafik und westdeutschem Konzeptualismus beleuchtet. Die Ausstellung, kuratiert von Dr. Sigrun Haberle, vereint rund 140 Arbeiten aus öffentlichen und privaten Sammlungen und ist bis zum 25. Mai zu sehen. Der Eintritt beträgt acht Euro.

Kristoffer Dahl-Hauge buried a 94th-minute winner to give Brann a dramatic 2–1 victory over Molde FK at Brann Stadion on Saturday, pulling the Bergen club to within three points of the Eliteserien summit with only six rounds remaining. Substitute Patience Osei had equalised for Molde FK just after the hour mark, cancelling out Emre Şahin's early opener, before Dahl-Hauge's thunderous header sealed all three points in front of a sold-out crowd of 17,686.

Der SC Freiburg hat am Samstagabend im Schwarzwald-Stadion einen überzeugenden 3:1-Sieg gegen den FC Augsburg eingefahren und sich damit auf den vierten Tabellenplatz der Bundesliga vorgeschoben. Vor 24.000 Zuschauern trafen Marek Vrábel doppelt sowie die eingewechselte Lena-Stürmerin Katalin Boros, bevor Augsburgs Ansgar Petrow den Ehrentreffer erzielte. Freiburgs Trainer Benedikt Haas lobte nach dem Abpfiff die Geschlossenheit seines Teams in der zweiten Hälfte.

The Scottish Parliament voted on Thursday to pass landmark legislation overhauling the country's social care funding framework, with 74 members backing the bill against 49 opposed and 3 abstentions — a margin that Health Secretary Fionnuala Dreich described as "a historic step forward for every family in Scotland." The Greens and the SNP formed the decisive coalition of support, while the Conservatives and Scottish Labour voted unanimously against, arguing the £2.4 billion annual cost was fiscally irresponsible. Parliament's presiding officer Callum Fergusson confirmed the bill will now pass to the Crown for royal assent.

The Reykjavík Art Museum opens its much-anticipated autumn survey, "Frequencies of the North," on Friday, bringing together seventeen Nordic artists whose large-scale textile and video installations explore the relationship between landscape, memory, and industrial decay. Curated by Sigríður Magnúsdóttir and co-organised with the Malmö Konstmuseum, the exhibition runs through 19 January and is expected to draw some 28,000 visitors over its fourteen-week run. Admission is set at 1,800 Icelandic króna for adults.

The Städel Museum in Frankfurt am Main opens its long-anticipated retrospective on Tuesday, bringing together more than 140 paintings, drawings, and prints by the Swiss-German Expressionist Paula Schreiber-Haas — the largest gathering of her work since a modest 1987 show in Basel. Curated by Dr. Miriam Vogt, the exhibition runs through 4 May and is expected to draw visitors from across Europe, with an opening-night gala already sold out at €95 a ticket.

Reykjavik delivered a remarkable double bill on Saturday when the Harpa Concert Hall hosted the Nordic premiere of composer Sigríður Björnsdóttir's choral symphony "Vatnið" before a sold-out audience of 1,200, while across the harbour the national rugby union side Iceland Vikings clinched a tense 24–19 victory over the Faroe Islands Eagles in a World Rugby Nations Cup qualifier at Laugardalsvöllur Stadium, with fly-half Einar Magnússon scoring the decisive try in the seventy-eighth minute.

The question of whether Stuttgart's ageing tram network can be modernised without displacing the street-level arts scene that has quietly colonised its disused depot buildings has occupied urban planners, transit officials, and gallery owners alike for the better part of a decade — yet no proposal has so far commanded anything resembling a consensus.

Der SV Wehen Wiesbaden empfing am Samstagabend den FC Hansa Rostock im Brita-Arena und setzte sich in einem intensiven Zweitliga-Duell mit 3:1 durch. Vor 8.942 Zuschauern brachten Torjäger Lasse Günnewig (14.) und Doppelpacker Nico Ferretti (38., 71.) die Gastgeber auf die Siegerstraße, ehe Hannes Möllenbeck in der 89. Minute nur noch Ergebniskosmetik für die Rostocker betreiben konnte. Mit diesem Sieg klettert Wiesbaden auf Platz fünf der Tabelle.

The Reykjavík Art Museum opens its most ambitious group exhibition in years this Friday, bringing together seventeen sculptors and installation artists from across the Nordic countries under the curatorial eye of Sigríður Ólafsdóttir. Entitled "Permafrost and Memory," the show will run through March 9th and is expected to draw crowds well beyond the museum's usual weekend figures of around 2,400 visitors. Admission is set at 1,800 Icelandic króna for adults.

Copenhagen's city council voted 31 to 14 on Thursday to approve a €2.4 billion expansion of the Metro's Cityringen line, extending it southward to Sydhavn with six new stations — a flagship infrastructure pledge of Mayor Astrid Voss's re-election campaign. The opposition Conservative People's Party, which had sought to defer the project pending a cost review, fell short despite a last-minute coalition with smaller centre-right councillors. Construction is expected to begin in early 2026, with Metroselskabet named as the operating authority; once operational, the extension is projected to serve an additional 47,000 passengers daily on the heavily used circular line.

The Scottish Parliament voted narrowly on Thursday to reject a proposed amendment to the Housing (Scotland) Bill that would have capped private rental increases at three percent annually, with 63 MSPs voting against the measure, 58 in favour, and four abstaining. The result was a significant setback for the Scottish Greens and their co-sponsor Fiona Dalgety, who had argued the cap was essential to prevent mass evictions in Edinburgh and Glasgow ahead of winter. Scottish National Party ministers, led by Housing Secretary Callum Urquhart, insisted that a blanket cap would deter investment and promised instead a revised affordability framework to be published before the end of the year.

The Bavarian state parliament in Munich delivered a stinging rebuke to the governing coalition on Thursday, voting 97 to 82 — with four abstentions — to reject a proposed reform of the Länderfinanzausgleich, the fiscal equalisation scheme that redistributes tax revenues among Germany's sixteen states. CSU floor leader Margarethe Döllinger called the outcome "a clear signal that Bavaria will not subsidise the mismanagement of others," while SPD lawmakers accused her bloc of prioritising electoral posturing over structural fairness. The defeat leaves Finance Minister Konrad Pfeiffer's budget framework in an uncertain position ahead of next spring's scheduled state elections.

Josefine Kragholm held off a late surge from defending champion Amara Diallo to win the women's elite race at the Copenhagen Half Marathon on Sunday, crossing the line in 1:07:42 to the roar of an estimated 28,000 spectators packed along the Frederiksberg course. Kragholm, 24, is the youngest Danish woman to claim the title in the event's four-decade history.

Berlin's public transit authority BVG announced on Thursday that S-Bahn services on the S7 and S75 lines will be suspended between Ostbahnhof and Erkner from 22 to 28 March due to emergency track replacement work near Köpenick, leaving an estimated 47,000 daily passengers without direct rail service and forcing the operator to deploy replacement buses along the affected corridor.

Benedikt Sørensen delivered a masterclass under the floodlights at Eleda Stadion on Saturday, scoring twice as Malmö FF edged Djurgårdens IF 3–2 in a breathless Allsvenskan derby that drew a sell-out crowd of 21,500. The hosts' goalkeeper, Tobias Krantz, kept them in the game with a stunning late save, but it was Sørensen's brace in the first half — his seventh and eighth goals of the season — that ultimately proved decisive.

ÖBB has confirmed that engineering works on the Westbahn corridor between Salzburg and Linz will force a complete suspension of intercity rail services from the night of 14 March through to the early hours of 18 March, with an estimated 47,000 passengers expected to be affected over the four-day closure. Replacement bus services will operate along the route, though journey times are anticipated to stretch to nearly three hours — roughly double the usual rail connection. The works, valued at approximately €28 million, are aimed at upgrading signalling infrastructure and laying a third track between Attnang-Puchheim and Wels.

Die ÖBB hat am Montag bestätigt, dass die Weststrecke zwischen Salzburg und Linz vom 14. bis 21. Juli wegen umfangreicher Gleiserneuerungsarbeiten vollständig gesperrt wird. Betroffen sind vor allem die Intercity-Verbindungen IC 510 und IC 514 sowie mehrere Regionalzüge; Reisende werden auf Schienenersatzverkehr mit Bussen umgeleitet. Laut ÖBB-Sprecher Markus Halbinger rechnet das Unternehmen mit rund 38.000 beeinträchtigten Fahrgästen pro Tag.

The Frankfurter Buchmesse opens its doors on Wednesday for its 76th edition, drawing publishers, agents, and literary scouts from more than 100 countries to the Messe Frankfurt fairgrounds. This year's guest of honour is Italy, whose pavilion — curated by the novelist and cultural diplomat Cristina Valenti — promises a sweeping retrospective of Italian literature from the postwar period to the present day. Tickets for trade days are priced at €65, with public admission on the weekend available for €18.

Die Frankfurter Buchmesse eröffnet am 15. Oktober ihre 76. Ausgabe auf dem Messegelände Frankfurt mit einem Festakt, bei dem die österreichische Schriftstellerin Marta Siebenlinden die Eröffnungsrede hält. Erwartet werden rund 4.200 Aussteller aus über 100 Ländern; der diesjährige Ehrengast ist Norwegen. Veranstaltet wird die weltweit größte Buchmesse vom Börsenverein des Deutschen Buchhandels, der das Programm bis zum 19. Oktober angelegt hat.

The Helsinki City Council voted 51 to 18 on Thursday to approve a €340 million expansion of the metro network westward to Espoo's Keilaniemi district, a project championed by Mayor-elect Päivi Leinonen, who was formally inaugurated into office at City Hall just hours before the landmark infrastructure vote. The western extension, to be operated by HSL, will add seven new stations along a 13-kilometre route and is expected to serve an estimated 85,000 additional daily passengers when it opens in late 2029.

Vienna's Wiener Festwochen will open its 2025 edition on May 9 with a landmark production of Ivo van Hove's "Antigone" at the Burgtheater, drawing an expected 1,800 attendees on opening night — but theatregoers should plan ahead, as the Wiener Linien has announced a partial suspension of U2 services between Schottentor and Karlsplatz from May 7 through May 12 due to emergency signalling repairs, affecting an estimated 95,000 daily commuters.

The Swedish Riksdag narrowly approved a sweeping reform to the national pension system on Thursday, with 176 votes in favour and 173 against, after an acrimonious debate that stretched past midnight. The bill, championed by Finance Minister Britta Söderqvist and opposed most vocally by Left Party leader Karin Almgren, would raise the statutory retirement age from 65 to 67 over the next decade. Centre-right coalition partners the Moderaterna and Kristdemokraterna backed the measure, while the Social Democrats and the Greens voted solidly against it.
