The Scottish Parliament voted by a narrow margin on Thursday to pass the Affordable Heating Bill, with 68 members backing the legislation against 57 opposed and 4 abstaining — a result that First Minister's office called "a historic step for fuel poverty relief," though Conservative MSPs warned the projected cost of £2.3 billion over five years would place unsustainable pressure on the Scottish budget. Labour MSPs, whose support proved decisive, secured a last-minute amendment requiring an independent annual review of the scheme's effectiveness.

Der Stadtrat von Freiburg im Breisgau hat am Donnerstagabend mit knapper Mehrheit einen umstrittenen Bebauungsplan für das nördliche Industriegebiet verabschiedet: 24 Stimmen votierten dafür, 19 dagegen, bei drei Enthaltungen. Die Grünen und die SPD unterstützten den Plan, während die CDU-Fraktion geschlossen Nein stimmte und Fraktionsvorsitzender Helmut Reinecke das Ergebnis als „planlos und verantwortungslos" bezeichnete. Oberbürgermeisterin Claudia Marwitz hatte den Entwurf im Vorfeld als zentrales Element der Stadtentwicklungsstrategie bis 2035 verteidigt.

Der Stadtrat von Freiburg im Breisgau hat am Donnerstagabend mit knapper Mehrheit beschlossen, das städtische Nahverkehrsbudget um 12 Millionen Euro aufzustocken — ein Sieg für die Grünen, die den Antrag gemeinsam mit der SPD eingebracht hatten. Die CDU-Fraktion stimmte geschlossen dagegen, während drei Ratsmitglieder der Freien Wähler sich enthielten. Oberbürgermeisterin Carla Sontheimer begrüßte das Ergebnis als „klares Signal für eine klimafreundliche Stadtentwicklung".

Commuters on the U6 and U8 lines faced severe delays on Monday morning after a signal failure at Neukölln forced BVG to operate trains at reduced frequency for nearly four hours, leaving an estimated 47,000 passengers stranded or significantly delayed across the southern Berlin network. Engineers restored full service by midday, but the operator warned that ageing infrastructure along both corridors remains a persistent vulnerability heading into the winter season.

The Stormont Assembly voted narrowly on Thursday to reject a proposed reform of Northern Ireland's planning regulations, with 52 members opposing the bill and 44 in favour, after a heated three-hour debate during which Democratic Unionist Party legislators argued the changes would strip local councils of meaningful oversight. Sinn Féin and the Alliance Party had jointly championed the legislation, framing it as essential to unlocking housing development across rural constituencies, but their combined bloc fell short of the cross-community threshold required for passage. Assembly Speaker Máire Ó Briain described the outcome as "a setback for affordable housing ambitions" and indicated that a revised draft could be tabled before the end of the current mandate.

The Scottish Parliament voted on Thursday to reject the Scottish Conservative Party's motion of no confidence in First Minister Catriona Lamont by 74 votes to 51, with 4 abstentions, as SNP and Scottish Green legislators held together despite weeks of bitter cross-party recriminations over the government's stalled housing policy.

Die Frankfurter Buchmesse eröffnet am 15. Oktober ihre 76. Ausgabe mit einem Festakt im Römer, bei dem die Verlegerin Katarzyna Wierzbicka-Holt die Eröffnungsrede hält. Gastland in diesem Jahr ist Norwegen, das mit rund 70 Autorinnen und Autoren sowie einem eigens gestalteten Pavillon in Halle 4.1 vertreten sein wird. Bis zum 19. Oktober präsentieren mehr als 4.200 Aussteller aus 95 Ländern ihre Neuerscheinungen; der Eintritt für Fachbesucherinnen und Fachbesucher beträgt 48 Euro.

The Swedish Riksdag narrowly approved a sweeping pension reform package on Thursday, with 176 votes in favour and 173 against, after weeks of bitter debate that exposed deep fissures within the ruling coalition. Finance Minister Astrid Söderholm, who shepherded the bill through three rounds of committee review, called the outcome "a hard-won step toward generational fairness," while opposition leader Mikael Brandt of the Social Democrats vowed to reverse the changes if his party returns to government. The reform raises the standard retirement age from 65 to 67 and links future adjustments to demographic projections updated every five years.

The Oslo City Council voted narrowly on Thursday to approve a €340 million expansion of the Fornebubanen metro line, extending it by four stations northward to Fornebu Senter, after months of bitter debate between the Labour-led majority and the Conservative opposition. The 35-to-28 vote, with three abstentions, was hailed by Council Leader Astrid Moen Bakke as "a generational investment in clean urban mobility," though Conservative group spokesman Håkon Ulveseth warned that cost overruns could burden taxpayers well into the 2040s. Ruter, Oslo's public transport authority, confirmed that construction will begin in March 2026, with full passenger service on the new stretch expected no earlier than 2031, and that an estimated 48,000 daily commuters stand to benefit from the link between the city centre and the Fornebu peninsula.

Grasshopper Club Zürich edged out FC Winterthur 2–1 in a tense Super League fixture at the Letzigrund on Saturday evening, with midfielder Dragan Vukčević scoring the winner four minutes from time in front of a crowd of 11,400. The result lifts Grasshopper into fifth place, ending a three-match winless run that had begun to unsettle the club's technical staff.

The Viennese city council voted on Thursday to restore public funding for the Wiener Festwochen after a two-year freeze, with 41 votes in favour and 12 against, a decision hailed by festival director Magdalena Streibl as "the breath of life this city's arts scene desperately needed." The annual festival, which draws artists from across Europe and beyond, is now confirmed to open at the Rathausplatz on 9 May for a five-week run, with Hungarian theatre director Ádám Forgács headlining the programme alongside a retrospective of work by visual artist Nora Svensson.

The Swedish Riksdag narrowly passed a sweeping climate package on Thursday, with 176 votes in favour and 173 against, after weeks of fractious debate pitting the ruling coalition of the Social Democrats and the Greens against a united opposition bloc led by the Moderate Party. Finance minister Britta Söderholm hailed the result as "a generational turning point," while Moderate leader Erik Wrangel warned that the legislation would impose unsustainable costs on rural households. One member abstained.

The Flemish parliament passed a landmark housing affordability bill on Thursday by a margin of 71 votes to 44, with 8 abstentions, after a bruising overnight debate that exposed deep rifts between the governing N-VA and its junior coalition partner Open Vld over rent-cap thresholds. The measure, championed by Housing Minister Lena Verstraeten, will freeze annual rent increases at 2.3 percent for private tenants across Flanders for a period of three years, a policy the opposition Vooruit party had long demanded but never expected to see carried by a right-leaning majority. "This is not the bill we would have written," Verstraeten told reporters outside the chamber in Brussels, "but it is a bill Flemish families can live with."

Passengers on the S-Bahn München network faced significant delays on Monday morning after a signal failure near Ostbahnhof brought three lines to a near-standstill for roughly four hours, with Deutsche Bahn estimating that upwards of 47,000 commuters were affected during the peak period. Engineering crews restored full service by mid-morning, but the disruption reignited longstanding calls from the Bavarian state government for accelerated investment in the ageing signalling infrastructure across the network.

Brøndby IF ended their six-match winless run in the Danish Superliga on Sunday, grinding out a tense 2–1 victory over FC Nordsjælland at Brøndby Stadion in front of 16,204 supporters. Midfielder Kasper Hvidt opened the scoring just before the half-hour mark, and although Marcus Anker equalised for the visitors shortly after the break, a late header from defender Søren Thygesen sealed all three points for the hosts with nine minutes to play.

The Irish government announced on Wednesday that it would provide €2.4 million in emergency arts funding following a Dáil vote that passed 87 to 34, with Sinn Féin and the Social Democrats backing the measure over Fianna Fáil objections — a landmark moment for cultural policy that Culture Minister Aoife Ní Bhriain called "long overdue." The funding will anchor the centrepiece of the initiative: a new six-week interdisciplinary festival, Éigse Éireann, scheduled to open at the National Concert Hall in Dublin on 14 March, featuring work by more than forty Irish and diaspora artists curated by Tomás Ó Cualáin and Siobhán Ferriter.

The Wiener Konzerthaus will host a rare complete performance of Leoš Janáček's "The Cunning Little Vixen" on 14 March, led by Czech conductor Markéta Horáčková and featuring the Vienna Philharmonic in what promises to be the ensemble's first staging of the opera in over two decades. Tickets are priced at €95 for premium seats, and organisers at the Wiener Konzerthaus Gesellschaft expect a sold-out house of 1,840 attendees.

Wegen eines Kabelbrands in einem Stellwerk am Frankfurter Hauptbahnhof kommt es seit dem frühen Dienstagmorgen zu massiven Behinderungen im Regional- und Fernverkehr: Die Deutsche Bahn teilte mit, dass die S-Bahn-Linien S3, S4 und S5 zwischen Darmstadt und Bad Vilbel bis voraussichtlich Mittwochabend komplett gesperrt sind. Rund 87.000 Pendlerinnen und Pendler seien täglich betroffen, Schienenersatzverkehr werde eingerichtet. Ein Sprecher des Konzerns, Markus Reifenrath, entschuldigte sich bei den Fahrgästen und versicherte, dass alle verfügbaren Techniker im Einsatz seien.

Die Frankfurter Buchmesse eröffnet am 15. Oktober ihre 76. Ausgabe auf dem Messegelände Frankfurt mit einem Festakt, bei dem die Schriftstellerin Layla Okonkwo die Eröffnungsrede halten wird. Erwartet werden rund 4.200 Aussteller aus mehr als 100 Ländern; der Ehrengast in diesem Jahr ist Kanada. Die Messe dauert bis zum 19. Oktober und präsentiert Neuerscheinungen aus den Bereichen Belletristik, Sachbuch und Graphic Novel.

Commuters on the U6 and U4 lines in Vienna faced lengthy delays on Monday morning after a signalling fault near Längenfeldgasse brought underground services to a near-standstill for close to three hours, with Wiener Linien estimating that roughly 47,000 passengers were affected before normal operations resumed shortly before noon.

Die Österreichischen Bundesbahnen haben ab Montag, dem 14. April, die Preise für Einzeltickets im Fernverkehr um durchschnittlich 4,2 Prozent angehoben — die erste Fahrpreiserhöhung seit drei Jahren. Besonders betroffen sind Reisende auf der Weststrecke zwischen Wien und Salzburg sowie auf der Verbindung Innsbruck–Bregenz. Die ÖBB begründen den Schritt mit gestiegenen Energiekosten und notwendigen Investitionen in die Schieneninfrastruktur.

Commuters on the Øresund rail corridor faced a second consecutive morning of severe delays on Thursday after Trafikverket confirmed that a failed overhead line mast near Hässleholm had brought cross-border services between Malmö and Copenhagen to a standstill, stranding an estimated 14,000 passengers during the peak rush. Engineers arrived at the site before dawn but repair work is not expected to be completed until late Friday evening, leaving SJ and DSB intercity trains as well as regional Pågatågen services suspended for most of the day. Passengers were advised to seek alternative transport via the Öresundsbron bus replacement coaches laid on by the two operators.

ÖBB has confirmed that engineering works on the Westbahn corridor between Salzburg and Linz will close the main line to through-traffic from 14 March to 22 March, forcing an estimated 47,000 daily rail passengers onto replacement bus services operated by a fleet of 38 coaches. The disruption, attributed to urgent track-bed reinforcement ahead of a planned high-speed upgrade, is expected to add up to 90 minutes to journey times on affected services.

Commuters across the Finnish capital faced severe disruptions on Monday after Helsinki Regional Transport Authority workers walked off the job in a 48-hour strike, halting metro, tram, and local bus services simultaneously. The walkout, called by the transport union PAU over stalled wage negotiations, left an estimated 340,000 daily passengers scrambling for alternatives during the morning and evening peaks. Regional operator HSL urged travellers to work from home where possible and warned that services would not resume before Wednesday morning.

Die Frankfurter Buchmesse eröffnete am Mittwoch ihre 76. Ausgabe mit einem Festakt im Römer, bei dem die österreichische Autorin Magdalena Vrankić ihre vielbeachtete Essaysammlung „Stille Gewässer" dem Publikum vorstellte. Rund 4.200 Besucher verfolgten die Veranstaltung, für die Tageskarten zu je 18 Euro erhältlich waren. Schirmherrin des Abends war die Frankfurter Kulturdezernentin Dr. Renate Sölch, die das Werk als „einen der wichtigsten deutschsprachigen Beiträge des Jahres" würdigte.

The Reykjavík Art Museum opens its most ambitious group show in years this Friday, bringing together seventeen artists from across Scandinavia and the Baltic states under the curation of Sigríður Ólafsdóttir and Danish critic Mads Thorvaldsen. Titled "Fault Lines," the exhibition runs through March 9th and explores themes of geological memory and displacement through sculpture, video installation, and printmaking. Admission is set at 1,500 króna for adults.

Commuters on the Merseyrail network faced severe disruption on Thursday after a signalling fault near Lime Street station forced the suspension of all Northern Line services for more than six hours, stranding an estimated 47,000 passengers during the morning rush. Merseyrail engineers worked through the afternoon to isolate a relay failure in the ageing infrastructure, with full services only resuming shortly before 19:00. The Rail Delivery Group described the incident as a reminder of the urgent investment case for replacing signal equipment installed in the 1980s.

The Frankfurter Buchmesse opens its doors on Wednesday for a five-day run that organisers expect to draw more than 300,000 visitors to the Messe Frankfurt fairgrounds, with Norwegian literature taking centre stage as the guest-of-honour theme for 2024. Among the marquee events, novelist Sigrid Brandt and essayist Torben Haugen will lead a sold-out evening reading at the Lesezelt on Thursday, while publishers from over 90 countries have registered stands across the sprawling exhibition halls. Admission for a single day costs €18 for adults.

Passengers on the Oslo–Stockholm corridor faced significant disruption on Thursday after SJ AB suspended all cross-border express services indefinitely, citing emergency maintenance work on a failing bridge section near Karlstad. The Swedish Transport Administration warned that repairs could take up to three weeks, leaving an estimated 14,000 daily travellers to seek alternative connections via bus or domestic rail. No replacement fare scheme has been announced.

Krakow's Wisła Stadium hosted a tense Ekstraklasa clash on Saturday evening as Wisła Kraków edged out Legia Warszawa 2–1 in front of 31,420 fans, with a brace from striker Tomasz Bednarski proving the difference after Legia's Piotr Mrózek had briefly levelled proceedings in the second half.

Der Regionalverkehr zwischen Salzburg und Linz wird ab Montag, dem 14. Juli, für voraussichtlich drei Wochen vollständig eingestellt: Die ÖBB muss auf dem betroffenen Streckenabschnitt dringend notwendige Gleiserneuerungsarbeiten durchführen, die nicht weiter aufgeschoben werden konnten. Reisende werden gebeten, auf die eingerichteten Ersatzbusse der Linie R5 auszuweichen, wobei erhebliche Fahrzeitverlängerungen von bis zu 55 Minuten einzuplanen sind. Rund 18.400 Fahrgäste pro Tag sind laut ÖBB-Angaben von der Unterbrechung betroffen.

The Oslo City Council voted on Thursday to approve a €340 million expansion of the Fornebubanen metro line, extending it by three stations northward to Fornebu, in a vote that saw 41 councillors in favour and just nine opposed. The decision, championed by the city's Labour-led coalition under Mayor Silje Brattberg, ends nearly two years of fractious debate over financing; the line is now expected to open in late 2028, with Ruter AS confirmed as the operating authority for the new segment and an estimated 58,000 daily passengers set to benefit once services begin.

Der Stadtrat von Freiburg im Breisgau hat am Donnerstagabend mit knapper Mehrheit beschlossen, die umstrittene Nahverkehrsabgabe für Pendler ab kommendem Jahr einzuführen — 24 Stimmen dafür, 19 dagegen, bei drei Enthaltungen. Oberbürgermeisterin Carla Weßling, die den Antrag gemeinsam mit den Grünen und der SPD eingebracht hatte, sprach von einem „historischen Schritt für klimafreundliche Mobilität". Die oppositionellen Fraktionen CDU und FDP kündigten umgehend an, rechtliche Schritte gegen den Beschluss prüfen zu wollen.

Die Frankfurter Buchmesse eröffnet am 15. Oktober ihre 76. Ausgabe auf dem Messegelände Frankfurt mit einem dicht gedrängten Programm: Über 4.200 Aussteller aus mehr als 95 Ländern präsentieren Neuerscheinungen aus allen Sparten des Buchmarkts, während die Ehrengast-Delegation aus Slowenien mit einem Eröffnungsabend im Literaturhaus Frankfurt den kulturellen Reigen einläutet. Festivalchefin Luisa Brenntner sprach von einem „Signal der Weltoffenheit in unsicheren Zeiten" und kündigte an, dass der österreichische Autor Benedikt Mayrhofer am Samstag seinen vielbesprochenen Debütroman vorstellen werde.

Passengers travelling on the Piccadilly line faced severe delays for the third consecutive morning on Wednesday after a points failure near Hammersmith forced Transport for London to run a severely reduced service between Heathrow Airport and Acton Town, leaving an estimated 47,000 commuters stranded or forced onto replacement bus routes during the peak hours.

Im Rückspiel der zweiten Runde des DFB-Pokals bezwang der FC Augsburg den Zweitligisten SV Elversberg am Dienstagabend mit 3:1 im WWK Arena und zog damit souverän ins Achtelfinale ein. Vor 21.340 Zuschauern erzielte Mergim Berisha zwei Treffer in der ersten Halbzeit, ehe Jonas Hoffmann den Endstand besiegelte.

Die Wiener Linien haben für den kommenden Samstag, den 14. Juni, eine vollständige Sperrung der U4 zwischen den Stationen Hütteldorf und Schwedenplatz angekündigt, um dringende Instandhaltungsarbeiten an den Gleisanlagen im Bereich des Stadtparks durchzuführen. Betroffen sind nach Schätzungen des Unternehmens rund 87.000 Fahrgäste. Als Ersatz werden Schienenersatzverkehr-Busse auf der gesamten Strecke eingesetzt, die Fahrtzeit verlängert sich jedoch um etwa 25 Minuten.

Network Rail has confirmed that a major signalling failure along the West Coast Main Line will suspend all services between London Euston and Glasgow Central from Friday evening until at least Sunday midday, with approximately 47,000 passengers expected to be affected over the weekend. Engineers from Amey Infrastructure were deployed overnight but have so far been unable to isolate the fault, which first emerged near Crewe. Avanti West Coast is urging customers to postpone non-essential travel and has issued full refunds for tickets purchased on the disrupted corridor.

Beim packenden Drittliga-Duell im Stadion am Bieberer Berg setzte sich der FC Viktoria Köln am Samstagabend mit 3:1 gegen den VfB Oldenburg durch. Vor 6.200 Zuschauern war es vor allem Mittelfeldspieler Tomas Vrábel, der mit einem Doppelpack in der zweiten Halbzeit den Sieg sicherstellte. Für Oldenburg traf zwar Lucas Brandt kurz nach der Pause zum zwischenzeitlichen Ausgleich, doch die Gäste fanden danach kein Mittel mehr gegen eine kompakte Kölner Defensive.

The Scottish Parliament voted by a narrow margin on Thursday to approve a sweeping overhaul of the country's social care funding framework, with 68 members backing the bill against 57 opponents and three abstentions — a result that the governing Scottish National Party hailed as "a generational shift" in how the state supports elderly and disabled citizens. The measure, championed by Health Secretary Fiona Drummond, had been fiercely contested by the Scottish Conservatives and Scottish Labour throughout a bruising committee stage that stretched across six weeks. Speaking outside Holyrood after the vote, SNP group convener Callum Bryce declared the legislation would come into force by April 2026.

Lena Vrábelová of Slovakia held off a fierce late charge from defending champion Astrid Moen to win the Copenhagen Half Marathon on Sunday in a personal best of 1:07:43, crossing the finish line at Rådhuspladsen to a roar from an estimated 38,000 spectators lining the course. The 26-year-old's time marks the fastest half-marathon ever recorded on Danish soil.

The Vienna City Council voted on Thursday to grant €2.3 million in public funding to the Wiener Festwochen, securing the festival's expanded programme for the coming year in a move championed by Cultural Councillor Renate Horvath over the objections of the FPÖ, whose representatives cast all fourteen of their votes against the measure. The festival, which opens at the Burgtheater on 9 May and runs through 15 June, will this year feature productions directed by Selin Çelik and Markus Drabauer alongside a retrospective of works by composer Ágnes Vásárhelyi.

Kristóf Vásárhelyi's late header sealed a dramatic 2–1 victory for Ferencváros over Fehérvár FC at Groupama Aréna in Budapest on Saturday, keeping the hosts top of the OTP Bank Liga with eight matches played. The winning goal, nodded in from a Dávid Solymosi corner in the 87th minute, sent the capacity crowd of 22,400 into raptures and left Fehérvár without a win in five league outings.

Dublin City Council voted on Thursday evening to approve a sweeping new housing affordability package, with 41 councillors in favour, 12 against, and 3 abstentions, after a fractious four-hour debate that pitted Sinn Féin and the Social Democrats against a Fianna Fáil-led bloc. The measure, championed by local housing convenor Órla Mescal, will redirect €85 million toward below-market rental units across the North Inner City and Ballymun districts over the next three years.

Ragnhild Sæther put on a masterclass at the Ullevaal Stadion on Sunday evening, scoring twice in the final eighteen minutes to hand Vålerenga a stunning 3–1 comeback victory over Rosenborg in the Toppserien, Norway's top women's football division. An attendance of 11,240 — a season record for the fixture — roared the hosts through a nervy second half before Sæther's brace settled the contest.

The Scottish Parliament voted narrowly on Thursday to reject a proposed amendment to the Housing (Scotland) Bill that would have capped private rental increases at two percent annually, with 63 MSPs voting against the measure, 58 in favour, and four abstaining — a result that drew swift condemnation from the Scottish Greens, whose housing spokesperson Ailsa Drummond described the outcome as "a surrender to landlord lobbying."

Commuters on the S-Bahn network in Munich faced widespread delays on Thursday after a signalling fault near Ostbahnhof paralysed services on lines S2, S4, and S6 for nearly four hours during the morning peak, with Deutsche Bahn estimating that around 85,000 passengers were affected before engineers restored normal operations shortly after midday.

The Vienna city council voted narrowly on Thursday to approve a €2.3 billion extension of the U2 underground line southward to Wienerberg, with 43 votes in favour and 38 against after a heated three-hour chamber debate in which opposition councillors from the FPÖ demanded a public referendum. The project, to be delivered by Wiener Linien over a projected eleven-year construction period, will add seven new stations and is expected to serve an estimated 180,000 additional passengers daily once operational.

The Scottish Parliament voted by a narrow margin on Thursday to advance the Renters' Rights (Scotland) Amendment Bill, with 67 members in favour and 58 against, after a bruising floor debate in which Housing Minister Catriona Dalgety accused the Conservatives of "deliberate obstruction" and Scottish Labour's Ewan Nairn called the government's timetable "reckless." The Scottish Greens provided the decisive votes needed to push the bill past its Stage 1 hurdle.

Brendan Kowalczyk scored twice in the final twelve minutes to give Bohemian FC a dramatic 3–2 victory over Shelbourne at Dalymount Park on Friday evening, with 4,350 supporters packed into the ground to witness one of the League of Ireland's most breathless derbies of the season.

Commuters on the Jubilee line faced severe delays for the third consecutive morning on Wednesday after a points failure near Canning Town forced Transport for London to run a reduced service between Stanmore and Stratford, with TfL estimating that roughly 47,000 passengers were affected during the peak hours. Engineers have been on site since Tuesday but warned that full service would not resume before Thursday at the earliest.

Passengers travelling on the S-Bahn network in Munich face significant disruption this week after Bayerische Oberlandbahn engineers discovered severe stress fractures in the overhead line infrastructure at Ostbahnhof, forcing the suspension of S2 and S8 services between Ostbahnhof and Munich Airport from Monday through at least Friday. DB Regio has urged commuters to use U-Bahn lines or regional bus replacements, though authorities warn that up to 47,000 daily passengers could be affected during the closure.

The weekend proved doubly festive in Göteborg, where the Gothenburg Symphony Orchestra opened its autumn season with a sold-out performance of Sibelius and Nielsen at the Gothenburg Concert Hall on Saturday evening, drawing an audience of 1,850, while just hours earlier the city's football faithful packed Gamla Ullevi to watch IFK Göteborg edge Malmö FF 2–1 in a tightly contested Allsvenskan derby — the two events together lending the city a carnival air that locals said had not been felt since the club's last league title run.

Mit einem Last-Minute-Treffer von Stürmer Benedikt Ohrdorf sicherte sich der FC Rot-Weiß Erfurt am Samstagabend einen dramatischen 2:1-Sieg gegen den SV Wacker Nordhausen im Thüringer Landespokal-Viertelfinale. Vor 4.200 Zuschauern im Steigerwaldstadion verwandelte Ohrdorf in der 93. Spielminute einen Freistoß aus spitzem Winkel und ließ die Erfurter Anhänger ausrasten. Das Halbfinale ist nun für den 15. März 2025 angesetzt.

Lausanne's Pontaise Stadium hosted a tense Swiss Super League encounter on Saturday evening as Lausanne-Sport edged Servette FC 2–1, with midfielder Tobias Wehrli netting the decisive goal in the 88th minute before a crowd of 9,400. The result lifts Lausanne-Sport out of the relegation zone for the first time since October, while Servette's title ambitions suffer a damaging blow with five matches remaining in the season.

The Scottish Parliament voted narrowly on Thursday to approve a sweeping new housing affordability bill, with 67 members backing the legislation against 59 opposed and four abstaining — a result that SNP minister Catriona Drummond hailed as "a generational turning point for renters across Scotland," even as Conservative MSPs vowed to challenge the bill's rent-cap provisions in committee. Labour's Fiona Breckenridge, whose amendment softening the eviction moratorium had been defeated earlier in the day, nonetheless signalled cautious support for the final text.

Beim packenden Abendspiel im Wildparkstadion bezwang der Karlsruher SC den SV Sandhausen am Freitagabend mit 3:1 und festigte damit seinen Tabellenplatz in der 2. Bundesliga. Vor 14.200 Zuschauern erzielte Mittelfeldspieler Lena Vordran das entscheidende dritte Tor in der 78. Minute, nachdem Sandhausens Abwehr einen Eckball nicht klären konnte. Für den KSC war es der dritte Sieg in Folge – die Gäste aus Sandhausen hingegen rutschten weiter in Richtung Abstiegszone.

Dynamo Kyiv edged out Galatasaray 2–1 in a tense Europa League group-stage clash at the NSC Olimpiyskiy on Thursday evening, with substitute Mykola Verbytsky sealing the win in the 88th minute before a crowd of 31,400.

The Olympiastadion in Berlin has long been a subject of architectural fascination, its sweeping colonnades and aged concrete bulk drawing historians and tourists alike, yet city planners and BVG officials have never quite agreed on how best to connect the stadium district to the broader U-Bahn network — a debate that has simmered without resolution for the better part of two decades. Supporters of the local Hertha BSC fanbase, meanwhile, continue to press for a dedicated transit corridor, while cultural preservationists argue that any expansion must respect the stadium's protected heritage status.

Passengers travelling through central Oslo faced significant delays on Monday after a signalling fault brought tram services on lines 12 and 19 to a near-standstill for roughly six hours, leaving an estimated 34,000 commuters scrambling for alternative transport. Ruter, the city's public transit authority, deployed additional bus capacity along the affected corridors but warned that disruption would persist into the evening peak. Engineers traced the fault to a failed relay unit at Jernbanetorget junction and confirmed full service had been restored by 21:00.

Beim Rückrundenauftakt der 2. Bundesliga besiegte der FC Schalke 04 den Hamburger SV am Samstagabend mit 3:1 vor ausverkauftem Haus in der Veltins-Arena. Der überragende Torschütze war Mittelfeldspieler Lukas Brandt, der zwei Treffer erzielte und damit maßgeblich zum deutlichen Heimsieg beitrug. Mit diesem Ergebnis festigt Schalke seinen zweiten Tabellenplatz und hält den Abstand zu den Aufstiegsrängen.

Commuters on the Rhine-Ruhr network faced severe disruptions Monday morning after Deutsche Bahn engineers discovered a signalling fault near Duisburg Hauptbahnhof, halting all S-Bahn services on lines S1, S3, and S6 for nearly four hours and stranding an estimated 47,000 passengers. Repair crews restored partial service by midday, though VRR officials warned that delays of up to 40 minutes would persist through the evening peak.

Der Wiener Architekt Benedikt Hauswirth hat jahrelang darüber nachgedacht, wie sich öffentliche Verkehrsinfrastruktur und kulturelle Identität einer Stadt gegenseitig beeinflussen. In einem kürzlich erschienenen Essay in der Zeitschrift „Stadtbild" argumentiert er, dass neue U-Bahn-Linien nicht nur Pendlerströme lenken, sondern auch das Selbstbild ganzer Stadtteile formen – ein Gedanke, der in Wien angesichts der geplanten Verlängerungen der U2 und U5 besonders virulent ist.

Der Stadtrat von Freiburg im Breisgau hat am Donnerstagabend mit knapper Mehrheit den umstrittenen Haushaltsentwurf für das kommende Jahr verabschiedet: 27 Mitglieder stimmten dafür, 19 dagegen, bei vier Enthaltungen. Die Grünen und die SPD, die gemeinsam die Koalition tragen, setzten sich damit gegen die CDU-Fraktion und die FDP durch, die eine grundlegende Überarbeitung der Ausgaben für den öffentlichen Nahverkehr gefordert hatten. Oberbürgermeisterin Saskia Vordermüller zeigte sich erleichtert: „Dieser Haushalt sichert die Handlungsfähigkeit unserer Stadt für die nächsten zwölf Monate."

Commuters on the S-Bahn network in Hamburg faced significant delays on Thursday morning after a signalling fault between Dammtor and Hauptbahnhof brought services on lines S1, S3, and S31 to a near-standstill for roughly four hours. DB Regio, which operates the service under contract to the Hamburger Verkehrsverbund, estimated that some 85,000 passengers were affected before engineers restored full functionality shortly before noon. Replacement bus services were deployed along the corridor, though overcrowding was reported at several stops. A spokesperson for DB Regio said the fault had been traced to a software update installed overnight and that a full technical review was now under way.

The Stuttgart city council voted on Thursday by a narrow margin to approve a €340 million expansion of the U-Bahn network, extending Line U12 north to Stammheim — a decision that came just hours after the ruling CDU and Greens coalition narrowly survived a no-confidence motion tabled by the SPD. Transport operator SSB confirmed that construction is expected to begin in March 2026, with the new stretch adding four stations and serving an estimated 28,000 passengers daily.

The Flemish parliament voted narrowly on Thursday to approve a controversial housing reform bill that would cap rent increases at 2.5 percent annually, with 72 members backing the measure, 61 opposing it, and four abstaining — a result that Nieuw-Vlaamse Alliantie hailed as a generational shift in Flemish social policy, even as opposition leaders from Vooruit warned the legislation would do little to ease pressure on working families in Antwerp and Ghent.

Commuters on Stockholm's blue metro line faced severe delays for the third consecutive morning on Wednesday after a signalling fault near Kungsträdgården station forced SL to reduce train frequency to one service every eighteen minutes during peak hours, stranding an estimated 47,000 passengers. The operator said engineers had identified a faulty relay unit and expected full service to resume by Thursday evening.

Der Stadtrat von Freiburg im Breisgau hat am Donnerstagabend mit knapper Mehrheit beschlossen, das städtische Wohnbauprogramm um 45 Millionen Euro aufzustocken — 24 Stimmen dafür, 19 dagegen, bei drei Enthaltungen. Bürgermeisterin Klara Svendt (Grüne) bezeichnete das Ergebnis als „überfälliges Signal für bezahlbaren Wohnraum", während der Fraktionsvorsitzende der CDU, Tobias Rennert, vor einer „unverantwortlichen Verschuldung der Stadt" warnte. Die SPD und die Grünen hatten den Antrag gemeinsam eingebracht; FDP und AfD stimmten geschlossen dagegen.

Die Frankfurter Buchmesse eröffnet am 15. Oktober ihre 76. Ausgabe auf dem Messegelände Frankfurt und zieht erfahrungsgemäß über 300.000 Besucher aus mehr als 100 Ländern an. In diesem Jahr fungiert Italien als Gastland; die renommierte Verlegerin Carla Spinetti wird die Eröffnungsrede halten. Der Börsenvereins des Deutschen Buchhandels rechnet mit rund 4.000 ausstellenden Verlagen, darunter erstmals ein Gemeinschaftsstand der baltischen Staaten.

Oslo's Nationaltheatret station will close for emergency track repairs from 14 to 21 July, forcing tens of thousands of daily commuters onto replacement bus services along the Holmenkollen Line, just as the city's celebrated Øya Festival prepares to welcome an estimated 85,000 visitors to Tøyen Park over the same week. Ruter, the regional transit authority, has urged festival-goers to allow an additional 40 minutes of travel time and has coordinated with organisers to extend replacement bus frequency to midnight on concert nights. Festival director Annelise Varg called the timing "deeply unfortunate" but confirmed that the programme — headlined by British indie acts and a string of Nordic jazz ensembles — would proceed as planned, with gates opening on 15 July.

Leinster Rugby handed Ulster a bruising 34–17 defeat at the Aviva Stadium in Dublin on Saturday evening, extending their unbeaten run in the United Rugby Championship to eleven matches. Flanker Ciarán Doyle was instrumental throughout, crossing for two tries and setting up a third with a break that split the Ulster defence wide open. A crowd of 48,500 roared the hosts through a dominant second half that Ulster, despite a spirited opening twenty minutes, could never quite recover from.

Die Frankfurter Buchmesse eröffnet am 15. Oktober ihre 76. Ausgabe auf dem Messegelände Frankfurt und erwartet in diesem Jahr nach Angaben des Börsenvereins des Deutschen Buchhandels rund 95.000 Fachbesucher aus aller Welt. Ehrengast ist in diesem Jahr Kanada, und die kanadische Schriftstellerin Miriam Delacroix wird die offizielle Eröffnungsrede halten. Tickets für den Publikumstag am letzten Wochenende sind ab 18 Euro erhältlich.

The Frankfurter Buchmesse opens its 76th edition on Wednesday, drawing publishers, agents, and readers from more than 100 countries to the Messe Frankfurt fairgrounds for five days of signings, panel debates, and rights negotiations. This year's guest of honour is Italy, with a pavilion curated by Chiara Vettorino and an opening address scheduled from novelist Marco Pellegrini. Ticket prices start at €18 for a single day.

The Wiener Festwochen opens its 72nd edition on Friday at the Burgtheater, with Syrian-Austrian director Lara Khalil staging a new adaptation of Brecht's "The Good Person of Szechwan" that has already drawn comparisons to the landmark 1997 production that inaugurated her career. Tickets are priced at €45, and organisers expect a full house of some 1,300 on opening night.

The Reykjavík City Council voted by a narrow margin on Thursday to approve a sweeping climate zoning ordinance that would ban new fossil-fuel heating installations in all residential buildings constructed after 2027, with 11 councillors in favour, 8 opposed, and 2 abstentions. The measure, championed by the Left-Green Movement and reluctantly backed by the Independence Party's two swing votes, was fiercely resisted by the Progressive Party, whose spokesperson Birna Sigurðardóttir warned that the policy would place an "unbearable burden" on lower-income households in the city's outer districts. Mayor Jónatan Einarsson, who abstained from the procedural vote but praised the outcome in a brief statement afterwards, called it "a defining moment for how northern capitals choose to lead on the climate."

The Scottish Parliament voted narrowly on Thursday to approve a landmark package of social care reforms backed by the Scottish National Party, with 65 members in favour and 58 against, after a bruising three-hour debate in which Labour MSPs accused the governing party of underfunding the proposals by nearly £400 million. Finance Secretary Catriona Drummond called the vote "a turning point for dignity in old age," while Conservative leader Alistair Muir warned that the legislation would collapse within two years without a credible funding formula.

Die Kunsthalle Bremen eröffnet am kommenden Freitag eine umfassende Retrospektive des flämischen Malers Dirk Vanderhaegen, die rund 140 Gemälde und Druckgrafiken aus sechs Jahrzehnten seines Schaffens vereint. Kuratorin Lena Marthaler hat die Schau unter dem Titel „Licht und Vergänglichkeit" konzipiert und dabei erstmals mehrere Leihgaben aus dem Museo del Prado sowie aus Privatsammlungen in Amsterdam zusammengeführt. Die Ausstellung läuft bis zum 18. Mai 2025 und ist täglich von zehn bis achtzehn Uhr geöffnet; der Eintritt beträgt 14 Euro.

Midfielder Catalina Vreeland scored twice in the opening twenty minutes as FC Turbine Potsdam dismantled Werder Bremen 4–1 at the Karl-Liebknecht-Stadion on Sunday, extending their unbeaten run in the Frauen-Bundesliga to eleven matches. Bremen's consolation came from a late Josefa Nkrumah penalty, but it was never going to be enough on a day when Potsdam's pressing game was simply too relentless for the visitors to handle.

Hammarby IF edged Djurgårdens IF 2–1 in a tense Stockholm derby at Tele2 Arena on Saturday evening, with midfielder Sofía Lindqvist converting a curling free kick in the 88th minute to seal all three points before a crowd of 22,415. The victory lifts Hammarby to second place in the Damallsvenskan standings, four points behind leaders Rosengård with six fixtures remaining.

The Reykjavík Art Museum opens its long-anticipated retrospective of Icelandic painter Sigríður Magnúsdóttir on Friday, spanning four decades of her luminous, large-format oil canvases across three floors of the Hafnarhús building — an exhibition that curator Björn Eiríksson has described as "the most ambitious solo show this institution has mounted in a generation." Tickets are priced at 2,500 Icelandic króna, and the retrospective runs through 14 September.

ÖBB has confirmed that cross-border rail services between Salzburg and Munich will be suspended from 14 March through 19 March while engineers replace a deteriorating rail bridge over the Salzach river — an infrastructure bottleneck that has troubled planners since at least 2019. During the six-day closure, an estimated 38,000 passengers will be redirected onto replacement coach services operated jointly by ÖBB and Deutsche Bahn. Travellers are advised to allow an additional 55 minutes for each journey.

Tens of thousands of supporters heading to Saturday's Scottish Premiership clash between Hibernian and Rangers at Easter Road were caught off guard when Lothian Buses suspended all services on the Leith corridor from 13:00 until at least 18:30 after a burst water main on Easter Road itself left the street impassable; the operator urged fans to use the Edinburgh Trams Line 1 to York Place and walk the remaining distance. Despite the chaos outside the stadium, the match itself proved a thriller, with Hibs forward Callum Drennan scoring a late equaliser to secure a 2–2 draw in front of a sold-out crowd of 20,312.

The Barbican Centre will host the European premiere of "Hollow Meridian," a large-scale video installation by Lisbon-based artist Catarina Ferreira Neves, opening on 14 March and running through 2 April. The work, which spans three interconnected galleries and immerses visitors in a 72-minute loop of footage shot across the Atacama Desert, was curated by Dominic Ashworth-Lyle, head of visual arts at the Barbican. Tickets are priced at £12 per adult, and a free public lecture by Neves is scheduled for 21 March.

Dundee United came from behind to defeat Hibernian 3–2 in a breathless Scottish Premiership clash at Tannadice Park on Saturday, with midfielder Cormac Shields netting a stoppage-time winner to send the home crowd into raptures. A crowd of 9,412 witnessed what many described as the most dramatic derby of the season, as Hibernian twice led before United's second-half fightback — capped by a sublime curling effort from Shields in the 94th minute — turned the tie on its head. Hibs manager Priya Strathmore cut a frustrated figure at full time, insisting that her side had deserved at least a point from the encounter.

The Reykjavík Art Museum opens its long-anticipated retrospective of Icelandic sculptor Bergþór Sigurðsson on Friday, bringing together more than 140 works spanning four decades of the artist's career — from his early bronze abstractions to the monumental glacial-resin installations that earned him a Turner Prize nomination in 2019. Curated by Freyja Eiríksdóttir, the exhibition runs through 15 March and is expected to draw visitors from across Scandinavia and beyond.

The Reykjavík City Council voted narrowly on Thursday to approve a sweeping housing affordability package, with 11 councillors in favour and 8 opposed, after nearly four hours of fractious debate in which the opposition Progressive Alliance accused the ruling Social Democrats of circumventing standard public consultation procedures. Deputy Mayor Sigríður Halldórsdóttir, who steered the bill through committee, called the outcome "a hard-won step toward making this city liveable for working families," while Progressive Alliance floor leader Benedikt Óskarsson vowed to challenge the measure before the national ombudsman.

Der Wiener Gemeinderat hat am Donnerstag mit 54 zu 37 Stimmen bei zwei Enthaltungen beschlossen, die städtische Kulturförderung für das Jahr 2025 um 8,2 Millionen Euro aufzustocken – ein Beschluss, der unmittelbar dem neu eröffneten Internationalen Filmfestival Wien zugutekommen soll, das seit Freitag im Gartenbaukino läuft und noch bis zum 2. Februar Werke aus über vierzig Ländern zeigt. Kulturstadträtin Irene Wollhardt sprach von einem „klaren Bekenntnis zum lebendigen Kulturleben der Stadt", während die Opposition unter Führung der FPÖ die Ausgaben als unverantwortlich bezeichnete. Das Festival, das von der Vereinigung Österreichischer Filmschaffender organisiert wird, präsentiert in diesem Jahr unter der künstlerischen Leitung von Markus Fendl rund 120 Lang- und Kurzfilme und erwartet mehr als 18.000 Besucherinnen und Besucher.

The Salzburg provincial parliament approved a sweeping housing-subsidy reform by a margin of 28 votes to 14 on Thursday, with three members abstaining, after nearly five hours of heated debate in which the opposition Freiheitliche Partei Österreichs accused the governing ÖVP-Grüne coalition of favouring urban renters at the expense of rural homeowners. Regional deputy Magdalena Traunsteiner, who piloted the bill through committee, called the result "a historic step toward affordable living in the Alpine provinces," while FPÖ floor leader Benedikt Haslauer vowed to challenge the legislation before the constitutional court.

The Scottish Parliament voted narrowly on Thursday to pass a motion of no confidence in Regional Transport Minister Callum Dreich, with 67 members backing the motion against 61 opposed and four abstentions, following weeks of bitter cross-party recrimination over the collapse of the A9 dualling programme. The SNP government, which had staked considerable political capital on completing the corridor upgrade by 2025, now faces mounting pressure from both Scottish Labour and the Scottish Conservatives to replace Dreich before the summer recess.

The Barbican Centre announced this week that the Polish composer and pianist Marta Wierzbicka will headline a three-night residency beginning on 14 March, performing works drawn from her recently released album "Zima" alongside pieces by Arvo Pärt and Leoš Janáček. The intimate series, curated by the Barbican's own Alistair Drummond, is expected to draw audiences of roughly 900 each evening to the hall's main auditorium, with tickets priced at £45.

Rowan Szymański delivered a masterclass at the Świętokrzyski Arena on Saturday, scoring twice in the final twelve minutes to hand Korona Kielce a stunning 3–1 victory over Wisła Kraków in their Ekstraklasa derby, watched by a sell-out crowd of 15,200.

Der Stadtrat von Freiburg im Breisgau hat am Donnerstagabend mit knapper Mehrheit beschlossen, die Straßenbahnlinie 5 bis zum Jahr 2031 zu verlängern — ein zentrales Vorhaben der rot-grünen Koalition, das nach monatelangem Ringen nun formell besiegelt wurde. Für den Beschluss stimmten 28 Ratsmitglieder, dagegen votierten 19, bei drei Enthaltungen. Bürgermeisterin Karoline Veit zeigte sich erleichtert: „Heute haben wir eine Weichenstellung für eine klimagerechtere Stadt getroffen." Die CDU-Fraktion hatte bis zuletzt auf eine Verschiebung des Projekts gedrängt, scheiterte jedoch an der Geschlossenheit der Koalitionspartner SPD und Grüne.

Lukas Brenntner's brace in the final twelve minutes salvaged a nervy 2–1 victory for FC Ingolstadt 04 over visiting Hansa Rostock at Audi Sportpark on Saturday, keeping Ingolstadt level on points with the 3. Liga summit with just four fixtures remaining. A sparse crowd of 6,200 watched Brenntner poke home a 79th-minute equaliser before burying a left-footed volley in the 88th to send the home faithful into relief-tinged delirium.

Commuters on the S-Bahn network in Hamburg faced severe disruptions on Thursday after a signalling fault near Dammtor station forced Deutsche Bahn to suspend services on the S1 and S3 lines for nearly six hours, leaving an estimated 47,000 passengers stranded or redirected to replacement bus services. Engineers worked through the morning to isolate the fault, which engineers traced to a degraded relay component installed during last year's infrastructure overhaul. Deutsche Bahn apologised for the inconvenience and said full services were restored by early afternoon.

The Stormont Assembly voted narrowly on Thursday to approve a landmark cross-border trade facilitation agreement brokered between the Northern Ireland Executive and Dublin, with 54 members backing the motion and 43 voting against, amid fierce opposition from the Democratic Unionist Party. Deputy First Minister Caoimhe Ó Briain hailed the result as "a practical step forward for businesses and families on both sides of the border," while DUP leader Graeme Forsythe warned that his party would challenge the measure in the courts. Sinn Féin and the Alliance Party provided the bulk of the votes in favour.

Benedikt Fallås delivered a masterclass from the tee box as Sweden edged Norway 3–1 in a rain-soaked Nordic Cup clash at Ullna Golf Club outside Stockholm on Saturday, with the visitor's lone reply coming from a composed chip-in by Sigrid Haakonsen on the fourteenth hole before Fallås sealed matters with a birdie on eighteen in front of an enthusiastic crowd of 4,200.

Commuters across Greater Manchester faced severe disruption on Monday after Avanti West Coast announced the suspension of all express services between Manchester Piccadilly and London Euston until at least Wednesday evening, citing a signalling fault detected near Crewe that engineers have so far been unable to isolate. Metrolink tram services, operated by KeolisAmey, reported a surge of roughly 34,000 additional passengers on Monday alone as travellers scrambled for alternatives. Rail replacement coaches — sourced at short notice — were described by passengers as wholly inadequate for the volume of demand.

The Scottish Parliament voted by a narrow margin on Thursday to reject a proposed council tax freeze extension, with 65 members voting against the measure and 58 in favour, after a fractious three-hour debate in which SNP finance spokesperson Catriona Begg accused the Scottish Conservatives of "wilful obstruction dressed up as fiscal prudence." The Scottish Greens, whose support the government had counted on, abstained en bloc following a last-minute dispute over climate funding provisions embedded in the bill.

Oslo's city council narrowly approved a landmark NOK 4.2 billion expansion of the Fornebubanen metro line on Thursday, with 35 votes in favour and 28 against, after hours of heated debate over financing and neighbourhood disruption. The vote, championed by Arbeiderpartiet and backed by the Miljøpartiet De Grønne, will extend the line from Majorstuen to Fornebu, adding six new stations and an estimated 65,000 daily passengers to the network. Ruter, the regional transit authority, confirmed that construction is set to begin in March 2026 and is expected to last roughly four years.

Die Wiener Linien haben angekündigt, dass die U-Bahn-Linie U4 zwischen den Stationen Karlsplatz und Hütteldorf vom 14. Juli bis zum 3. August 2025 vollständig gesperrt wird, um dringend notwendige Gleiserneuerungen und die Modernisierung von Signalanlagen durchzuführen. Rund 87.000 Fahrgäste täglich sind von der Maßnahme betroffen; als Ersatz werden Shuttlebusse auf der gesamten Strecke eingerichtet. „Wir bitten die Fahrgäste um Verständnis – die Arbeiten sind unerlässlich für einen sicheren Betrieb", sagte Pressesprecherin Mirela Horvath.

Das Wiener Konzerthaus eröffnet am 14. März seine diesjährige Kammermusik-Reihe „Stimmen der Stille" mit einem Abend, der ganz dem zeitgenössischen Streichquartett gewidmet ist. Auf dem Programm stehen Werke von Komponistinnen aus dem deutschsprachigen Raum; als Hauptensemble tritt das Amaryllis Quartett auf, das zuletzt beim Heidelberger Frühling für Furore gesorgt hatte. Der Eintritt kostet zwischen 18 und 46 Euro, und das Konzerthaus rechnet mit rund 720 Besucherinnen und Besuchern im Mozartsaal.

Sydney's transport authority confirmed Friday that the T4 Eastern Suburbs & Illawarra Line will face partial suspensions between Bondi Junction and Cronulla across three consecutive weekends beginning August 9, as crews replace aging track infrastructure beneath the harbour crossing at Sydenham. Transport for NSW estimates roughly 47,000 commuters will be affected each weekend, with replacement bus services R4 and R4X bridging the gap during the closure window.

The Oslo Philharmonic Orchestra will open its centenary season at the Konserthuset on 14 September with a programme of works by Sibelius and Grieg, but concertgoers travelling by public transport should plan ahead: Ruter has announced a partial suspension of tram lines 12 and 19 from 10 September through 21 September while crews replace ageing track infrastructure in the Majorstuen junction, a project valued at approximately 47 million kroner and expected to affect some 38,000 daily passengers.

Commuters across Greater Manchester faced significant disruption on Thursday after Avanti West Coast and Northern Rail both suspended services on the Piccadilly–Liverpool corridor following the discovery of a fractured overhead line near Warrington Bank Quay station. Metrolink tram services absorbed much of the overflow, but network officials warned that an estimated 47,000 passengers would face delays of up to three hours before full restoration of services, expected by Friday evening at the earliest.

The FA Cup fourth-round replay between Millwall and Sheffield Wednesday drew 17,842 fans to The Den on Tuesday evening, with Millwall's Dariusz Kowalski heading home a stoppage-time winner to seal a 2–1 victory — but thousands of supporters faced significant disruption on their way home after Transport for London suspended all District line services south of Earl's Court following an emergency track inspection, leaving commuters stranded for nearly two hours.

Tens of thousands of supporters heading to Saturday's Bundesliga clash between Borussia Dortmund and Bayer Leverkusen at Signal Iduna Park were met with severe disruptions on the S-Bahn network after a signalling fault near Dortmund Hauptbahnhof forced the suspension of S1 and S4 services for nearly three hours, with Deutsche Bahn estimating that around 34,000 passengers were affected. On the pitch, the drama was no less intense: goals from Konstantinos Papadakis and a late header by Miroslav Šebek sealed a 2–1 victory for the hosts in front of a sell-out crowd of 81,365, keeping Dortmund within striking distance at the top of the Bundesliga table.

Górnik Zabrze edged out Lechia Gdańsk 2–1 at the Stadion im. Ernesta Pohla on Saturday evening in a tense Ekstraklasa encounter that drew 21,400 supporters despite the bitter January cold. Midfielder Tomasz Wierzbicki opened the scoring in the 34th minute before Lechia's Rafał Okonkwo levelled shortly after the break, only for substitute forward Paweł Dziedzic to settle the match with a curling effort ten minutes from time.

Vienna's U-Bahn operator Wiener Linien has confirmed that a seven-week partial suspension of the U4 line will begin on 14 April, with services between Hütteldorf and Längenfeldgasse halted to allow urgent replacement of aging signalling infrastructure along the western corridor. Passengers are advised to use the ring-road tram routes as substitutes, though officials concede that an estimated 87,000 daily commuters will face significant delays during the works period, which is scheduled to conclude on 2 June.

Die Frankfurter Buchmesse eröffnet am 15. Oktober ihre 76. Ausgabe in der Messe Frankfurt und erwartet in diesem Jahr über 4.000 Aussteller aus mehr als 100 Ländern. Als Gastland tritt Slowenien auf, dessen Literatur durch eine eigens kuratierte Ausstellung sowie zahlreiche Lesungen und Podiumsdiskussionen in den Vordergrund gerückt wird. Die Schriftstellerin Maja Novak, die Lyriker Tomaž Šalamun-Preisträger Dejan Koban sowie die Verlegerin Ana Werschitz gehören zu den prominentesten slowenischen Gästen. Messedirektorin Claudia Eberhardt betonte bei der Vorabpressekonferenz, die Messe wolle in Zeiten globaler Verunsicherung ein „unerschütterliches Bekenntnis zur Offenheit des Wortes" setzen. Die Veranstaltung läuft bis zum 19. Oktober.

Copenhagen's Parken Stadium hosted the decisive Group B clash between Denmark and Finland on Friday evening, drawing an attendance of 38,400, with a late strike from midfielder Rasmus Elkjær securing a 2–1 victory for Denmark. The surge of fans travelling to the ground, however, exposed persistent weaknesses in the city's rail infrastructure: the S-Tog line connecting København H to Østerport was suspended for nearly three hours after a signalling fault overloaded the system, leaving an estimated 22,000 passengers stranded and forcing DSB to deploy emergency bus replacements along the affected corridor.

Dynamo Kyiv stunned host club Fenerbahçe 3–1 at Şükrü Saracoğlu Stadium on Thursday evening in a commanding Europa League group-stage display, with striker Pavlo Hrynchenko scoring twice in the second half to seal the result before a crowd of 41,200.

A stoppage-time header from midfielder Caitríona Ní Bhriain secured a dramatic 2–1 victory for Shelbourne FC over Galway United at Tolka Park on Sunday, keeping the Dublin club two points clear at the top of the SSE Airtricity Women's Premier Division with just four matchdays remaining. An estimated 3,200 supporters witnessed the turnaround, with Galway having led for much of the second half following a composed finish from striker Aoife Callanan in the 61st minute.

Frankfurt's public transit authority RMV has confirmed that weekend engineering works on S-Bahn lines S3 and S4 will force a full suspension of services between Darmstadt Hauptbahnhof and Frankfurt Süd from Saturday, 19 July through Sunday, 20 July, with replacement bus services running at reduced frequency. Approximately 34,000 passengers are expected to be affected over the two-day closure, which is required to complete trackbed reinforcement works ahead of the autumn timetable change.

Wer durch das alte Hafenviertel von Marseille spaziert, stößt unweigerlich auf die Spuren einer Stadt, die sich seit Jahrzehnten zwischen industriellem Erbe und kultureller Erneuerung bewegt: verfallene Lagerhallen neben frisch renovierten Galerien, ein Straßenbahnnetz, das die Stadtplaner seit Jahren zu erweitern debattieren, und Graffiti, die mal als Vandalismus, mal als Kunst verhandelt werden. Die Frage, ob solche Viertel durch Investitionen gerettet oder durch sie zerstört werden, beschäftigt Kulturjournalisten wie Nathalie Ferraud ebenso wie Stadtpolitiker in ganz Südfrankreich.

Vor 14.200 Zuschauern in der Merkur Spiel-Arena setzte sich Fortuna Düsseldorf am Samstag mit 3:1 gegen den SC Paderborn 07 durch und festigte damit seinen zweiten Tabellenplatz in der 2. Bundesliga. Den entscheidenden Doppelpack erzielte Stürmer Radosław Kempka in der 61. und 78. Minute, nachdem Paderborns Verteidiger Timo Söllner kurz vor der Halbzeit den zwischenzeitlichen Ausgleich erzielt hatte.

The Reykjavik City Council voted narrowly on Thursday to approve a new housing policy aimed at curbing short-term rental platforms, with 13 councillors in favour, 9 against, and 2 abstentions — a result that the governing coalition of the Social Democrats and the Left-Green Movement hailed as a breakthrough for long-term residents struggling with soaring rents. Opposition leader Þóra Magnúsdóttir of the Independence Party called the measure "a heavy-handed intervention in the private market" and vowed to challenge it at the national level. The vote, held at Ráðhúsið, caps months of increasingly fractious debate within the chamber.

Das Wiener Burgtheater gilt seit Jahrzehnten als eine der renommiertesten Bühnen des deutschsprachigen Raums, und Kulturkritiker streiten bis heute darüber, ob die Intendanz von Claus Peymann in den 1980er und 1990er Jahren die Hochzeit des Hauses markierte oder ob die nachfolgenden Direktoren das Ensemble ebenso nachhaltig geprägt haben. Welche Rolle das Theater in einer Stadt wie Wien für den gesellschaftlichen Zusammenhalt spielt, bleibt eine Frage, die weit über Spielpläne und Förderbudgets hinausgeht.

Das Stadtfest Graz feierte am Wochenende seinen Auftakt mit einem Freilichtkonzert der Wiener Philharmoniker auf dem Hauptplatz, das rund 12.000 Besucher anzog — tags darauf lieferte der SK Sturm Graz im Merkur Arena einen 3:1-Sieg gegen den FK Austria Wien, womit die Grazer ihre Tabellenführung in der Bundesliga eindrucksvoll verteidigten. „Dieses Wochenende hat gezeigt, wie lebendig unsere Stadt ist", sagte Bürgermeisterin Claudia Fercher nach dem Abpfiff.

Die Frankfurter Buchmesse eröffnet am 15. Oktober ihre 76. Ausgabe auf dem Messegelände Frankfurt und versammelt in diesem Jahr über 4.200 Aussteller aus mehr als 100 Ländern. Als Gastland tritt Slowenien auf, dessen Verlage und Autoren in einer eigens gestalteten Pavillon-Schau präsentiert werden. Messedirektorin Astrid Lampe bezeichnete die diesjährige Ausgabe als „ein Fest der literarischen Vielfalt" und hob besonders die Beteiligung unabhängiger Buchhandlungen aus dem deutschsprachigen Raum hervor. Die Messe läuft bis zum 19. Oktober.

Malmö FF ended Djurgårdens IF's four-match winning run with a composed 2–1 victory at Eleda Stadion on Saturday evening, courtesy of a clinical brace from striker Teodor Ångström that left the visiting side unable to find a response after the hour mark. The result keeps Malmö four points clear at the top of the Allsvenskan table with six rounds remaining.

Commuters on the Piccadilly line faced lengthy delays on Thursday morning after a points failure near Hammersmith station brought services to a near standstill for close to three hours, with Transport for London estimating that roughly 47,000 passengers were affected during the peak period. TfL engineers were on site by 06:15 and managed to restore full services by 09:30, though knock-on disruptions persisted well into the late morning. The operator apologised and advised travellers to use the District line or local bus routes as alternatives while repairs were under way.

The Reykjavík Art Museum opens its much-anticipated winter exhibition "Fractured Horizons" on Friday 14 February, bringing together seventeen Nordic artists whose large-format oil paintings and mixed-media installations explore the psychological landscape of arctic isolation. Curator Sigríður Magnúsdóttir has spent three years assembling the show, which will run through 30 March across the museum's Hafnarhús building. Admission is set at 2,500 ISK for adults, and a series of free public lectures will accompany the programme every Thursday evening.

The Vienna Philharmonic's much-anticipated run of Mahler concerts at the Musikverein kicks off on Friday, drawing audiences from across Europe — but rail travellers heading into the city should plan ahead, as ÖBB has confirmed that the Westbahn main line will be suspended between Salzburg and St. Pölten from Friday through Sunday for urgent track-renewal works affecting an estimated 34,000 passengers, with replacement bus services laid on throughout the closure period.

Im packenden Halbfinale des DFB-Pokals setzte sich Eintracht Frankfurt am Dienstagabend mit 3:1 gegen den SC Freiburg durch und buchte damit das Ticket für das Endspiel in Berlin. Vor 48.200 Zuschauern im ausverkauften Deutsche Bank Park verwandelte Stürmer Luca Waldmann zwei Tore in der zweiten Hälfte, während Mittelfeldspieler Oren Shavit den zwischenzeitlichen Ausgleich der Gäste egalisierte. Freiburg-Trainer Mats Engström zeigte sich nach dem Abpfiff enttäuscht, lobte jedoch die Leistung seiner Mannschaft über die gesamte Saison.

The city of Gothenburg celebrated a rare cultural-sporting weekend when the Gothenburg Symphony Orchestra's open-air summer concert at Slottsskogen Park drew an estimated 14,000 spectators on Friday evening, before the attention of the entire region shifted the following afternoon to Gamla Ullevi, where IFK Göteborg edged Malmö FF 2–1 in a tightly contested Allsvenskan derby that kept some 18,500 fans on their feet until the final whistle. Striker Oskar Lindqvist scored both home goals, while conductor Annika Söderström had given a rapturous account of Sibelius and Nielsen under the July sky the night before.

Die Österreichischen Bundesbahnen haben ab Montag den grenzüberschreitenden Nachtzugbetrieb zwischen Wien Hauptbahnhof und Warschau Centralna offiziell aufgenommen. Die neue Verbindung, für die ÖBB gemeinsam mit PKP Intercity insgesamt zwölf modernisierte Schlafwagen in Dienst stellt, hält unterwegs in Brünn, Ostrava und Krakau. Fahrgäste zahlen für ein Liegebett im Zweibettkabinen-Segment ab 49 Euro, deutlich weniger als vergleichbare Flugverbindungen. Verkehrsministerin Klaudia Tanner begrüßte die Eröffnung als „wichtigen Schritt für den klimafreundlichen Reiseverkehr innerhalb Europas".

Benedikt Wałęsa's brace in the dying minutes hauled Górnik Zabrze back from the brink to claim a dramatic 3–2 victory over Raków Częstochowa at Stadion im. Ernesta Pohla on Saturday, lifting Górnik to fifth place in the PKO BP Ekstraklasa standings ahead of a packed midweek fixture schedule. An attendance of 11,240 roared the home side on as Łukasz Ferreira had given the visitors a two-goal cushion before the interval.

The Frankfurter Buchmesse opens its doors on Wednesday for a five-day run that organisers expect to draw more than 300,000 visitors, with Norwegian literature taking centre stage as Guest of Honour this year. Among the most anticipated appearances is debut novelist Sigrid Nøstvold, whose first novel "Havets Stillhet" will be presented at a packed reading in the Harmonie-Saal on Friday evening before its international release. The fair's programme director, Lena Morbach, described the Norwegian pavilion as "unlike anything we have staged in a decade."

The city of Gothenburg will host a rare double bill this coming weekend: the Swedish Chamber Orchestra takes the stage at Konserthuset on Saturday evening for a programme of Nordic premieres curated by conductor Linnea Björkqvist, while just across the Göta älv river, the women's football derby between GAIS and Göteborgs FF kicks off at Gamla Ullevi on Sunday afternoon in a Damallsvenskan fixture expected to draw some 6,500 supporters.

The Reykjavík Art Museum opens its long-anticipated retrospective of Icelandic sculptor Dagný Sigurðardóttir on Friday, with works spanning four decades drawn from private collections across Scandinavia and North America. Curator Einar Björnsson has arranged the sixty-three pieces — carved stone, cast bronze, and hand-blown glass — across three floors of the Hafnarhús building, tracing Sigurðardóttir's evolution from austere minimalism to the monumental organic forms that brought her international recognition in the 2010s. Admission is set at 1,800 Icelandic króna, and the exhibition runs through 14 September.

Borussia Dortmund hat am Samstagabend im Signal Iduna Park mit einem überzeugenden 3:1-Sieg gegen den FC Augsburg seine Aufholjagd in der Bundesliga fortgesetzt. Vor 81.365 Zuschauern erzielte Mittelfeldspieler Torben Klessmann zwei Tore in der zweiten Halbzeit, nachdem Stürmer Delano Ferreira den BVB in der 23. Minute erstmals in Führung gebracht hatte. Für Augsburg traf Verteidiger Sönke Prill per Kopfball zum zwischenzeitlichen Ausgleich, doch der Gastgeber ließ sich nicht beirren.

The Scottish Parliament voted narrowly on Thursday to extend free prescriptions to all residents regardless of income, with the Scottish National Party and Scottish Greens combining to push the measure through by 68 votes to 55, while Conservative MSPs led the opposition charge and two Labour members broke ranks to abstain. Health Secretary Catriona Fergusson called the result "a watershed moment for universal healthcare in Scotland," though shadow health spokesperson Alistair Drummond warned that the policy would place unsustainable pressure on NHS Scotland's already strained budget.

The Frankfurter Buchmesse opens its doors on Wednesday for its 76th edition, drawing publishers, literary agents, and readers from more than 100 countries to the Messe Frankfurt fairgrounds for five days of panel discussions, rights negotiations, and author readings. This year's guest of honour is Italy, whose pavilion — curated by Chiara Valsecchi and Dario Ferrante of the Istituto per il Commercio Estero — spans two halls and foregrounds contemporary voices alongside Renaissance manuscripts. Tickets are priced at €18 for a single-day admission.

Der Architekt Wendelin Haßler hat in einem langen Essay für die Frankfurter Allgemeine Zeitung beschrieben, wie das neue Velodrom am Stadtrand von Leipzig — dessen Baukosten auf rund 47 Millionen Euro geschätzt werden — sowohl als Sportstätte als auch als kulturelles Zentrum fungieren soll, ohne dass bislang ein Eröffnungstermin feststeht.

Die Frankfurter Buchmesse eröffnet am 15. Oktober ihre 76. Ausgabe auf dem Messegelände Frankfurt und versammelt in diesem Jahr mehr als 4.200 Aussteller aus über 100 Ländern. Als Ehrengast tritt Slowenien auf, das seine literarische Vielfalt mit einem eigens kuratierten Programm unter der Leitung von Maja Haderlap präsentiert. Erstmals wird eine eigene Halle ausschließlich für Hörbücher und Podcasts reserviert — ein Schritt, den Messedirektorin Klaudia Viereck als „längst überfällig" bezeichnete.

Northampton Saints edged out Toulouse 24–21 in a bruising Heineken Champions Cup quarter-final at Franklin's Gardens on Saturday evening, with fly-half Declan Moorby kicking seven points off the tee and centre Émile Raverdy crossing for the decisive try in the sixty-eighth minute before a capacity crowd of 15,200.

Commuters on Berlin's S-Bahn network faced significant disruption on Monday after a signalling fault near Ostkreuz station forced S-Bahn Berlin GmbH to suspend services on the S3, S5, and S7 lines for roughly six hours, leaving an estimated 340,000 passengers scrambling for alternative routes during the morning rush. Repair crews worked through midday to restore full operations, and the BVG deployed additional bus bridging services along the affected corridors as a temporary measure.

The Swedish Riksdag narrowly approved a package of austerity measures on Thursday, with 176 votes in favour and 173 against, after weeks of fractious debate over proposed cuts to unemployment benefits and regional healthcare subsidies. Finance Minister Britta Söderholm, speaking from the floor of the chamber in Stockholm, called the result "a difficult but necessary step," while opposition leader Markus Eklund of the Social Democrats vowed to reverse the legislation at the earliest opportunity. The Moderate Party, which anchors the governing coalition, had spent the final days of negotiations lobbying smaller allies to hold the line.

Passengers travelling through central Oslo faced significant delays on Monday after a signal fault brought the Holmenkollbanen line to a standstill for nearly four hours, leaving an estimated 23,000 commuters stranded or diverted onto replacement bus services operated by Ruter. Engineers restored full service by early afternoon, though the operator warned that minor disruptions could persist into the evening peak.

The Flemish parliament in Brussels voted narrowly on Thursday to approve a landmark housing affordability bill championed by the N-VA, with 72 members in favour, 61 against, and 4 abstentions — a result that coalition partner Vooruit hailed as a "once-in-a-generation" step toward curbing runaway rents across the region, though opposition leader Lieselotte Maesen of Groen warned that the measure fell far short of binding rent controls and would do little for the lowest-income households.

Linfield FC edged out Glentoran FC 2–1 in a tense Friday-night Belfast derby at Windsor Park, with a late header from midfielder Ciarán Doherty sealing the points in front of a sold-out crowd of 9,800. The victory lifts Linfield to the top of the NIFL Premiership table heading into the winter break.

The Renfrewshire Council voted narrowly on Thursday evening to reject a proposed rezoning of agricultural land on the outskirts of Paisley for residential development, with 23 councillors opposing the measure, 19 in favour, and 4 abstaining — a result that opposition Conservatives called "a victory for local communities" while the SNP administration conceded it would revisit the proposal in the spring.

The Frankfurter Buchmesse opens its doors on Wednesday for a five-day run at Messe Frankfurt, drawing publishers, agents, and literary enthusiasts from more than 100 countries; this year's Guest of Honour is Slovenia, whose pavilion — curated by Nataša Kramberger and designed in collaboration with the Slovenian Book Agency — promises an unusually rich programme of readings, panel discussions, and illustrated manuscript displays. Tickets for the public days start at €18.

Beim packenden Stadtderby in der 3. Liga trennten sich der SV Wacker Nordhausen und der FC Rot-Weiß Erfurt am Samstagabend im Stadion Nordhausen mit einem torlosen Unentschieden, vor 4.200 Zuschauern. Nordhausens Torwart Benedikt Saalfeld rettete in der 87. Minute mit einer spektakulären Glanzparade das 0:0 für die Gastgeber und verhinderte damit die erste Niederlage der Saison.

Der Wiener Gemeinderat hat am Donnerstagabend mit 54 zu 38 Stimmen bei vier Enthaltungen einem umstrittenen Wohnbaupaket zugestimmt, das den Bau von mindestens 12.000 geförderten Mietwohnungen bis 2030 vorsieht. Die regierende Koalition aus SPÖ und NEOS setzte sich damit knapp gegen die vereinte Opposition von ÖVP, FPÖ und den Grünen durch. Wohnbaustadträtin Karoline Ferstl bezeichnete das Paket als „historischen Schritt für leistbares Wohnen in Wien", während ÖVP-Fraktionschef Markus Doblinger die Finanzierbarkeit des Vorhabens scharf bezweifelte.

Der Stadtrat von Graz hat am Donnerstagabend mit knapper Mehrheit den umstrittenen Haushaltsentwurf für das kommende Jahr verabschiedet: 28 Stimmen stimmten dafür, 24 dagegen, bei drei Enthaltungen. Die ÖVP und die Grünen trugen den Plan gemeinsam, während die SPÖ und die FPÖ geschlossen Nein sagten. Bürgermeisterin Karin Vötterl sprach von einem „wichtigen Signal für die Handlungsfähigkeit der Stadt", wohingegen SPÖ-Fraktionschef Dominik Prauhart den Beschluss als „sozialpolitisches Versagen" bezeichnete.

Beim packenden Viertelfinale der 3. Liga trafen der VfB Oldenburg und der SV Waldhof Mannheim am Dienstagabend im Marschwegstadion aufeinander – vor ausverkauftem Haus entschied Waldhof die Partie mit 3:1 für sich und zog damit in die Runde der letzten Vier ein. Überragender Mann des Abends war Mittelfeldspieler Torsten Graupner, der zwei Treffer erzielte und das Spiel nahezu im Alleingang drehte.

Kaylee Drost crossed the finish line in a time of 2:27:14 to claim victory at the Rotterdam Marathon on Sunday, edging out compatriot Nienke Vahl by a mere eleven seconds in one of the closest women's finishes the race has seen in over a decade. A crowd estimated at 43,000 lined the rain-slicked streets along the Erasmusbrug and through Feijenoord, roaring the pair home through the final kilometre. Race director Tobias Grünfeld called it "an extraordinary display of Dutch distance running."

The Bavarian state parliament narrowly passed a controversial housing reform bill on Thursday, with 97 votes in favour and 89 against, after an overnight session that stretched well past midnight. The legislation, championed by the governing CSU–Freie Wähler coalition, would cap rent increases in Munich and Augsburg at 1.5 per cent annually for a period of five years. Opposition leader Carola Niedermayer of the SPD condemned the measure as "too timid by half," while the Greens' parliamentary spokesman Tobias Fenrich called the cap "a hollow gesture that leaves tens of thousands of renters exposed." A final vote on implementation regulations is expected before the end of the calendar year.

Beim diesjährigen Linzer Kulturfest „Donauklang" eröffnete die Mezzosopranistin Valeria Hrubesch am Freitagabend im Brucknerhaus mit einer umjubelten Uraufführung des Vokalzyklus „Flussgedichte" des Komponisten Markus Sandtner – während wenige Stunden zuvor der LASK im Raiffeisen Arena ein hart erkämpftes 2:1 gegen den FK Austria Wien verbucht hatte, womit der Verein den dritten Tabellenplatz in der ADMIRAL Bundesliga festigte. Rund 1.400 Besucher strömten zum Konzert, das von der Kulturhauptstadt Linz und dem Land Oberösterreich gemeinsam getragen wird und noch bis kommenden Sonntag läuft; der sportliche Erfolg davor lockte immerhin 8.950 Zuschauer in das Stadion.

Die Österreichischen Bundesbahnen haben für das kommende Wochenende eine vollständige Streckensperrung auf der Weststrecke zwischen Salzburg und Linz angekündigt: Von Samstag, dem 14. Juni, bis Montag, dem 16. Juni, wird kein Personenzug verkehren, da dringende Erneuerungsarbeiten an den Oberleitungsanlagen durchgeführt werden müssen. Schätzungsweise 47.000 Reisende sind betroffen; als Ersatz richtet die ÖBB einen Schienenersatzverkehr mit Bussen ein.

The Frankfurter Buchmesse opens its doors on Wednesday for a five-day run that organisers expect to draw more than 300,000 visitors from around the world, with Norwegian literature taking centre stage as Norway serves as the Guest of Honour nation for the first time since 2019. Among the highlights is a keynote lecture by acclaimed novelist Ingrid Solberg-Hauge at the Festhalle on Thursday evening, followed by a sprawling programme of panel discussions, manuscript markets, and readings in German, English, and Norwegian spanning the entire fairground on Ludwig-Erhard-Anlage.

The Reykjavík Art Museum will open "Fractured Horizons," a survey exhibition of new Nordic sculpture curated by Sigríður Björnsdóttir, on 14 March, with works from fourteen artists spanning Iceland, Norway, and Sweden. The show, which runs through 29 June, is expected to draw on the museum's recently expanded east wing and promises an immersive arrangement of large-scale steel and cast-glass installations. Admission has been set at 1,800 ISK for adults, and a public opening lecture by Björnsdóttir herself is scheduled for the first evening.

Leinster edged out Toulouse 24–21 in a bruising Champions Cup quarter-final at the Aviva Stadium on Saturday evening, with flanker Ciarán Doyle crossing for two crucial tries in the final twenty minutes before a sell-out crowd of 51,700.

Die Berliner Verkehrsbetriebe (BVG) haben angekündigt, dass die U-Bahnlinie U5 zwischen den Haltestellen Alexanderplatz und Hönow vom 14. Februar bis zum 2. März 2025 vollständig gesperrt wird, um dringend notwendige Gleiserneuerungen durchzuführen. Für die geschätzten 47.000 täglich betroffenen Fahrgäste wird ein Ersatzverkehr mit Bussen eingerichtet. „Die Arbeiten lassen sich nicht weiter aufschieben", erklärte BVG-Sprecherin Miriam Schlotterbeck auf einer Pressekonferenz am Mittwoch in Berlin.

The Scottish Parliament voted narrowly on Thursday to extend free personal care entitlements to residents under the age of sixty-five, with 68 votes in favour, 55 against, and 4 abstentions — a result that Holyrood observers described as a quiet but consequential victory for the Scottish National Party, which has championed the measure since its reintroduction by Health Secretary Fiona Drummond-Mackay earlier this year.

Die Frankfurter Buchmesse eröffnet am 15. Oktober ihre 76. Ausgabe auf dem Messegelände Frankfurt und versammelt in diesem Jahr erstmals mehr als 4.000 Aussteller aus über 100 Ländern unter einem Dach — ein Rekord, der laut Direktorin Klara Steinbach die anhaltende Strahlkraft des gedruckten Wortes belege.
