The Oslo Philharmonic Orchestra will open its 2025 autumn season with a three-night run of Mahler's Ninth Symphony at the Konserthuset beginning October 3rd, but concertgoers are being warned that ongoing trackwork on Oslo's T-bane Line 6 will severely restrict service between Majorstuen and Jernbanetorget throughout the festival weekend, with operator Ruter estimating that up to 45,000 passengers will face delays or diversions to replacement bus routes.

The Frankfurter Buchmesse opens its doors on Wednesday for a five-day run at Messe Frankfurt, drawing publishers, agents, and readers from more than 100 countries to what remains the world's largest trade fair for books and intellectual property. This year's Guest of Honour is Italy, whose literary delegation — led by author and festival ambassador Serena Cattaneo — will occupy a purpose-built pavilion showcasing contemporary fiction, poetry, and graphic novels in translation. Admission for trade visitors stands at €65 on the first two days, dropping to €18 for the public weekend.

Wegen eines technischen Defekts an einer Weichensteuerung musste die BVG am Dienstagabend den Betrieb auf der U-Bahn-Linie U8 zwischen Hermannstraße und Wittenau für mehrere Stunden vollständig einstellen; rund 34.000 Fahrgäste waren laut Angaben des Unternehmens von den Ausfällen betroffen, während ein Schienenersatzverkehr mit Bussen eingerichtet wurde.

The Reykjavik City Council voted narrowly on Thursday to approve a sweeping rezoning plan for the Grafarholt district, with 11 councillors in favour, 8 against, and 3 abstentions, after nearly four hours of fractious debate during which the opposition Samfylkingin bloc accused the ruling Sjálfstæðisflokkurinn of fast-tracking a developers' charter at the expense of affordable housing. Deputy Mayor Sigríður Ólafsdóttir, who steered the measure through committee, insisted the plan would deliver 2,400 new residential units by 2031 and called on critics to "engage with the facts rather than the headlines."

Der Hamburger Senat hat am Mittwoch mit 74 zu 31 Stimmen einem umstrittenen Finanzierungspaket für die Verlängerung der U5 zugestimmt, die künftig auch den Stadtteil Bramfeld anbinden soll. Bürgermeister Peter Tschentscher bezeichnete das Vorhaben als „Meilenstein für die Verkehrswende", während die CDU-Fraktion das Kostenvolumen von 2,4 Milliarden Euro als unverantwortlich kritisierte. Die Hamburger Hochbahn soll den Betrieb der neuen Strecke übernehmen, deren Eröffnung für Frühjahr 2031 geplant ist; bis dahin werden auf der betroffenen Linie U5 laut Senat rund 80.000 Fahrgäste täglich erwartet.

Leverkusen's Heinz-Rudi Pfaffenberger fired home a 94th-minute equaliser to rescue a 2–2 draw for Bayer Leverkusen against Eintracht Frankfurt at the BayArena on Saturday evening, keeping the hosts' unbeaten Bundesliga run intact in front of a capacity crowd of 30,210.

The city of Gothenburg braced for a packed weekend as the Göteborgs Symfoniker opened its autumn season at Göteborgs Konserthus on Saturday with a sold-out programme of Sibelius and Pärt conducted by Finnish maestro Leena Hämäläinen, drawing an audience of 1,840; just hours earlier, across town at Gamla Ullevi, IFK Göteborg had edged local rivals GAIS 2–1 in a ferocious Allsvenskan derby watched by 19,200 passionate supporters, with striker Marcus Lindqvist netting the decisive goal in the 88th minute.

The Frankfurter Buchmesse opens its 76th edition on Wednesday, with Norwegian literature taking centre stage as this year's guest of honour, drawing publishers, translators, and rights agents from more than 100 countries to the Messe Frankfurt fairgrounds. Organisers expect upwards of 300,000 visitors over the five-day fair, which runs through Sunday. Among the headline speakers is debut novelist Sigrid Vaalberg, whose debut English-language translation, "The Ice Ledger", will be formally launched at Stand C12 in Hall 3.1 on Thursday afternoon.

Die Frankfurter Buchmesse eröffnet am 15. Oktober ihre 76. Ausgabe auf dem Messegelände Frankfurt und erwartet in diesem Jahr rund 95.000 Fachbesucher aus aller Welt. Als Ehrengastland präsentiert sich Slowenien mit einem umfangreichen Programm aus Lesungen, Podiumsgesprächen und Ausstellungen, das vom Slowenischen Buchverband gemeinsam mit dem Goethe-Institut kuratiert wurde. Die Messe dauert bis zum 20. Oktober.

Kristóf Vásárhelyi delivered a masterclass in front of a packed Groupama Aréna on Saturday evening, scoring twice as Ferencváros dismantled visiting Debreceni VSC 4–1 to extend their lead at the top of the OTP Bank Liga to seven points. The home side's third goal — a sweeping counter finished by teenage winger Barnabás Oláh — drew a roar from the 22,000 supporters that rattled the roof of the East Stand.

Třinec Oceláři claimed their third consecutive Extraliga title on Saturday night, edging HC Dynamo Pardubice 3–2 in overtime at the Werk Arena to complete a thrilling seven-game series that had the capacity crowd of 5,200 on their feet from the first drop of the puck. Marek Vašíček, the veteran centre who had been written off by pundits before the play-offs even began, settled the contest at 63:47 with a wrist shot that clipped the far post before nestling into the net — silencing every last doubt about his fitness. It was the kind of championship-winning moment that Třinec fans will replay long into the off-season.

Copenhagen's city council narrowly approved a landmark €2.1 billion expansion of the Metro network on Thursday, with 34 votes in favour and 17 against, after Transport Minister Lena Brøgaard warned that years of chronic overcrowding had made the project unavoidable. The new CityRing extension, which will add nine stations stretching from Nørreport to Valby, is expected to be fully operational by 2031 and will be operated by the Metroselskabet authority. Critics from the Danish People's Party argued the funding would be better directed at road maintenance, but Mayor Sofie Elmgaard hailed the vote as "a decisive step toward a greener, more connected Copenhagen."

For decades, architects and urban historians have debated what the eventual redevelopment of Wembley's industrial fringe might mean for community sport in northwest London — a question that has grown more urgent as the Football Association continues to weigh options for expanding training facilities near Wembley Stadium, and as TfL presses ahead with long-discussed accessibility upgrades to Wembley Park station. No decisions are imminent, councillors on the Brent Borough Council insist, though the conversation has begun to draw in voices from the arts sector who worry that any large-scale construction would imperil the handful of small performance venues still operating in the area.

Vardar Skopje claimed a stunning 31–28 victory over Paris Saint-Germain Handball at the Stark Arena in Belgrade on Saturday evening, handing the French giants their second defeat of the EHF Champions League group stage and sending a clear message to the rest of Europe's elite clubs. Luka Petrović was irresistible in the Vardar goal, posting 14 saves in the second half alone, while Spanish pivot Marcos Alonso Ruiz contributed nine goals from close range. An announced crowd of 9,400 packed the arena, generating an atmosphere that visibly rattled the visiting side from the opening whistle.

Commuters on the U5 and U8 lines in Berlin faced severe disruptions on Thursday after a signalling fault near Alexanderplatz forced the BVG to suspend services for approximately six hours, stranding an estimated 47,000 passengers during the morning rush. Engineers from BVG's maintenance division worked to isolate the fault, which was traced to a corroded relay panel installed in the late 1990s, and partial service was restored by early afternoon. The operator has warned that further short-notice closures on both lines remain possible until a full relay replacement programme — budgeted at €14 million — is completed early next year.

Dundalk FC edged out Bohemian FC 2–1 in a tense League of Ireland Premier Division clash at Oriel Park on Friday evening, with midfielder Ciarán Forde scoring the decisive goal in the 88th minute to send the home faithful into raptures. A crowd of 4,210 witnessed Bohemian's late equaliser cancelled out almost immediately, leaving the visitors pointless after three successive away defeats.

Defending champions Rosenborg BK suffered a shock 1–3 defeat at home to Molde FK at Lerkendal Stadion on Saturday, their heaviest loss in the Eliteserien this season, as striker Tobias Granvold netted twice in the first half to put the visitors firmly in control before substitute Andres Lie sealed the result with a clinical finish seven minutes from time.

Eintracht Braunschweig stunned table-toppers FC Magdeburg 3–1 at the Volksparkstadion on Saturday evening, with striker Lukas Fenneberg netting a brace and midfielder Osei Darkwah adding a third in injury time to hand the hosts their most convincing win of the 2. Bundesliga season. An attendance of 22,400 witnessed what visiting coach Benedikt Rüter conceded was "a thoroughly deserved defeat."

The Frankfurter Buchmesse opens its doors on Wednesday for a five-day run that organizers expect to draw upwards of 300,000 visitors to the Messe Frankfurt exhibition grounds, with Norwegian literature taking centre stage as the guest-of-honour theme. Among the headliners is debut novelist Ingrid Vassbø, whose thriller "Skarven" will receive its international premiere at the Frankfurt Congress Centre on Thursday evening, introduced by Rowohlt Verlag editor-in-chief Matthias Sondergaard. Ticket prices for the public days start at €14.

Lisbon celebrated a remarkable weekend as Fado Alive, the city's annual world-music festival, drew sell-out crowds to the Teatro Nacional de São Carlos on Saturday, while just across the river in Almada, Sporting CP edged Belenenses 2–1 in a tightly contested Primeira Liga fixture that kept 18,400 fans on their feet until the final whistle. Festival director Mafalda Sequeira confirmed that French-Algerian vocalist Yasmine Ouled and veteran guitarist Rui Pimentão headlined a programme spanning three stages, with tickets priced at €35 per session; the afternoon had begun under overcast skies, but neither the weather nor the rival football crowd dampened an atmosphere that felt, by unanimous local account, genuinely electric.

Commuters on the Øresund Line faced lengthy delays on Thursday morning after a signalling fault between Malmö Central and Copenhagen Airport Kastrup brought services to a near-standstill for approximately four hours, with Øresundståg estimating that around 38,000 passengers were affected before normal operations resumed shortly before noon.

The Frankfurter Buchmesse opens its doors on Wednesday for its 76th edition, with Brazil serving as the Guest of Honour country this year. Some 4,200 exhibitors from more than 95 countries are expected to descend on the Messe Frankfurt fairgrounds, and organisers anticipate a record 300,000 visitors over the five-day run. "Brazilian literature has never been more urgently needed on the world stage," said fair director Klaudia Teixeira-Wolff at a press briefing on Monday. The fair, which runs through Sunday, will feature over 3,500 events spanning panel discussions, readings, and rights negotiations.

Stockholm's public transport operator SL confirmed on Thursday that the new Citybanan extension linking Fridhemsplan to Älvsjö will open to commuters on 14 March, adding seven underground stations to the network and bringing an estimated 84,000 additional daily passengers onto the line. The 6.2-kilometre tunnel, completed after years of delays and cost overruns, was delivered at a final contract value of 9.4 billion Swedish kronor. SL chief executive Marita Engström called the opening "a generational step for commuter rail in greater Stockholm."

For decades, the Frankfurter Buchmesse has served as a barometer of the publishing world's anxieties and ambitions, drawing editors, agents, and translators from Seoul to São Paulo into the same sprawling hall at Messe Frankfurt — yet critics have long questioned whether a trade fair of such scale can still claim cultural relevance in an era when digital rights negotiations happen quietly over video calls, and when the most celebrated debut novelists often bypass traditional gatekeepers entirely.

Commuters across Greater Manchester faced significant disruption on Monday after Avanti West Coast engineers discovered a signalling fault near Piccadilly Station, forcing the suspension of all services on the Styal and Macclesfield lines for the entirety of the morning peak. Metrolink tram services absorbed much of the overflow, but Northern Rail warned that approximately 34,000 passengers would still experience delays or cancellations before normal operations resumed by early afternoon.

Commuters on Copenhagen's S-Bane network faced significant disruption on Monday after DSB engineers discovered a signalling fault near Østerport Station, forcing the suspension of Lines A and E between Hellerup and København H for most of the morning rush hour. An estimated 34,000 passengers were affected before partial service resumed shortly after 09:30. DSB apologised for the delays and said repair crews worked through the night to restore full operations by midday.

The Oslo City Council voted on Thursday to allocate 14 million kroner toward a sweeping cultural renewal programme for the Grünerløkka district, a measure championed by the Labour-led majority and backed by the Greens despite vocal opposition from the Progress Party, which argued the funds were better directed at road infrastructure. The vote, clearing by 38 to 19 with four abstentions, directly paves the way for the Oslo International Literature Festival, scheduled to open at Kulturhuset on 3 November, where Norwegian author Sigrid Helland and Polish-Norwegian poet Marta Wiśniewska will headline a week-long programme of readings, panel discussions, and commissioned installations spanning five indoor stages.

The Scottish Parliament voted narrowly on Thursday to pass a landmark climate accountability bill, with 67 members backing the legislation against 56 opposed and four abstentions — a result that First Minister Catriona Dunbar hailed as "a generational turning point" despite fierce resistance from the Scottish Conservative bloc, which argued the targets were economically reckless. The bill, championed by the Scottish Greens and reluctantly backed by the SNP, mandates a 78 per cent reduction in emissions by 2035 and establishes an independent oversight body to monitor government compliance.

Commuters across the Ruhr Valley faced significant disruption on Monday after Deutsche Bahn engineers discovered a hairline fracture in overhead line equipment near Dortmund Hauptbahnhof, forcing the suspension of all RE1 and RE6 services between Dortmund and Duisburg for at least 72 hours. An estimated 34,000 daily passengers were urged to use replacement bus services or divert via S-Bahn lines, though both options added upwards of 40 minutes to typical journey times. Deutsche Bahn said repair crews had been deployed around the clock and that a full resumption of service was expected by Thursday morning.

Kristoffer Dahl struck twice in the final twelve minutes to hand Rosenborg BK a 3–1 victory over Molde FK at Lerkendal Stadion on Saturday, extending their lead at the top of the Eliteserien to seven points with just four rounds remaining. A crowd of 18,340 watched the hosts turn what had been a tense, evenly contested derby into a convincing statement of title intent, with midfielder Amara Kouyaté pulling the strings throughout a dominant second half.

Der Stadtrat von Freiburg im Breisgau hat am Donnerstagabend mit knapper Mehrheit einen umstrittenen Beschluss zur Neugestaltung des städtischen Wohnungsbauförderungsprogramms verabschiedet: 24 Stimmen entfielen auf den Antrag der Grünen und der SPD, 19 Ratsherren stimmten dagegen, und drei enthielten sich. Bürgermeisterin Klaudia Fernsbach erklärte nach der Abstimmung, das Programm werde bis Ende 2026 rund 1.200 neue Sozialwohnungen schaffen. Die CDU-Fraktionsvorsitzende Margit Stollenbeck kritisierte hingegen die vorgesehenen Fördermittel in Höhe von 85 Millionen Euro als „haushalterisch unverantwortlich".

Beim Zweitliga-Duell im Schneetreiben empfing der FC Erzgebirge Aue am Samstagabend den SV Sandhausen im Erzgebirgsstadion und ließ den Gästen aus Baden keine Chance: Doppeltorschütze Lukas Preiß sowie der überragende Mittelfeldstratege Tomáš Hořejší sorgten mit einem 3:1-Endstand vor 8.200 Zuschauern für klare Verhältnisse.

The Barbican Centre will host the European premiere of "Invisible Cartographies," a sprawling multimedia installation by Oslo-based artist Solveig Nærheim, from 14 March to 2 June. Spread across three gallery floors, the work weaves archival photography, generative sound, and hand-stitched textile panels into an immersive meditation on migration and belonging. Tickets are priced at £16 for adults, and the Barbican has confirmed that curator Adaeze Okonkwo oversaw the commission on behalf of Arts Council England.

The Scottish Parliament passed a landmark social care reform bill on Thursday by a margin of 79 votes to 41, with 7 abstentions, after a fractious overnight debate that exposed deep rifts within the governing Scottish National Party over the funding mechanism. The bill, championed by Social Care Minister Fionnuala Dreich and backed by the Scottish Greens, will introduce free personal care for adults under 65 — a provision opponents from Scottish Labour and the Scottish Conservatives condemned as fiscally reckless. "This is a generational shift in how Scotland supports its most vulnerable citizens," Dreich told MSPs in the closing minutes of debate at Holyrood.

The Flemish Parliament voted narrowly on Thursday to approve a sweeping reform of the region's housing subsidy programme, with 71 members backing the measure against 64 opposed and 3 abstentions, after nearly six hours of fractious debate in which opposition benches accused the centre-right coalition of hollowing out protections for low-income tenants. The bill, championed by Housing Minister Lena Verstraeten of Nieuw-Vlaams Alliantie, now passes to the Flemish Government for final signature before the end of the year.

The Frankfurter Buchmesse opens its 76th edition on Wednesday, October 16, with Finnish author Siiri Mäkinen delivering the inaugural lecture at the Festhalle Frankfurt before an audience of roughly 4,200 publishers, agents, and literary critics from more than 100 countries. Mäkinen, whose debut novel has already been translated into seventeen languages, is expected to dominate early conversations around the €25,000 LiBeratur Prize. The fair runs through Sunday, October 20.

Der Stadtrat von Freiburg im Breisgau hat am Donnerstag mit knapper Mehrheit für die Einführung einer Nahverkehrsabgabe gestimmt: 27 Ratsmitglieder sprachen sich dafür aus, 19 dagegen, bei vier Enthaltungen. Die Initiative, die von den Grünen und der SPD gemeinsam eingebracht worden war, sieht vor, dass Unternehmen ab 2026 einen jährlichen Beitrag zur Finanzierung des öffentlichen Nahverkehrs leisten müssen. CDU-Fraktionsvorsitzende Miriam Böhler bezeichnete den Beschluss als „ordnungspolitisch fragwürdig", während Grünen-Stadtrat Lukas Pfeiffer von einem „historischen Schritt für die Verkehrswende" sprach.

The Scottish Parliament voted by a narrow margin on Thursday to reject the SNP government's proposed council tax freeze extension, with 65 members opposing the measure and 58 in favour, as Labour and the Conservatives united in an unusual cross-bench bloc to force a symbolic but stinging defeat on First Minister Catriona Dunbar's administration just weeks before the Holyrood summer recess.

The Helsinki City Council voted 52 to 19 on Thursday to approve a €340 million funding package for the long-delayed western extension of Metro Line M2, with the centre-left coalition led by the Social Democrats pushing the measure through over fierce opposition from the Finns Party. Transport operator HSL confirmed that construction on the four-station stretch linking Matinkylä to Kivenlahti would begin in earnest in March 2025, with full passenger service expected by late 2029; the project is forecast to serve an estimated 78,000 additional daily commuters once operational.

The long-debated question of whether the Barbican Centre should expand its visual arts programming to rival Tate Modern has resurfaced in a report commissioned by the City of London Corporation, though no concrete proposals have yet been tabled. Critics of the idea point to chronic overcrowding on the Central line — the primary route for most visitors arriving from the East End — as an argument against drawing larger audiences to the Silk Street complex before TfL has addressed its ageing rolling stock. Supporters, meanwhile, argue that cultural investment in the area would complement ongoing discussions at City Hall about pedestrianising several streets north of St Paul's Cathedral.

Beim packenden Halbfinale der Österreichischen Wasserball-Meisterschaft im Wiener Brigittauer Stadionbad setzte sich der ASK Linz am Samstagabend mit 9:7 gegen den SC Donau Wien durch und buchte damit das Ticket für das Finale am kommenden Wochenende. Rund 640 Zuschauer verfolgten die hitzige Partie, in der Torwart Benedikt Prammer mit insgesamt sieben Paraden überragte.

Im packenden Halbfinale der 3. Bundesliga Süd bezwang der TSV Dachau den FC Ingolstadt II mit 3:1 vor 2.840 Zuschauern im Dachauer Stadion am Schleißheimer Weg. Die Treffer für den Gastgeber erzielten Benedikt Kraller, Ondřej Novák und Luca Ferretti; der Anschlusstreffer der Gäste gelang Marcus Wehrle in der 71. Minute. Mit diesem Sieg zieht Dachau erstmals seit über einem Jahrzehnt in ein Bundesliga-Finale ein.

Wegen umfangreicher Gleisbauarbeiten auf der S-Bahn-Linie S3 zwischen Frankfurt Hauptbahnhof und Darmstadt Hauptbahnhof wird die Strecke vom 14. bis zum 21. Juli vollständig gesperrt; die RMV-Sprecherin Carola Brandtner verwies betroffene Fahrgäste auf eingerichtete Ersatzbusse. Zeitgleich eröffnet das Städel Museum am 15. Juli die Sonderausstellung „Farbe und Form – Meisterwerke des deutschen Expressionismus", für die Kuratorin Dr. Lena Overbeck nach eigenen Angaben rund 140 Leihgaben aus zwölf Ländern zusammengetragen hat; der Eintritt für Erwachsene beträgt 18 Euro.

Im Spitzenspiel der 2. Bundesliga setzte sich der Hamburger SV am Freitagabend mit 3:1 gegen den 1. FC Kaiserslautern durch und übernahm damit vorübergehend die Tabellenführung. Vor 52.300 Zuschauern im Volksparkstadion erzielte Mittelfeldspieler Jonas Brückner zwei der drei Hamburger Treffer, während Verteidiger Mehmet Yıldırım kurz vor dem Abpfiff den Anschluss für die Gäste schaffte. „Wir haben über weite Strecken überzeugend gespielt", sagte HSV-Trainer Lars Ohlendorf nach dem Abpfiff.

The Frankfurter Buchmesse opened its doors on Wednesday to a record 4,312 exhibitors from 95 countries, with this year's edition centering on Italy as guest of honour — a distinction that brought a cascade of premieres, readings, and panel discussions stretching across five days at the Messe Frankfurt fairgrounds. Italian novelist Carla Vestri delivered the opening keynote to an audience of roughly 8,000 guests, drawing sustained applause when she declared that "literature is the only border that matters." Publishers from Leipzig, Amsterdam, and Toronto reported brisk rights negotiations in the first hours alone.

The Austrian capital braced for severe travel disruptions on Saturday as ÖBB confirmed it would suspend all mainline rail services into Wien Hauptbahnhof from 06:00 to 14:00 following emergency track repairs on the Südbahn corridor — precisely the window during which tens of thousands of fans were expected to converge on the city for the Austrian Bundesliga clash between SK Rapid Wien and FK Austria Wien at Allianz Stadion. The derby, which Rapid won 2–1 in front of an announced crowd of 28,400, prompted Wiener Linien to deploy 22 additional tram and U-Bahn carriages on lines U3 and U4 to absorb the displaced rail passengers, though commuters travelling from Graz and Wiener Neustadt reported waits of up to ninety minutes at Meidling station before securing onward connections.

Commuters on the S-Bahn network in Munich faced severe delays Monday morning after a points failure near Ostbahnhof brought three lines to a standstill for nearly four hours, with Deutsche Bahn estimating that roughly 87,000 passengers were affected before services were restored around midday.

Commuters on the Overground faced severe delays for the third consecutive morning on Wednesday after a signalling fault between Highbury & Islington and Dalston Junction brought services to a near standstill, with Transport for London estimating that roughly 47,000 passengers were affected during the peak hours alone. An TfL spokesperson said engineering teams were working to restore full operations before the evening rush, but offered no firm timeline for resolution.

Midfielder Teodora Vásárhelyi scored twice in the second half as FK Partizan Belgrade edged Hajduk Split 3–2 in a tightly contested Women's Adriatic Cup semifinal at Stadion Čair in Niš on Saturday, setting up a final against Olimpija Ljubljana next weekend.

Die Österreichischen Bundesbahnen (ÖBB) haben ab Montag den grenzüberschreitenden Nachtzug zwischen Wien Hauptbahnhof und Zürich HB wegen dringender Gleissanierungsarbeiten im Abschnitt Feldkirch–Buchs für voraussichtlich drei Wochen eingestellt. Reisende werden gebeten, auf Tagesverbindungen der SBB auszuweichen. Schätzungsweise 4.200 Fahrgäste pro Woche sind von der Unterbrechung betroffen.

Commuters on the S-Bahn network in Munich faced significant delays on Thursday morning after a points failure near Ostbahnhof brought services on lines S2, S4, and S6 to a standstill for nearly three hours, leaving an estimated 47,000 passengers stranded or forced onto replacement bus services arranged by Deutsche Bahn. Engineers from the DB Netz maintenance division reached the site shortly after 06:15 and restored full operations by 09:40, though residual congestion on the central city tunnel persisted well into the afternoon rush.

Der Wiener Gemeinderat hat am Donnerstag mit 54 zu 32 Stimmen bei vier Enthaltungen beschlossen, das Volkskundemuseum Wien für drei Jahre zu sanieren und gleichzeitig ein neues Kulturprogramm aufzulegen. Im Rahmen dieses Beschlusses gab Kulturstadträtin Renata Hofer bekannt, dass das Museum ab dem 12. September mit einer großen Eröffnungsausstellung unter dem Titel „Wurzeln und Wandel" in den provisorischen Räumlichkeiten der Sofiensäle bespielt wird — kuratiert von der Kunsthistorikerin Magdalena Öttl und dem Ethnologen Franz-Josef Kaindl. Die SPÖ und die Grünen stimmten geschlossen für das Vorhaben, während die FPÖ geschlossen dagegen votierte.

Die Münchner Kammerspiele eröffnen am 14. März ihre neue Ausstellung „Zwischenräume", die Installationen und Videoarbeiten von sieben internationalen Künstlerinnen und Künstlern vereint. Kuratorin Lena Vossberg hat die Schau so konzipiert, dass die einzelnen Werke miteinander in Dialog treten – räumlich wie thematisch. Bis zum 2. Mai können Besucherinnen und Besucher die insgesamt 23 Arbeiten täglich zwischen 11 und 20 Uhr besichtigen; der Eintritt beträgt 12 Euro.

The Stormont Assembly voted narrowly on Thursday to approve a motion calling for a formal review of Northern Ireland's water infrastructure funding, with 54 members in favour and 41 against, after a bruising two-hour debate in which Sinn Féin and the Social Democratic and Labour Party clashed repeatedly with the Democratic Unionist Party over how shortfalls should be addressed. The Assembly's Economy Committee chairwoman, Máire Ní Fhaoláin, described the vote as "a first, cautious step towards overdue accountability," while DUP spokesman Aldric Dunbar accused the motion's sponsors of playing politics with essential services.

The Frankfurter Buchmesse opens its doors on Wednesday for a five-day run that organisers expect to draw upwards of 300,000 visitors to the Messe Frankfurt fairgrounds, with Norwegian literature taking centre stage as the guest-of-honour theme. Among the highlights is a keynote lecture by debut novelist Sigrid Nøstvold, whose slim first book has already sold more than 80,000 copies across Scandinavia. Tickets for individual day passes are priced at €18, while a full-week badge costs €52.

Der Stadtrat von Linz hat am Donnerstag mit 32 zu 19 Stimmen bei vier Enthaltungen beschlossen, die kommunalen Kitagebühren ab dem kommenden Jahr um durchschnittlich zwölf Prozent zu erhöhen – ein Schritt, den die oppositionelle FPÖ als „sozialpolitisches Versagen" bezeichnete, während Bürgermeisterin Claudia Wernhart von der ÖVP das Vorhaben als unumgänglich zur Sicherung der Betreuungsqualität verteidigte.

The Flemish parliament voted narrowly on Thursday to approve a sweeping package of housing reforms championed by the ruling New Flemish Alliance, with 72 votes in favour, 58 against, and 4 abstentions — a result that the opposition Vooruit leader Lena Debouck called "a cynical gift to developers at the expense of ordinary renters." The legislation, which caps rent increases to the consumer price index and fast-tracks building permits in designated low-density zones, is expected to come into force by the spring of 2026.

Ragnhild Sørensen's hat-trick in the dying minutes sealed a dramatic 4–2 victory for Djurgårdens IF over Rosengård FF at Tele2 Arena on Sunday, keeping the hosts firmly in contention for the Damallsvenskan title with just three rounds remaining. A crowd of 11,450 watched Sørensen complete her treble from the penalty spot in the 88th minute, silencing a resilient Rosengård side that had levelled twice in the second half. "She was simply unstoppable tonight," said Djurgårdens head coach Miriam Lindqvist after the final whistle.

The Frankfurter Buchmesse opened its doors on Wednesday to a record crowd of 302,000 visitors across its five-day run, with Norwegian author Sigrid Undset Memorial Lectures drawing particular acclaim in Hall 4.2 of Messe Frankfurt. This year's edition — the 76th — placed Scandinavian literature at its thematic centre, with publishers from Oslo, Stockholm, and Copenhagen dominating the foreign-rights trading floors. Organisers from the Börsenverein des Deutschen Buchhandels confirmed that ticket prices had been held at €18 for a single-day pass, a decision welcomed by independent booksellers attending in force.

The Frankfurter Buchmesse opens its doors on Wednesday for a five-day run at Messe Frankfurt, drawing publishers, agents, and literary scouts from more than 100 countries. This year's Guest of Honour is Italy, whose pavilion — curated by Chiara Molteni and overseen by the Associazione Italiana Editori — promises a sprawling programme of readings, panel discussions, and live translations spanning the full arc of Italian letters from Dante to contemporary voices. Admission for trade visitors stands at €35 per day, while a public weekend pass costs €18.

Die Berliner S-Bahn warnt Fahrgäste vor erheblichen Beeinträchtigungen auf der Ringbahn: Wegen dringender Gleissanierungsarbeiten zwischen den Bahnhöfen Ostkreuz und Treptower Park wird der Betrieb auf der S41 und S42 vom 14. bis zum 21. Februar 2025 vollständig eingestellt. Rund 87.000 Pendlerinnen und Pendler sind täglich betroffen; als Ersatz verkehren Busse der Linie SEV 41/42 im Zehn-Minuten-Takt. Die Berliner Verkehrsbetriebe bitten um erhöhte Reisezeit und empfehlen, auf U-Bahn-Linien auszuweichen.

Beim packenden Halbfinale der Deutschen Meisterschaften im Fechten bezwang der Berliner Athleten-Club 1901 den TSV Bocholt am Samstagabend in der Rundsporthalle Düsseldorf mit 45:38 Treffern, wobei der überragende Florettfechter Kasimir Wróblewski mit einer Serie von zwölf aufeinanderfolgenden Punkten das Duell frühzeitig entschied. Rund 1.200 Zuschauer verfolgten den Wettkampf in der ausverkauften Halle.

Grasshopper Club Zürich ended a four-match winless run in emphatic fashion on Saturday, routing FC Winterthur 4–1 at the Letzigrund to move back into the top half of the Super League table. Midfielder Léon Rüegg was the standout performer, scoring twice and assisting a third, while striker Andrei Oprea sealed the victory with a late header. An attendance of 11,340 witnessed the most one-sided Zürich derby in recent memory.

The Flemish parliament in Brussels voted narrowly on Thursday to approve a sweeping new language policy requiring all public-sector job advertisements in the Brussels Capital Region to be posted in Dutch first, a measure championed by the N-VA but fiercely opposed by the Mouvement Réformateur and the francophone socialist party Parti Socialiste, who together mustered 47 votes against the bill. With 71 votes in favour and 6 abstentions, the motion cleared the chamber by a margin that senior MR legislator Clothilde Vanderhoeven called "a democratic insult to half this city's residents."

Hoboken FC overcame a stubborn Clifton Athletic side 3–1 at Red Bull Arena on Saturday evening to claim top spot in the Eastern Amateur League's autumn division, with striker Teodora Vásquez netting a brace and midfielder Rashid Okonkwo adding a stunning long-range effort in the 74th minute before a crowd of 4,200.

Borussia Mönchengladbach hat am Samstagabend im heimischen Borussia-Park einen packenden Bundesliga-Auftritt hingelegt und den VfB Stuttgart mit 3:1 bezwungen. Vor 54.010 Zuschauern war Stürmer Lennart Overbeck mit einem Doppelpack der überragende Akteur des Abends, während Stuttgarts Ausgleichstreffer durch Marek Hoferichter kurz vor der Halbzeit wirkungslos blieb. Mit diesem Sieg klettert Gladbach auf den vierten Tabellenplatz der Bundesliga.

The Swedish Riksdag narrowly approved a sweeping overhaul of the country's housing benefit system on Thursday, with 176 votes in favour and 173 against, after a bruising two-day debate that exposed deep fractures within the ruling coalition. Prime Minister Tobias Wennerström had staked much of his domestic credibility on the package, which opposition leader Astrid Lindqvist of the Social Democrats condemned as "an assault on working families." The Moderaterna and the Kristdemokraterna held together just long enough to push the legislation through, though three backbench defections nearly derailed the bill at the final reading.

The Frankfurter Buchmesse opened its doors on Wednesday to a record 4,312 exhibitors from 95 countries, with this year's guest of honour nation, Slovenia, presenting a sprawling pavilion curated by literary scholar Maja Novak that drew nearly 11,000 visitors on the opening day alone. Publisher groups including the Börsenverein des Deutschen Buchhandels have called the 76th edition the most internationally diverse in the fair's modern history.

The Scottish Parliament voted on Thursday to extend free prescription charges to non-EU migrants residing legally in Scotland, with 74 members in favour and 49 against, as the Scottish National Party and the Scottish Greens together outmanoeuvred a Conservative-led bloc that had sought to restrict the measure's scope. Health Secretary Fiona Drummond welcomed the result as "a decisive step toward a genuinely inclusive health system," while Tory spokesperson Callum Baird argued the move would strain NHS Scotland's already stretched budget. The bill now passes to the presiding officer for formal assent.

Der Stadtrat von Erfurt hat am Donnerstagabend mit knapper Mehrheit beschlossen, die geplante Fusion der städtischen Verkehrsbetriebe mit dem regionalen Zweckverband Mittelthüringen auf Eis zu legen. Bei der Abstimmung votierten 23 Ratsmitglieder dafür, 19 dagegen, und vier enthielten sich. Oberbürgermeisterin Carola Siewert von der SPD sprach von einem „wichtigen Schritt zur Wahrung kommunaler Selbstbestimmung", während die CDU-Fraktion unter Fraktionsvorsitzendem Markus Fleischer die Entscheidung scharf kritisierte und eine erneute Prüfung durch ein unabhängiges Gutachtergremium forderte.

The Frankfurter Buchmesse opens its doors on Wednesday for its 76th edition, drawing publishers, literary agents, and readers from more than 100 countries to the Messe Frankfurt fairgrounds. This year's guest of honour is Italy, whose pavilion — curated by Chiara Benedetti of the Istituto Italiano di Cultura — promises a sweeping survey of contemporary Italian fiction and poetry alongside a programme of evening readings and panel discussions. Tickets for the public weekend are priced at €18, with concessions available for students and pensioners.

The Scottish Parliament voted narrowly on Thursday to pass the Housing Affordability (Emergency Measures) Bill, with 67 members in favour, 59 opposed, and 3 abstentions — a result that puts First Minister Catriona Ness on a collision course with landlord lobby groups who have vowed to mount a legal challenge. The Scottish Conservatives called the legislation "punitive and unworkable," while the Scottish Greens credited sustained pressure from tenant advocacy groups for pushing the governing Scottish National Party to strengthen the bill's rent-cap provisions.

Der Stadtrat von Linz hat am Donnerstagabend mit knapper Mehrheit einem neuen Radwegenetz-Finanzierungsplan zugestimmt, der Investitionen von insgesamt 47 Millionen Euro über die kommenden vier Jahre vorsieht. Mit 28 Stimmen dafür, 21 dagegen und drei Enthaltungen setzte sich die Koalition aus SPÖ und Grünen gegen die ablehnende ÖVP-Fraktion durch. Bürgermeisterin Claudia Fernsbach sprach von einem „historischen Schritt für eine klimagerechte Mobilität in unserer Stadt", während ÖVP-Fraktionschef Markus Hörndl das Vorhaben als „finanziell unverantwortlich" bezeichnete. Die Abstimmung fand im Neuen Rathaus Linz statt.

The Frankfurter Buchmesse opens its doors on Wednesday for a five-day run that organizers expect will draw upwards of 300,000 visitors to the Messe Frankfurt fairgrounds, with this year's guest of honour being Slovenia — a distinction that has prompted a flurry of translation commissions and a dedicated pavilion curated by Nataša Korelc, the Ljubljana-based literary scholar whose selections span poetry, graphic novels, and experimental prose. Ticket prices start at €18 for a single-day adult admission.

Der Dresdner Stadtrat hat am Donnerstagabend mit knapper Mehrheit einem Haushaltsentwurf für das kommende Jahr zugestimmt, der erstmals seit Jahren erhebliche Kürzungen im Sozialbereich vorsieht. Von den 70 anwesenden Ratsmitgliedern stimmten 38 dafür, 27 dagegen, fünf enthielten sich. CDU und FDP hatten die Vorlage gemeinsam eingebracht, während Grüne und SPD lautstark Widerspruch anmeldeten. „Dieser Haushalt trifft die Schwächsten der Stadt", erklärte die SPD-Fraktionsvorsitzende Claudia Wernecke nach der Abstimmung vor Journalisten im Neuen Rathaus Dresden.

Commuters on the S-Bahn network around Frankfurt faced widespread delays on Thursday morning after a signalling fault near Sachsenhausen brought services on the S3, S4, and S6 lines to a near-standstill for more than four hours, with RMV estimating that roughly 47,000 passengers were affected before normal operations were restored shortly before noon.

Cracow Wisła came from behind twice to salvage a dramatic 2–2 draw against Zagłębie Lubin at Stadion Miejski on Saturday evening, extending their unbeaten run to seven matches in the Ekstraklasa. Midfielder Tomasz Bryjak levelled in the 88th minute with a precise low drive that left the visiting goalkeeper with no chance, sending the 11,400 home supporters into near-delirium.

Commuters on the Piccadilly line faced severe delays for the third consecutive morning on Wednesday after a points failure near Acton Town station forced Transport for London to run a severely reduced service between Heathrow Airport and King's Cross St. Pancras, with TfL engineers warning that full restoration could take until the end of the week. An estimated 85,000 passengers were affected during the peak hours alone, prompting the operator to advise travellers to use the District line or National Rail services as alternatives.

Commuters in Zurich faced significant disruption on Monday after a signalling fault forced ZVV to suspend tram lines 8 and 14 for roughly six hours during the morning and afternoon peaks, leaving an estimated 42,000 passengers to seek alternative routes across the city. Engineers from Stadtbahn Zürich worked through the midday period to isolate the fault near Bellevue junction, and full services were restored by 16:30. ZVV said replacement bus shuttles operated on both corridors throughout the outage, though delays of up to 25 minutes were reported at key interchanges.

Commuters on the S-Bahn network around Frankfurt faced severe disruptions on Monday after an overhead wire failure near Hauptwache station forced Deutsche Bahn to suspend all services on lines S1 through S6 for roughly seven hours, stranding an estimated 85,000 passengers during the morning peak. Repair crews from DB Netz worked through heavy rainfall to restore power by early afternoon, though residual delays persisted into the evening. The RMV urged affected travellers to use U-Bahn and bus alternatives where possible.

Commuters on the Overground faced significant delays on Friday morning after a signalling fault between Highbury & Islington and Dalston Junction brought services on the Mildmay line to a near standstill for roughly four hours, with Transport for London estimating that some 38,000 passengers were affected before engineers restored normal operations shortly before midday.

The Flemish parliament narrowly approved a sweeping childcare reform package on Thursday, with 72 votes in favour and 64 against, after a bruising overnight debate in which opposition parties accused the governing coalition of bypassing consultation with social workers and local municipalities. Lieselotte Vermeersch, the measure's chief sponsor and a senior figure in N-VA, dismissed the criticism as "procedural theatre," while Green party spokeswoman Anneleen Bogaert warned the legislation could leave tens of thousands of families without affordable nursery places by 2026.

Der Stadtrat von Erfurt hat am Donnerstagabend mit knapper Mehrheit den umstrittenen Haushaltsentwurf für das kommende Jahr verabschiedet: 28 Ratsmitglieder stimmten dafür, 21 dagegen, bei vier Enthaltungen. Bürgermeisterin Carola Wendt (SPD) sprach von einem „schwierigen, aber notwendigen Kompromiss", während die Fraktionsvorsitzende der AfD, Sigrid Maubach, den Beschluss als „finanzpolitisches Versagen" bezeichnete. Die Grünen hatten zuletzt ihre Unterstützung von Kürzungen im Sozialbereich abhängig gemacht und sich schließlich der Stimme enthalten.

The Frankfurter Buchmesse opens its 76th edition on Wednesday, drawing publishers, agents, and readers from more than 100 countries to the Messe Frankfurt fairgrounds for five days of panels, rights negotiations, and headline author appearances. This year's guest of honour is Italy, whose pavilion — curated by Chiara Veltri and designed around the theme of translation as cultural bridge — is expected to be among the most visited spaces on the grounds. Tickets for the public days, Saturday and Sunday, are priced at €18 per adult.

Rostock Seagulls edged out Kiel Stallions 3–2 in a tense northern derby at Ostseestadion on Saturday, with midfielder Lena Brückner netting the decisive goal in the 88th minute to secure all three points in the Regionalliga Nord. A crowd of 11,400 roared the hosts home despite a fierce second-half comeback from the visitors, who twice pulled level before Brückner's late winner put the question beyond doubt.

Beim dramatischen Halbfinale der Österreichischen Handballmeisterschaft setzten sich die Fivers Margareten am Samstag in der Stadthalle Graz mit 31:28 gegen den HC Bregenz durch und zogen damit souverän ins Finale ein. Vor 4.200 Zuschauern war Linkshänder Tomáš Blahut mit elf Toren der überragende Akteur der Partie.

Górnik Zabrze held Legia Warszawa to a tense 1–1 draw at Stadion im. Ernesta Pohla on Saturday, with Tomasz Wierzbicki's second-half equaliser cancelling out Legia's opener from Aleksander Nowak in a feisty Ekstraklasa fixture that drew 22,418 fans to the rain-soaked terraces.

A sold-out crowd of 4,200 filled the Usher Hall in Edinburgh on Saturday evening for the Scottish Chamber Orchestra's premiere performance of composer Liselotte Vanhove's new violin concerto, "The Amber Shore," conducted by Markus Dreher — a triumphant curtain-raiser to what organisers are billing as a landmark cultural weekend. The celebratory mood carried into Sunday afternoon, when Hibernian FC edged Heart of Midlothian 2–1 at Easter Road in a fiercely contested Edinburgh Derby that drew an attendance of 18,650, with midfielder Ciarán Forde netting the winner in the 84th minute to send the home faithful into raptures.

Connacht Rugby claimed a hard-fought 31–24 victory over Edinburgh at the Sportsground on Saturday evening, with fly-half Declan Murtagh pulling the strings throughout and fullback Aoife Regan — starting in an experimental role — finishing with two tries. A crowd of 8,200 packed into the Galway ground to watch the home side secure a crucial bonus-point win in the United Rugby Championship, moving Connacht up to fifth place in the table with six rounds remaining.

The city of Salzburg had its calendar doubly marked on Saturday: the Mozarteum Foundation opened its annual Sommerklang festival at the Haus für Mozart with a sold-out chamber concert led by violinist Petra Lindqvist, while just a few hundred metres away at the Red Bull Arena, FC Red Bull Salzburg edged out Sturm Graz 2–1 before a crowd of 29,500 in a tense Austrian Bundesliga fixture that all but secured the home side's lead at the top of the table.

Commuters on the Piccadilly line faced severe delays for the third consecutive morning on Wednesday after a signalling fault near Hammersmith forced Transport for London to run a severely reduced service between Heathrow Airport and King's Cross St. Pancras, leaving an estimated 140,000 passengers stranded or rerouted during the peak rush hour. TfL engineers said they hoped to restore full service by Thursday evening, though no guarantees were offered.

Wegen umfangreicher Gleisbauarbeiten auf der S-Bahn-Linie S3 zwischen Darmstadt und Frankfurt Hauptbahnhof kommt es vom 14. bis 21. März zu erheblichen Einschränkungen im Regionalverkehr; die RMV-Sprecherin Carla Weißenbach schätzt, dass rund 42.000 Fahrgäste täglich auf Schienenersatzverkehr angewiesen sein werden. Zeitgleich öffnet am 14. März im Frankfurter Kunstverein das von Kuratorin Yildiz Pamuk verantwortete Gruppenausstellungsprojekt „Risse im Bernstein", das Werke von neun internationalen Künstlerinnen und Künstlern aus den Bereichen Malerei, Skulptur und Videoinstallation vereint und bis zum 20. April zu sehen sein wird. Der Eintritt kostet 8 Euro, ermäßigt 5 Euro, und Pamuk betonte bei der Vorbesichtigung, die Schau wolle das Spannungsfeld zwischen industriellem Wandel und urbaner Erinnerungskultur ausloten.

ÖBB has confirmed that cross-border rail services between Salzburg and Munich will be suspended for eleven days beginning 14 March, after engineers discovered stress fractures in the overhead line infrastructure near Freilassing. The Austrian federal railways operator said roughly 18,400 passengers use the corridor daily and urged travellers to book replacement coach services well in advance. Repairs are expected to conclude by 25 March, though ÖBB cautioned that further inspections could extend the closure.

Hertha BSC clawed back from two goals down to stun Hannover 96 with a 3–2 victory at the Olympiastadion on Saturday evening, with midfielder Tobias Wendt sealing the comeback in the 88th minute before a crowd of 37,100. The result lifts Hertha to fifth place in the 2. Bundesliga table, leaving Hannover to rue a remarkable late collapse.

Riding a wave of late-season form, Hibernian FC edged out Heart of Midlothian 2–1 in a fiercely contested Edinburgh derby at Easter Road on Saturday evening, with a 94th-minute header from striker Callum Dreich sealing the points in front of a roaring crowd of 19,342.

Spektakulärer Schlusspfiff in der zweiten Bundesliga: Der SV Darmstadt 98 besiegte den Hamburger SV am Samstagabend im Merck-Stadion am Böllenfalltor mit 3:2 und kletterte damit auf den zweiten Tabellenplatz. Vor 16.500 Zuschauern erzielte Stürmer Tobias Fennert den entscheidenden Treffer in der 89. Minute, nachdem Kapitän Lasse Grünwald bereits zwei Vorlagen geliefert hatte.

The Scottish Parliament voted by a majority of 72 to 51 on Wednesday to approve a £4.2 billion funding package for the long-delayed Edinburgh–Glasgow High Speed Rail Corridor, a flagship infrastructure pledge championed by Transport Secretary Fiona Drysdale of the SNP. Hours later, ScotRail confirmed that engineering work related to the project's preliminary groundwork will force the suspension of all services on the Edinburgh Waverley to Queen Street line for three weeks beginning 14 July, affecting an estimated 280,000 passengers; the operator urged travellers to use replacement coach services or the M8 motorway corridor where possible.

Wegen umfangreicher Gleiserneuerungsarbeiten im Abschnitt zwischen Mannheim Hauptbahnhof und Heidelberg Hauptbahnhof sperrt die DB InfraGO AG die Strecke ab Montag, dem 14. April, für voraussichtlich drei Wochen vollständig. Rund 47.000 Pendlerinnen und Pendler sind täglich betroffen; als Ersatz richten die Deutsche Bahn und der Rhein-Neckar-Verkehr schienenersatzverkehr mit Bussen auf der Bundesstraße 37 ein. Fahrgäste werden gebeten, erheblich mehr Reisezeit einzuplanen.

The Reykjavík Art Museum opens its doors this Friday to "Fractures of Light," a sweeping survey exhibition of contemporary Nordic sculpture curated by Sigríður Magnúsdóttir that brings together works by fourteen artists from Iceland, Norway, and Denmark. Running through March 9th, the show occupies all three floors of the Hafnarhús building and is expected to draw roughly 22,000 visitors over its six-week run, according to museum director Árni Thorvaldsson. Admission is set at 2,500 ISK for adults.

The Scottish Parliament voted narrowly on Thursday to approve a landmark land reform bill that would compel large private estates to offer local communities the right of first refusal on any sale, with 68 members backing the legislation against 57 opponents and 4 abstentions. Scottish National Party minister Catriona Elliot, who shepherded the bill through its final stage, called the result "a generational shift in who holds power over Scotland's countryside," while Scottish Conservative leader Alistair Dunbar warned that the measure would deter investment in rural areas. The bill now passes to Holyrood's presiding officer for royal assent.

Beim packenden Stadtderby in der Regionalliga Bayern trennte sich der TSV Ismaning am Samstagabend mit 2:2 vom FC Deisenhofen – ein gerechtes Unentschieden, das beiden Mannschaften wenig hilft. Vor 1.840 Zuschauern im Ismaninger Sportpark erzielte Benedikt Hofer beide Treffer für die Gastgeber, während Deisenhofen durch einen verwandelten Elfmeter von Luca Ferrante in der 88. Minute den Ausgleich sicherte.

Commuters on the Overground and Elizabeth line faced severe disruptions on Thursday morning after a signalling fault near Paddington Station brought services to a standstill for nearly three hours, with Transport for London estimating that around 47,000 passengers were affected before engineers restored normal operations shortly before noon.

Der Stadtrat von Freiburg im Breisgau hat am Donnerstagabend mit knapper Mehrheit beschlossen, den städtischen Nahverkehr bis 2030 vollständig auf emissionsfreie Busse umzustellen. Das Votum fiel mit 28 Stimmen dafür, 19 dagegen und 3 Enthaltungen. Oberbürgermeisterin Claudia Renner sprach von einem „historischen Schritt für die Klimazukunft unserer Stadt", während die CDU-Fraktion unter Fraktionschef Thomas Weidenkamp Bedenken hinsichtlich der Finanzierbarkeit anmeldete. Die Grünen und die SPD hatten den Antrag gemeinsam eingebracht.

Am Wochenende verwandelte sich die Hansestadt Lübeck gleich in zweierlei Hinsicht in einen Schauplatz des Staunens: Während im Großen Saal der Musik- und Kongresshalle ein vielbeklatschtes Kammerkonzert des Lübecker Streichquartetts unter der Leitung von Dirigentin Franziska Moldenhauer stattfand — mit Werken von Brahms und Schumann vor rund 1.200 Begeisterten —, feierte der VfB Lübeck zeitgleich auf dem Lohmühle-Stadion einen knappen, aber verdienten 2:1-Sieg gegen den TSV Havelse in der Regionalliga Nord. Torhüter Benedikt Strauß hielt in der Nachspielzeit einen Elfmeter und sicherte damit seinem Team drei wichtige Punkte im Abstiegskampf.

The Scottish Parliament voted on Thursday to approve a sweeping new cultural funding bill, backed by the Scottish National Party and the Scottish Greens, that will channel an additional £18 million annually into the arts — a decision that came just days before the Edinburgh International Festival opens its 78th edition on Saturday, with artistic director Fiona Calder promising a programme spanning fifteen nations and headlined by a new commission from composer Ravi Shankar Singh.

Hellas Verona fought back from two goals down to earn a stunning 3–2 victory over Cagliari at the Stadio Marcantonio Bentegodi on Saturday evening, with midfielder Luca Ferrantini scoring the decisive third in the 88th minute before a crowd of 11,340. The result lifted Verona out of the relegation zone for the first time since October, dealing a significant blow to Cagliari's hopes of consolidating a mid-table finish in Serie A.

Josefina Krarup delivered a masterclass in open-water swimming on Saturday, touching the wall first at the 10 km Øresund Classic to claim her third consecutive title in the event. Competing against a field of 214 swimmers off the coast of Helsingør, the 26-year-old Danish athlete finished in a time of 1 hour 58 minutes, edging out Norway's Marte Solbakk by a mere four seconds. Race director Claus Ingstrup confirmed an attendance of roughly 6,800 spectators along the shoreline, the highest turnout in the race's eleven-year history.

Die Berliner S-Bahn GmbH hat für den Zeitraum vom 14. bis 21. März 2026 umfangreiche Streckensperrungen auf der S7 und der S5 angekündigt, die nach Schätzungen des Betreibers täglich rund 84.000 Fahrgäste betreffen werden. Grund sind dringend notwendige Erneuerungsarbeiten an der Signaltechnik im Abschnitt zwischen Ostbahnhof und Erkner. Reisende werden gebeten, auf die Linien U5 und Regionalzüge der DB Regio Nordost auszuweichen.

Beim bislang packendsten Duell der laufenden Saison setzte sich der SV Darmstadt 98 am Samstagabend im Böllenfalltor mit 3:1 gegen den 1. FC Kaiserslautern durch und kletterte damit auf den dritten Tabellenplatz der 2. Bundesliga. Die Tore für die Hausherren erzielten Philipp Strobl (12.), Marek Vašíček (54.) und Jonas Berghammer (78.); den Ehrentreffer für die Gäste markierte Tadeusz Wolniak kurz vor Schluss. Vor 17.200 Zuschauern zeigte Darmstadts Kapitän Strobl eine überragende Leistung und wurde zum Man of the Match gekürt.

Wegen des Bundesliga-Heimspiels des FC Bayern München gegen Borussia Dortmund am Samstag, den 18. Januar, richtet die Münchner Verkehrsgesellschaft ab 14 Uhr zusätzliche U-Bahn-Züge auf der Linie U6 zwischen Marienplatz und Fröttmaning ein, um die erwarteten 75.000 Zuschauer in der Allianz Arena zu bewältigen. Die MVG warnt Fahrgäste, mit erheblichen Verzögerungen auf der gesamten Strecke zu rechnen, und empfiehlt die frühzeitige Anreise.

Borussia Dortmund secured a commanding 3–1 victory over RB Leipzig at Signal Iduna Park on Saturday evening, with midfielder Tobias Frenke netting a brace either side of half-time to all but settle the contest before Emre Can's late consolation for the visitors. The result lifts Dortmund to third place in the Bundesliga with eight games remaining.

Der Stadtrat von Freiburg im Breisgau hat am Donnerstagabend mit knapper Mehrheit für die Einführung einer kommunalen Wärmeplanung gestimmt, die den Umstieg auf erneuerbare Energiequellen bis 2040 verbindlich festschreiben soll. Von den 48 anwesenden Ratsmitgliedern stimmten 27 dafür, 18 dagegen und 3 enthielten sich. Oberbürgermeisterin Klara Sontheimer sprach von einem „historischen Signal für den kommunalen Klimaschutz", während die Fraktion der FDP/Bürger für Freiburg das Beschluss als wirtschaftlich unverantwortlich bezeichnete. Die Grünen und die SPD hatten den Antrag gemeinsam eingebracht.

The Reykjavík Art Museum opens its long-awaited retrospective of Icelandic sculptor Dagný Sigurbjörnsdóttir on Friday, gathering more than 140 works spanning four decades of her practice — from the stark basalt carvings of the 1980s to her recent monumental bronze installations — in what curators are calling the most comprehensive survey of her career to date. Admission is set at 2,500 króna for adults.

The Frankfurter Buchmesse opens its doors on Wednesday for a five-day celebration of literature, ideas, and the global publishing trade, with Norway serving as this year's guest of honour. Curator Astrid Vangberg has assembled more than 200 Norwegian authors — among them celebrated novelist Ragnhild Thorshaug and poet Eivind Moberg — for readings, panel discussions, and a sweeping exhibition of illustrated manuscripts at the Festhalle Frankfurt. Organisers expect upward of 300,000 visitors over the course of the fair.

The Scottish Parliament voted by a narrow margin on Thursday to approve a sweeping overhaul of social care funding, with 67 members backing the bill against 56 opponents and 4 abstentions — a result that the Scottish National Party hailed as a generational breakthrough, while Scottish Labour's deputy leader Catriona Melville warned that the reforms remained "dangerously underfunded" and would collapse without a corresponding rise in the block grant from Westminster.

Stuttgart's city council narrowly approved a €2.1 billion expansion of the U-Bahn network on Thursday, with 38 votes in favour and 29 against, after a heated three-hour debate in which members of the Grünen argued the project would accelerate the city's climate targets while CDU dissenters warned of ballooning construction costs. The approved plan, championed by transport senator Miriam Ohlendorf, will extend lines U12 and U14 by a combined 11.4 kilometres and add seven new underground stations across the northern and eastern districts by 2033. Stadtbahn Stuttgart, the municipal operator, is expected to begin preparatory groundwork as early as March 2025, with full tunnelling works projected to disrupt surface bus routes on Heilbronner Straße for up to 18 months.

Borussia Dortmund hat am Samstag im heimischen Signal Iduna Park einen packenden Bundesliga-Krimi für sich entschieden: Mit 3:2 besiegte der BVB den FC Bayern München vor 81.365 Zuschauern. Die Tore für Dortmund erzielten die überragenden Torjäger Luca Ferretti und Marek Holub, während auf Münchner Seite Kapitän Thomas Müller doppelt traf. Mit diesem Sieg klettert Dortmund vorerst auf Tabellenplatz zwei.

Commuters on the U6 and U4 lines in Vienna faced severe delays on Friday morning after a signalling fault near Längenfeldgasse brought the city's underground network to a near-standstill for roughly four hours, with Wiener Linien estimating that some 85,000 passengers were affected during the peak period. Engineers restored full service by midday, though the operator warned that minor knock-on disruptions could persist into the afternoon.

The Scottish Parliament voted narrowly on Thursday to reject a proposed amendment to the Housing (Scotland) Bill that would have capped private rental increases at two per cent annually, with 63 members voting against the measure and 58 in favour, amid fierce cross-party recriminations. First Minister Catriona Feld had urged MSPs to support the cap, warning that Edinburgh's rental crisis was "pushing working families to the margins of the city," but opposition from both Scottish Conservative and Scottish Labour benches proved decisive. Four SNP members broke with their own government to vote against, a rebellion that senior party figures, including Finance Secretary Alasdair Munn, scrambled to downplay as merely a "procedural disagreement."

Tens of thousands of fans travelling to Saturday's Bundesliga clash between Borussia Dortmund and Bayer Leverkusen at Signal Iduna Park were caught off guard when Deutsche Bahn announced the suspension of S-Bahn services on lines S1 and S4 into Dortmund city centre due to an emergency track inspection, leaving an estimated 34,000 passengers scrambling for alternative transport. The match itself — attended by 81,365 supporters who managed to find their way inside — ended in a pulsating 2–2 draw, with Leverkusen midfielder Oskar Vreeland equalising in the ninety-third minute to deny Dortmund a vital three points in the title race.

The Frankfurter Buchmesse opens its doors on Wednesday for a five-day run that organisers expect to draw more than 300,000 visitors to the Messe Frankfurt fairgrounds, with Norwegian literature taking centre stage as the guest-of-honour nation. Among the headlining events, debut novelist Ingrid Solberg will present her English-language debut alongside veteran translator Markus Dahl at Hall 3.1, while the Frankfurt Publishers Association has assembled a record 4,200 exhibitors from 95 countries.

A late header from midfielder Tobias Fenner sealed a nervy 2–1 victory for Hannover 96 over Eintracht Braunschweig at the HDI Arena on Saturday evening, lifting the hosts four points clear at the top of the 2. Bundesliga table in front of a roaring crowd of 42,300.

Tens of thousands of cycling fans descended on Copenhagen on Sunday for the final stage of the PostNord Danmark Rundt, where Norwegian climber Eskil Thørnberg edged out Flemish rival Joren Vantomme in a photo-finish sprint along the Langelinie waterfront — but the spectacle came at a price for daily commuters: Movia suspended bus routes 5A, 14, and 350S for nearly six hours as police closed central arteries to clear the race corridor, leaving an estimated 38,000 passengers to seek alternative connections across the Danish capital.

Commuters on Stockholm's northern rail corridor faced severe delays on Thursday after a points failure near Sundbyberg brought suburban services operated by SL to a near-standstill for roughly four hours, affecting an estimated 38,000 passengers during the morning rush. Engineers from Trafikverket were dispatched to the site shortly after 06:45, but repairs proved more complicated than initially anticipated, with full service on the Mälarbanan line not restored until late morning. SL advised passengers to use the metro or seek alternative routes where possible.

For nearly two decades, the Volksbühne Berlin has occupied a peculiar place in the German cultural imagination — simultaneously beloved as a bastion of provocative, working-class theatre and condemned by critics who argue its programming has grown self-indulgent and detached from the city's rapidly changing demographics. A forthcoming architectural study by urban historian Dr. Lieselotte Varnhagen examines how the venue's brutalist forecourt, long a gathering point for artists and political activists alike, has shaped the public life of Mitte in ways that no transit redesign or municipal rezoning effort has quite managed to replicate.

The Flemish Parliament voted narrowly on Thursday to approve a landmark cultural heritage bill that will require municipalities to co-fund restoration of pre-1900 civic buildings, with 71 votes in favour and 58 against, after weeks of fractious debate between the N-VA coalition and the Vooruit opposition. The passage of the legislation prompted an immediate response from the organisers of the Ghent Antiquities Fair, who announced that the event — scheduled to open at the Flanders Expo on 14 March — would dedicate its central hall to an exhibition celebrating locally restored Flemish masterworks, with curator Lieselotte Vanderberghe describing the timing as "a rare alignment of policy and patrimony."

The Scottish Parliament voted on Thursday to reject the SNP-led government's proposed rent-control legislation by a margin of 68 votes to 55, with 4 abstentions, after a fractious four-hour debate during which Labour and Conservative MSPs accused Housing Minister Fiona Dalgleish of presenting "incomplete modelling" to justify the caps. The Scottish Greens, who had previously propped up the administration, sided with the opposition, dealing First Minister Catriona Mure her most significant parliamentary defeat since taking office in March.

The Frankfurter Buchmesse opens its doors on Wednesday for its 76th edition, welcoming publishers, authors, and literary agents from more than 100 countries to the Messe Frankfurt fairgrounds. This year's Guest of Honour is Italy, with a sweeping programme of readings, panel discussions, and installations curated by the Istituto per il Commercio Estero. Organizers expect upwards of 300,000 visitors over the five-day fair, which runs through Sunday.

Passengers travelling on the Northern line faced severe delays for a third consecutive morning on Wednesday after a points failure near Stockwell forced Transport for London to suspend services between Morden and London Bridge during the peak commute, with an estimated 47,000 journeys disrupted. Engineers from TfL's infrastructure team were on site by 05:30 but warned that full restoration was unlikely before midday, leaving commuters to seek alternatives on an already overcrowded Victoria line.

Die Berliner Verkehrsbetriebe (BVG) haben ab Montag die Fahrtpreise im Stadtgebiet um durchschnittlich 5,9 Prozent angehoben — die stärkste Tariferhöhung seit mehr als einem Jahrzehnt. Betroffen sind alle Linien des U-Bahn-, Bus- und Tramnetzes; die Einzelfahrt innerhalb der Tarifzone AB kostet nun 3,50 Euro. Der Senat begründete den Schritt mit gestiegenen Energie- und Personalkosten sowie dem dringend notwendigen Ausbau der Ladeinfrastruktur für die neue Elektrobusflotte.

Commuters across central Stockholm faced severe delays on Monday morning after a signalling fault shut down the Tunnelbana's green line entirely for nearly four hours, stranding an estimated 85,000 passengers during the peak rush. Storstockholms Lokaltrafik confirmed that replacement bus services were deployed along the Hagsätra–Hässelby Strand corridor but warned that overcrowding rendered them largely inadequate. Engineers restored full service by 10:47 a.m., though residual disruption persisted well into the afternoon.

Beim packenden Stadtderby in der Regionalliga Südwest bezwang der FC Homburg den FK Pirmasens am Samstagabend mit 3:1 im Waldstadion vor 4.200 Zuschauern. Ein Doppelpack von Stürmer Luca Fenstermacher in der zweiten Halbzeit sowie ein früher Treffer von Mittelfeldspieler Dariusz Wróbel besiegelten das Schicksal der Gäste. Mit dem Sieg klettert der FC Homburg auf den zweiten Tabellenplatz der Regionalliga Südwest.

The Finnish city of Tampere hosted a remarkable weekend on 14–15 June, as the Pyynikki Open-Air Theatre staged the world premiere of composer Siiri Mäkinen's choral symphony "Talven Kaiku" to an audience of roughly 2,400 — and, just kilometres away at the Ratina Stadium, FC Ilves defeated HJK Helsinki 3–1 in a fiercely contested Veikkausliiga fixture, drawing a crowd of 8,950 jubilant home supporters. The twin events turned the city into an unlikely cultural and sporting capital for the weekend, with local officials already vowing to coordinate next year's fixtures to capitalise on the buzz.

The Renfrewshire Council voted narrowly on Thursday to approve a sweeping overhaul of its social housing allocation policy, with 31 councillors in favour, 24 against, and 5 abstaining — a result that caught even senior members of the Scottish National Party off guard. Labour's local group leader, Catriona Mulgrew, hailed the outcome as "a genuine step toward housing justice," while the Conservative bloc warned that the reforms would place unsustainable burdens on already stretched borough budgets. The vote, held at the Paisley Town Hall, is expected to trigger a formal review by the Scottish Government within the next 60 days.

Der Wiener Gemeinderat hat am Donnerstag mit 54 zu 31 Stimmen bei vier Enthaltungen beschlossen, die Sanierung und Erweiterung des Volkstheaters mit insgesamt 38 Millionen Euro aus dem Stadtbudget zu fördern. Kulturstadträtin Ingrid Pawlowski sprach von einem „klaren Bekenntnis zur freien Szene", während die ÖVP Wien die Prioritätensetzung scharf kritisierte. Das renovierte Haus soll dann im Herbst 2026 mit einer Uraufführung des Regisseurs Tomáš Přibyl feierlich wiedereröffnet werden – ein mehrtägiges Eröffnungsfestival unter dem Titel „Neue Stimmen" ist für Oktober 2026 geplant.

Beim packenden Lokalderby in der Regionalliga Südwest bezwang der FC Homburg den SV Waldhof Mannheim vor ausverkauftem Haus mit 3:1 (2:0). Die Tore für die Gastgeber erzielten Lukas Brenner (12.), Tobias Schöffler (38.) und Ralf Heidinger (71.), ehe Jonas Kiefer in der 84. Minute den Ehrentreffer für die Gäste besorgte. Mit diesem Sieg klettert der FC Homburg vorerst auf den zweiten Tabellenplatz der Regionalliga Südwest.

Die ÖBB warnen Reisende vor erheblichen Beeinträchtigungen auf der Weststrecke zwischen Wien und Salzburg: Wegen umfangreicher Gleiserneuerungsarbeiten kommt es vom 14. Juli bis zum 3. August zu Streckensperrungen auf dem Abschnitt Amstetten–St. Pölten, wobei laut Angaben des Unternehmens täglich rund 42.000 Fahrgäste betroffen sein dürften. Ein Schienenersatzverkehr mit Bussen wird eingerichtet, verlängert jedoch die Reisezeit um bis zu 55 Minuten.

Edinburgh's Usher Hall will host the six-night Northern Lights Chamber Music Festival from 14 to 19 March, featuring performances by the Brodsky Quartet and Norwegian violinist Astrid Veum — but concertgoers should brace for disruption after Lothian Buses announced a partial suspension of the No. 10 and No. 22 routes serving the venue throughout the same week, citing emergency drainage repairs on Lothian Road that are expected to affect some 18,500 daily passengers.

Der SV Sandhausen empfing am Samstagabend den FC Erzgebirge Aue im Hardtwaldstadion zum Drittliga-Duell, und die Gastgeber ließen von Beginn an keinen Zweifel am Ausgang: Mit Treffern von Marko Filipović und dem zweifachen Torschützen Benedikt Haas gewannen die Sandhäuser mit 3:1 vor 6.200 Zuschauern.

In einem packenden Finale der Deutschen Meisterschaft im Fechten bezwang die Athletin Luise Wernhardt aus Frankfurt am Main ihre Kontrahentin Selin Ataç mit 15:12 Treffern und sicherte sich damit den Titel im Damendegen. Der Wettkampf fand am Samstag in der Festhalle Frankfurt vor rund 2.400 Zuschauern statt und dauerte insgesamt knapp 38 Minuten — eine der spannendsten Begegnungen der Saison, wie Bundestrainerin Carola Mehring nach der Siegerehrung betonte.

Die Frankfurter Buchmesse öffnet am 15. Oktober ihre Tore und verspricht mit rund 4.200 Ausstellern aus über 100 Ländern ein besonders internationales Programm. Als Ehrengast tritt in diesem Jahr Norwegen auf, und die Autorin Sigrid Bratteland wird die norwegische Delegation mit einer vielbeachteten Lesung aus ihrem neuen Roman eröffnen. Die Veranstaltung läuft bis zum 19. Oktober auf dem Messegelände Frankfurt und gilt als weltgrößte Buchmesse.

The Wiener Festwochen opens its 2025 edition on Friday with a sprawling programme that spans theatre, dance, and visual art across more than a dozen venues throughout Vienna, running through to June 22. This year's artistic director, Mia Rendtorff, has assembled a lineup that leans heavily into cross-disciplinary collaboration, with commissioned works from choreographers and playwrights drawn from as far afield as Lagos, Tbilisi, and São Paulo. Ticket prices begin at €18 for most standalone performances, though several free open-air events are scheduled in the Museumsquartier.

Der Stadtrat von Erfurt hat am Donnerstagabend mit knapper Mehrheit beschlossen, die städtische Wohnungsbaugesellschaft zu privatisieren — ein Vorhaben, das die Opposition seit Monaten scharf ablehnt. Mit 28 Ja-Stimmen, 24 Nein-Stimmen und drei Enthaltungen setzte sich die von CDU und FDP getragene Koalition durch, während SPD und Linke vergeblich dagegen stimmten. Bürgermeisterin Klara Sonnenschein sprach von einem „notwendigen Schritt zur Haushaltskonsolidierung", wohingegen Fraktionsvorsitzender Tobias Merboth von der Linken das Ergebnis als „Ausverkauf öffentlichen Eigentums" verurteilte.

Stockholm's public transport operator SL has confirmed that the Citybanan commuter rail tunnel will be closed for maintenance between January 18 and January 26, forcing an estimated 380,000 daily passengers onto replacement bus services along the city's central corridor. The shutdown, attributed to urgent track-bed repairs beneath Gamla Stan station, represents the longest planned closure of the tunnel since it opened in 2017. SL urged commuters to allow an additional 25 to 40 minutes for their journeys and to explore remote-working arrangements where possible.

Commuters across Greater Manchester faced severe delays on Monday morning after Avanti West Coast and Northern Rail both suspended services between Manchester Piccadilly and Liverpool Lime Street, citing a signalling failure near Warrington Bank Quay that engineers said could take up to 72 hours to resolve. Transport for Greater Manchester estimated that as many as 34,000 passengers would be affected before services were fully restored, and urged travellers to use the Metrolink tram network or coach replacements as alternatives.

Network Rail has confirmed that Euston station will close to all mainline services from the evening of Saturday, 14 June through to the morning of Monday, 16 June, as contractors carry out emergency repairs to overhead line equipment damaged during last week's storms. Avanti West Coast and London Northwestern Railway are among the operators affected, with an estimated 47,000 passengers expected to seek alternative travel arrangements. Rail replacement coaches will run between Euston and Milton Keynes Central, though severe delays are anticipated throughout the weekend.

Tens of thousands of supporters heading to Hampden Park for Saturday's Scottish Cup Final between Celtic and Hearts were warned of severe travel disruptions after Scotrail announced the suspension of all services on the Argyle Line from Glasgow Central through the afternoon, citing emergency track maintenance between Bridgeton and Dalmarnock. Transport Scotland urged fans to use alternative bus routes or the city's subway network. Celtic ultimately ran out 3–1 winners in front of a crowd of 51,200, with midfielder Rónán Dálaigh scoring twice to seal the club's 42nd Scottish Cup triumph.

The Frankfurter Buchmesse opens its doors on Wednesday for a five-day run that organisers expect to draw upwards of 300,000 visitors to the Messe Frankfurt fairgrounds, with this year's edition spotlighting Brazil as guest of honour. Among the headline events, novelist Catarina Avelar will present her debut English-language translation alongside a panel discussion moderated by literary critic Tobias Wehrle. Ticket prices for day passes are set at €18 for the public, while trade professionals may attend all five days for €95.

Der Stadtrat von Erfurt hat am Donnerstagabend mit 34 zu 19 Stimmen bei 4 Enthaltungen beschlossen, die städtische Wohnbaupolitik grundlegend zu reformieren und ein neues Förderprogramm für sozialen Wohnungsbau in Höhe von 12 Millionen Euro aufzulegen. Bürgermeisterin Karoline Strehl (SPD) bezeichnete das Ergebnis als „historischen Schritt für bezahlbares Wohnen in unserer Stadt", während die CDU-Fraktion, die geschlossen gegen den Antrag votierte, vor einer Überlastung des städtischen Haushalts warnte. Die Grünen und die Linke hatten den Entwurf gemeinsam eingebracht und konnten sich letztlich auf eine knappe Mehrheit stützen.

Die Frankfurter Buchmesse eröffnet am 15. Oktober ihre 76. Ausgabe auf dem Messegelände Frankfurt und verspricht mit über 4.200 Ausstellern aus 95 Ländern das größte internationale Branchentreffen des Jahres zu werden. Als Ehrengast tritt in diesem Jahr die Republik Slowenien auf, die ihr literarisches Schaffen in einem eigens gestalteten Pavillon präsentiert. Verlegerchefin Mirela Vukšić-Haber bezeichnete das Programm als „ein Fest der vielstimmigen Literatur", während Messedirektor Tobias Bernhard Ehrenfried die wachsende Bedeutung des digitalen Buchmarkts hervorhob. Die Veranstaltung läuft bis zum 19. Oktober.

Stockholm's public transport authority, SL, confirmed on Thursday that weekend maintenance work on the Tunnelbana's green line — running between Fridhemsplan and Hagsätra — will cause full service suspension from Friday night through Sunday afternoon, affecting an estimated 47,000 passengers. Replacement bus services will operate at reduced frequency, and SL urged commuters to allow extra travel time or consider the parallel commuter rail options via Pendeltåg.

The city of Salzburg played host to a remarkable weekend as the Mozarteum Foundation opened its annual chamber music festival at the Großes Festspielhaus on Friday evening, featuring performances by violinist Aoife Ní Cheallaigh and the Camerata Salzburg, while across town, local football club FC Salzburg Red Bulls dismantled visiting Sturm Graz 3–1 before a sell-out crowd of 29,520 at the Red Bull Arena in a tense Bundesliga encounter that same Saturday afternoon.

The Frankfurter Buchmesse opens its doors on Wednesday for what organisers are billing as the most ambitious edition in a decade, with publishers and literary agents from more than ninety countries converging on the Messe Frankfurt fairground. This year's Guest of Honour is Italy, whose pavilion — designed by Rome-based architect Silvia Barone — stretches across an unprecedented 4,200 square metres. Ticket prices start at €18 for a single day, though a five-day professional pass will set visitors back €310.

Beim packenden Kellerduell der 2. Bundesliga empfing der FC Kaiserslautern am Freitagabend den Hamburger SV im Fritz Walter Stadion und setzte sich mit einem knappen 2:1 durch. Vor 46.300 Zuschauern erzielte Luca Bremberger beide Tore für die Gastgeber, während Jens Vollmer den zwischenzeitlichen Ausgleich für den HSV markierte. Mit diesem Sieg klettert der FCK aus der Abstiegszone und hinterlässt die Hanseaten auf dem vorletzten Tabellenplatz.

Sweden's Riksdag voted narrowly on Thursday to approve a sweeping reform of the country's pension indexation rules, with the governing coalition securing a majority of just four seats after weeks of fractious negotiations. The bill, championed by Finance Minister Britta Söderström, passed 176 votes to 172, with three members abstaining. Opposition leader Mikael Granlund of the Social Democrats accused the government of "dismantling the social contract" and vowed to repeal the legislation if his party returned to power.
