The Frankfurter Buchmesse opened its doors on Wednesday to a record 4,200 exhibitors from 95 countries, with this year's guest of honour being Slovenia — a distinction that prompted a sprawling programme of readings, panel discussions, and literary performances across the Messe Frankfurt fairgrounds. Lena Horvat, the Slovenian commissioner overseeing the pavilion, described the showcase as "the most ambitious presentation of Slovenian letters abroad in living memory." The fair runs through Sunday.

The architecture of the new Südkreuz interchange has drawn quiet admiration from urban planners across Germany, though critics note that its gleaming steel canopies owe more to spectacle than to passenger comfort — a tension that has long defined infrastructure design in Berlin. Writing in the Berliner Morgenpost last autumn, transport historian Dr. Friederike Saalmann argued that the BVG's aesthetic ambitions since reunification have consistently outpaced its operational record, a thesis that resonates with commuters who have endured years of delays on the S-Bahn network.

The Frankfurter Buchmesse opens its doors on Wednesday for a five-day run through Sunday, with this year's guest of honour being Slovenia, whose publishers and authors will occupy a dedicated pavilion in Hall 3 of the Messe Frankfurt fairgrounds. Organising director Klara Vondráčková told reporters that more than 4,200 exhibitors from 95 countries have registered, making the 2024 edition the largest since the pandemic interrupted the fair's unbroken run. Tickets are available from €18 at the door.

The Wiener Festwochen opens its 72nd edition on Friday with a programme spanning seventeen countries, anchored by a long-awaited staging of Elfriede Jelinek's "Licht" at the Burgtheater — directed by Marta Soldevila-Reus — alongside retrospectives, participatory installations, and three world premieres from emerging choreographers. Festwochen director Ingrid Haslbauer told reporters the festival would run through 22 June, with tickets starting at €12.

Reigning champions Djurgårdens IF held off a spirited comeback from Hammarby IF to claim a hard-fought 2–1 victory in Sunday's Stockholm derby at Tele2 Arena, with midfielder Kristoffer Janås scoring the decisive goal in the 78th minute before a crowd of 29,500. The win keeps Djurgårdens five points clear at the top of Allsvenskan heading into the winter break.

The Frankfurter Buchmesse opens its 76th edition on Wednesday, October 16, drawing publishers, agents, and literary figures from more than 100 countries to the Messe Frankfurt fairgrounds. This year's guest of honour is Italy, whose pavilion — designed by curator Alessandra Ferretti and co-curated by Marco Salvini — will trace five centuries of Italian print culture across a series of immersive reading rooms. Organisers expect upward of 285,000 visitors over the five-day fair, which runs through Sunday, October 20.

Commuters across Brussels faced widespread disruption on Monday after STIB-MIVB drivers walked off the job in a 24-hour strike over stalled wage negotiations, halting all four metro lines as well as dozens of tram and bus routes during the morning and evening rush hours. The Belgian transport workers' union CSC Transcom confirmed that roughly 340,000 passengers were affected over the course of the day. Service was expected to resume in full by Tuesday morning, though union representatives warned that further stoppages could follow if management failed to table a revised pay offer within the week.

The Scottish Parliament voted by a narrow margin on Thursday to back a landmark tenants' rights bill championed by the Scottish Greens, with 68 votes in favour, 55 against, and 4 abstentions — a result that obliges the Scottish National Party government to incorporate stronger eviction protections into the pending housing legislation, despite fierce resistance from Conservative MSPs who argued the measure would deter private landlords from the rental market altogether. Deputy First Minister Catriona Muir welcomed the outcome as "a decisive step toward housing justice," while Scottish Tory housing spokesman Alasdair Fergusson called it "reckless economic vandalism dressed up as compassion."

The debate over whether Rotterdam's sprawling Ahoy arena should be overhauled to accommodate larger touring productions has quietly divided the city's cultural establishment for the better part of a decade, with architects, venue managers, and municipal officials trading position papers but never arriving at a formal proposal. Supporters of expansion argue that Amsterdam's Ziggo Dome continues to siphon away premium bookings that might otherwise strengthen Rotterdam's profile as a serious concert destination, while critics counter that any structural enlargement would compromise the building's unusual post-war geometry. The city council has not scheduled a vote on the matter, and the alderman responsible for culture, Ineke Sorgdrager-Haas, acknowledged in an interview with NRC Handelsblad last month that a decision remains "some years away at the earliest."

Borussia Dortmund's Mirela Voss delivered a composed brace in the second half to secure a 3–1 victory over SC Freiburg at Signal Iduna Park on Saturday, extending Dortmund's unbeaten run to seven games in the Frauen-Bundesliga. Goalkeeper Renate Strohmeier, meanwhile, earned widespread praise for a string of crucial stops that kept Freiburg at bay in a tense opening forty-five minutes, with an announced attendance of 12,400 making it one of the best-supported Frauen-Bundesliga fixtures of the season.

Commuters across the Oslo region faced significant delays on Monday morning after Ruter announced an indefinite suspension of tram services on lines 12 and 19 following the discovery of critical track faults near Nationaltheatret station. Engineers from Bane NOR were dispatched overnight to assess the damage, with repair works expected to last at least four days. Passengers are advised to use replacement bus services running parallel routes between Majorstuen and Ljabru, though authorities warned that capacity on the substitute network would be severely strained during peak hours. An estimated 38,000 daily commuters are affected by the outage.

The Wiener Konzerthaus will host a three-night retrospective of the late composer Árpád Vásárhelyi's orchestral works beginning Friday, 18 October, with the Vienna Philharmonic under the baton of conductor Liselotte Brantner performing rarely heard symphonies from the 1970s and 1980s; tickets are priced at €45 for standard seating. Curated by musicologist Dr. Renata Schiavone, the programme has been hailed by Austrian critics as the most significant celebration of Vásárhelyi's legacy since his death in 2009.

The Frankfurter Buchmesse opens its doors on Wednesday for a five-day run that organisers expect to draw upwards of 300,000 visitors to the Messe Frankfurt fairgrounds, with Norwegian literature taking centre stage as this year's Guest of Honour. Hilde Knudsen-Voss, the festival's newly appointed director, said the programme would feature more than 4,000 exhibitors from 95 countries, alongside panel discussions, readings, and a dedicated translation-rights forum. Tickets are priced at €18 for a single day's admission.

The Scottish Parliament voted by a narrow margin on Thursday to reject the proposed Rural Land Reform Bill, with 63 members voting against and 59 in favour, after a heated debate in which opposition MSPs accused the governing Scottish National Party of overreaching its mandate. Catriona Muirhead, the SNP's rural affairs spokesperson, conceded that the bill would be reintroduced in amended form before the end of the current parliamentary session, though she offered no firm timetable. The Scottish Conservatives and Scottish Labour both backed the rejection, while the Scottish Greens sided with the SNP in pushing for the legislation's passage.

Sébastien Kowalczyk delivered a masterclass at the Parc des Princes on Saturday evening, netting a hat-trick as Paris FC dismantled visiting Clermont Foot 4–1 in a Ligue 2 fixture that drew 18,432 fans to the terraces. Clermont's consolation goal, bundled in by Théo Andrieu late in the second half, did little to disguise the gulf between the sides. Paris FC's head coach, Miriam Ouédraogo, described the performance as "exactly what we'd rehearsed all week."

Galatasaray held off a spirited second-half comeback to defeat Fenerbahçe 2–1 in a ferocious Istanbul derby at Rams Park on Saturday, with midfielder Emre Doğan's curling strike ten minutes from time proving the decisive moment. A crowd of 52,400 roared the home side through a frantic closing spell as Fenerbahçe pressed relentlessly for an equaliser that never came, leaving Galatasaray four points clear at the top of the Süper Lig table.

The Frankfurter Buchmesse opened its doors on Wednesday to a record 4,312 exhibitors from 95 countries, with Norwegian author Sigrid Tønnessen delivering a closely watched keynote address in Hall 4.1 that drew sustained applause from an audience of roughly 2,800 publishing professionals. This year's guest of honour is Slovenia, whose pavilion — designed by Ljubljana-based architect Maruša Kranjc — has been singled out by curators as one of the most striking in the fair's recent history. The edition runs through Sunday.

The Flemish parliament in Brussels voted narrowly on Thursday to approve a new austerity package championed by the centre-right coalition, with 72 members voting in favour, 58 against, and 11 abstaining, as opposition leaders from Vooruit and the Greens accused the ruling N-VA and CD&V of placing an unfair burden on working families. Finance Minister Katrien Vande Moortel defended the measures as "a necessary correction after years of overspending," while Vooruit's parliamentary floor leader Stef Brouwers called for an emergency summit with trade unions before the budget takes effect on 1 March 2026.

A brace from winger Teodora Vaszilević and a composed finish by striker Lena Brøgger sealed a 3–1 victory for Klepp IL over Arna-Bjørnar at Jærhallen on Sunday, lifting Klepp to third place in the Toppserien table with just four rounds remaining in the season.

Die Frankfurter Buchmesse eröffnet am 15. Oktober ihre 76. Ausgabe auf dem Messegelände Frankfurt mit einem Abendempfang für rund 3.200 geladene Gäste — darunter Verleger, Literaturagenten und Autorinnen aus aller Welt. Als Ehrengast des diesjährigen Jahrgangs tritt die Republik Slowenien auf, deren Kulturministerin Vesna Mlakar in ihrer Eröffnungsrede die „unerschöpfliche Kraft kleiner Literaturen" beschwor. Die Messe läuft bis zum 19. Oktober und umfasst nach Angaben des Börsenvereins des Deutschen Buchhandels mehr als 4.000 Aussteller aus über 95 Ländern.

The Barbican Centre will open its long-anticipated retrospective of textile artist Maren Søviknes on 14 March, bringing together more than 120 woven and embroidered works spanning four decades of her practice. Curated by Lena Hoffstadt of the Barbican's visual arts team, the exhibition — titled "Thread and Silence" — draws on loans from the Städel Museum, the Victoria and Albert Museum, and several private collections. Admission is priced at £18 for adults, and the show is scheduled to run until 1 June.

The debate over whether London's Barbican Centre should undergo a long-delayed structural overhaul has resurfaced in architectural circles, with some critics arguing that TfL's proposed expansion of the nearby Moorgate station would complicate any renovation timeline significantly; the Labour-controlled City of London Corporation has so far declined to set a public consultation date, leaving both cultural advocates and commuters in a state of prolonged uncertainty that the Guardian described last autumn as "a masterclass in institutional drift."

Beim packenden Halbfinale der Deutschen Schwimmmeisterschaften in der Neptunhalle Hamburg setzte sich die 4×100-Meter-Freistilstaffel des SC Magdeburg am Samstagabend mit einer Zeit von 3:31,04 Minuten gegen den Rivalen Wasserfreunde Spandau 04 durch und zog damit souverän ins Finale ein. Überragender Akteur war der 22-jährige Staffelschlussschwimmer Luca Frenzel, der seinen Teilabschnitt in beeindruckenden 48,6 Sekunden absolvierte und damit die entscheidende Aufholjagd einleitete. Rund 2.400 Zuschauer in der ausverkauften Halle feierten die Leistung des Magdeburger Teams lautstark.

Eurostar has confirmed that engineering works on the high-speed link between London St Pancras International and Brussels-Midi will force a reduced timetable from 14 March to 22 March, with roughly 47,000 passengers expected to be affected. The disruption stems from track renewal on the Belgian side of the Channel Tunnel corridor, and travellers are advised to check their bookings in advance. A spokesperson for Eurostar said full services would resume on 23 March.

The Flemish parliament voted narrowly on Thursday to approve a controversial cultural funding bill that redirects €12 million annually toward contemporary art institutions, with the centre-right N-VA pushing the measure through by just four votes against fierce opposition from Vooruit and the Greens. The vote's passage has already galvanised Brussels' arts community: the Wiels Contemporary Art Centre announced the same evening that it will host a landmark group exhibition titled "New Cartographies," opening on 14 March and running through late June, featuring works by twelve emerging artists from Belgium, the Netherlands, and the Democratic Republic of Congo.

Leverkusen came from behind twice to earn a gritty 2–2 draw against RB Leipzig at the BayArena on Saturday, with midfielder Tomás Enríquez salvaging a point in the 88th minute after Leipzig's Dawid Krawczyk had restored the visitors' lead just six minutes earlier. The result leaves Bayer 04 Leverkusen four points adrift of the Bundesliga summit heading into the winter break.

The Swedish Riksdag narrowly passed a landmark housing-reform bill on Thursday, with 176 votes in favour and 173 against, after weeks of fractious debate that tested the fragile coalition between the Moderaterna and Sverigedemokraterna. Finance minister Ingrid Sollberg hailed the vote as "a decisive step toward tackling Sweden's chronic shortage of affordable homes," while opposition leader Tobias Eklöf of the Socialdemokraterna warned that the legislation would accelerate privatisation at the expense of low-income tenants. No abstentions were recorded.

Wegen eines technischen Defekts an einer Weichenanlage im Bereich des Hauptbahnhofs Frankfurt ist der S-Bahn-Verkehr auf den Linien S3, S4 und S5 seit dem frühen Dienstagmorgen erheblich gestört. Die DB Regio AG empfiehlt betroffenen Fahrgästen, auf U-Bahn- und Buslinien auszuweichen; Schätzungen zufolge sind rund 47.000 Pendler betroffen. Ein Ende der Störung war bis Redaktionsschluss nicht absehbar.

The Riksdag voted narrowly on Thursday to approve a sweeping overhaul of Sweden's housing benefit system, with the centre-right coalition securing a majority of just four votes after hours of acrimonious debate. Prime Minister-designate Britta Söderholm, who had staked her fledgling government's credibility on the legislation, welcomed the result as "a turning point for working families priced out of the rental market." The Social Democrats and the Greens voted unanimously against the bill, warning that cuts to housing subsidies would deepen inequality in cities like Gothenburg and Malmö. Final tallies showed 176 votes in favour, 172 against, and three abstentions.

Cross-border rail services between München and Salzburg will be suspended for eleven days starting 14 March, as ÖBB and Deutsche Bahn carry out emergency trackwork on a deteriorating section of the Rosenheim–Freilassing corridor. An estimated 28,000 daily passengers are expected to use replacement bus services, which both operators warn will add up to 90 minutes to journey times. The two railways have asked travellers to consider delaying non-essential trips until full service resumes on 25 March.

Commuters across Greater Manchester faced severe disruption on Monday after Avanti West Coast and Northern Rail both announced emergency suspensions of all services through Piccadilly station, citing a fractured overhead line discovered during routine maintenance checks at 4 a.m. Repair crews from Network Rail worked through the morning, but engineers warned that full service restoration was unlikely before Wednesday at the earliest, leaving an estimated 47,000 passengers to seek alternative routes via Metrolink trams or replacement bus services laid on by Transport for Greater Manchester.

Sydney's rail network faces its most severe disruption in years this weekend as workers represented by the Rail, Tram and Bus Union walk off the job from Friday evening through Sunday midnight, halting services on the T1, T2, T3, T4 and T8 lines and leaving an estimated 340,000 commuters without train services. Transport for NSW confirmed that a skeleton bus replacement network would operate on major corridors, but urged passengers to avoid non-essential travel. The strike, which union officials say stems from stalled negotiations over a pay rise of $4,200 per year and improved rostering conditions, is the second industrial action in four months.

Beim packenden Stadtderby in der 2. Bundesliga trennten sich der FC Hansa Rostock und der FC Erzgebirge Aue am Samstagabend im Ostseestadion mit 2:2, nachdem Aues Stürmer Pawel Krzyzanowski in der 89. Minute den Ausgleich erzielt hatte. Vor 22.400 Zuschauern war es Hansas Verteidiger Torben Striewe gewesen, der die Gastgeber in der zweiten Halbzeit zweimal in Führung gebracht hatte – vergeblich, wie sich zeigte.

The Stormont Assembly voted narrowly on Thursday to approve a cross-party motion calling on Westminster to devolve full fiscal powers to Northern Ireland, with 58 members backing the measure against 43 opposed and 7 abstaining — a result that Sinn Féin's chief whip, Caoimhe Ní Bhriain, described as "a turning point in the relationship between Belfast and London." The Democratic Unionist Party, which had lobbied hard against the motion, accused the Assembly of overstepping its mandate, while the Alliance Party welcomed the outcome as overdue.

The Swedish Riksdag narrowly approved a sweeping pension reform package on Thursday, with 176 votes in favour and 173 against, after weeks of fractious cross-party negotiations that at one point threatened to collapse the minority government led by the Moderate Party. Finance Minister Agneta Söderblom hailed the result as "a generational act of responsibility," while opposition leader Birger Lundqvist of the Social Democrats vowed to reverse the changes if his party returns to power following next autumn's general election.

Nadia Ferreira-Blom held her nerve in a tense final-set tiebreak to defeat Petra Solberg 7–5, 4–6, 7–6 at the Rothenbaum Tennis Center in Hamburg on Saturday, claiming the women's singles title at the Hamburg Open and ending a three-year run without a Tour-level trophy.

The Frankfurter Buchmesse opens its doors on Wednesday for its 76th edition, welcoming more than 4,200 exhibitors from 95 countries to the Messe Frankfurt fairgrounds for five days of readings, panel discussions, and rights negotiations that will shape the publishing world's agenda well into next year. This year's guest of honour is Italy, and a sprawling programme of Italian authors, translators, and illustrators will occupy a dedicated pavilion throughout the fair. Tickets for the public days, running Saturday and Sunday, are priced at €18.

Die Frankfurter Buchmesse öffnet am 15. Oktober ihre Tore für Fachbesucher und feiert damit ihre 76. Ausgabe — ein Ereignis, das laut Messedirektorin Carola Veit erstmals einen eigenen Pavillon für graphic novels und illustrierte Literatur umfasst. Rund 4.200 Aussteller aus mehr als 95 Ländern haben sich angemeldet, und der Ehrengast in diesem Jahr ist Norwegen. Die Messe dauert bis zum 20. Oktober und findet wie gewohnt auf dem Messegelände Frankfurt statt.

Die Städtische Galerie Karlsruhe eröffnet am 14. März eine umfangreiche Retrospektive des österreichischen Malers Tobias Fennrich, die rund 120 Werke aus vier Jahrzehnten versammelt. Gezeigt werden Öl- und Acrylgemälde sowie großformatige Zeichnungen, die Fennrichs obsessive Auseinandersetzung mit urbaner Architektur und Verfall dokumentieren. Die Ausstellung, kuratiert von Dr. Miriam Stollwasser vom Zentralinstitut für Kunstgeschichte München, läuft bis zum 8. Juni und wird von einem umfangreichen Rahmenprogramm mit Führungen und Vorträgen begleitet. Der Eintritt kostet 12 Euro.

Der Stadtrat von Freiburg im Breisgau hat am Donnerstagabend mit knapper Mehrheit beschlossen, die geplante Erweiterung des kommunalen Wohnbauprogramms um 4.200 neue Sozialwohnungen voranzutreiben. Bei der Abstimmung votierten 28 Ratsmitglieder dafür, 21 dagegen, während sich fünf enthielten. Oberbürgermeisterin Kerstin Vollbrecht sprach von einem „historischen Schritt für bezahlbares Wohnen in unserer Stadt", während der Fraktionsvorsitzende der CDU, Markus Dörflinger, die Finanzierbarkeit des Vorhabens grundsätzlich in Frage stellte. Die Grünen und die SPD hatten das Programm gemeinsam eingebracht und sehen darin einen zentralen Baustein ihrer Koalitionsvereinbarung für die laufende Legislaturperiode.

The Frankfurter Buchmesse opens its doors on Wednesday for a five-day run through Sunday, drawing an expected 85,000 visitors to Messe Frankfurt for what organisers are billing as the largest gathering of publishers, literary agents, and rights traders in the world. This year's Guest of Honour is Slovenia, with a pavilion curated by Tanja Kovič showcasing more than forty Slovenian authors in translation. Tickets are priced at €18 for a single-day adult entry.

The Frankfurter Buchmesse opens its doors on Wednesday for a five-day run that organisers expect to draw upward of 300,000 visitors, with Norwegian literature taking centre stage as the guest-of-honour theme. Among the highlights is a keynote lecture by debut novelist Astrid Vøllestad at the Festhalle on Thursday evening, followed by a panel discussion moderated by cultural journalist Knut Erling Berge.

The Scottish Parliament voted by a narrow margin on Thursday to extend free school meal provision to all primary-age children across Scotland, with 68 members in favour and 55 against, after a heated three-hour debate during which SNP backbencher Catriona Dunbar accused the Scottish Conservatives of "wilful indifference to child poverty." The Scottish Labour Party backed the measure, proving decisive in securing the government's majority.

The Frankfurter Buchmesse opened its doors on Wednesday to a record 4,200 exhibitors from 95 countries, with Argentine novelist Camila Restrepo-Vidal delivering the inaugural address at the Festhalle in a ceremony that drew nearly 9,800 guests. This year's guest of honour is Slovenia, whose pavilion — curated by cultural director Maruša Žnidarič — occupies an entire wing of Hall 4.1 and showcases more than three decades of Slovenian literary output. The fair runs through Sunday.

The Reykjavik City Council voted narrowly on Thursday to approve a new housing affordability framework, with 11 councillors in favour, 8 against, and 2 abstentions — a result that the governing coalition of Samfylkingin and Vinstri Græn hailed as a "generational commitment" to tackling the capital's acute rental crisis. Council leader Sigríður Björk Einarsdóttir, who steered the measure through three months of contentious debate, said the policy would require all new residential developments above 50 units to include at least 30 per cent below-market-rate housing.

Beim packenden Halbfinale der Deutschen Volleyball-Meisterschaft bezwang der VfB Friedrichshafen am Samstagabend die Berlin Recycling Volleys mit 3:1 Sätzen vor ausverkauftem Haus in der ZF Arena. Rund 4.200 Zuschauer erlebten eine kämpferische Vorstellung beider Teams, wobei der Friedrichshafener Außenangreifer Tobias Gremmler mit 24 Punkten herausragte. Das Rückspiel findet am kommenden Samstag in Berlin statt.

Der Stadtrat von Freiburg im Breisgau hat am Donnerstagabend mit knapper Mehrheit für die Einführung einer kommunalen Mietpreisbremse gestimmt: 27 Ratsmitglieder votierten dafür, 21 dagegen, bei vier Enthaltungen. Die Initiative wurde maßgeblich von den Grünen und der SPD getragen, während die CDU-Fraktion geschlossen Nein sagte. Bürgermeisterin Karoline Wethmann zeigte sich erleichtert und sprach von einem „längst überfälligen Signal für bezahlbares Wohnen in unserer Stadt".

Malmö FF edged past Djurgårdens IF 2–1 in a tense Allsvenskan clash at Eleda Stadion on Saturday evening, with midfielder Tobias Renström sealing the points in the 87th minute after a low drive that wrong-footed the visiting goalkeeper. A crowd of 19,450 witnessed the home side climb provisionally to second place in the table, leaving Djurgårdens to rue a succession of squandered chances in the first half.

Der Stadtrat von Regensburg hat am Donnerstagabend mit knapper Mehrheit beschlossen, das städtische Wohnbauprogramm um 45 Millionen Euro aufzustocken — 23 Stimmen votierten dafür, 19 dagegen, bei zwei Enthaltungen. Bürgermeisterin Klara Fendt von der SPD bezeichnete den Beschluss als „überfälliges Signal für bezahlbares Wohnen", während der CSU-Fraktionsvorsitzende Markus Oberleitner die fehlende Finanzierungsgrundlage scharf kritisierte. Die Grünen hatten den Antrag gemeinsam mit der SPD eingebracht.

The Reykjavik Arts Festival opens its 48th edition on Friday at Harpa Concert Hall, bringing together visual artists, composers, and performers from across Scandinavia and the North Atlantic for a twelve-day programme that culminates in a large-scale sound installation by Icelandic composer Sigríður Níelsdóttir. Tickets are priced at 3,500 Icelandic krónur for individual events, with a full-festival pass available at 18,000 krónur. Festival director Ólafur Magnússon described the theme this year as "the acoustics of landscape," promising audiences an experience that blurs the boundaries between concert hall and wilderness.

Der Stadtrat von Freiburg im Breisgau hat am Donnerstagabend mit knapper Mehrheit beschlossen, die Straßenbaugebühren für Anlieger vollständig abzuschaffen — ein Vorhaben, das die Grünen und die SPD gemeinsam eingebracht hatten, während die CDU-Fraktion geschlossen dagegenstimmte. Bei der Abstimmung entfielen 27 Stimmen auf den Antrag, 24 dagegen, bei drei Enthaltungen. Bürgermeisterin Karla Sönnichsen sprach von einem „wichtigen Schritt zur sozialen Gerechtigkeit in unserer Stadt".

The Frankfurter Buchmesse opens its doors on Wednesday, drawing publishers, agents, and literary enthusiasts from more than 100 countries to the Messe Frankfurt fairgrounds for five days of readings, panel discussions, and rights negotiations. This year's Guest of Honour is Italy, with a sprawling programme curated by the Istituto Italiano di Cultura that spans contemporary fiction, poetry, and graphic novels. Organisers expect upward of 300,000 visitors over the course of the fair, which runs through Sunday.

Marta Olszewska struck twice in the final twelve minutes to hand Górnik Zabrze a stunning 3-2 comeback win over Zagłębie Lubin in the Polish Women's First League on Saturday, with 2,140 supporters packed into the Stadion im. Ernesta Pohla witnessing one of the most dramatic reversals of the season.

Commuters across Greater Manchester faced significant disruption on Wednesday after Avanti West Coast and Northern Rail both suspended services between Manchester Piccadilly and Liverpool Lime Street following the discovery of a cracked bridge beam near Warrington Bank Quay, a fault engineers said could not be safely bypassed without a full structural inspection lasting up to four days. Metrolink tram services absorbed some of the overflow, but passengers heading to Liverpool were advised to use replacement coach services laid on by Transport for the North. An estimated 47,000 daily rail users are expected to be affected before full line reinstatement, currently projected for Sunday.

Die ÖBB haben angekündigt, dass die Weststrecke zwischen Wien Westbahnhof und Salzburg Hauptbahnhof vom 14. bis 28. März 2026 wegen umfangreicher Gleiserneuerungsarbeiten vollständig gesperrt wird; rund 42.000 Fahrgäste täglich sind betroffen, und als Ersatz verkehren Schienenersatzbusse auf der gesamten Strecke.

The city of Edinburgh braced for significant travel disruption this weekend as Lothian Buses announced the suspension of four key routes through the city centre on Saturday and Sunday, citing emergency resurfacing works on Princes Street — a move that forced thousands of rugby fans attending the sold-out Six Nations match between Scotland and France at Scottish Gas Murrayfield Stadium to seek alternative arrangements. Scotland ultimately prevailed 27–19 before a capacity crowd of 67,144, with flanker Callum Dreich named Player of the Match after a commanding display in the loose.

Der Wiener Gemeinderat hat am Donnerstag mit knapper Mehrheit den umstrittenen Stadtentwicklungsplan für das Gebiet rund um den Nordbahnhof verabschiedet. Die Abstimmung endete mit 46 Ja-Stimmen, 39 Nein-Stimmen und vier Enthaltungen, nachdem eine mehrstündige Debatte im Rathaus die tief greifenden Meinungsverschiedenheiten zwischen der regierenden Koalition aus SPÖ und NEOS auf der einen und FPÖ sowie ÖVP auf der anderen Seite offenbart hatte. Fraktionschefin Ingrid Wallner (SPÖ) erklärte, der Plan sichere langfristig leistbares Wohnen für tausende Wienerinnen und Wiener, während der freiheitliche Stadtrat Clemens Brachner das Vorhaben als „überstürzt und finanziell unverantwortlich" bezeichnete.

Trailing by two sets and seemingly on the verge of collapse, Teodora Vašíček clawed her way back to defeat fourth-seeded Miriam Osei-Bonsu 4–6, 3–6, 6–4, 7–5, 6–3 in a gripping quarterfinal at the Rothenbaum Tennis Centre in Hamburg on Thursday, sending the capacity crowd into prolonged applause and setting up a blockbuster semifinal clash at the Deutschlandpokal.

The Frankfurter Buchmesse opened its doors on Wednesday to an estimated 93,000 trade visitors and members of the public, marking the fair's 76th edition with a sprawling programme of panel discussions, author signings, and rights negotiations spread across six halls of Messe Frankfurt. This year's guest of honour, Italy, brought a delegation of more than two hundred publishers and writers to the fairgrounds, where a central pavilion showcased translations of Italian literature into over forty languages. The fair runs through Sunday.

Commuters on the U6 and U4 lines in Vienna face significant disruptions this weekend after Wiener Linien announced emergency track repairs at Längenfeldgasse station, with full service suspensions expected from Saturday morning through Sunday night. Replacement bus services will operate at reduced frequency, and the operator estimates roughly 87,000 passengers will be affected over the two-day closure. A spokesperson for Wiener Linien cited accelerated rail joint fatigue as the cause, attributing the deterioration to the record passenger volumes recorded during the previous month's public transport fare reform, which slashed single-journey prices to €1.50.

Marta Soldevila scored a brace in the final twelve minutes to hand FC Barcelona Femení a dramatic 3–2 victory over Arsenal Women at the Estadi Johan Cruyff on Saturday, extending the Spanish side's unbeaten run in the UEFA Women's Champions League to eleven games.

Die Frankfurter Buchmesse eröffnet am 15. Oktober ihre 76. Ausgabe auf dem Messegelände Frankfurt mit einem Festakt, bei dem die österreichische Autorin Mara Villenbach die Eröffnungsrede halten wird. Erwartet werden rund 4.200 Aussteller aus über 100 Ländern; der Ehrengast in diesem Jahr ist Kanada. Die Messe läuft bis zum 19. Oktober und gilt als die weltweit bedeutendste Zusammenkunft der Buchbranche.

Commuters on the Merseyrail network faced significant delays on Wednesday morning after a signalling failure between Liverpool Central and Hunts Cross brought all services on the Northern Line to a standstill for nearly three hours. Merseytravel confirmed that around 47,000 passengers were affected before engineers restored full operations by 11:15 a.m., though the operator urged travellers to expect residual disruption throughout the afternoon peak.

Defending champions Rosenborg BK were held to a bruising 1–1 draw by Molde FK at Lerkendal Stadion in Trondheim on Saturday, a result that hands Bodø/Glimt a four-point cushion at the summit of the Eliteserien with just six matchdays remaining. Rosenborg's leveller — a clinical 79th-minute header from midfielder Erlend Mæhle — came too late to rescue all three points, and the home side's title hopes now look decidedly fragile. An announced attendance of 18,340 underlined the fixture's intensity.

Beim Rückrundenauftakt der 2. Bundesliga empfing der FC Kaiserslautern am Samstagabend den Hamburger SV im Fritz Walter Stadion vor ausverkauftem Haus. Die Gastgeber, angetrieben von einem überragenden Doppelpack des Stürmers Luca Renner, setzten sich verdient mit 3:1 durch und kletterten damit auf den dritten Tabellenplatz. HSV-Kapitän Mats Dröge verkürzte zwar zwischenzeitlich auf 1:2, doch der eingewechselte Timo Scharmann besiegelte in der 88. Minute den Endstand. Rund 49.800 Zuschauer erlebten im Pfälzer Stadion eines der emotionalsten Duelle dieser Saison.

The Frankfurter Buchmesse opens its doors on Wednesday for a five-day run that organisers expect to draw upwards of 300,000 visitors, with Norwegian literature taking centre stage as the guest-of-honour theme this year. Among the most anticipated events is a keynote lecture by debut novelist Sigrid Tanvik, whose debut collection "Winterhold" has already sold out its first printing across Scandinavia. The fair, held as ever at Messe Frankfurt, will also host panel discussions, translation workshops, and an evening reading series curated by Lena Brandt of the Frankfurter Literaturhaus.

The Swedish Riksdag narrowly approved a controversial housing deregulation bill on Thursday, with 176 votes in favour and 173 against, after weeks of fractious debate that had threatened to unseat the fragile coalition between the Moderaterna and Sverigedemokraterna. Finance Minister Britta Söderholm, who shepherded the legislation through its final reading, called the outcome "a decisive step toward affordable housing for ordinary Swedes," while opposition leader Klas Engström of the Socialdemokraterna vowed to challenge the measure in committee at the earliest opportunity.

The same weekend that Borussia Dortmund edged Eintracht Frankfurt 2–1 at Signal Iduna Park in a tense Bundesliga clash before 81,365 supporters — a goal from midfielder Lukas Brenner proving decisive in stoppage time — the adjacent Ruhrfestspiele Recklinghausen opened its summer season with a sold-out premiere of a new chamber opera by composer Miriam Soltau, staged at the Festspielhaus and drawing an audience of over 900.

Midfielder Tomáš Beránek scored twice in the final twelve minutes to hand FK Pardubice a dramatic 3–2 victory over Zbrojovka Brno at the Městský fotbalový stadion on Saturday evening, lifting Pardubice to fourth place in the Czech First League table. A crowd of 6,114 watched the hosts surrender a two-goal lead before Beránek's brace settled the nerves of the home faithful.

Die Münchner Kammerspiele eröffnen am 14. März ihre neue Ausstellungsreihe „Zwischen den Worten", die sich dem zeitgenössischen Buchkunst-Schaffen widmet und bis zum 2. April läuft. Kuratorin Leonie Fassbender hat gemeinsam mit dem Stadtmuseum München rund 180 Originalillustrationen und Typografiearbeiten von zwölf internationalen Buchkünstlerinnen zusammengestellt. Der Eintritt kostet 8 Euro; zur Vernissage am Eröffnungsabend werden über 400 Gäste erwartet.

Im packenden Kellerduell der 2. Bundesliga setzte sich der FC Schalke 04 am Samstagabend auf dem heimischen Rasen mit 3:1 gegen den Hamburger SV durch und kletterte damit vorerst aus der Abstiegszone. Vor 61.482 Zuschauern in der Veltins-Arena erzielte Mittelfeldspieler Tomás Vrábel zwei der drei Schalker Treffer und wurde zum umjubelten Mann des Abends.

The Frankfurter Buchmesse opened its doors on Wednesday for its 76th edition, drawing publishers, agents, and literary scouts from more than 100 countries to the Messe Frankfurt fairgrounds. This year's guest of honour is Italy, whose pavilion — designed by architect Giulia Santorini and curated by the Associazione Italiana Editori — showcases over 400 titles in translation alongside a series of evening readings by authors including Renata Colombo and Marco Ferretti. Organisers expect upwards of 300,000 visitors before the fair closes on Sunday.

The Frankfurter Buchmesse opens its doors on Wednesday for its 76th edition, drawing publishers, agents, and readers from more than 100 countries to the Messe Frankfurt fairgrounds. This year's Guest of Honour is Italy, with a sweeping programme of Italian-language readings, panel discussions, and a dedicated pavilion curated by the Associazione Italiana Editori. Organisers expect upwards of 300,000 visitors across the five-day fair, which runs through Sunday.

Grasshopper Club Zürich held Servette FC to a tense 1–1 draw at Letzigrund on Saturday evening, with midfielder Dario Pellegrini cancelling out a stunning opener from Servette's Théo Magnin just before the hour mark. A crowd of 11,240 watched the Super League encounter, which leaves both clubs separated by a single point in the table heading into the winter break.

Zara Mwangi's brace in the final twelve minutes sealed a dramatic 3–1 comeback victory for Brøndby IF over FC Zürich at Brøndby Stadion on Saturday evening, keeping the Danish side's Women's Champions League group-stage hopes firmly alive. The Swiss visitors had led through Petra Hollenstein's first-half strike before Mwangi and substitute Elin Thorvaldsdóttir turned the tie on its head in front of 6,200 supporters.

Wegen eines Stellwerksausfalls in Hannover Hauptbahnhof kommt es seit den frühen Morgenstunden des 14. Juli zu erheblichen Beeinträchtigungen im Regional- und Fernverkehr: Die Deutsche Bahn meldete Verspätungen von bis zu 90 Minuten auf den Linien RE 9, RE 60 sowie dem ICE-Korridor Richtung Hamburg. Schätzungsweise 47.000 Reisende sind betroffen. Ein Sprecher der Deutschen Bahn erklärte, Techniker arbeiteten mit Hochdruck an der Behebung des Schadens; ein Ende der Störung sei frühestens am späten Nachmittag zu erwarten.

Der Hamburger Senat hat am Dienstag mit einer knappen Mehrheit von 51 zu 44 Stimmen den milliardenschweren Ausbau der U5 beschlossen — ein Projekt, das seit Jahren zwischen SPD und Grünen umstritten war. Bürgermeisterin Klara Söffner sprach von einem „historischen Tag für die Mobilität der Stadt" und betonte, dass die neue Linie bis 2034 rund 200.000 Fahrgäste täglich befördern solle. Die Hamburger Hochbahn soll als Betreiber fungieren und erhält dafür Bundesmittel in Höhe von 2,3 Milliarden Euro. Noch am selben Abend kündigte die CDU-Fraktion an, gegen den Beschluss eine Volksinitiative einzuleiten, da sie die Finanzierungsgrundlage für unsolide hält.

The Bundestag approved a sweeping overhaul of Germany's renewable energy subsidies late Wednesday evening after a fractious four-hour debate, with the coalition's motion passing by 387 votes to 241, with 19 abstentions. The SPD and the Grüne celebrated the result as a landmark step toward carbon neutrality by 2045, while the CDU/CSU and the AfD condemned the legislation as economically reckless. Energy Minister Dorothea Wengler, who steered the bill through committee over the past three months, told reporters outside the Reichstag that the vote represented "the most consequential climate legislation this parliament has passed in a generation."

Wegen des Bundesliga-Derbys zwischen dem FC St. Pauli und dem Hamburger SV am Sonnabend im Volksparkstadion hat die Hamburger Hochbahn AG angekündigt, auf den Linien U2 und U3 ab 14 Uhr Sonderzüge einzusetzen sowie rund um den Anpfiff um 18:30 Uhr zusätzliche Busse auf der Linie 15 bereitzustellen. Rund 57.000 Zuschauer werden zum Nordderby erwartet, das Verkehrsunternehmen rechnet mit etwa 38.000 zusätzlichen Fahrgästen. Das Spiel gilt als erstes Stadtderby beider Klubs in der ersten Liga seit über einem Jahrzehnt.

Commuters on the S-Bahn München network faced severe disruptions on Monday after a signalling fault near Ostbahnhof brought the entire City Tunnel to a standstill for roughly four hours, with Deutsche Bahn estimating that around 340,000 passengers were affected. Services on lines S1 through S8 were suspended between Pasing and Leuchtenbergring while engineers worked to isolate the fault, and replacement bus shuttles struggled to absorb the surge in demand during the morning rush. A Deutsche Bahn spokesperson said full operations were restored shortly after noon.

Der Stadtrat von Freiburg im Breisgau hat am Donnerstagabend mit knapper Mehrheit beschlossen, die städtische Kitaförderung um 3,2 Millionen Euro jährlich aufzustocken. Der Antrag der Grünen und der SPD wurde mit 27 Stimmen dafür, 22 dagegen und 4 Enthaltungen angenommen, nachdem Stadträtin Lena Vossberg (Grüne) die sozialpolitische Notwendigkeit der Maßnahme in einer engagierten Rede unterstrichen hatte. Die CDU-Fraktion, die das Vorhaben als haushalterisch unverantwortlich bezeichnete, kündigte an, die Entscheidung auf der nächsten Sitzung anfechten zu wollen.

Die Frankfurter Buchmesse eröffnet am 15. Oktober ihre 76. Ausgabe auf dem Messegelände Frankfurt und erwartet in diesem Jahr rund 95.000 Fachbesucher aus aller Welt. Als Gastland tritt Slowenien auf, dessen Verlage und Autoren in einer Sonderschau im Pavillon 3 präsentiert werden. Die Schriftstellerin Nataša Vogrič, die in Ljubljana als eine der profiliertesten Stimmen der slowenischen Gegenwartsliteratur gilt, wird am Eröffnungstag eine vielbeachtete Lesung halten. Veranstalter ist, wie jedes Jahr, der Börsenverein des Deutschen Buchhandels.

Sixteen-year-old Mirela Okonkwo became the youngest winner in the history of the Hannover Junior Rowing Championships on Saturday, steering her single scull to a commanding victory over a field of 34 competitors at the Maschsee regatta course. Okonkwo, representing Ruderclub Hannover, finished the 2,000-metre final in 7 minutes 43 seconds — nearly twelve seconds ahead of her nearest rival. An estimated 2,100 spectators lined the banks to watch the afternoon programme.

The Scottish Parliament voted narrowly on Thursday to pass the Housing Affordability (Scotland) Bill, backed by the Scottish National Party and the Scottish Greens over fierce opposition from Scottish Labour and the Conservatives, with 68 votes in favour, 57 against, and 4 abstentions. Housing minister Fiona Dalrymple described the legislation as "a generational shift" in how tenants are protected from no-fault evictions, while Conservative MSP Alistair Drummond warned it would deter private investment in the rental sector for years to come.

The Flemish Parliament in Brussels passed a sweeping industrial emissions bill on Thursday by a razor-thin margin of 71 votes to 68, with three abstentions, after a fractious overnight debate in which Environment Minister Lieselot Vermeersch warned that further delays would leave Belgium in breach of EU directives. The bill, championed by N-VA and backed reluctantly by the Mouvement Réformateur, was fiercely opposed by Groen and Vooruit, who argued the transition timetable gave heavy industry an unjustifiable reprieve.

Copenhagen's city council approved a landmark €2.3 billion expansion of the Metro network on Thursday, with 41 votes in favour and just 9 against, clearing the way for three new stations along the contested Sydhavn corridor. The vote, championed by Transport Minister Lene Dalgaard of the Socialdemokraterne, came hours after a partial shutdown of the existing Cityringen line left an estimated 85,000 commuters stranded during the morning rush, when a signalling fault forced Metroselskabet to suspend services between Vanløse and København H for nearly four hours.

Marta Solberg's brace in the dying minutes secured a dramatic 3–2 victory for Rosenborg BK over Brøndby IF at Lerkendal Stadion on Saturday, extending the Norwegian side's unbeaten run in the UEFA Women's Champions League group stage to seven matches. A crowd of 11,340 watched Solberg convert a low cross in the 87th minute and then slot home a penalty in stoppage time, overturning a deficit that had looked insurmountable at the break. Brøndby's Astrid Nygaard had been exceptional throughout, but her side now face an almost impossible task to advance from Group C.

Die Kunstmesse „Positions Berlin" eröffnet am Donnerstag zum zwölften Mal ihre Pforten im Kraftwerk Berlin und präsentiert bis Sonntag Arbeiten von über 90 Galerien aus 22 Ländern. Kuratorin Lena Vossberg hat in diesem Jahr einen besonderen Schwerpunkt auf großformatige Skulptur gelegt, während der Berliner Senat als Hauptförderer auftritt. Eintrittskarten sind ab 18 Euro erhältlich.

Der Gemeinderat von Innsbruck hat am Donnerstagabend mit 28 zu 14 Stimmen bei drei Enthaltungen beschlossen, die städtische Wohnbaupolitik grundlegend zu reformieren: Künftig sollen mindestens 30 Prozent aller Neubauprojekte als geförderter Mietwohnraum ausgewiesen werden. Bürgermeisterin Sabine Kröll von der ÖVP sprach von einem „historischen Schritt für soziale Gerechtigkeit in unserer Stadt", während die FPÖ-Fraktion das Vorhaben als wirtschaftsfeindlich ablehnte. Die Grünen und die SPÖ stimmten gemeinsam mit der ÖVP für die Vorlage.

Magdalena Fořt seized control of the Women's European Squash Championships on Friday, dismantling third seed Aïssatou Diallo 11–6, 11–4, 11–8 in a dominant 47-minute display at the National Squash Centre in Manchester before a crowd of 2,150. The Czech 22-year-old, widely regarded as the most exciting talent on the PSA World Tour, will face top seed Nour El-Sherbini lookalike Petra Szymańska of Poland in Saturday's final after the latter's shock victory over defending champion Yuki Taniguchi in the other semifinal.

The Frankfurter Buchmesse opens its doors on Wednesday for a five-day run that organisers expect to draw more than 300,000 visitors, with Norwegian author Sigrid Undset's centenary forming the centrepiece of this year's literary programme. Publisher Mathilde Krüger, whose debut translation of a Mongolian epic has already attracted fierce pre-fair buzz, will give a reading at the Festhalle on Thursday evening before a panel discussion chaired by the Börsenverein des Deutschen Buchhandels. Ticket prices for individual evening events have been set at €18.

Beim Doppelereignis des SC Freiburg-Wochenendes strömten am Samstagnachmittag rund 24.000 Zuschauer ins Europa-Park Stadion, um den 3:1-Heimsieg der Breisgauer gegen den VfL Bochum in der Bundesliga zu feiern – Youngster Tomás Reinert avancierte mit zwei Treffern zum umjubelten Mann des Spiels. Nur wenige Stunden später eröffnete Oberbürgermeisterin Klara Sieverts im benachbarten Konzerthaus Freiburg das zweitägige Kammermusikfestival „Klingendes Breisgau", das unter der künstlerischen Leitung des Geigers Pavel Ondruš bis Sonntagnacht Werke von Brahms und Ravel auf das Programm stellt.

Die Frankfurter Buchmesse öffnet am 15. Oktober ihre Tore zum 76. Mal und erwartet in diesem Jahr laut Messedirektor Tilman Krämer über 4.200 Aussteller aus mehr als 95 Ländern. Als Ehrengast tritt Slowenien auf, das seine lebhafte Verlagslandschaft in einer eigens gestalteten Halle auf dem Messegelände Frankfurt präsentieren wird. Für die Eröffnungslesung am Abend des ersten Tages konnte die Schriftstellerin Ana Jeršič gewonnen werden, die ihren neuen Roman auf Slowenisch und in deutscher Übersetzung vorstellen wird.

Beim Derby im Hamburger Volksparkstadion setzte sich der Hamburger SV am Samstagabend mit 3:1 gegen den FC St. Pauli durch und festigte damit seine Spitzenposition in der 2. Bundesliga. Vor 57.000 Zuschauern erzielte Mittelfeldspieler Lukas Brennecke zwei der drei Tore und wurde von den Fans zum Mann des Spiels gekürt.

Magdeburg handed Kiel their first Bundesliga defeat of the season on Saturday, with a commanding 3–1 victory at the MDCC-Arena that left a sellout crowd of 26,500 on its feet. Striker Lennart Osbahr netted twice in the opening half before midfielder Sune Thorvaldsen added a third early in the second, reducing the damage to mere consolation for the visitors. The result tightens the table considerably heading into the winter break.

Commuters on the S-Bahn München network faced significant disruption on Monday after a signalling fault near Ostbahnhof brought services on lines S3 and S8 to a near-standstill for roughly four hours, with Deutsche Bahn estimating that around 47,000 passengers were affected during the morning rush. Replacement bus shuttles were deployed along the corridor, though queues stretched well beyond the platform concourses at Marienplatz and Pasing. Engineers cleared the fault by early afternoon, and full services resumed by 13:40.

A sold-out crowd of nearly 2,400 filled the Barbican Centre on Friday evening for a landmark performance by the Kronos Quartet, who marked their fiftieth anniversary with a programme spanning Terry Riley's minimalist classics and newly commissioned works by composers from Lagos to Reykjavík. "Nothing prepared us for the warmth of this audience," said violinist Dara Moschetti after the final bow. The concert, presented by the Barbican's music department under the supervision of artistic director Lena Vanthorpe, drew listeners from across Europe and North America.

Die Frankfurter Buchmesse eröffnet am 15. Oktober ihre 76. Ausgabe auf dem Messegelände Frankfurt und erwartet in diesem Jahr nach Angaben der Ausstellungs- und Messe-GmbH rund 95.000 Fachbesucher aus aller Welt. Als Ehrengast präsentiert sich die Republik Indonesien mit einem eigens kuratierten Länderpavillon, für den die Literaturwissenschaftlerin Dr. Sari Wulandari die inhaltliche Verantwortung übernimmt. Die Messe läuft bis zum 19. Oktober.

The future of the old Tempelhof terminal building in Berlin has long fascinated architects, urbanists, and politicians alike, with competing visions ranging from a vast contemporary art museum to a cycling and mobility hub capable of rivalling Copenhagen's best infrastructure. No consensus has emerged from City Hall, and the Berliner Morgenpost noted last autumn that the debate has outlasted three successive senators for urban development. Meanwhile, the building's sheer monumental scale — a relic of the Third Reich era — continues to draw heritage scholars and curious tourists in roughly equal measure.

Commuters on the Northern and Jubilee lines faced severe delays on Monday morning after a signal failure at London Bridge brought both routes to a near-standstill for roughly three hours, with Transport for London estimating that some 180,000 passengers were affected during the peak period. TfL engineers restored full service by 10:15 a.m., though residual crowding persisted well into the mid-morning.

Der Stadtrat von Erfurt hat am Donnerstagabend mit knapper Mehrheit beschlossen, die städtische Wohnungsbaugesellschaft zu privatisieren — 23 Stimmen dafür, 19 dagegen und vier Enthaltungen. Die CDU und die FDP stimmten geschlossen für den Antrag, während SPD und Linke ihn vehement ablehnten. Oberbürgermeister Carsten Fleischmann, der die Initiative maßgeblich vorangetrieben hatte, sprach von einem „historischen Schritt zur Entlastung des städtischen Haushalts". Kritiker, angeführt von der SPD-Fraktionsvorsitzenden Miriam Tuchscheidt, warnen hingegen vor einem dauerhaften Verlust bezahlbaren Wohnraums für einkommensschwache Haushalte.

Road closures around the Allianz Arena forced tens of thousands of Bayern Munich supporters to abandon their cars ahead of Saturday's Bundesliga clash against Borussia Dortmund, with Munich transport authority MVG urging fans to use the U6 line exclusively after a water main rupture sealed off Fröttmaning Straße and two adjacent access roads for the duration of the match weekend. Despite the travel chaos, an announced crowd of 75,000 packed the arena, where a brace from Bayern winger Tomás Kreuzberg helped the hosts to a commanding 3–1 victory — their seventh successive win in the league this season.

Beim packenden Abendspiel der 2. Bundesliga am Freitag bezwang der Hamburger SV den 1. FC Kaiserslautern mit 3:1 im Volksparkstadion vor 54.200 Zuschauern. Die Tore für Hamburg erzielten Lukas Fendrich (zweimal) und Mikael Sørensen, während Kaiserslautern durch Andrei Petruțan lediglich verkürzen konnte. Mit dem Sieg kletterte der HSV vorläufig auf den zweiten Tabellenplatz.

Der Wiener Gemeinderat hat am Donnerstag mit 54 zu 38 Stimmen bei sieben Enthaltungen einem weitreichenden Klimaschutzpaket zugestimmt, das unter anderem ein Verbot von Ölheizungen in Neubauten ab 2027 vorsieht. Die Koalition aus SPÖ und NEOS setzte sich damit gegen den Widerstand von FPÖ und ÖVP durch. Bürgermeister Michael Ludwig bezeichnete die Entscheidung als „historischen Schritt für eine lebenswerte Stadt", während FPÖ-Fraktionschefin Marlene Bruckner das Paket als „ideologische Belastung für Haushalte mit kleinem Einkommen" scharf kritisierte.

The Swedish Riksdag approved a landmark childcare reform bill late Thursday evening by a razor-thin margin, with 176 votes in favour and 173 against, after a fractious six-hour debate in which the governing coalition of the Moderates and the Sweden Democrats faced fierce opposition from the Social Democrats and the Greens. Finance Minister Britta Söderqvist, who steered the bill through its final reading, called it "the most consequential investment in Swedish families in a generation," while Social Democrat leader Karl-Henrik Boström warned the measure would widen inequality between urban and rural municipalities. The reform, expected to cost an estimated 4.2 billion kronor annually, will expand subsidised childcare places and introduce income-linked fee caps from January 2026.

Edinburgh's Usher Hall will host the three-day Nordic Music Festival beginning Friday 14 March, featuring the Oslo Philharmonic Orchestra under conductor Sigrid Halvorsen alongside a programme of contemporary Scandinavian chamber works — but festivalgoers should note that Lothian Buses has announced a suspension of the No. 11 and No. 23 routes serving the venue from Thursday evening through Sunday, owing to emergency resurfacing works on Lothian Road, with an estimated 18,000 passengers expected to be affected and a replacement shuttle service operating from Haymarket station at no extra charge.

Commuters on the Overground network faced significant delays on Thursday morning after a signalling failure near Dalston Junction brought services on the Mildmay line to a standstill for nearly four hours, with Transport for London estimating that around 47,000 passengers were affected before normal operations resumed shortly before noon.

The Austrian parliament voted on Thursday to approve a landmark cultural funding package worth €45 million, earmarked primarily for regional arts festivals following months of coalition wrangling between the ÖVP and the Grüne. The bill passed by 112 votes to 68, with 14 abstentions. Culture Minister Sabine Wollner hailed the decision as "a turning point for the country's creative communities," while opposition lawmakers from the FPÖ denounced it as fiscal overreach. Among the immediate beneficiaries is the Wiener Festwochen, which opens its 72nd edition at the Burgtheater and across multiple Vienna stages on 9 May, with artistic director Marta Holeczek overseeing a programme that spans contemporary theatre, dance, and experimental music.

Beim diesjährigen Stadtfest Regensburg, das am Freitagabend im Innenhof des Thon-Dittmer-Palais feierlich eröffnet wurde, begeisterte die Sängerin Lena Vossberg mit einem einstündigen Solokonzert rund 1.200 Besucher. Nur einen Steinwurf entfernt gewann der Regensburger Sportverein 1907 am Samstagmittag sein Heimspiel gegen den TSV Landshut mit 3:1 vor ausverkauftem Haus im Jahnstadion, wobei Mittelstürmer Dragomir Pelić beide Treffer in der zweiten Halbzeit erzielte.

Commuters across the Austrian capital faced widespread delays on Monday morning after ÖBB confirmed that a signalling fault had knocked out S-Bahn services on lines S1, S2, and S7 simultaneously, stranding an estimated 47,000 passengers at stations stretching from Floridsdorf to Wien Meidling. Engineers worked through the night but were unable to restore full service before the peak-hour rush, prompting Wiener Linien to deploy additional U-Bahn trains and a fleet of replacement buses as a stopgap. ÖBB said the fault, traced to a software update rolled out over the weekend, was ongoing and warned that disruptions could persist into Tuesday evening.

Die Berliner Verkehrsbetriebe (BVG) haben ab kommendem Montag eine vollständige Sperrung der U-Bahn-Linie U8 zwischen den Haltestellen Hermannstraße und Leinestraße angeordnet, nachdem bei Routinearbeiten erhebliche Schäden an den Gleisanlagen festgestellt wurden. Die Sperrung soll nach aktuellem Stand mindestens drei Wochen andauern; rund 47.000 Fahrgäste pro Tag sind von der Maßnahme betroffen. Als Ersatz richten die BVG einen Schienenersatzverkehr mit Bussen auf der betroffenen Strecke ein.

Beim packenden Nachholspiel in der 2. Bundesliga setzte sich der Hamburger SV am Dienstagabend mit 3:1 gegen den 1. FC Kaiserslautern im Volksparkstadion durch. Vor 52.400 Zuschauern erzielte Mittelstürmer Lennart Vossberg zwei Treffer und legte das dritte Tor mustergültig auf. Mit dem Sieg klettert Hamburg vorerst auf den zweiten Tabellenplatz.

Beim packenden Stadtderby in der 3. Liga trennten sich der SC Preußen Münster und der FC Westfalia Herne am Samstagabend mit einem 2:2-Unentschieden. Vor 9.800 Zuschauern im Preußenstadion erzielte der eingewechselte Luka Vrančić in der 88. Minute den umjubelten Ausgleichstreffer für die Gäste. Münster-Stürmer Tobias Engelhardt hatte die Hausherren zweimal in Führung gebracht, ehe Herne jeweils antwortete.

Werder Bremen held Borussia Dortmund to a gritty 1–1 draw at Weserstadion on Saturday evening, with midfielder Lukas Fehrenbach equalising in the 88th minute to rescue a point for the hosts in front of 42,100 passionate supporters. The result leaves Dortmund three points adrift of Bayern Munich at the top of the Bundesliga table heading into the winter break.

The Frankfurter Buchmesse opens its doors on Wednesday, drawing publishers, literary agents, and readers from more than 100 countries to the Messe Frankfurt fairgrounds for the world's largest trade fair for books. This year's guest of honour is Italy, whose pavilion — curated by Fondazione Bellonci and designed to evoke the texture of Renaissance manuscript culture — stretches across an entire hall on the ground floor. The fair runs through Sunday, with ticketed evening readings priced at €18 per session.

The Wiener Festwochen opens its 74th edition on Friday with a sold-out premiere of Elfriede Jelinek's rarely staged "Schatten (Eurydike sagt)" at the Burgtheater, directed by the Belgian theatre-maker Lies Pauwels, whose austere, image-heavy productions have divided Vienna audiences since her last visit in 2019. Organisers expect some 4,200 attendees across the opening weekend, with standing-room tickets priced at €18.

Die ÖBB hat für das kommende Wochenende umfangreiche Streckenarbeiten auf der Westbahn zwischen Wien Westbahnhof und Salzburg Hauptbahnhof angekündigt: Von Samstag, dem 14. Juni, bis Sonntagnacht werden auf dem betroffenen Abschnitt keine Züge verkehren, da Gleise und Weichen im Bereich Attnang-Puchheim grundlegend erneuert werden müssen. Rund 27.000 Fahrgäste sind laut Unternehmensangaben betroffen; als Ersatz werden Schienenersatzbusse eingesetzt, die jedoch deutlich längere Fahrzeiten mit sich bringen. Reisende werden gebeten, auf die Verbindungen der WESTbahn auszuweichen, soweit möglich.

When the Pritzker Architecture Prize was awarded to a Norwegian firm three years ago, critics on both sides of the Atlantic spent weeks debating whether the selection reflected a broader shift in how Western institutions define cultural prestige — a conversation that has resurfaced now that the Guggenheim Bilbao is marking its twenty-fifth anniversary and urban planners in cities from Lisbon to Leipzig are once again invoking the so-called "Bilbao effect" to justify eye-catching civic investments.

Borussia Dortmund hat am Samstagabend im ausverkauften Signal Iduna Park mit einem überzeugenden 3:1 gegen den FC Augsburg seine Tabellenführung in der Bundesliga gefestigt. Vor 81.365 Zuschauern erzielte Lena Vordenbäumer zwei Treffer in der zweiten Halbzeit, während Tomáš Přikryl den Schlusspunkt setzte. Augsburgs Anschlusstreffer durch Kofi Mensah-Acheampong reichte nicht aus, um die Partie zu wenden.

Commuters across the Greater Manchester region faced severe disruptions on Monday after Avanti West Coast and Northern Rail both suspended services on the Liverpool–Manchester Victoria corridor, stranding an estimated 34,000 passengers during the morning peak. Network Rail cited a signalling failure near Eccles as the root cause, adding that engineers expected full restoration by early afternoon. Replacement bus services were deployed along the affected route, though Transport for Greater Manchester warned that capacity would fall far short of demand.

The Frankfurter Buchmesse opened its doors on Wednesday to record crowds, with organisers reporting that more than 302,000 visitors passed through the Frankfurt Messe fairgrounds over the five-day event — the strongest attendance figure since 2019. This year's guest of honour, Italy, was celebrated with a sprawling pavilion designed by architect Francesca Moretti, while keynote addresses were delivered by novelist Emre Şahin and essayist Lieselotte Brandt. Ticket prices for day passes stood at €22, with a full-week professional accreditation available for €195.

The Swedish parliament voted on Thursday to approve a sweeping cultural funding package worth 480 million kronor, with the Moderaterna-led coalition securing 189 votes in favour against 162 opposed, after Culture Minister Britta Söderlund argued that the arts had been systematically underfunded for a decade. The measure's most visible beneficiary will be the Gothenburg International Film Festival, which organisers confirmed will expand to a twelve-day run beginning 24 January 2026 at the Draken cinema, with Lebanese-Swedish director Nadia Khalil set to open the programme with her debut feature.

Im strömenden Regen des Wildparkstadions setzte sich der Karlsruher SC am Samstagabend mit 3:1 gegen den 1. FC Kaiserslautern durch und festigte damit seinen zweiten Tabellenplatz in der 2. Bundesliga. Vor 21.400 Zuschauern erzielte Mittelfeldspieler Tobias Frenk zwei Treffer in der zweiten Halbzeit, nachdem Angreifer Sven Dallwitz bereits früh für die Führung gesorgt hatte. Kaiserslautern, das nach der Pause kurzzeitig ausgleichen konnte, fand gegen die kompakte Defensive des KSC kein weiteres Mittel.

Marta Vujčić delivered a masterclass at the Scandinavium Arena on Saturday evening, scoring 28 points and pulling down 11 rebounds as Göteborg Flames crushed visiting Oslo Storm 84–61 to claim the Nordic Women's Basketball Cup in front of a raucous crowd of 9,200.

The Scottish Parliament voted narrowly on Thursday to approve a £4.2 million cultural endowment for the newly opened Tramway arts centre in Glasgow, with 67 members in favour and 54 against — a decision that came just hours before the venue launched its landmark autumn festival, "New Latitudes," featuring works by painters Sorcha Muirhead and Dariusz Kępka alongside installations from the São Paulo-based collective Fio Branco.

The Flemish parliament voted narrowly on Thursday to approve a landmark coalition agreement between the N-VA, Vlaams Belang, and the cd&v, ending nearly four months of fractious negotiations and handing the new Flemish minister-president, Lieselotte Vandenberghe, a razor-thin working majority of just three seats. The deal, which prioritises fiscal consolidation and a tightening of regional migration competencies, passed by 71 votes to 68, with two abstentions.

The Edinburgh International Book Festival opens its doors at Charlotte Square Gardens on Saturday, drawing an expected 75,000 visitors over a fortnight of readings, debates, and author signings, but festivalgoers have been warned that Lothian Buses will suspend services on George Street from the same day through August 31 to allow emergency resurfacing work on a stretch of road badly damaged by last winter's frost. The festival's programme director, Catriona Meldrum, urged attendees to use the Waverley railway station connections provided by ScotRail or to arrive by bicycle, noting that the George Street closure will affect routes 19, 24, and 41.

Wegen des Halbfinales im DFB-Pokal zwischen dem FC St. Pauli und Bayer 04 Leverkusen am Dienstagabend im Volksparkstadion Hamburg richtet die Hamburger Hochbahn umfangreiche Sonderzüge auf der U3 ein: Ab 17 Uhr werden laut Sprecher Markus Drevenstedt zusätzliche Züge im Vier-Minuten-Takt bis in die Nacht hinein eingesetzt, um die erwarteten 57.000 Zuschauer zu befördern. Das Spiel, das um 20:45 Uhr angepfiffen wird, gilt als eines der meistbeachteten Duelle der laufenden Saison – Bayer 04 Leverkusen reist als Titelverteidiger an, während der FC St. Pauli auf den Heimvorteil setzt.

Die Frankfurter Buchmesse öffnet am 15. Oktober ihre Tore für das Publikum und zieht damit nach vier Tagen reinem Fachprogramm auch Leserinnen und Leser in die Messehalle 3.0. In diesem Jahr wird Norwegen als Ehrengastland präsentiert; die Schriftstellerin Astrid Veland hält die Eröffnungsrede im Literaturcafé. Über 4.200 Aussteller aus 95 Ländern haben sich angemeldet, und der Eintritt für Einzelpersonen beträgt 18 Euro.

Der TSV Großhadern hat am Samstagabend im Münchner Derbyklassiker gegen den FC Aubing-West mit 3:1 die Oberhand behalten. Vor 1.240 Zuschauern im Sportpark Aubing traf Mittelfeldspieler Lukas Breinlinger doppelt, ehe Stürmer Ondřej Vašíček kurz vor dem Schlusspfiff für den Endstand sorgte. Für die Gäste war es die dritte Niederlage in Folge in der Bayernliga Süd.

Die Frankfurter Buchmesse eröffnet am 15. Oktober ihre 76. Ausgabe auf dem Messegelände Frankfurt, wo über 4.000 Aussteller aus mehr als 100 Ländern erwartet werden. Die diesjährige Ehrengastland-Präsentation übernimmt Italien, und die Schriftstellerin Carla Menotti wird die offizielle Eröffnungsrede halten. Bis zum 19. Oktober können Besucherinnen und Besucher an täglich wechselnden Lesungen, Podiumsdiskussionen und Verlagsvorstellungen teilnehmen; eine Tageskarte kostet 18 Euro.

Commuters on the Northern and Jubilee lines faced severe delays on Thursday morning after a signalling fault at London Bridge station brought large swaths of the Underground to a near-standstill for roughly four hours, with Transport for London estimating that around 340,000 passengers were affected during the peak period. Engineers restored full service by 10:47 a.m., but TfL has promised a formal investigation into the ageing relay infrastructure that is believed to have triggered the outage.

Die Frankfurter Buchmesse eröffnet am 15. Oktober ihre 76. Ausgabe in der Messe Frankfurt und erwartet in diesem Jahr nach Angaben der Veranstalter rund 95.000 Besucherinnen und Besucher aus aller Welt. Als Gastland tritt Norwegen auf, dessen Verlage und Autorinnen wie die gefeierte Schriftstellerin Astrid Lund eine breite Auswahl norwegischsprachiger und international übersetzter Werke präsentieren werden. Messedirektorin Carola Penner betonte bei einer Pressekonferenz am Montag, die Messe wolle „die Vielfalt der Weltliteratur in einem einzigen Ort sichtbar machen".

The Städel Museum in Frankfurt will open its long-anticipated retrospective of Swiss painter Margrit Voser on 14 March, bringing together more than 140 canvases, drawings, and prints spanning four decades of her career. Curated by Dr. Leonie Bachhausen of the Städel's modern collections department, the exhibition — titled "Voser: Depth and Surface" — marks the first major institutional survey of her work in Germany and runs through 29 June. Admission is priced at €14 for adults, with reduced rates available for students and seniors.

Die Kunstmesse Art Düsseldorf öffnet am 14. November ihre Tore in der Messe Düsseldorf und präsentiert bis zum 17. November Werke von über 90 Galerien aus 22 Ländern. Kuratiert wird die diesjährige Ausgabe von Nadine Försterling, die einen thematischen Schwerpunkt auf zeitgenössische Skulptur und raumgreifende Installationen legt. Der Eintritt kostet 28 Euro, und die Veranstalter rechnen mit rund 30.000 Besucherinnen und Besuchern über das gesamte Wochenende.

Beim Stadtderby in der Regionalliga Bayern setzte sich der TSV Ingolstadt-Nord mit 3:1 gegen den FC Ingolstadt Süd durch und kletterte damit auf den zweiten Tabellenplatz. Vor 2.140 Zuschauern im Sportpark Friedrichshofen glänzte Mittelfeldmann Luca Obermayer mit zwei Toren und einer Vorlage. Der FC Ingolstadt Süd, der bereits in der ersten Halbzeit in Rückstand geraten war, fand trotz der Einwechslungen von Stürmer Markus Reindl keine Antwort auf die druckvolle Spielweise der Gastgeber.

Die Diskussion um die künftige Gestaltung des Wiener Hauptbahnhofs reißt nicht ab: Stadtplaner, Architekten und Vertreter der ÖBB streiten seit Monaten darüber, ob der Bahnhof um einen zweiten unterirdischen Abschnitt erweitert werden soll, der die Verbindung zur U1 verbessern würde. Kulturschaffende aus dem dritten Bezirk melden sich ebenfalls zu Wort und fordern, dass im Zuge eventueller Umbauten auch Raum für eine dauerhafte Ausstellungsfläche geschaffen wird – ein Vorschlag, den die Stadtpolitik bislang wohlwollend, aber unverbindlich aufgenommen hat.

The Frankfurter Buchmesse opens its 76th edition on Wednesday, October 16, drawing publishers, agents, and literary scouts from more than 100 countries to the Messe Frankfurt fairgrounds. This year's guest of honour is Italy, whose pavilion — designed by Rome-based architect Silvia Brandolini — takes up an entire hall with an installation tracing five centuries of Italian print culture. Ticket prices start at €18 for a single day, though industry professionals may register for the full five-day run at a reduced rate. Organisers from the Börsenverein des Deutschen Buchhandels expect attendance to surpass 300,000 visitors over the course of the fair, which closes on Sunday, October 20.

Die Frankfurter Kunsthalle zeigt ab dem 14. März eine umfangreiche Retrospektive der Malerin Sonja Veltkamp, die über dreißig Jahre Schaffen in rund 120 Ölgemälden und Aquarellen versammelt. Kuratorin Brigitte Haselmann hat die Schau unter dem Titel „Schichten der Zeit" konzipiert, der sich bewusst auf Veltkamps Technik des mehrfachen Übermalens bezieht. Bis zum 25. Mai können Besucherinnen und Besucher die Werke täglich besichtigen; der Eintritt kostet 14 Euro.

The Vienna city council voted narrowly on Thursday to approve a €2.3 billion funding package for the long-delayed extension of U-Bahn line U5 to Hernals, with 54 votes in favour and 38 against after a fractious four-hour debate in which ÖVP councillors accused the ruling SPÖ of burying the true cost in supplementary budgets. Construction on the nine-station stretch is scheduled to begin in March 2026 and is expected to disrupt existing tram services on lines 43 and 44 for up to 18 months, affecting an estimated 120,000 daily passengers in the city's outer 17th district.

Wegen dringender Sanierungsarbeiten an einem Brückenabschnitt der A8 bei Augsburg sperrt das Bayerische Staatsministerium für Wohnen, Bau und Verkehr die Fahrbahn in Richtung München ab Montag, dem 14. April, für voraussichtlich drei Wochen vollständig. Rund 74.000 Fahrzeuge, die die Strecke täglich nutzen, müssen über die Bundesstraße 2 umgeleitet werden. Autofahrerinnen und Autofahrer sollten laut der Behörde mit erheblichen Verzögerungen rechnen.

The Frankfurter Buchmesse opens its doors on Wednesday, drawing publishers, literary agents, and authors from more than 100 countries to the Messe Frankfurt fairgrounds for five days of readings, panel discussions, and rights negotiations. This year's Guest of Honour is Italy, with a sprawling pavilion curated by Chiara Vettorino showcasing the breadth of contemporary Italian letters — from debut novelists to heavyweight essayists. Tickets for individual day visits are priced at €18, though industry professionals have flooded advance registrations, with organisers reporting over 285,000 expected attendees across the full run.

For decades, the crumbling facade of the Odeon Theatre on Marlborough Street has divided architectural critics and local councillors alike: preservationists argue that its ornate Victorian ironwork represents an irreplaceable piece of the city's cultural fabric, while a growing faction within the Labour-controlled borough council insists the site would better serve residents as a transit hub connecting the proposed Northern Extension tram line to the existing bus network. The debate has so far generated more column inches than concrete policy.

Wegen eines technischen Defekts an einer Weichenanlage im Bahnhof Hannover Hauptbahnhof kommt es seit Dienstagmorgen zu erheblichen Verspätungen und Teilausfällen auf den Linien S1, S2 und S5 der S-Bahn Hannover. Die Üstra und die DB Regio haben gemeinsam angekündigt, dass rund 47.000 Fahrgäste täglich von den Störungen betroffen sein könnten, während die Reparaturarbeiten voraussichtlich bis Donnerstagabend andauern werden.

Die Berliner Verkehrsbetriebe (BVG) haben ab dem 1. Februar 2025 die Monatskarte für das Berliner Stadtgebiet um 4,50 Euro auf 86,00 Euro angehoben – eine Entscheidung, die nach Angaben des Unternehmens notwendig sei, um steigende Energie- und Personalkosten aufzufangen. Fahrgastverbände kritisierten die Erhöhung scharf und forderten den Senat auf, den öffentlichen Nahverkehr stärker zu bezuschussen.

Die Frankfurter Buchmesse eröffnet am 15. Oktober ihre 76. Ausgabe auf dem Messegelände Frankfurt mit einem Festakt, bei dem die diesjährige Ehrengastländer-Präsentation Malaysias im Mittelpunkt stehen wird. Rund 4.200 Aussteller aus mehr als 90 Ländern werden erwartet, darunter der Suhrkamp Verlag als einer der prominentesten deutschsprachigen Teilnehmer. Die Veranstalterin, die Frankfurter Buchmesse GmbH, rechnet bis zum Abschluss am 19. Oktober mit rund 300.000 Besucherinnen und Besuchern.

The Städel Museum in Frankfurt opens its long-anticipated retrospective on Dutch Golden Age portraiture this Saturday, bringing together more than 140 works on loan from the Rijksmuseum, the National Gallery in London, and a dozen private collections across Europe. Chief curator Dr. Lieselotte Brandes has spent four years assembling the show, which runs through March 9, with a particular focus on lesser-known contemporaries of Rembrandt whose careers were cut short by the Thirty Years' War. Admission is set at €16 for adults.

The Frankfurter Buchmesse opens its doors on Wednesday for a five-day run that is expected to draw more than 300,000 visitors to the Messe Frankfurt fairgrounds, with Norwegian literature taking centre stage as this year's guest of honour. Publishers from over 90 countries have registered stands, and the programme includes a headline lecture by novelist Ingrid Sørvåg, whose debut English translation arrives in bookshops simultaneously with the fair's opening.

Der Gemeinderat von Innsbruck hat am Donnerstagabend mit knapper Mehrheit einem neuen Mobilitätskonzept für den öffentlichen Nahverkehr zugestimmt: 23 Mitglieder votierten dafür, 19 dagegen, bei zwei Enthaltungen. Die Grünen und die SPÖ trugen den Beschluss gemeinsam, während die FPÖ als stärkste Oppositionskraft vehement Einspruch erhob. Stadtrat Benedikt Waltner, der das Konzept im Auftrag der Koalition vorstellte, sprach von einem „historischen Schritt für eine klimagerechte Stadt".

The Scottish Parliament voted narrowly on Thursday to reject a proposed amendment to the Renters' Rights Bill that would have capped annual rent increases at two per cent, with 63 members voting against and 58 in favour, after a heated two-hour debate during which SNP housing spokesperson Catriona Dunbar accused the Conservative benches of "protecting landlords over families struggling to stay in their homes."

Edinburgh's Usher Hall will host the three-day Nordic Currents festival of Scandinavian contemporary music from 14 to 16 March, featuring performers including the Oslo Sinfonietta and mezzo-soprano Astrid Vanhanen — but concertgoers are being warned that Lothian Buses will suspend routes 11, 22, and 35 serving the city centre on all three evenings from 19:00, due to emergency resurfacing works on Lothian Road, leaving an estimated 12,000 passengers to seek alternative travel arrangements.

The Frankfurter Buchmesse opens its doors on Wednesday for a five-day run that organisers expect to draw upwards of 300,000 visitors to the Messe Frankfurt fairgrounds, with Norwegian literature taking centre stage as the guest-of-honour theme. Curator Ingrid Solberg-Haas has assembled more than eighty Nordic authors for readings, panel discussions, and live translation workshops, while the opening ceremony will feature a keynote address by celebrated novelist Petter Dahl-Vik. Tickets for individual day passes are priced at €18.

A late header from striker Tomás Vedral sealed a dramatic 2–1 victory for Bohemian FC over Shelbourne at Dalymount Park on Friday evening, keeping Bohemian's League of Ireland Premier Division title challenge firmly alive with just four rounds remaining. An attendance of 4,312 — the ground's largest of the season — roared the home side home after Shelbourne had levelled through a deflected Ciara Nwosu effort just past the hour mark.

Wrocław Panthers ended a four-match winless run on Saturday, defeating Kraków Wolves 3–1 at Stadion Olimpijski to consolidate third place in the Ekstraliga Futsal table. Patryk Dąbrowski was the standout performer, netting twice in the opening quarter-hour, while Wolves goalkeeper Tomasz Lipiński could do little to stem the tide. An attendance of 2,140 — modest for the venue but unusually robust for futsal — underscored growing regional interest in the sport.

Galatasaray came from behind to defeat Fenerbahçe 3–2 in a breathless Istanbul derby at RAMS Park on Sunday, with midfielder Emirhan Demir scoring the decisive goal in the 88th minute to send the home end into raptures. Defender Yusuf Çelik had equalised for the visitors with a precise low drive just before the hour mark, but Demir's late header off a Kerem Aktürk corner proved too much for Fenerbahçe to answer. The victory lifts Galatasaray to the top of the Süper Lig table with nine matches played.

The Frankfurter Buchmesse opens its doors on Wednesday for its 76th edition, welcoming more than 4,200 exhibitors from 95 countries to the Messe Frankfurt fairgrounds — the largest gathering of the international publishing trade since the pandemic reshuffled the calendar. This year's guest of honour is Italy, whose pavilion, curated by novelist and essayist Carla Menotti, draws on five centuries of Italian literary tradition.
