Stockholm's public transport operator SL confirmed on Thursday that a month-long partial closure of the Tunnelbana's Green Line will begin on 14 April, affecting services between Fridhemsplan and Hässelby Strand as engineers carry out essential track renewal and overhead line upgrades along a 12-kilometre stretch. Replacement bus services will run at increased frequency, though commuters are warned to expect journey times up to 25 minutes longer than usual. The Swedish Transport Administration estimates that approximately 74,000 daily passengers will be disrupted during the works, which are scheduled to conclude on 14 May.

Commuters on the western fringes of Vienna faced significant disruption on Monday after ÖBB announced an emergency suspension of S-Bahn lines S50 and S45 between Westbahnhof and Hütteldorf, citing urgent repairs to a signal relay box damaged by last week's flooding. The Austrian rail operator said roughly 34,000 passengers would be affected during the 72-hour closure, with replacement bus services deployed along both corridors. Normal operations are expected to resume by Thursday morning.

The architectural legacy of Wembley Stadium has long fascinated urban historians, who note that the site's successive incarnations—from the Empire Exhibition grounds of the 1920s to the gleaming steel bowl inaugurated in 2007—reflect shifting ideas about spectacle, civic identity, and the relationship between sport and national pride. Architectural critic Lena Thorvaldsen, writing in The Architectural Review, argues that the current structure's sweeping arch, visible from much of northwest London, functions less as a sporting venue than as a piece of monumental branding for the Football Association and, by extension, for England itself.

Die Berliner Verkehrsbetriebe (BVG) haben angekündigt, dass die U-Bahnlinie U5 zwischen den Stationen Alexanderplatz und Hönow vom 14. Februar bis zum 3. März 2026 vollständig gesperrt wird, um dringend erforderliche Gleiserneuerungsarbeiten durchzuführen. Rund 87.000 Fahrgäste täglich sind von der Sperrung betroffen, ein Schienenersatzverkehr mit Bussen wird eingerichtet. Die BVG bittet Pendlerinnen und Pendler, auf die S-Bahn Berlin auszuweichen.

Grasshopper Club Zürich edged out FC Winterthur 2–1 in a tightly contested Swiss Super League fixture at Letzigrund on Saturday evening, with midfielder Nico Petrov curling a stoppage-time free kick past the helpless visiting goalkeeper to seal the points in front of 11,400 rain-soaked supporters.

Der Stadtrat von Graz hat am Donnerstagabend mit knapper Mehrheit für eine Erhöhung der kommunalen Wohnbauförderung gestimmt: 28 Ratsmitglieder votierten dafür, 21 dagegen, bei vier Enthaltungen. Die Initiative ging auf einen gemeinsamen Antrag von SPÖ und Grünen zurück, während die ÖVP geschlossen die Ablehnung empfahl. Bürgermeisterin Adela Strohmayer erklärte nach der Abstimmung, das Ergebnis sei „ein klares Signal für leistbares Wohnen in unserer Stadt".

The Frankfurter Buchmesse opened its doors on Wednesday to more than 300,000 visitors expected over five days, with Norwegian literature taking centre stage as the guest of honour this year. Curated by Margit Solvang and her team at the Norwegian Publishers' Association, the pavilion on the fairground's eastern hall features installations by debut novelist Håkon Breivik alongside translated works spanning poetry, graphic fiction, and children's books. Tickets for the public weekend are priced at €18, while publishers and trade visitors have been streaming through the gates since Monday.

Commuters across the Greater Manchester area faced severe disruption on Thursday after Avanti West Coast suspended all services on the Manchester Piccadilly to London Euston corridor, citing a signalling fault near Crewe that engineers said could take up to 48 hours to resolve. Transport for Greater Manchester urged affected passengers to seek alternatives via TransPennine Express or National Rail routes through Sheffield, though officials warned that those services were already running at near capacity. An estimated 85,000 travellers are expected to be affected before normal operations resume.

The Swedish Riksdag narrowly passed a landmark housing reform bill on Thursday, with 176 votes in favour and 173 against, after weeks of fractious debate that exposed deep rifts within the ruling coalition. Prime Minister Kajsa Lindqvist, who had staked considerable personal authority on the measure, welcomed the outcome as "a decisive step toward affordability for ordinary families," while the Sweden Democrats — the main opposition force — denounced the legislation as fiscally reckless and vowed to contest it at the next general election. The Moderate Party and the Liberals, both coalition partners, ultimately held the line despite last-minute wavering from a handful of backbenchers.

Mit einem dramatischen 3:2-Sieg nach Verlängerung hat der SC Weißenfels am Samstagabend im Stadtderby den FC Burgenland-Nord aus dem Kreispokal geworfen. Vor 1.240 Zuschauern im Städtischen Stadion Weißenfels entschied Mittelfeldspielerin Dorota Kwasniewski mit ihrem Treffer in der 118. Minute die Partie zu Gunsten der Gastgeber. Für den FC Burgenland-Nord traf Abwehrchef Lukas Prenner doppelt, ohne dass es am Ende reichen sollte.

Der Stadtrat von Erfurt hat am Donnerstagabend mit knapper Mehrheit für die Einführung einer kommunalen Wärmeplanungssatzung gestimmt, die den schrittweisen Ausstieg aus fossilen Heizungssystemen in städtischen Gebäuden bis 2035 vorschreibt. Von den 62 anwesenden Ratsmitgliedern votierten 34 dafür, 21 dagegen, bei sieben Enthaltungen. Bürgermeisterin Claudia Rettner, die die Initiative federführend vorangetrieben hatte, sprach von einem „historischen Schritt für den kommunalen Klimaschutz". Die Fraktion der AfD stimmte geschlossen dagegen und kündigte eine rechtliche Prüfung der Satzung an; die Grünen und die SPD hatten die Vorlage gemeinsam eingebracht.

Commuters across central Stockholm faced significant disruption on Monday after Trafikverket confirmed that the Citybanan rail tunnel would be closed for emergency track repairs until at least Thursday, suspending all commuter rail services on lines C1 and C4 and forcing an estimated 140,000 daily passengers onto replacement bus corridors already strained by rush-hour congestion.

Rowan Kettlewell scored a composed hat-trick as Dunfermline Athletic dismantled Airdrieonians 4–1 at East End Park on Saturday, extending their unbeaten run in the Scottish Championship to eleven matches. Substitute Priya Chaudhary added the fourth with a crisp volley nine minutes from time, while Airdrieonians' consolation came from a Declan Mosse penalty shortly before half-time. A crowd of 5,340 watched the home side move three points clear at the top of the table.

The Swedish parliament narrowly approved a sweeping overhaul of the country's housing rental laws on Thursday, with 176 votes in favour and 173 against, after a fractious all-night debate that exposed deep rifts within the ruling coalition. Prime Minister Lena Forsmark, who had staked considerable political capital on the bill, hailed the outcome as "a victory for ordinary tenants," while the opposition Sweden Democrats and Left Party condemned the reforms as inadequate and, in some clauses, actively harmful to low-income renters.

The Reykjavík City Council voted late on Thursday evening to approve a sweeping affordable housing policy that would require developers to set aside at least 20 percent of new residential units for low-income tenants — a measure championed by councillor Sigríður Ásgeirsdóttir of the Left-Green Movement and bitterly opposed by the Independence Party, whose floor leader, Páll Kristján Björnsson, called it "an assault on the property market." The motion passed 11 votes to 6, with 2 abstentions.

Der Stadtrat von Freiburg im Breisgau hat am Donnerstagabend mit knapper Mehrheit einen neuen Haushaltsplan verabschiedet, der erhebliche Investitionen in den sozialen Wohnungsbau vorsieht. Mit 28 Ja-Stimmen, 19 Gegenstimmen und 4 Enthaltungen setzte sich das Bündnis aus Grünen, SPD und Volt gegen die vereinte Opposition aus CDU und AfD durch. Bürgermeisterin Katrin Söllner sprach von einem „historischen Schritt für bezahlbares Wohnen in unserer Stadt", während CDU-Fraktionschef Markus Dreher das Vorhaben als „finanziell unverantwortlich" bezeichnete. Die Abstimmung fand im Rathaus Freiburg statt.

Beim packenden Halbfinale der Deutschen Volleyball-Meisterschaft in der Stuttgarter Schleyer-Halle setzte sich der VfB Friedrichshafen am Samstagabend mit 3:1 Sätzen gegen den BR Volleys Berlin durch und zog damit souverän ins Finale ein. Überragender Spieler auf dem Parkett war Mittelblocker Tomáš Hrušecký, der mit 14 Blocks eine herausragende Leistung zeigte. 4.800 Zuschauer feierten die Entscheidung lautstark.

Der Wiener Gemeinderat hat am Donnerstagabend mit 54 zu 31 Stimmen beschlossen, das marode Volkskundemuseum im 8. Bezirk umfassend zu sanieren und ab Herbst 2026 als neues Zentrum für zeitgenössische Volkskultur zu betreiben. Bürgermeister Michael Ludwig begrüßte den Beschluss als „kulturpolitischen Meilenstein". Im Zuge der Debatte gab die Kulturstadträtin Vera Hollmann bekannt, dass das Museum ab dem 15. März 2026 unter dem Festivaltitel „Wurzeln & Wandel" eine Eröffnungsausstellung zeigen wird, für die die Kuratorin Brigitte Sattler gewonnen werden konnte.

The same weekend that Malmö's Folkets Park hosted a sold-out performance by the Swedish Chamber Orchestra under conductor Britta Söderström — part of the three-day Nordic Sound Festival — saw the nearby Eleda Stadion erupt with local pride as IFK Malmö edged FK Österlen 2–1 in a tense Superettan clash before a crowd of 11,400. Söderström, who has drawn comparisons to the great Scandinavian conductors of the previous generation, led a programme of Sibelius and Nielsen that drew enthusiastic reviews, while at the stadium, a brace from forward Casimir Hedlund sealed the points for the home side in what manager Gösta Lindmark later called "the most complete performance of the season."

Głogów Copper Miners edged past Zagłębie Lubin 2–1 in a bruising Lower Silesian derby at Stadion Miejski on Saturday evening, with striker Radosław Pietruk netting the decisive header in the 88th minute before a crowd of 9,200. The result lifts Copper Miners to third place in Poland's Ekstraklasa standings, putting pressure on the leaders ahead of the winter break.

The Frankfurter Buchmesse opened its doors on Wednesday for a five-day run that organisers say has drawn more than 280,000 visitors in advance registrations alone, with Norwegian author Sigrid Helland delivering the keynote address at the Festhalle to a packed audience of editors, agents, and rights managers from across the industry. This year's guest-of-honour pavilion, dedicated to Brazil, was inaugurated by culture minister Renata Figueiredo Lopes in a brief ceremony that drew sustained applause. Ticket prices for day-visitor passes were set at €18, a modest rise from last year.

The Prague City Council voted narrowly on Thursday to approve a €340 million contract for the extension of Metro Line D, with 38 councillors in favour and 21 against, despite fierce opposition from the ANO grouping, which argued the project would burden taxpayers for decades. The new southern stretch, running from Náměstí Míru to Nové Dvory, is scheduled to begin construction in March 2025 and is expected to add seven stations to the network, serving an estimated 85,000 passengers daily once operational.

Commuters on the Overground faced severe delays on Monday morning after a signal failure near Highbury & Islington brought services on the Mildmay line to a standstill for nearly four hours, with Transport for London estimating that around 47,000 passengers were affected during the disruption. Engineers were deployed to the site shortly after 06:15 and full service was restored by 10:30, though TfL warned residual knock-on effects could persist into the afternoon peak.

Hamburg's public transport authority HVV has confirmed that S-Bahn services on the S3 and S31 lines will be suspended between Harburg Rathaus and Neugraben from the night of Friday, 18 April through Sunday, 20 April 2025, as engineers carry out urgent track-bed reinforcement work beneath the Elbe embankment. An estimated 47,000 passengers are expected to be affected over the three-day closure, with Deutsche Bahn replacement buses running at ten-minute intervals along the route. Commuters are advised to allow an additional 25 minutes for their journeys.

The Frankfurter Buchmesse opened its doors on Wednesday to some 4,200 exhibitors from 95 countries, with Norwegian literature taking centre stage as this year's Guest of Honour — a distinction that has drawn record pre-registration figures and prompted organisers to expand the main hall at Messe Frankfurt by a full additional pavilion. "We have never seen demand at this level before the fair has even begun," said Ingrid Solberg-Haas, director-general of the Börsenverein des Deutschen Buchhandels. The fair runs through Sunday.

Wegen umfangreicher Gleisbauarbeiten auf der S-Bahn-Linie S3 zwischen Darmstadt Hauptbahnhof und Frankfurt Süd wird der Zugverkehr vom 14. bis 21. März 2025 vollständig eingestellt; die Rhein-Main-Verkehrsgesellschaft richtet einen Schienenersatzverkehr mit Bussen ein, von dem täglich rund 28.000 Fahrgäste betroffen sein dürften. Zeitgleich eröffnet die Städtische Galerie Darmstadt am 14. März ihre neue Ausstellung „Zwischenräume – Deutsche Gegenwartskunst seit 1989", kuratiert von der Kunsthistorikerin Dr. Luise Varnhagen, die bis zum 25. Mai 2025 zu sehen sein wird und Werke von mehr als vierzig Künstlerinnen und Künstlern versammelt.

The Flemish parliament voted narrowly on Thursday to approve a sweeping housing reform bill championed by the N-VA, with 72 members in favour and 63 against, after a fractious five-hour debate in which opposition lawmakers from Vooruit and the Greens accused the governing coalition of bypassing public consultation. Deputy Minister Lieselotte Verbruggen hailed the outcome as "a generational shift in how Flanders manages its social housing stock," while Vooruit floor leader Dries Maenhout warned the measure would deepen inequality across the region.

Der Gemeinderat von Innsbruck hat am Donnerstagabend mit knapper Mehrheit einem umstrittenen Wohnbaupaket zugestimmt, das den Bau von rund 1.200 geförderten Mietwohnungen im Stadtgebiet vorsieht. Bei der namentlichen Abstimmung votierten 23 Ratsmitglieder dafür, 19 dagegen, bei vier Enthaltungen. Bürgermeisterin Claudia Seethaler von der ÖVP sprach von einem „historischen Schritt für die Wohnraumversorgung der Stadt", während die Fraktionsvorsitzende der Grünen, Miriam Tschurtschenthaler, das Paket als unzureichend kritisierte und auf fehlende Klimaschutzauflagen hinwies. Die SPÖ hatte das Vorhaben bis zuletzt unterstützt und es als sozialpolitische Notwendigkeit bezeichnet.

The Reykjavík City Council voted narrowly on Thursday to approve a sweeping overhaul of the city's social housing policy, with 13 members backing the measure against 9 opposed and 2 abstentions, in what opposition councillors from the Independence Party called "a reckless fiscal experiment." The motion, championed by Mayor Sigríður Björk Magnúsdóttir of the Left-Green Movement, would earmark roughly 4.2 billion Icelandic króna for the construction of 1,400 new affordable units by 2029. Centre-right bloc leader Gunnar Þór Einarsson warned that the council had "mortgaged the city's future," while housing advocates packed the public gallery of Ráðhúsið to applaud the result.

A late header from midfielder Lena Sorokina sealed a dramatic 2–1 victory for FC Dinamo Tbilisi over Çukurova SK in front of 14,200 fans at the Boris Paichadze Dinamo Arena on Saturday evening, sending the Georgian side through to the quarterfinals of the UEFA Women's Champions League qualifying round.

Commuters across Oslo faced significant delays on Monday after Ruter suspended all T-bane services between Nationaltheatret and Stortinget stations following the discovery of a structural fault in the tunnel lining. Engineers from the Norwegian Public Roads Administration were deployed to assess the damage, with repairs expected to take at least four days. Around 47,000 daily passengers are being redirected to replacement bus services on routes 20, 31, and 54 during the closure.

The Scottish Parliament erupted in sharp exchanges on Wednesday as MSPs voted 72 to 49, with four abstentions, to reject the Scottish National Party's proposed Rent Freeze Extension Bill, dealing First Minister Catriona Dunbar-Mackay a significant early defeat just three months into her tenure. The Conservatives and Scottish Labour, voting in a rare joint bloc, argued the measure would deter landlords and deepen the housing crisis across Glasgow and Edinburgh. A spokesperson for the Scottish Greens, who had backed the bill, described the outcome as "a capitulation to property interests."

Im Spitzenspiel der 2. Bundesliga setzte sich der Hamburger SV am Freitagabend mit 3:1 gegen den 1. FC Kaiserslautern durch und kletterte damit vorübergehend auf den zweiten Tabellenplatz. Vor 52.300 Zuschauern im Volksparkstadion war Mittelfeldspieler Torben Glasneck mit einem Doppelpack der überragende Akteur des Abends, ehe Lasse Brinkmann kurz vor Schluss den Endstand markierte.

The Frankfurter Buchmesse opens its doors on Wednesday, drawing publishers, literary agents, and readers from more than 100 countries to the Messe Frankfurt for what organisers have billed as the most international edition in the fair's seven-decade history. This year's Guest of Honour is Italy, whose pavilion — designed by architect Serena Cattaneo Adorno — spans three floors and features over 200 Italian authors, including debut novelist Margherita Volpi, whose first work has already sold translation rights in seventeen languages. Ticket prices start at €18 for a single day's admission.

Borussia Dortmund kept their Bundesliga top-four hopes alive on Saturday with a commanding 3–1 victory over Bayer Leverkusen at Signal Iduna Park, with midfielder Tobias Feldkamp scoring twice in the opening twenty minutes before substitute Anya Nwosu sealed the result late in the second half. A crowd of 81,365 watched Leverkusen pull one back through a penalty shortly after the hour, but Dortmund's defensive discipline proved unshakeable for the remainder of the match.

Rowers from nine countries descended on Lucerne's Rotsee on Saturday for the opening day of the FISA World Rowing Cup II, with Germany's Tobias Wengert and Finn Krause producing the standout performance of the afternoon by winning the men's lightweight double sculls in a time of 6:23.41, edging out a tenacious Italian crew by less than a second in front of an enthusiastic crowd of 11,400.

Wegen eines technischen Defekts an einer Weichenanlage im Bereich des Frankfurter Hauptbahnhofs musste die Deutsche Bahn am Dienstagmorgen den Fernverkehr auf der Strecke zwischen Frankfurt und Mannheim für rund vier Stunden vollständig einstellen; betroffen waren nach Angaben eines Bahnsprechers schätzungsweise 18.000 Reisende, darunter zahlreiche Pendler auf den ICE-Linien 10, 11 und 42.

Brendan Achterberg scored twice in the final twelve minutes to hand FK Haugesund a stunning 3–2 comeback win over Rosenborg BK at Haugesund Stadion on Saturday, with an attendance of 6,814 making it the loudest home night the club has seen in years. The result leaves Haugesund fourth in the Eliteserien table heading into the winter break.

The Frankfurter Buchmesse opened its doors on Wednesday to a record 4,312 exhibitors from 95 countries, with this year's guest of honour being Slovenia, whose pavilion — curated by the Ljubljana-based cultural foundation Fabula — drew immediate praise from visitors for its bold bilingual displays pairing Slovenian texts with English translations. Festival director Marika Oblonšek told reporters that advance ticket sales had already surpassed those of any previous edition, with single-day passes priced at €18.

The Scottish Parliament passed a landmark motion on Thursday backing a second independence referendum, with 72 votes in favour and 55 against, after a heated four-hour debate that saw First Minister Catriona Muirhead warn that Westminster's continued refusal to grant a Section 30 order was "constitutionally untenable." The Scottish National Party and the Scottish Greens, who together commanded a slim majority of 72 seats, had pressed the vote despite fierce opposition from Scottish Labour, the Conservatives, and the Liberal Democrats.

Commuters on the Piccadilly line faced severe delays for the third consecutive morning on Wednesday after a signalling fault between King's Cross St. Pancras and Hammersmith brought services to a near standstill, with Transport for London estimating that up to 180,000 passengers were affected during the peak hours alone. TfL engineers were dispatched overnight but confirmed the fault had not been fully resolved by 07:00, prompting the operator to advise travellers to use alternative routes via the District and Circle lines or the Elizabeth line where possible. A TfL spokesperson said the disruption was expected to last into the early afternoon.

Grasshopper Club Zürich edged FC Winterthur 2–1 in a tightly contested Swiss Challenge League fixture at the Letzigrund on Saturday evening, with midfielder Luca Brägger netting the decisive goal in the 88th minute before a crowd of 9,800. The hosts had twice come from behind in the second half, and the win lifts Grasshopper into third place in the table heading into the winter break.

Commuters on the Overground faced significant delays on Monday morning after a signalling fault between Highbury & Islington and Dalston Junction brought services on the Mildmay line to a standstill for nearly three hours, with Transport for London estimating that around 47,000 passengers were affected before engineers restored full operation shortly before midday.

Stockholm's metro operator MTR Nordic confirmed on Thursday that a signalling fault on the green line — running between Hässelby strand and Hagsätra — had forced it to suspend services for at least six hours during the morning peak, stranding an estimated 47,000 commuters and prompting SL, the regional transit authority, to deploy replacement bus bridges along the entire corridor.

The Städel Museum in Frankfurt will open its long-anticipated retrospective of Dutch Golden Age printmaking on 14 March, running through 29 June, with curators Lena Vosburgh and Dirk Hoffmeister having assembled more than two hundred works drawn from collections across the Netherlands, Germany, and the United Kingdom. Admission for the opening weekend has been set at €12 per adult, and the museum expects upwards of 85,000 visitors over the course of the exhibition.

Commuters across Frankfurt faced significant disruption on Monday morning after the RMV suspended all S-Bahn services on lines S3, S4, and S6 due to a signal failure at Hauptwache station, with engineers estimating repairs would take at least six hours. Roughly 47,000 passengers were affected during the morning rush, and RMV urged travellers to use U-Bahn and bus alternatives where possible. Full services were restored by early afternoon, though delays persisted well into the evening peak.

Die Berliner Verkehrsbetriebe haben ab dem 1. Februar 2026 eine Fahrpreiserhöhung von durchschnittlich 4,9 Prozent angekündigt, die sämtliche Tarife im Verbundnetz des Verkehrsverbunds Berlin-Brandenburg betrifft. Besonders hart trifft es Pendler auf den Linien S1, S7 und U6, die bereits mit chronischen Verspätungen kämpfen. Der BVG-Sprecher Tobias Grunewald erklärte, die Maßnahme sei unumgänglich, um steigende Betriebskosten und den geplanten Ausbau des U-Bahn-Netzes zu finanzieren. Schätzungsweise 1,4 Millionen Fahrgäste täglich sind von der Änderung betroffen.

The Scottish Parliament voted narrowly on Thursday to reject a cross-party motion tabled by the Scottish Greens calling for an independent inquiry into police conduct during last year's COP30 protests in Edinburgh, with 63 votes against, 59 in favour, and 4 abstentions — a result that drew immediate condemnation from civil liberties groups and left the governing SNP accused of closing ranks with the Scottish Conservatives to suppress scrutiny.

A second-half brace from midfielder Tomasz Wierzbicki sealed a commanding 3–1 victory for Cracovia over Wisła Płock at Stadion Cracovii on Saturday evening, lifting the Kraków side to third place in the PKO Ekstraklasa table with nine matches remaining. An estimated 11,200 supporters packed the ground despite bitter November winds, and Wisła Płock's consolation goal in the 78th minute did little to dampen the home crowd's celebrations.

Tens of thousands of football fans heading to Saturday's Bundesliga clash between Borussia Dortmund and Bayer Leverkusen at Signal Iduna Park were left scrambling for alternatives after the BVG announced an unplanned suspension of S-Bahn lines S1 and S4 through Dortmund city centre, citing a signalling fault detected in the early hours. Transport officials estimated that up to 85,000 passengers would be affected, and replacement bus services were hurriedly deployed along both corridors. The match itself, watched by a sell-out crowd of 81,365, ended in a tense 2–1 victory for Borussia Dortmund, with midfielder Tobias Reusch scoring the decisive goal in the 88th minute to keep the hosts firmly in the Bundesliga title race.

Commuters in Gothenburg faced significant disruption on Monday after Västtrafik suspended all tram services on lines 3, 6, and 11 due to a signalling fault detected overnight at the Brunnsparken junction, with engineers warning that repairs could take up to 48 hours and urging passengers to use replacement bus services in the meantime. An estimated 74,000 daily riders are affected by the outage, which comes just weeks before the agency had planned to showcase the network's reliability ahead of a major infrastructure review.

Der Wiener Architekt Benedikt Harlander hat sich in einem Essay für die Zeitschrift „Stadtbild" ausführlich mit der Frage beschäftigt, ob der geplante Ausbau der U-Bahn-Linie U5 langfristig dazu beitragen könnte, die Kultureinrichtungen im Nordwesten der Stadt besser zu erschließen – darunter das Kunsthistorische Museum und die Volksoper. Eine abschließende politische Entscheidung des Wiener Gemeinderats steht nach wie vor aus.

Stockholm's public transport operator SL confirmed on Thursday that a partial suspension of the Tunnelbana's Green Line will take effect from 14 July through 3 August, as maintenance crews replace ageing track switches at Fridhemsplan station — work that is expected to disrupt an estimated 95,000 daily commuters. Replacement bus services will operate along the affected corridor, though SL has warned that journey times between Alvik and T-Centralen could increase by up to 25 minutes during peak hours.

Die Berliner S-Bahn hat für das kommende Wochenende umfangreiche Streckensperrungen angekündigt: Zwischen Ostbahnhof und Erkner wird der Betrieb auf der S3 von Samstag, dem 14. Juni, bis Montag, dem 16. Juni, vollständig eingestellt, da dringend notwendige Gleiserneuerungsarbeiten durchgeführt werden müssen. Rund 38.000 Fahrgäste sind laut BVG von den Maßnahmen betroffen; Schienenersatzverkehr mit Bussen wird eingerichtet.

The future of the old Tempodrom site in central Berlin has become a recurring topic among urban planners and cultural advocates alike, with some pushing for a permanent concert venue while others argue the land should be freed for mixed-use housing. No decision from the Berlin Senate is expected before next spring, and transit officials at BVG have separately noted that any major construction near Möckernbrücke would require months of revised bus routing — a logistical headache that further complicates the already fractious debate.

Die Österreichischen Bundesbahnen haben ab Sonntag den Fernverkehr auf der Weststrecke zwischen Wien und Salzburg für voraussichtlich vier Tage unterbrochen, nachdem ein Erdrutsch bei Attnang-Puchheim Gleisschäden verursacht hat. Rund 28.000 Fahrgäste täglich sind von der Sperrung betroffen; als Ersatz werden Busse der ÖBB Postbus GmbH eingesetzt. Die Reparaturarbeiten sollen laut Unternehmenssprecherin Katharina Freihofer bis Donnerstagabend abgeschlossen sein.

The Frankfurter Buchmesse opened its doors on Wednesday for its 76th edition, drawing an estimated 285,000 visitors from more than 100 countries to the Messe Frankfurt fairgrounds over five days. This year's Guest of Honour, Italy, presented a sweeping programme of Italian literature in translation, with author Federica Salmoni delivering the opening address alongside Buchmesse director Jürgen Boos. Ticket prices for public days were set at €18, with concessions available for students and under-18s.

The Swedish parliament voted narrowly on Thursday to approve a sweeping urban transport package worth 14.2 billion kronor, greenlighting the long-contested extension of Stockholm's green metro line southward to Flemingsberg — a project that transit authority Storstockholms Lokaltrafik has championed for over a decade. The bill passed 178 votes to 161, with nine abstentions, after coalition partners the Social Democrats and the Centre Party overcame fierce resistance from the Sweden Democrats, who argued the cost was fiscally reckless. Construction is now expected to begin in March 2026, adding seven new stations and linking some 340,000 additional commuters to the network.

Die Wiener Konzerthausgesesellschaft eröffnet am 14. März die diesjährige Ausgabe des Festivals „Resonanzen", das sich unter der künstlerischen Leitung von Petra Sobianski ganz dem mittelalterlichen und frühbarocken Repertoire widmet. Auf dem Programm stehen unter anderem das Ensemble Odhecaton aus Bologna sowie die Lautenistin Margrét Sigurðardóttir, die erstmals in Wien auftreten wird. Die Veranstaltungsreihe läuft bis zum 22. März im Konzerthaus Wien; Karten sind ab 18 Euro erhältlich.

The Barbican Centre will host a four-day retrospective of Finnish composer Kaija Saariaho's orchestral and chamber works beginning Friday, with the BBC Symphony Orchestra performing on the opening night alongside mezzo-soprano Liisa Vanhanen-Korhonen and violinist Emre Çelik. Tickets are priced at £35 for evening concerts and £18 for afternoon chamber sessions, and organisers at the Barbican Trust expect to draw around 6,200 attendees across the run.

The Scottish Parliament voted by a narrow margin on Thursday to reject a proposed reform of the land-ownership tax, with 65 members voting against the measure and 58 in favour, while 4 abstained. The Scottish National Party, which had championed the bill alongside the Scottish Greens, suffered what opposition figures called a significant setback, as Conservative MSPs united with a handful of Labour rebels to defeat it. Finance Secretary Moira Dunbar, who had staked considerable political capital on the legislation, told reporters outside Holyrood that her party would bring a revised version to the chamber before the summer recess.

Der Wiener Gemeinderat hat am Donnerstag mit knapper Mehrheit einem umstrittenen Wohnbaupaket zugestimmt, das den Bau von 4.200 geförderten Mietwohnungen in den Außenbezirken vorsieht. Von den 100 anwesenden Mandataren stimmten 54 dafür, 39 dagegen, bei 7 Enthaltungen. SPÖ und NEOS, die die Stadtregierung tragen, setzten sich damit gegen FPÖ und ÖVP durch, während die Grünen wegen fehlender Klimaauflagen gespalten waren. Wohnbaustadträtin Klaudia Feuerstein sprach von einem „historischen Signal für leistbares Wohnen", wohingegen FPÖ-Klubobmann Reinhard Söllner das Paket als „planwirtschaftlichen Irrweg" bezeichnete. Das Gesetz soll laut Beschluss bis Ende 2027 umgesetzt werden.

Malmö FF edged past Djurgårdens IF 2–1 in a tense Allsvenskan derby at Eleda Stadion on Saturday evening, with midfielder Tobias Grenvik sealing the points from the spot in the 83rd minute before a crowd of 20,514 roaring supporters. The victory pulls Malmö level on points with league leaders IFK Göteborg with just four matchdays remaining.

Atletico Bilbao Under-19s handed Real Sociedad B a bruising 4–1 defeat at Lezama on Saturday evening, with midfielder Gorka Etxeberria scoring twice and setting up a third in a dominant first-half display that left the visitors without a credible answer for large stretches of the game. The result lifts Bilbao's youth side to the top of the División de Honor Juvenil Group 4 table ahead of the winter break.

Reigning champions Dinamo Zagreb were held to a tense 1–1 draw by NK Rijeka at Stadion HNK Rijeka on Saturday, a result that hands rivals Hajduk Split a precious opportunity to close the gap at the top of the HNL table. Midfielder Tomislav Grbić opened the scoring for the visitors in the 34th minute before Sebastijan Vuković levelled with a low finish just before the hour, sending a crowd of 11,200 into uproar. Zagreb coach Petar Đuranović cut a frustrated figure at full-time, noting that dropped points this late in the season could prove decisive.

The Frankfurter Buchmesse opens its doors on Wednesday for its 76th edition, drawing publishers, agents, and literary luminaries from more than 100 countries to the Messe Frankfurt fairgrounds. This year's guest of honour is Italy, and the Italian pavilion — curated by Serena Calvetti of the Istituto Italiano di Cultura — is expected to be among the most visited spaces of the five-day fair. Ticket prices begin at €18 for a single day's admission.

ÖBB has confirmed that engineering works on the Westbahn corridor between Salzburg and Linz will force a complete suspension of intercity rail services from 14 March to 22 March, with replacement bus coaches operating on all affected routes throughout the nine-day closure. Roughly 48,000 daily passengers are expected to be disrupted, and travellers are advised to allow an additional ninety minutes for journeys during the period.

The Frankfurter Buchmesse opens its doors on Wednesday for a five-day run that organisers expect to draw more than 300,000 visitors, with Norwegian literature taking centre stage as the guest-of-honour programme, curated by Astrid Vemøy Halvorsen, showcases over forty publishers from Oslo and Bergen. This year's edition marks the fair's 76th instalment, and ticket prices have been set at €18 for day passes.

On the same weekend that local footballers FC Winterthur edged Servette FC 2–1 in a tense Swiss Super League fixture at the Schützenwiese, the city's Casinotheater hosted the opening night of "Voices of the Danube," a folk and classical crossover festival curated by soprano Mirela Vásárhelyi that drew a sell-out crowd of 1,400. Mayor Katrin Obrecht praised the twin events as proof that Winterthur punches well above its weight in both sport and culture.

The Flemish regional parliament voted narrowly on Thursday to approve a controversial housing reform package backed by the N-VA and Vlaams Belang, with 71 votes in favour, 64 against, and 3 abstentions — a result that drew an immediate rebuke from opposition leader Sofie Vandenberghe, who called the bill "a gift to developers and a betrayal of working families." The Grüne-aligned party Groen walked out of the chamber before the final tally, accusing the coalition of bypassing a scheduled committee review.

Wegen umfangreicher Gleiserneuerungsarbeiten zwischen den Bahnhöfen Hannover Hauptbahnhof und Lehrte wird die Strecke der S-Bahn-Linie S5 vom 14. bis zum 28. Juli vollständig gesperrt; die Üstra setzt in diesem Zeitraum Ersatzbusse ein, mit denen täglich rund 34.000 Fahrgäste rechnen müssen. Reisende werden gebeten, auf die parallel verkehrenden Regionalzüge der DB Regio auszuweichen.

Das neue Stadion am Stadtrand von Leipzig, dessen Fertigstellung seit Jahren immer wieder verschoben wird, ist inzwischen zum Symbol einer tief gespaltenen Kommunalpolitik geworden: Während Befürworter auf wirtschaftliche Impulse für den lokalen Einzelhandel verweisen, warnen Architekturkritiker wie die Wiener Essayistin Claudia Fertner davor, dass solche Großbauten das gewachsene Stadtbild unwiederbringlich verändern könnten.

Die Frankfurter Buchmesse eröffnet am 15. Oktober ihre 76. Ausgabe in der Messe Frankfurt und erwartet nach Angaben von Direktorin Klara Svensson rund 95.000 Fachbesucher aus aller Welt. Schwerpunktthema ist in diesem Jahr das Gastland Italien, das mit mehr als 200 Autorinnen und Autoren vertreten sein wird. Tickets für die Publikumstage kosten ab 18 Euro.

Commuters on the U6 and U3 lines in Vienna faced significant delays on Monday morning after a signalling fault near Westbahnhof brought service to a near standstill for roughly three hours, with Wiener Linien estimating that around 47,000 passengers were affected before normal operations resumed shortly before noon.

Wegen umfangreicher Gleiserneuerungsarbeiten zwischen den Bahnhöfen Hannover Hauptbahnhof und Celle sperrte die DB Netz AG die betreffende Strecke ab Montag vollständig für den gesamten Schienenverkehr. Betroffen sind die Linien RE 8 und RB 46, deren Fahrgäste für voraussichtlich drei Wochen auf Schienenersatzverkehr mit Bussen umsteigen müssen. Die Bahn schätzt, dass täglich rund 18.000 Reisende von der Sperrung betroffen sein werden. Ein Sprecher der DB Netz AG erklärte, die Arbeiten seien notwendig, um die Streckensicherheit langfristig zu gewährleisten; die Wiederinbetriebnahme sei für den 14. April geplant.

Bursaspor's hopes of avoiding relegation dimmed considerably on Saturday as Trabzonspor ran out comfortable 3–1 winners at Timsah Arena, with midfielder Kerem Yıldızhan netting twice and defender Ozan Çakır adding a late third to seal the points. The result, watched by a crowd of 18,400, keeps Trabzonspor firmly in contention for a European berth ahead of the final four rounds of the Süper Lig season.

The Bavarian state parliament approved a sweeping overhaul of its rural broadband subsidy programme on Thursday, with the governing coalition of the CSU and Freie Wähler pushing the measure through by 98 votes to 61, over the strenuous objections of the SPD and the Greens, who warned that the revised funding formula would leave dozens of smaller municipalities without adequate connectivity for years to come. Finance Minister Klara Sönnichsen, defending the package from the lectern of the Maximilianeum, insisted that the new framework represented "the most ambitious digital infrastructure commitment this chamber has ever made."

The city of Salzburg has found an unlikely pairing this weekend: the Austrian tennis star Mira Hollenstein opens her title defence at the Salzburg Open on Saturday at the Volksgarten Arena, while just across the Salzach, the Rupertinum Museum inaugurates a sweeping retrospective of painter Josef Reindl whose sun-scorched landscapes have long captivated central European collectors. "We planned the timing deliberately," said festival director Claudia Ferstl, noting that visiting tennis fans could stroll from the courts to the galleries within twenty minutes. Hollenstein, seeded first, dispatched her opening-round opponent in straight sets before a crowd of 4,200.

Wegen umfangreicher Gleisbauarbeiten auf der S-Bahn-Linie S3 zwischen Hauptbahnhof und Flughafen Frankfurt wird die ÖBB-Schwestergesellschaft DB Regio ab dem 14. März für voraussichtlich drei Wochen einen Schienenersatzverkehr einrichten; Fahrgäste müssen laut RMV mit Verzögerungen von bis zu 40 Minuten rechnen. Rund 28.000 Pendler täglich sind von der Sperrung betroffen. Ausgerechnet in diesem Zeitraum eröffnet die Frankfurter Buchmesse ihre Sonderausstellung „Wörter in Bewegung" im Frankfurter Kunstverein, die ab dem 15. März bis zum 6. April gezeigt wird und von Kuratorin Lena Vossberg gestaltet wurde; die Schau beleuchtet literarische Reisejournale aus drei Jahrhunderten.

Die Frankfurter Buchmesse eröffnet am 15. Oktober ihre 76. Ausgabe auf dem Messegelände Frankfurt, wo rund 4.200 Aussteller aus über 100 Ländern erwartet werden. Ehrengast in diesem Jahr ist die Tschechische Republik. Die Schriftstellerin Lenka Procházková wird die tschechische Delegation mit einer Lesung im Pavillon des Gastlandes eröffnen, teilte Messedirektorin Sonja Albrecht mit.

Josefine Albrecht outswam the field in the 1500-metre freestyle final at the European Aquatics Championships on Saturday, touching the wall in 15:53.04 to claim gold ahead of defending champion Marta Sokolova and Italy's Francesca Delledonne at the Duna Arena in Budapest. The victory drew a roaring crowd of 11,200, and Albrecht — swimming for the German national team — is now expected to be a strong contender for a medal at next year's Paris Olympics.

Der Wiener Gemeinderat hat am Donnerstag mit 54 zu 31 Stimmen bei vier Enthaltungen einen Fördervertrag für das Internationale Jazzfestival Wien verabschiedet, das vom 18. bis 27. Juli 2025 im Wiener Konzerthaus stattfinden wird. Kulturstadträtin Brigitte Falkner-Hofer begrüßte den Beschluss als „klares Bekenntnis der Stadt zur lebendigen Musikszene". Das Festival, das heuer seine zwölfte Ausgabe feiert, wird unter anderem die polnische Pianistin Zofia Wierzbicka sowie das Berliner Ensemble für Neue Musik präsentieren; der Eintritt für Abendveranstaltungen ist auf 38 Euro festgesetzt worden.

Die ÖBB warnen vor erheblichen Behinderungen auf der Weststrecke zwischen Wien und Salzburg: Wegen dringender Gleiserneuerungsarbeiten wird der Streckenabschnitt zwischen Linz Hauptbahnhof und Attnang-Puchheim vom 14. bis zum 28. März vollständig gesperrt. Betroffen sind täglich rund 18.000 Fahrgäste, die auf Schienenersatzverkehr umsteigen müssen. Die ÖBB empfehlen, wo möglich auf den Railjet zwischen Wien Hauptbahnhof und Salzburg Hauptbahnhof auszuweichen, der über eine Umleitung via Passau verkehrt.

The Scottish Parliament voted by a narrow margin on Thursday to approve a sweeping reform of the country's social care funding system, with 68 members backing the government's National Care Bill and 57 voting against, following a fractious debate that exposed deep rifts within the opposition ranks. First Minister Catriona Drummond hailed the result as "a generational step forward," while Scottish Conservative leader Ewan Fergusson accused the governing Scottish National Party of "railroading through an uncosted fantasy." Two members abstained, and observers noted that the bill's passage now clears the way for a formal consultation period beginning in January 2025.

The Brussels regional parliament approved a €2.3 billion expansion of the city's metro network on Thursday, with 72 votes in favour and 18 against, after transport minister Lieselotte Vanderberghe argued that the new Nord–Sud extension would ease chronic congestion along the ring road. Hours later, the STIB-MIVB confirmed that construction work on Line 3 will begin in March 2025, temporarily suspending tram services on routes 51 and 82 for an estimated duration of fourteen months while underground tunnelling proceeds beneath the Schaerbeek district.

Der Stadtrat von Freiburg im Breisgau hat in seiner Sitzung am Donnerstagabend mit 28 zu 14 Stimmen bei zwei Enthaltungen beschlossen, die Grundsteuer B ab dem kommenden Jahr um 95 Punkte auf 595 Prozent anzuheben — ein Schritt, den Bürgermeisterin Carola Hennings als „schmerzhaft, aber unausweichlich" bezeichnete, während die Fraktionsvorsitzende der FDP/Bürger-für-Freiburg-Fraktion, Mirjam Säuberlich, von einem „beispiellosen Angriff auf die Eigenheimbesitzer der Stadt" sprach.

Borussia Dortmund hat am Samstagabend im Signal Iduna Park einen dramatischen 3:2-Sieg gegen den FC Augsburg eingefahren und damit den Anschluss an die Tabellenspitze der Bundesliga gewahrt. Den Siegtreffer erzielte Stürmer Lennart Vossberg in der 89. Minute, nachdem Augsburg zwischenzeitlich ausgeglichen hatte. Rund 81.365 Zuschauer verfolgten das packende Spiel live im Stadion.

The Frankfurter Buchmesse opens its 76th edition on Wednesday, October 16, drawing publishers, agents, and literary scouts from more than 100 countries to the Messe Frankfurt fairgrounds, where Slovenian author Petra Kovačič will deliver the opening address before a crowd of roughly 7,200 industry delegates. Ticket prices for day passes have risen to €38 this year, a modest increase that organisers at the Börsenverein des Deutschen Buchhandels say reflects higher logistics costs.

The Flemish parliament voted narrowly on Thursday to ratify the coalition agreement between the N-VA, the Vlaams Belang, and the CD&V, with 72 members in favour and 63 opposed, as newly appointed Minister-President Diederik Vantomme pledged to prioritise housing reform and a sweeping overhaul of regional tax policy over the next five years.

The Barbican Centre will host a three-night retrospective of Icelandic composer Sigríður Níelsdóttir's work beginning Friday, 18 October, featuring the BBC Symphony Orchestra under the baton of guest conductor Márton Vásárhelyi. Tickets are priced at £35, and the opening night is expected to draw an audience of roughly 1,900 to the Barbican Hall. The series, curated by arts programmer Leonie Fassbender, spans Níelsdóttir's chamber and orchestral output from the past two decades and will close on Sunday, 20 October.

Unai Dorronsoro's late header rescued a point for Athletic Bilbao as they drew 1–1 with Real Sociedad at San Mamés on Saturday evening, in a Basque derby that kept both clubs locked together on 34 points at the top of La Liga's mid-table cluster. A crowd of 48,200 roared the home side forward throughout, but it was Sociedad's Ander Goikoetxea who had put the visitors ahead in the 61st minute before Dorronsoro levelled deep into stoppage time.

The Scottish Parliament voted by a margin of 73 to 48 on Thursday to pass the Housing Emergency (Temporary Measures) Bill, with the SNP and Scottish Greens forming an unlikely voting bloc against a fractious Conservative opposition; Labour MSPs largely abstained, leaving Scottish Conservative leader Miriam Forsythe to condemn what she called "a rushed and half-baked intervention in the private rental market" that would cap rent increases at two percent annually across all local authority areas.

Beim packenden Halbfinale der Deutschen Wasserball-Meisterschaft im Neptunbad Köln setzte sich der SV Poseidon Hamburg am Samstag mit 11:9 gegen den Wasserfreunde Spandau 04 durch und zog damit souverän ins Finale ein. Vor 1.340 Zuschauern ragte der Hamburger Kapitän Florian Degenhardt mit vier Toren heraus, während Spandaus Torhüter Mirek Szymański trotz zahlreicher Paraden am Ende das Nachsehen hatte.

Im packenden Halbfinale des DFB-Pokals bezwang Bayer 04 Leverkusen den Hamburger SV am Dienstagabend mit 3:1 im BayArena, vor ausverkauftem Haus. Florian Mertesacker traf doppelt in der zweiten Halbzeit und sicherte damit den Einzug ins Finale, während Leverkusens Torhüter Jonas Praß mit mehreren Glanzparaden überzeugte. Für den HSV erzielte Knut Söderblom lediglich den zwischenzeitlichen Anschlusstreffer zum 1:2.

Commuters across the Danish capital faced severe disruption on Thursday after S-Tog drivers walked out indefinitely over a pay dispute, bringing all eight lines of the suburban rail network to a standstill and stranding an estimated 220,000 daily passengers. DSB, the state railway operator, urged affected travellers to seek alternatives via the Metro or regional bus services, though both networks were swiftly overwhelmed. Negotiations between DSB management and the 3F transport union broke down late Wednesday and are not expected to resume before the weekend.

Beim packenden Kellerduell der 2. Bundesliga setzte sich der FC Schalke 04 am Samstagabend im Veltins-Arena gegen den Hamburger SV mit 3:1 durch und kletterte damit vorläufig aus der Abstiegszone. Vor 61.817 Zuschauern erzielte Mittelfeldspieler Tomás Veselý zwei Treffer, während Angreifer Luca Brinkmann den Schlusspunkt setzte. Für den HSV war es die dritte Niederlage in Folge.

Die Frankfurter Buchmesse eröffnet am 15. Oktober ihre 76. Ausgabe auf dem Messegelände Frankfurt mit einem Festakt, bei dem die Verlegerin Astrid Rosenbach eine Grundsatzrede zur Zukunft des Buchhandels halten wird. Ehrengast in diesem Jahr ist Norwegen, das seine literarische Vielfalt mit mehr als 80 Autoren und Autorinnen präsentieren wird. Erwartet werden rund 180.000 Besucher aus aller Welt; Tagestickets kosten 22 Euro.

Im Viertelfinale des DFB-Pokals setzte sich der SC Freiburg am Dienstagabend im Europa-Park Stadion mit 3:1 gegen den Hamburger SV durch. Die Tore für die Breisgauer erzielten Lena Vogt (12.), Markus Strümpfel (54.) und Benedikt Ohler (78.), während Fabio Santoro für die Hanseaten den zwischenzeitlichen Ausgleich verpasste und erst in der 61. Minute traf. Vor 24.000 Zuschauern bestätigte Freiburg damit seinen Platz unter den letzten Vier des Wettbewerbs.

Die Österreichischen Bundesbahnen haben ab Sonntag, dem 13. April, den Fernverkehr auf der Weststrecke zwischen Wien Hauptbahnhof und Salzburg Hauptbahnhof für voraussichtlich vier Tage eingestellt, nachdem ein Erdrutsch bei Attnang-Puchheim erhebliche Schäden an der Gleisanlage verursacht hat. Rund 28.000 Fahrgäste täglich sind von der Sperrung betroffen; als Ersatz werden Fernbusverbindungen der ÖBB Postbus eingerichtet, die jedoch mit deutlich längeren Fahrzeiten rechnen müssen.

The Frankfurter Buchmesse opened its 76th edition on Wednesday at the Messe Frankfurt fairgrounds, drawing publishers and literary agents from more than 100 countries for what organisers described as the world's largest trade fair for books and media. Curator-general Lena Vossberg told reporters that this year's Guest of Honour pavilion, dedicated to Italy, would feature over 200 authors including several Nobel Prize shortlisted writers. Ticket prices for public days stand at €18, with the fair running through Sunday.

The Frankfurter Buchmesse opens its doors on Wednesday for a five-day run that organisers expect will draw more than 300,000 visitors to the Messe Frankfurt fairgrounds, with Norwegian literature taking centre stage as the guest-of-honour nation. Among the highlights is a debut reading by novelist Ingrid Solberg-Haave, whose debut novel "Vintersol" arrives in German translation through S. Fischer Verlag. The fair's programme director, Markus Tiedemann, said the 2024 edition would place "particular emphasis on the interplay between digital storytelling and the printed page."

The Frankfurter Buchmesse opens its doors on Wednesday for a five-day run that organisers expect to draw upwards of 300,000 visitors to the Messe Frankfurt fairgrounds, with Norwegian literature headlining as this year's guest-of-honour theme. Among the most anticipated events is a reading and conversation with debut novelist Sigrid Opsahl, whose first book, "Svart Vann," has already sold more than 80,000 copies across Scandinavia since its release in January. Fair director Klaudia Brenner told reporters on Tuesday that more than 4,200 exhibitors from 95 countries have registered stands, making this the largest edition in over a decade.

The Frankfurter Buchmesse opened its doors on Wednesday to an estimated 93,000 visitors on its first public day, with Norwegian author Lena Brøgger drawing the longest queues at Hall 3.1 for the launch of her debut novel "Saltfjord," translated into eleven languages and already shortlisted for the Nordic Council's Literature Prize. This year's guest of honour is Slovenia, whose pavilion — designed by curator Maša Kovač — occupies a striking corner of the Ludwig-Erhard-Anlage exhibition grounds.

The Frankfurter Buchmesse opens its doors on Wednesday, drawing publishers, agents, and literary enthusiasts from more than 100 countries to the Messe Frankfurt fairgrounds for what organisers are billing as the most internationally diverse edition in the fair's seven-decade history. This year's guest of honour is Italy, and a sprawling programme of readings, panel discussions, and rights negotiations is expected to fill every hall through Sunday. Ticket prices for day visitors have been set at €18, while the professional trade days on Wednesday and Thursday remain restricted to accredited attendees. The Börsenverein des Deutschen Buchhandels, which oversees the event, has confirmed that more than 4,200 exhibitors have registered — a record since the pandemic-era low of 2021.

Defending champions Hibernian FC were held to a tense 1–1 draw by Inverness Caledonian Thistle at Easter Road on Saturday, a result that leaves both clubs locked together on 34 points midway through the Scottish Premiership season. Leandro Vásquez opened the scoring for the hosts in the 23rd minute before substitute Callum Dreich levelled with a curling effort eleven minutes from time, denying Hibernian a chance to close the gap on league leaders Celtic. A crowd of 16,204 watched the stalemate unfold in Edinburgh.

The Scottish Parliament voted narrowly on Thursday to approve a sweeping package of reforms to the country's social care funding system, with 65 members backing the bill against 59 opposed and three abstentions. The vote came after a bruising seven-hour debate in which Health Secretary Fiona Carmichael — a backbench defector from the Scottish Conservatives who crossed the floor to support the SNP minority government — reportedly delivered what several observers called the most persuasive speech of her career. Opposition spokespeople from Scottish Labour and the Liberal Democrats had argued the legislation would place an undue burden on local councils, a charge Finance Minister Alistair Dunbar flatly rejected. The bill now passes to committee stage before returning for a final reading expected in early March.

The Swedish Riksdag voted narrowly on Thursday to approve a sweeping pension reform package put forward by the ruling coalition, with 176 members backing the measure against 173 opposed and four abstentions — a margin so thin that Speaker Margareta Åkerlund called for absolute silence in the chamber before the tally was announced. The Socialdemokraterna and Vänsterpartiet had fought the bill at every stage, arguing that cuts to index-linked payouts would fall disproportionately on low-income retirees, while Finance Minister Björn Hedlund insisted the changes were indispensable to long-term fiscal stability.

Commuters on the S-Bahn München network faced significant delays on Friday morning after a points failure near Ostbahnhof brought services on lines S2, S4, and S8 to a near-standstill for more than three hours, stranding an estimated 47,000 passengers during the peak rush. DB Regio Bayern, which operates the network under a concession from the Bavarian state government, deployed replacement bus services along the most heavily affected corridors but acknowledged that full service restoration was not achieved until shortly before noon. "We sincerely apologise to everyone affected," said a spokesperson for DB Regio Bayern, adding that engineers were working to prevent a recurrence.

The Scottish Parliament voted by a narrow margin on Thursday to reject the Holyrood Infrastructure Levy Bill, with 64 members opposing the measure against 59 in favour and three abstentions — a result that hands the SNP its most stinging legislative defeat of the current session and leaves First Minister Catriona Muir scrambling to salvage a revised proposal before the summer recess. The Conservatives and Scottish Labour combined forces to block the bill, arguing that the levy would burden smaller construction firms at a time of acute economic pressure.

Commuters across Greater Manchester faced severe disruption on Monday after Avanti West Coast and Northern Rail both suspended services on the Liverpool–Leeds cross-city corridor, stranding an estimated 47,000 passengers during the morning peak. A signal failure near Piccadilly station, compounded by overnight engineering overruns on the Castlefield viaduct, left platforms at Manchester Victoria heaving with delayed travellers for more than six hours. Transport for Greater Manchester said it had deployed additional Metroshuttle bus services on routes 1, 2 and 3 to relieve pressure, but warned that full rail service would not resume until at least Tuesday morning.

Brynmor Hallett's brace in the final twelve minutes rescued Swansea City a hard-fought 2–1 victory over Coventry City at the Swansea.com Stadium on Saturday, keeping the Swans in third place in the Championship with ten games remaining. A first-half header from Coventry's Tomáš Vrábel had looked set to earn the visitors three points until Hallett struck twice in breathtaking fashion, sending a crowd of 19,344 into raptures.

For decades, the crumbling grandstands of Selhurst Park have inspired a peculiar affection among football writers and architectural historians alike, who see in its mismatched rooflines and flaking concrete a kind of stubborn civic poetry that neither the Premier League's vast television revenues nor Crystal Palace's intermittent ambitions to relocate have quite managed to erase.

Saturday's Serie A clash between Napoli and Fiorentina at the Stadio Diego Armando Maradona drew 47,200 spectators, with a late Emanuele Carfora header sealing a 2–1 victory for the hosts — but tens of thousands of fans faced significant disruption on the way home after Circumvesuviana operator EAV suspended all services on its Naples–Sorrento line from 22:00 onwards due to an overhead cable fault, leaving stranded supporters scrambling for buses and taxis across the city.

Commuters on the S-Bahn network around Frankfurt faced severe delays on Thursday morning after a signalling fault near Hauptwache station brought services on lines S3, S4, and S6 to a near-standstill for approximately four hours, with RMV estimating that around 85,000 passengers were affected before normal operations were restored shortly before midday.

Commuters on the Cologne–Aachen corridor faced severe disruption on Monday after Deutsche Bahn engineers discovered a hairline fracture in an overhead wire support structure near Düren, forcing the suspension of all RE1 and RE9 services for at least 72 hours while specialist repair crews work around the clock. Deutsche Bahn estimates that approximately 47,000 passengers will be affected before normal operations resume, and replacement bus services have been arranged along the full length of both routes, though officials concede journey times will roughly double. A spokesperson for Deutsche Bahn said no fare compensation scheme would be triggered unless the disruption extends beyond five days.

The Malmö Arena will serve double duty this weekend: on Friday evening it hosts the Swedish premiere of "Stillwater," a new chamber opera composed by Britta Söderqvist and directed by Lars Ekman, before the same venue transforms on Sunday into an ice bowl for the SHL clash between Malmö Redhawks and Djurgårdens IF — a fixture that sold out its 12,500 seats within hours of going on sale, according to the club's communications officer Patrik Lundwall.

Beim packenden Halbfinale der Deutschen Wasserball-Meisterschaft am Samstag in der Olympia-Schwimmhalle München behielten die Wasserfreunde Spandau 04 mit 9:7 gegen den SV Cannstatt die Oberhand. Vor 1.840 Zuschauern ragte Torwart Lennart Przybylski mit sieben gehaltenen Würfen überragend heraus, während Angreifer Tomás Vukić mit vier Treffern zum besten Schützen des Spiels avancierte. Im Finale am kommenden Sonntag treffen die Berliner nun auf den OSC Potsdam.

The Frankfurter Buchmesse opens its doors on Wednesday for a five-day run at Messe Frankfurt, drawing publishers, agents, and literary scouts from more than 100 countries in what organisers describe as the largest gathering of the international book trade since the pandemic. This year's guest of honour is Italy, with a pavilion curated by Chiara Dentamaro showcasing the full breadth of Italian writing from experimental fiction to graphic novels. Ticket prices start at €18 for day visitors.

Beim Halbmarathon Wien am Sonntag strömten rund 18.500 Läuferinnen und Läufer durch die Innenstadt, was die Wiener Linien dazu veranlasste, die U2 und die U4 zwischen Karlsplatz und Schottenring für knapp fünf Stunden zu unterbrechen. Der Lauf, der traditionell an der Staatsoper startet, wurde von der Österreichischen Leichtathletik-Verbandes organisiert und gewann der 29-jährige Kenianer Elias Korir mit einer Zeit von 1:01:43 Stunden vor dem Wiener Lokalmatador Benedikt Thalheimer. Fahrgäste der betroffenen U-Bahn-Linien wurden gebeten, auf die Straßenbahnlinien 1 und 71 auszuweichen, doch Verkehrsexpertin Marlene Seifert vom VCÖ warnte vor erheblicher Überlastung des Ersatzverkehrs an der wichtigen Umsteigestation Schwedenplatz.

Wegen umfangreicher Gleisbauarbeiten auf der S-Bahn-Linie S3 zwischen Darmstadt und Frankfurt Süd wird die Strecke vom 14. bis 18. August vollständig gesperrt; die RMV-Sprecherin Katharina Voß riet Reisenden, auf die parallel verkehrenden Regionalbusse auszuweichen. Besonders betroffen sind die rund 42.000 Fahrgäste, die diese Verbindung werktäglich nutzen – darunter zahlreiche Besucher des Jazzfestivals Rhein-Main, das vom 15. bis 17. August im Mousonturm Frankfurt sein zehnjähriges Jubiläum feiert und zu dessen Highlights ein Konzert der Pianistin Solène Marchand sowie eine Late-Night-Session des Frankfurter Ensembles Kollektiv Neun zählen.

Defending champions Roter Stern Graz were held to a gritty 1–1 draw by SK Wolfsberg at the Stadion Liebenau on Saturday evening, a result that leaves both sides locked on 34 points with just three rounds remaining in the Austrian Football Second Division. Midfielder Tobias Harlander opened the scoring for the visitors in the 28th minute before Roter Stern's captain Emeka Osei levelled with a thunderous header nine minutes before the break. An announced crowd of 6,200 watched the tension-filled encounter, with neither goalkeeper called upon to make a truly exceptional save in a second half that produced plenty of effort but little cutting edge.

Im packenden Finale des DFB-Pokals bezwang Bayer Leverkusen den Hamburger SV mit 3:1 im Berliner Olympiastadion vor 74.244 Zuschauern. Florian Kettner erzielte zwei Treffer für die Leverkusener, während Dani Olmo mit einem sehenswerten Weitschuss den zwischenzeitlichen Anschlusstreffer für Hamburg markierte. Es war der erste Pokalsieg der Werkself seit Jahren und löste auf den Rängen unbeschreibliche Begeisterung aus.

Die Frankfurter Buchmesse eröffnet am 15. Oktober ihre 76. Ausgabe auf dem Messegelände Frankfurt mit einem Rahmenprogramm, das über fünf Tage mehr als 4.200 Aussteller aus aller Welt zusammenbringt. Als Ehrengastland ist in diesem Jahr Italien vertreten, und die Schriftstellerin Giulia Marrone wird die Eröffnungsrede halten. Der Eintritt für Fachbesucher beträgt 42 Euro pro Tag.

The Swedish Riksdag passed a contentious pension reform bill on Thursday by a razor-thin margin of 176 votes to 173, with four abstentions, after nearly eleven hours of floor debate that stretched well past midnight. The legislation, championed by Finance Minister Britta Söderholm of the Moderaterna, would raise the standard retirement age from 65 to 67 over a six-year transitional period. Opposition leaders from the Socialdemokraterna accused the government of sacrificing low-income workers to balance the national budget, a charge Söderholm flatly rejected. Political observers noted it was the closest parliamentary vote on social policy in Stockholm since 2009.

Riding a ferocious second-half surge, Rosenborg BK dismantled visiting Molde FK 4–1 at Lerkendal Stadion on Saturday to reclaim top spot in the Eliteserien, with midfielder Tobias Færøvik netting twice and winger Sanna Kouyaté adding a thunderous strike from distance that left the crowd of 17,340 breathless.

Wegen des Bundesliga-Derbys zwischen dem VfB Stuttgart und dem SC Freiburg am kommenden Samstag im Mercedes-Benz Arena rechnet die Stuttgarter Straßenbahnen AG mit bis zu 54.000 zusätzlichen Fahrgästen und wird auf den Linien U1, U2 und U14 ab 15:00 Uhr einen Sonderfahrplan einrichten. Das Spiel, das Schiedsrichterin Lena Wörner leiten wird, gilt als wegweisend im Abstiegskampf der aktuellen Saison und ist mit rund 60.200 Zuschauern ausverkauft.

The Renfrewshire Council voted narrowly on Thursday evening to reject a proposed rezoning of agricultural land on the outskirts of Paisley for light industrial use, with 23 councillors opposing the measure, 19 in favour, and 4 abstentions — a result that drew audible relief from the gallery packed with residents of the Gallowhill ward. Labour group leader Councillor Fiona Drummond called the outcome "a victory for green space and community voice," while the SNP's Councillor Tariq Hussain warned that turning away investment would cost the area hundreds of jobs. The Scottish Greens, whose two votes proved decisive, said they would not support any development that failed a rigorous environmental impact assessment.

Edinburgh's much-anticipated International Book Festival opens its gates at Charlotte Square Gardens on Friday, drawing over forty authors from seventeen countries for a ten-day programme of readings, debates, and workshops — but festivalgoers should be prepared for significant disruption on the Lothian Buses network, after drivers voted overwhelmingly to strike from Thursday through Sunday in a dispute over a proposed wage restructuring, with an estimated 85,000 daily passengers expected to seek alternative transport.

Wegen des Bundesliga-Derbys zwischen dem Hamburger SV und dem FC St. Pauli am Samstagabend im Volksparkstadion wird die Hamburger Hochbahn rund um den Spieltag erhebliche Einschränkungen im U-Bahn-Betrieb verzeichnen: Die Linie U2 wird zwischen Schlump und Stellingen von 17 bis 24 Uhr vollständig gesperrt, wie das Unternehmen am Donnerstag mitteilte. Rund 38.000 Zuschauer werden in der Arena erwartet; die Hochbahn rechnet mit bis zu 55.000 betroffenen Fahrgästen auf den Alternativrouten. Das Derby gilt als eines der emotionalsten Stadtduelle im deutschen Fußball.

Der Stadtrat von Freiburg im Breisgau hat am Donnerstagabend mit knapper Mehrheit beschlossen, den städtischen Wohnungsbauplan für die kommenden zehn Jahre zu verabschieden — 28 Stimmen dafür, 19 dagegen und vier Enthaltungen. Oberbürgermeisterin Claudia Wernhardt begrüßte das Ergebnis als „historischen Schritt für bezahlbares Wohnen in unserer Stadt", während die CDU-Fraktion unter Fraktionsvorsitzendem Tobias Grellmann Nachbesserungen bei der Finanzierung forderte. Die Grünen und die SPD hatten die Vorlage gemeinsam eingebracht.

The Reykjavík Art Museum opens its long-awaited retrospective of Icelandic sculptor Sigríður Magnúsdóttir on 14 March, with curator Einar Þórsson describing the 87-piece survey — spanning nearly four decades of bronze and volcanic-stone work — as "the most comprehensive look at her practice ever assembled." The show runs through 29 June and is expected to draw upwards of 22,000 visitors.

Beim packenden Halbfinale der Handball-Bundesliga bezwang der SC Magdeburg die Rhein-Neckar Löwen am Samstagabend in der GETEC Arena mit 31:27 und zog damit souverän ins Finale ein. Vor 6.800 Zuschauern ragten Marko Veljović mit neun Toren und der überragende Torhüter Lasse Freitag beim Sieger besonders heraus.

The Irish parliament voted narrowly on Thursday to approve a sweeping overhaul of the country's housing policy, with 82 members backing the government's Affordable Homes Bill against 74 opposed and 6 abstentions — a result that Taoiseach Micheál Martin hailed as "a turning point for a generation priced out of homeownership." Sinn Féin, which had tabled several wrecking amendments in the days prior, declared the legislation inadequate and vowed to reverse it should they enter government. The bill now proceeds to the Seanad for final ratification.

Commuters on the S-Bahn network in Munich faced severe delays on Thursday morning after a signalling fault near Marienplatz brought services on lines S1, S3, and S8 to a near-standstill for more than three hours, leaving an estimated 47,000 passengers stranded or forced onto replacement bus services. Deutsche Bahn, which operates the network, said engineers isolated the fault by 11:15 a.m. but warned that residual disruption would persist into the early afternoon. No injuries were reported.

Trailing by two goals at the break, Hibernian FC mounted a stunning second-half comeback to defeat Dundee United 3–2 at Easter Road on Saturday, with midfielder Catriona Svensson scoring the winner in the 88th minute to secure a vital three points in the Scottish Premiership. A crowd of 14,350 witnessed one of the most dramatic reversals of the Edinburgh club's season so far.

The Frankfurter Buchmesse opens its doors on Wednesday for a five-day run at Messe Frankfurt, drawing publishers, literary agents, and readers from more than 100 countries in what organisers at the Börsenverein des Deutschen Buchhandels are billing as the largest edition since the pandemic. Norwegian author Sigrid Helland will deliver the opening keynote, while debut novelist Farhan Osei-Bonsu is tipped to be the breakout name of this year's fair. Tickets for single-day admission are priced at €18.

Josefine Hartmann of Germany claimed gold in the women's 10,000-metre final at the European Athletics Championships in Rome on Friday evening, crossing the line in a championship-record 30:41.87 to hold off a fierce late challenge from Amara Diallo of France and Saoirse Ní Bhriain of Ireland. An estimated 38,000 spectators packed the Stadio Olimpico to witness the closest finish in the event's history, with just four seconds separating the top three.

Der Wiener Gemeinderat hat am Donnerstagabend mit 54 zu 38 Stimmen bei vier Enthaltungen einem umstrittenen Wohnbauprogramm zugestimmt, das den Bau von 12.000 geförderten Mietwohnungen bis 2031 vorsieht. Die regierende Koalition aus SPÖ und NEOS konnte sich dabei knapp gegen das Nein-Lager aus FPÖ und ÖVP durchsetzen. Bürgermeister Michael Ludwig bezeichnete das Ergebnis als „historischen Schritt für das soziale Wien", während FPÖ-Fraktionschef Markus Treiber von einer „Verschwendung von Steuergeld in Milliardenhöhe" sprach.

Stockholm's Tele2 Arena will host the opening match of the Allsvenskan season between Djurgårdens IF and IFK Göteborg on Saturday, 5 April, but fans travelling by public transport face significant disruption: Storstockholms Lokaltrafik has confirmed that the Tunnelbana's green line will run at reduced frequency from 18:00 until midnight due to emergency track maintenance between Gullmarsplan and Skärmarbrink, potentially affecting some 34,000 passengers. Club officials from both sides have urged supporters to allow extra journey time or make use of the shuttle bus service laid on from Slussen.

The Scottish Parliament voted on Thursday to approve a landmark arts funding bill championed by Culture Minister Fiona Macrae, allocating £12 million to community arts organisations across the country, with 81 votes in favour and just 34 against. The decision was widely celebrated by Edinburgh's creative sector, and in a direct expression of that energy, the Edinburgh International Festival announced the same evening that its 2024 edition would open with a commissioned orchestral premiere at the Usher Hall, conducted by rising Scottish talent Alasdair Muir.

The Frankfurter Buchmesse opens its doors on Wednesday for its 76th edition, drawing publishers, agents, and authors from more than 100 countries to the Messe Frankfurt fairgrounds. This year's Guest of Honour is Italy, with a sprawling programme of readings, panel discussions, and installations curated by Chiara Vettori and Marco Salviati that spans the full five-day run. Organisers at the Börsenverein des Deutschen Buchhandels expect upwards of 85,000 trade visitors before the fair closes on Sunday.

Karolína Horáčková dismantled third-seeded Priya Nambiar 6–2, 6–3 in just under ninety minutes on Centre Court at the All England Club on Saturday, advancing to her first Wimbledon quarter-final and silencing a crowd that had arrived expecting a much closer contest. The Czech qualifier, ranked 47th in the world, broke Nambiar's serve five times and faced no break points herself across the entire match.

Commuters on Berlin's S-Bahn network faced significant delays on Monday morning after a signalling fault near Ostbahnhof brought services on the S3, S5, S7, and S9 lines to a near standstill for roughly four hours, leaving an estimated 85,000 passengers stranded or forced onto already overcrowded U-Bahn and bus connections. S-Bahn Berlin GmbH, which operates the suburban rail network under a concession from the Berlin Senate, said engineers had isolated the fault by midday and that full services were expected to resume by early afternoon. It was the third major disruption on the network this year, renewing calls from opposition councillors for a review of the ageing signalling infrastructure.

Grasshoppers Zürich edged FC Aarau 2–1 in a tightly contested Swiss Challenge League fixture at the Letzigrund on Saturday evening, with a late header from midfielder Tomáš Blažek proving decisive in front of a crowd of 11,400. The victory lifts Grasshoppers three points clear at the summit, though second-placed Aarau retain a game in hand.

The Frankfurter Buchmesse opens its doors on Wednesday, welcoming publishers, agents, and literary enthusiasts from more than 100 countries to the Messe Frankfurt fairgrounds for what organisers are billing as the largest edition in a decade. This year's guest of honour is Norway, whose pavilion — designed by architect Ingrid Solberg-Haugen — traces the country's literary tradition from the Norse sagas to contemporary Nordic noir. The fair runs through Sunday, with headline readings by Norwegian authors Marta Vilde and Tobias Ødegård scheduled at the Friedrich-Rücker-Saal on Friday evening; tickets are priced at €18 per event.

Kristóf Vásárhelyi delivered a virtuoso display at the Nemzeti Atlétikai Központ on Saturday, winning the men's 3,000 metres steeplechase at the Hungarian Athletics Championships with a personal-best time of 8:14.63 — the fastest time recorded on Hungarian soil in over a decade. The 24-year-old from Győr finished a comfortable seven seconds ahead of his nearest rival, drawing a crowd of just over 6,200 spectators to the Budapest venue on a blustery late-September afternoon.

The Flemish parliament voted narrowly on Thursday to strip municipal councils of their power to override regional zoning decisions, a measure championed by the centre-right N-VA and long opposed by Groen and the socialists of Vooruit. The final tally was 71 votes in favour, 63 against, and 4 abstentions — a margin so slim that party whips had spent the preceding forty-eight hours in frantic corridor negotiations. "This is a victory for coherent territorial planning," declared Lore Deckmyn, the N-VA's lead spokeswoman on housing affairs, though critics from Vooruit argued the reform would effectively silence smaller communes on development disputes that directly affect their residents.

Der Gemeinderat von Innsbruck hat am Donnerstagabend mit knapper Mehrheit den umstrittenen Haushaltsentwurf für das kommende Jahr verabschiedet: 23 Stimmen entfielen auf den Entwurf, 19 Räte stimmten dagegen, und zwei enthielten sich. Bürgermeisterin Marlene Fürstauer von der ÖVP sprach von einem „wichtigen Signal für die Handlungsfähigkeit der Stadt", während die Grünen und die SPÖ die geplanten Kürzungen im Sozialbereich scharf kritisierten. Die FPÖ enthielt sich geschlossen der Stimme.

The Frankfurter Buchmesse opens its 76th edition on Wednesday, October 16, drawing publishers, agents, and literary scouts from more than 100 countries to the Messe Frankfurt fairgrounds. This year's guest of honour is Italy, whose pavilion — designed by architect Marta Pellegrini — sprawls across two halls and showcases over 400 titles in translation. Organiser Juergen Boos told reporters that advance ticket sales had already surpassed 285,000, reflecting what he called "an irreversible hunger for the physical book in the digital age."

The Scottish Parliament voted by a narrow margin on Thursday to approve a sweeping reform of the country's social care funding model, with 68 members backing the bill and 55 opposing it, while 4 abstained. The Scottish National Party and the Scottish Greens formed the backbone of support, while the Scottish Conservatives and Scottish Labour united in opposition, calling the legislation fiscally reckless. Health Secretary Fiona Drummond, who steered the bill through weeks of heated committee debate, hailed the outcome as "a historic step for dignity in old age," whereas shadow health spokeswoman Clare Aitken warned that the treasury projections underpinning the plan were, in her words, "built on sand."

Beim packenden Halbfinale der Deutschen Wasserball-Meisterschaft setzte sich der SV Poseidon Hamburg am Samstagabend mit 10:7 gegen den Wasserfreunde Spandau 04 durch und buchte damit sein Ticket für das Endspiel. Vor ausverkauftem Haus im Olympia-Schwimmstadion in Berlin verfolgten 2.840 Zuschauer, wie der überragende Torwart Niklas Brüggemann und der fünffache Torschütze Emre Yıldırım die Berliner alt aussehen ließen. Das Finale findet kommenden Sonntag statt.

Der Stadtrat von Freiburg im Breisgau hat am Dienstagabend mit knapper Mehrheit ein neues Klimaschutzpaket verabschiedet: 28 Stimmen entfielen auf den Antrag der Grünen und der SPD, 21 Räte stimmten dagegen, und vier enthielten sich. Bürgermeisterin Carola Weidemann zeigte sich erleichtert und sprach von einem „historischen Schritt für die Klimazukunft unserer Stadt", während CDU-Fraktionschef Benedikt Strauß die Maßnahmen als wirtschaftsfeindlich kritisierte.

The Scottish Parliament voted by a margin of 71 to 48 on Thursday to back a motion calling for a second independence referendum by 2027, with the Scottish National Party and the Scottish Greens combining to secure the majority despite fierce opposition from Scottish Labour and the Scottish Conservatives. First Minister Catriona Mhàiri Dunbar, who had staked much of her domestic agenda on the vote, described the result as "a democratic mandate that Westminster can no longer ignore," while Conservative MSP Alasdair Rennie accused the government of prioritising symbolism over economic stability.

Der SC Freiburg hat am Samstagabend im Schwarzwald-Stadion einen überzeugenden 3:1-Sieg gegen den VfL Bochum eingefahren und damit seinen vierten Bundesliga-Heimerfolg in Serie gefeiert. Vor 24.000 Zuschauern war es vor allem Stürmer Marek Hollenbeck, der mit einem Doppelpack in der zweiten Hälfte für klare Verhältnisse sorgte. Für Bochum traf Ersatzstürmer Dragan Vukić lediglich zum zwischenzeitlichen Anschlusstreffer.

The Flemish regional parliament voted narrowly on Thursday to approve a sweeping overhaul of housing subsidies, with the centre-right N-VA coalition pushing the measure through by 72 votes to 61, despite fierce objections from the socialist Vooruit bloc and two formal abstentions from independent members. Deputy Minister-President Lena Claes, who shepherded the bill through three weeks of fractious committee hearings at the Vlaams Parlement in Brussels, called the result "a necessary correction to a system that has failed working families for too long."
