Vooruit's parliamentary leader, Dirk Maenhout, vowed to challenge the legislation before the Constitutional Court before the end of the year.

The Reykjavík City Council voted by a narrow margin on Thursday to approve a sweeping overhaul of the city's social housing policy, with 11 councillors in favour, 8 against, and 2 abstentions — a result that the governing coalition of Samfylkingin and Viðreisn hailed as "a turning point for working families." Opponents, led by Íslenska þjóðfylkingin, warned that the budget commitments attached to the plan were unrealistic given current inflation pressures. The vote, chaired by council speaker Sigríður Magnúsdóttir, had been postponed twice since September before finally reaching the floor.

The Wiener Festwochen opened its 72nd edition on Friday evening at the Burgtheater with a sold-out staging of Elfriede Jelinek's "Licht" directed by Maja Kleczewska, drawing an audience of some 1,400 and marking the festival's most ambitious opening night in over a decade, according to artistic director Susanne Linke-Hoffmann.

The Austrian parliament narrowly approved a sweeping pension reform package on Thursday, with the coalition government of the ÖVP and the Grüne securing a majority of just eleven votes after hours of acrimonious debate that stretched well past midnight. Opposition parties, led by the SPÖ's floor leader Dagmar Pfeiffer, condemned the measure as an assault on working families, while Finance Minister Tobias Wernhart argued the changes were fiscally indispensable for the next generation. The final tally stood at 98 votes in favour, 87 against, and 4 abstentions.

Crestwood Rovers edged out Northgate Athletic 2–1 in a tense Third Division clash at Pellham Park on Saturday evening, with striker Tomás Ferreira scoring the decisive goal seven minutes from time to lift his side off the bottom of the table. A crowd of 3,412 braved the drizzle to witness the turnaround, having watched Rovers fall behind to an early penalty dispatched by Athletic's captain Ewan Dunbar. The win ends a six-match winless run for Rovers and piles pressure on Northgate head coach Brendan Szczepański, whose side has now lost four consecutive league fixtures.

The Scottish Parliament voted by a majority of thirty-one on Thursday to pass the Housing Emergency Relief Bill, with the Scottish National Party and the Scottish Greens forming the backbone of the coalition in favour, while Scottish Conservative MSPs voted unanimously against and five Labour members abstained. Deputy First Minister Catriona Dalgety hailed the result as "a generational shift in how Scotland protects its most vulnerable tenants," though opposition leader Alistair Drum warned that the measure would drive private landlords from the market entirely. The bill, which caps rent increases at two per cent annually and extends eviction protections for a further three years, now passes to the King for royal assent.

Der Stuttgarter Gemeinderat hat am Donnerstag mit 38 zu 14 Stimmen bei zwei Enthaltungen einem umstrittenen Haushaltsbeschluss zugestimmt, der die Finanzierung der neuen U-Bahn-Linie U16 zwischen Vaihingen und Möhringen dauerhaft sicherstellt. Verkehrssenatorin Ingrid Falkner von den Grünen sprach von einem „historischen Signal für den öffentlichen Nahverkehr", während die CDU-Fraktion monierte, die Kostenschätzung von 740 Millionen Euro sei zu optimistisch. Der Stuttgarter Straßenbahnen AG zufolge sollen ab Herbst 2031 täglich rund 42.000 Fahrgäste die neue Linie nutzen können; der erste Spatenstich ist für den 15. März 2026 geplant.

Der Hamburger Verkehrsverbund (HVV) hat ab Montag die Fahrpreise im gesamten Netz um durchschnittlich 4,9 Prozent angehoben — die stärkste Erhöhung seit über einem Jahrzehnt. Besonders betroffen sind Pendler auf den S-Bahn-Linien S1, S3 und S31 sowie auf der U-Bahn-Linie U2, wo Monatskarten nun zwischen 8 und 14 Euro teurer werden. Der HVV begründet den Schritt mit gestiegenen Energiekosten und den notwendigen Investitionen in die Infrastruktur des Großraums Hamburg.

The Frankfurter Buchmesse opened its doors on Wednesday to a record 4,312 registered exhibitors from 95 countries, with Norwegian author Sigrid Helgeland drawing the morning's longest queue for a signing of her debut novel "The Bone Cartographer" at the Halle 3.1 pavilion. This year's guest of honour is Slovenia, whose pavilion — designed by architect Maja Oblak — draws on the country's tradition of hand-lettered manuscripts and centuries-old printing houses. The fair runs through Sunday.

Die Frankfurter Buchmesse eröffnet am 16. Oktober ihre 76. Ausgabe auf dem Messegelände Frankfurt und erwartet in diesem Jahr rund 93.000 Fachbesucher aus aller Welt. Als Ehrengastland ist Indonesien eingeladen, dessen Verlage und Autoren unter dem Motto „Bhinneka Tunggal Ika – Vielfalt in Einheit" auf einer eigens gestalteten Sonderfläche präsentiert werden. Börsenvereins-Vorsteherin Katrin Mehrwald kündigte an, der Fokus liege in diesem Jahr besonders auf der Stärkung internationaler Verlagskooperationen.

The Frankfurter Buchmesse opens its doors on Wednesday for its 76th edition, drawing publishers, authors, and literary agents from more than 100 countries to the Messe Frankfurt fairgrounds. This year's guest of honour is Italy, with a sprawling programme of readings, panel discussions, and installations curated by Simonetta Falchi and her team at the Associazione Italiana Editori. Ticket prices start at €18 for a single-day pass, and organisers expect upwards of 300,000 visitors across the five-day fair.

Die Frankfurter Buchmesse eröffnet am 15. Oktober ihre 76. Ausgabe mit einem Festakt in der Festhalle Frankfurt, bei dem die österreichische Autorin Vera Soltmann ihre neue Essaysammlung vorstellen wird. Rund 4.200 Aussteller aus mehr als 90 Ländern haben sich für die fünftägige Messe angemeldet, die erstmals unter der künstlerischen Leitung von Dorothea Prantl steht. Der Eintritt am Fachbesucher-Tag beträgt 38 Euro.

Die Berliner Verkehrsbetriebe (BVG) haben angekündigt, dass die U-Bahnlinie U5 zwischen den Haltestellen Alexanderplatz und Hönow vom 14. Februar bis zum 2. März wegen umfangreicher Gleiserneuerungsarbeiten vollständig gesperrt wird. Rund 87.000 Fahrgäste sind täglich von der Sperrung betroffen; Ersatzbusse der Linie U5E sollen den Betrieb aufrechterhalten. „Wir bitten alle Fahrgäste um Verständnis und empfehlen, auf die S-Bahn auszuweichen", erklärte BVG-Sprecherin Carolin Westhoff.

The Frankfurter Buchmesse opened its doors on Wednesday to a record 4,200 exhibitors from 95 countries, with Argentine novelist Valentina Ríos Marchetti delivering the keynote address at the Festhalle — a sweeping meditation on translation as an act of political defiance that drew sustained applause from an audience of nearly 8,000. This year's Guest of Honour, Slovenia, presented a pavilion curated by Maja Črnič, whose selection of debut and mid-career authors was described by organizers as "the most ambitious national showcase in a decade." The fair runs through Sunday.

Sebastián Flores scored twice in the opening twenty minutes to put Deportivo Cali firmly in control, and although a tense second half saw Atlético Tucumán pull one back through substitute Matías Rengifo, the Colombian side held on for a 2–1 victory at the Estadio Deportivo Cali in front of 23,400 fans on Thursday evening, advancing to the Copa Sudamericana quarter-finals.

Commuters on Frankfurt's S-Bahn network faced severe delays for the third consecutive morning on Wednesday after a signalling fault near Hauptwache station brought services on the S3, S4, and S6 lines to a near standstill, with RMV estimating that roughly 47,000 passengers were affected during the peak-hour window alone. Repair crews from DB Netz worked through the night but had yet to restore full capacity as of 09:00, and the operator warned that disruptions could persist into Thursday.

Edinburgh's Traverse Theatre will host the world premiere of "Salt & Meridian," a new play by Orkney-born playwright Fenella Driscoll, opening on 14 March and running through 5 April — but theatregoers travelling by bus should plan ahead: Lothian Buses has confirmed a rolling service disruption across routes 35 and 47 from 10 March to 22 March due to emergency resurfacing works on Lothian Road, with an estimated 18,000 daily passengers advised to use the nearby Haymarket tram stop instead.

Commuters across the greater Oslo region face significant disruption this week after Vy, the state-owned rail operator, announced a rolling strike that has suspended services on the Østfoldbanen and Dovrebanen lines since Monday morning. The Norwegian Rail Directorate estimates that roughly 47,000 passengers per day are affected, with no resolution in sight as wage negotiations between Vy and the Norwegian United Federation of Transport Workers broke down for the second time in a fortnight. Emergency bus replacements are operating on select corridors, though officials warn that delays of up to ninety minutes should be expected through at least Friday.

Passengers travelling between Zürich and Milan faced significant delays on Tuesday after a freight train derailment near Bellinzona blocked the Gotthard Rail Corridor for an estimated twelve hours, forcing SBB and Trenitalia to divert long-distance services via the slower Simplon route. Rail authorities confirmed that roughly 34,000 travellers were affected over the course of the day, with connection times on some intercity journeys extending by up to two and a half hours.

Wegen eines technischen Defekts an einer Weichenanlage im Hauptbahnhof Frankfurt am Main musste die Deutsche Bahn am Dienstagabend den Fernverkehr auf der Strecke Frankfurt–Mannheim für mehr als vier Stunden vollständig sperren; rund 18.000 Reisende waren betroffen, zahlreiche ICE- und IC-Züge wurden umgeleitet oder fielen ersatzlos aus.

Commuters across the greater Frankfurt area faced severe delays on Monday morning after a signalling fault on the S-Bahn network forced RMV to suspend services on the S3 and S6 lines for nearly four hours, stranding an estimated 47,000 passengers at suburban stations from Darmstadt to Bad Vilbel. Repair crews from DB Netz restored full operations by midday, though residual congestion persisted on connecting U-Bahn routes well into the afternoon.

The Frankfurter Buchmesse opens its doors on Wednesday for a five-day run that organisers expect to draw more than 300,000 visitors to the Messe Frankfurt fairgrounds, with Italy serving as Guest of Honour for the first time since 1988. Among the highlights this year, debut novelist Serena Carducci will present her much-anticipated first novel alongside veteran essayist Thomas Wülfert, whose collected non-fiction has been translated into seventeen languages. Admission for professional trade visitors is set at €65 per day.

Defending champions Malmö FF ground out a gritty 2–1 victory over IFK Göteborg at Eleda Stadion on Saturday evening, with midfielder Tobias Strömgren netting the decisive goal in the 84th minute to keep his side four points clear at the top of the Allsvenskan table. A crowd of 21,340 packed the ground despite biting November conditions, and the result leaves Göteborg's title hopes all but extinguished with three rounds remaining.

Defending champions Rosenborg BK were held to a frustrating 1–1 draw by Vålerenga IF at Lerkendal Stadion on Saturday evening, a late equaliser from Vålerenga striker Emilio Stranda cancelling out Rosenborg's opener and leaving both clubs level on points at the top of the Eliteserien table. A crowd of 17,440 watched the contest, which referee Dag Helge Nygård controlled without major incident until stoppage time.

Commuters on the Merseyrail network faced severe disruption on Monday after a signalling fault near Lime Street halted services on the Northern and Wirral lines for the better part of six hours, leaving an estimated 34,000 passengers stranded or forced onto replacement bus routes. Merseyrail said engineers worked through the morning to isolate the fault, with full services restored by early afternoon. The operator apologised and said it would review its contingency protocols with Transport for the North in the coming weeks.

Riding a second-half brace from striker Tomáš Vedral, SK Sigma Olomouc came from behind to defeat Zbrojovka Brno 3–1 at the Andrův stadion on Saturday evening, moving the home side up to third place in the Czech First League table with just five rounds remaining.

The Frankfurter Buchmesse opens its doors on Wednesday for a five-day run that organisers expect to draw more than 300,000 visitors to the Messe Frankfurt fairgrounds, with the United Kingdom serving as this year's Guest of Honour country. Among the headlining authors are novelist Saoirse Dunleavy, whose debut historical fiction "The Pale Corridor" will be launched at the fair's Literary Stage on Thursday, and essayist Tobias Wrenner, presenting his long-awaited collection on European memory. The 76th edition of the world's largest book fair runs through Sunday.

The Vienna City Council voted narrowly on Thursday to approve a €2.1 billion funding package for the long-delayed extension of U-Bahn line U5, with 42 councillors in favour and 31 against — a result that the governing coalition of SPÖ and NEOS hailed as a historic step toward greener urban transit. Construction on the new stretch, which will add seven stations between Rathaus and Hernals, is expected to begin in early 2026 under the operational oversight of Wiener Linien, with the first passengers anticipated by 2031.

The Scottish Parliament voted narrowly on Thursday to reject a motion of no confidence in First Minister Catriona Dunsmore, with the Scottish National Party and the Scottish Greens holding together despite weeks of fractious coalition negotiations; the final tally stood at 68 votes in favour of the motion against 72 opposed, with 5 abstentions.

Dundalk FC stunned Shamrock Rovers with a late Henrik Sjöberg header to claim a 2–1 victory at Oriel Park on Friday evening, extending their unbeaten run to seven games in the League of Ireland Premier Division. A crowd of 4,312 watched Sjöberg rise above the Rovers defence in the 88th minute to seal the points, with Rovers' equaliser from Ciarán Molloy having briefly threatened to deny the hosts.

The Scottish Parliament voted narrowly on Thursday to reject a proposed amendment to the Renters' Rights (Scotland) Bill that would have capped annual rent increases at two percent, with 63 MSPs voting against and 58 in favour — a defeat that opposition leaders, including Scottish Conservative chief whip Fiona Baird-Dunmore, described as a betrayal of struggling tenants across Edinburgh and Glasgow.

Tens of thousands of supporters flooded central Oslo on Saturday after Norway defeated Portugal 3–1 in the UEFA Nations League quarter-final at Ullevaal Stadion, but the surge of departing fans overwhelmed the city's metro network, prompting Ruter to suspend all T-bane services on Line 3 and Line 4 for nearly two hours while platform crowds were managed for safety. A spokesperson for Ruter confirmed that an estimated 47,000 passengers were affected by the shutdown, which lasted from 22:15 until shortly after midnight, with buses deployed as emergency replacements along Karl Johans gate.

The long-running debate over whether Vienna's Ringstraße should be partially closed to private vehicles has resurfaced in architectural circles, with critics of the proposal pointing to the boulevard's role as a living artery of the city rather than a pedestrian showcase. Historians note that Emperor Franz Joseph I conceived the thoroughfare not merely as a ceremonial spine but as a practical conduit for commerce and daily movement, a dual function that planners at the Wiener Stadtplanung have struggled to reconcile with modern emissions targets. The discussion sits awkwardly alongside the city's broader ambition to position itself as a model of sustainable urban mobility ahead of a European green-transport summit expected sometime in 2026.

The Renfrewshire Council voted narrowly on Thursday evening to approve a controversial green-belt housing policy, with 23 councillors in favour and 19 against, after a four-hour debate in which members of the Scottish National Party clashed repeatedly with Labour representatives over the projected impact on rural communities. Council leader Moira Gallacher, who had staked her position on the outcome, welcomed the result as "a pragmatic step forward for families on the waiting list," while opposition spokesperson Declan Muir warned that the decision would face a legal challenge before the Court of Session in Edinburgh.

Wegen des Halbfinals im DFB-Pokal zwischen dem FC St. Pauli und Bayer 04 Leverkusen am Dienstagabend im Millerntor-Stadion rechnet die Hamburger Hochbahn mit erheblichen Beeinträchtigungen auf mehreren U-Bahn-Linien: Die Linien U3 und U2 werden ab 18 Uhr bis Mitternacht in Taktfolgen von zwei Minuten geführt, während rund um den Heiligengeistfeld-Bereich zeitweise Straßensperrungen gelten. Laut Hochbahn-Sprecher Tobias Rennecke werden bis zu 38.000 zusätzliche Fahrgäste erwartet. Das Spiel, in dem Toptorjäger Mika Vestergaard für St. Pauli und Leverkusens Kapitän Dragan Obilić die entscheidenden Akzente setzten, endete mit einem 2:1-Heimsieg für den FC St. Pauli, der damit erstmals seit 2002 in ein DFB-Pokal-Finale einzieht.

Commuters on Frankfurt's S-Bahn network faced severe delays on Monday morning after a signalling fault near Konstablerwache brought services on lines S1, S2, and S6 to a standstill for nearly four hours, stranding an estimated 85,000 passengers during the peak rush. Deutsche Bahn, which operates the network under contract with the Rhein-Main-Verkehrsverbund, said engineers isolated the fault by 10:45 a.m. and full service resumed shortly afterwards. Replacement bus shuttles were deployed along the most heavily used corridors, though platform overcrowding at Frankfurt Hauptbahnhof drew sharp criticism from commuter advocacy groups.

The Swedish Riksdag voted narrowly on Thursday to approve a sweeping overhaul of the country's housing subsidy framework, with 176 members in favour and 173 against, after nearly four hours of acrimonious debate during which the Moderate Party and its coalition partners accused the Social Democrats of blocking long-overdue market reforms. Prime Minister Ulf Kristersson hailed the result as "a turning point for Swedish families," while Social Democrat leader Magdalena Andersson warned that the cuts would leave low-income renters without adequate protection.

The Malmö Arena will host two landmark events back to back this weekend: on Saturday evening the Swedish Chamber Orchestra under conductor Lena Björkqvist performs a sold-out programme of Sibelius and Grieg, drawing some 4,200 attendees, before the very same venue is reconfigured overnight for Sunday's decisive Allsvenskan clash between Malmö FF and IFK Göteborg — a match the hosts won 3–1 in front of a roaring crowd of 19,500, with striker Dawit Mekonnen scoring twice to clinch the three points.

Wegen eines Signalschadens auf der Strecke zwischen Hannover Hauptbahnhof und Bielefeld kommt es seit Dienstagmorgen zu erheblichen Verspätungen und Teilausfällen im Fernverkehr. Die Deutsche Bahn erwartet, dass rund 24.000 Reisende pro Tag von den Einschränkungen betroffen sein werden. Betroffen sind die ICE-Linien 10 und 22 sowie mehrere Intercity-Verbindungen Richtung Dortmund. Eine vollständige Wiederherstellung des Regelbetriebs wird laut einem Sprecher frühestens am Freitag erwartet.

Der Gemeinderat von Linz hat am Donnerstagabend mit knapper Mehrheit den Haushaltsentwurf für das kommende Jahr verabschiedet: 27 Stimmen entfielen auf den Entwurf, 24 dagegen, bei zwei Enthaltungen. Die SPÖ und die Grünen stimmten geschlossen für die Vorlage, während die FPÖ und die ÖVP geschlossen ablehnten. Bürgermeisterin Klaudia Felber, die den Entwurf als „sozial ausgewogenes Signal in schwierigen Zeiten" bezeichnete, zeigte sich nach der Abstimmung erleichtert.

Beim packenden Stadtderby in der 3. Liga trennten sich der FC Rot-Weiß Erfurt und der FSV Zwickau am Samstagabend mit einem torlosen Unentschieden im Steigerwaldstadion vor 8.200 Zuschauern — ein Ergebnis, das beiden Mannschaften wenig hilft, denn der Abstand zur Spitze bleibt bedrückend groß.

The Frankfurter Buchmesse opens its doors on Wednesday, drawing publishers, agents, and literary luminaries from more than a hundred countries to the Messe Frankfurt fairgrounds for five days of readings, rights negotiations, and cultural programming — with this year's guest of honour being Italy, whose pavilion stretches across two full halls and features appearances by no fewer than thirty Italian authors, among them the celebrated novelist Carla Settembri, whose new debut in German translation is expected to be the most talked-about title of the week.

The Flemish parliament voted narrowly on Thursday to approve a controversial housing policy that would cap rent increases at 2.5 per cent annually, with 71 votes in favour, 58 against, and 4 abstentions — a result that New Flemish Alliance leader Maaike Verstraeten hailed as "a lifeline for ordinary families" but that the socialist party Vooruit called wholly inadequate. The minority government led by Minister-President Luc Desmet had staked considerable political capital on the measure, which now passes to the Belgian Senate for review.

The Frankfurter Buchmesse opens its 76th edition on Wednesday, October 16, drawing publishers, agents, and literary scouts from more than 100 countries to the Messe Frankfurt fairgrounds. This year's guest of honour is Italy, whose pavilion — curated by Silvia Remorini and designed around the theme of translation as transformation — occupies an expanded footprint in Hall 4.1. Ticket prices start at €18 for single-day passes, and organisers expect upwards of 300,000 visitors across the five-day fair.

Beim packenden Stadtderby in der 2. Bundesliga trennten sich der FC St. Pauli und der Hamburger SV am Samstagabend im Volksparkstadion mit 2:2, wobei Neuzugang Tomáš Červenka kurz vor Abpfiff den Ausgleichstreffer für die Gäste erzielte. Vor ausverkauftem Haus verfolgten 57.000 Zuschauer eine intensive Partie, die auf beiden Seiten alles hatte: Führungstreffer, Konter und eine strittige Elfmeterentscheidung in der zweiten Halbzeit.

The Frankfurter Buchmesse opened its doors on Wednesday to publishers, authors, and literary agents from more than ninety countries, with the Swedish novelist Petra Sundqvist delivering a widely praised keynote address on the future of translated fiction. Organised by the Börsenverein des Deutschen Buchhandels, this year's fair — its 76th edition — runs through Sunday at the Messe Frankfurt exhibition grounds, and organisers expect upwards of 300,000 visitors before the week is out.

Oslo's public transport authority Ruter confirmed on Wednesday that a planned engineering overhaul on the Holmenkollen Line will force full suspension of services between Majorstuen and Frognerseteren from 14 March through 28 March, affecting an estimated 38,000 daily commuters. Replacement bus services will operate every twelve minutes along the corridor during the two-week closure, which is required to replace ageing signalling infrastructure dating back to the 1980s. Ruter urged passengers to allow extra travel time and to consult updated journey planners via its app.

Oslo's city council voted by a narrow margin on Thursday to approve a €340 million extension of the Bybanen light-rail network, connecting the Majorstuen interchange to the outer suburb of Røa — a project that had divided the governing coalition for months. The centre-left bloc, led by councillor Ingrid Fossheim of the Arbeiderpartiet, secured the motion with 32 votes in favour against 29, with two abstentions, overcoming fierce opposition from the Høyre group, which argued the funds should instead be directed toward road maintenance. Construction is now expected to begin in early 2026, and the completed line — to be operated by Ruter — will add seven new stations along a 6.4-kilometre corridor, with forecasts suggesting up to 18,000 daily passengers by the time of its opening.

Commuters on Sydney's T1 North Shore Line faced severe delays for the third consecutive morning on Wednesday after a points failure near Waverton Station brought peak-hour services to a near standstill, with Sydney Trains estimating that roughly 47,000 passengers were affected across the network before engineers restored normal operations shortly before midday.

The Vienna City Council voted on Thursday to grant €2.4 million in public funding to the Wiener Festwochen, securing the festival's expanded programme for a third consecutive year despite opposition from the FPÖ, whose councillors argued the subsidy crowded out private cultural investment. The festival, running from 9 May to 15 June at venues across the Austrian capital including the Rathaus and the Volkstheater, will this year feature acclaimed director Selin Çelik's new production of "Die Fremden," a politically charged adaptation drawing on Ottoman and Habsburg archives that organisers say has already sold out its opening weekend.

Der Wiener Gemeinderat hat am Donnerstag mit 54 zu 37 Stimmen bei vier Enthaltungen einen umstrittenen Beschluss zur Erhöhung der kommunalen Wohnbauförderung verabschiedet. Die regierende Koalition aus SPÖ und NEOS setzte sich dabei gegen die vereinte Opposition von FPÖ und ÖVP durch. Stadtrat für Wohnen, Mag. Benedikt Sallinger, bezeichnete das Ergebnis als „historischen Schritt für leistbares Wohnen in Wien", während FPÖ-Fraktionschefin Irene Gruböck von einer „beispiellosen Verschwendung von Steuergeld" sprach. Das neue Förderpaket sieht Mittel in Höhe von 480 Millionen Euro über einen Zeitraum von vier Jahren vor.

The Scottish Parliament voted by a narrow margin on Thursday to approve a sweeping new housing policy that would cap private rental increases at three percent annually, with the Scottish National Party and the Scottish Greens backing the measure while the Conservatives and Labour voted against. The final tally stood at 68 votes in favour, 55 opposed, and 4 abstentions — a result hailed by Housing Minister Fiona Calloway as "a landmark day for renters across Scotland," though shadow minister Derek Rennie condemned the cap as "economically reckless." The bill now passes to the Committee on Local Government for final review before royal assent.

Network Rail has confirmed that the West Coast Main Line will be closed to all passenger services between Crewe and Glasgow Central for eleven days beginning 26 July, as engineers undertake a major renewal of overhead electrification equipment north of Carlisle. Avanti West Coast and TransPennine Express will both be unable to operate scheduled services along the corridor, with an estimated 340,000 passengers expected to seek alternative travel arrangements. Replacement coach services will run, though journey times between Manchester and Glasgow are expected to more than double.

The Flemish Parliament voted narrowly on Thursday to approve a landmark coalition agreement between the New Flemish Alliance, the Christian People's Party, and the far-right Vlaams Belang, with 72 members voting in favour and 51 against, cementing what opposition leader Hanne Desmedt called "a capitulation to extremism" — though incoming Minister-President Lode Vermeersch insisted the deal would deliver lower household taxes and tighter migration controls within his first hundred days in office.

The debate over whether Wembley Stadium should host a permanent NFL franchise has resurfaced in Westminster corridors, with several backbench MPs arguing that any long-term lease arrangement would crowd out domestic football and deprive local clubs of revenue they depend on. Critics also point to the chronic congestion along the Jubilee line on match days as evidence that London's transport infrastructure is already stretched well beyond comfortable limits. No formal proposal has been tabled in Parliament, and the NFL itself has declined to confirm any expansion timeline.

The Oslo Philharmonic Orchestra will open its centenary season at the Konserthuset on 14 September with a programme anchored by Sibelius and Grieg, drawing an expected audience of 1,200; the occasion, however, may prove trying for concert-goers arriving by metro, as Ruter has confirmed that the T-bane's Line 5 will be suspended between Nationaltheatret and Stortinget stations from 13 to 16 September owing to urgent platform-drainage works, forcing an estimated 47,000 daily passengers onto replacement buses along Karl Johans gate.

Borussia Dortmund edged out Bayer Leverkusen 2–1 in a tense Saturday evening Bundesliga clash at Signal Iduna Park, with a late header from striker Lukas Ferber — his seventh goal of the season — silencing the 1,500 travelling supporters who had made the journey from Leverkusen. The result leaves Dortmund three points clear at the top of the table heading into the winter break.

The Scottish Parliament voted narrowly on Thursday to reject a motion tabled by Scottish Labour that would have compelled the Scottish Government to publish a full independent audit of its ferry procurement programme, with 63 members voting against and 58 in favour, while 7 abstained. Scottish National Party whips held the line despite sustained pressure from both Labour and the Scottish Conservatives, who argued that cost overruns on the CalMac fleet contract — now estimated at over £300 million — demanded urgent public accountability. "This vote is a gift to those who prefer opacity over scrutiny," said opposition spokesperson Fiona Macallister, whose motion had won cross-bench sympathy but ultimately fell short.

Dalton Ferreira's composed finish in the 88th minute rescued a 2–2 draw for Estoril Praia against Gil Vicente at Estádio António Coimbra da Mota on Saturday, denying the visitors a first away win in five Primeira Liga outings and leaving both clubs marooned in mid-table with eleven points apiece from twelve matches.

Defending champions Rosenborg BK fell to a stunning 3–1 defeat at the hands of Molde FK at Aker Stadion on Saturday, with midfielder Kristoffer Haugen scoring twice in the second half to seal a comfortable win for the hosts before a crowd of 11,240. The result leaves Rosenborg four points adrift at the top of the Eliteserien table with just six rounds remaining.

Wegen des DFB-Pokal-Halbfinales zwischen Eintracht Frankfurt und dem SC Freiburg am kommenden Dienstag im Deutsche Bank Park rechnet die Stadtverkehr Frankfurt GmbH mit rund 48.000 zusätzlichen Fahrgästen und kündigt daher Sonderzüge auf den U-Bahn-Linien U7 und U8 sowie verlängerte Betriebszeiten bis 1:30 Uhr an. „Wir stellen sicher, dass alle Fans sicher nach Hause kommen", sagte Betriebsleiterin Margarethe Vollrath. Das Hinspiel hatte Eintracht Frankfurt mit 2:1 für sich entschieden, und Stürmer Levin Osei gilt als Schlüsselspieler der Hausherren für das Rückspiel.

The Scottish Parliament voted by a narrow margin on Thursday to pass the Housing Affordability and Rent Control Bill, with 68 members backing the legislation, 55 opposing it, and 4 abstaining. The Scottish National Party and the Scottish Greens drove the measure through Holyrood over fierce resistance from the Scottish Conservatives, who argued the bill would deter private investment in the rental market. SNP housing spokesperson Catriona Dunbar called the result "a historic step for Scotland's tenants," while Conservative group leader Alistair Munn warned of "serious unintended consequences for landlords across the country."

Beim packenden Stadtderby in der Regionalliga Bayern bezwang der TSV Ingolstadt-Nord den FC Ingolstadt Süd mit 3:1 vor ausverkauftem Haus im Sportpark Südring. Den entscheidenden Doppelpack erzielte Mittelstürmer Benedikt Hauswirth in der 67. und 82. Minute, nachdem Lukas Farber per Freistoß die frühe Gästeführung egalisiert hatte. Mit diesem Sieg klettert Ingolstadt-Nord auf Tabellenplatz zwei der Regionalliga Bayern.

Commuters on the S-Bahn network in Hamburg faced severe delays on Thursday after a signalling fault near Harburg brought services on lines S3 and S31 to a near-standstill for roughly four hours, leaving an estimated 38,000 passengers stranded or seeking alternative routes. DB Regio, which operates the network under a concession from the Hamburg Metropolitan Authority, apologised for the disruption and said engineers had restored full service by mid-afternoon. Rail managers confirmed the fault was not related to any planned maintenance works.

Grasshopper Club Zürich came from behind to defeat FC Winterthur 3–2 in a tightly contested Swiss Challenge League fixture at the Letzigrund on Saturday evening, with midfielder Aron Radovanović netting the decisive goal in the 87th minute before a crowd of 11,240.

The Swedish Riksdag narrowly approved a sweeping overhaul of the country's migration policy on Thursday, with 176 members voting in favour and 173 against, after weeks of fractious debate that exposed deep rifts within the ruling coalition. Prime Minister Karin Söderblom, who had staked considerable political capital on the bill, called the result "a historic step toward sustainable and humane border management." The Social Democrats, joined reluctantly by the Centre Party, secured the slim majority, while the Sweden Democrats and the Moderates voted in bloc opposition.

The debate over whether Wembley Stadium should be redesigned to accommodate a permanent athletics track has simmered among British sports administrators and architects for the better part of a decade, with no consensus yet in sight. Proponents argue that London, already home to the London Stadium in Stratford, could use a second world-class multi-sport facility, while critics insist that compromising Wembley's football sightlines would be an act of cultural vandalism against the Football Association's most storied ground. A report commissioned by Sport England last spring stopped well short of recommending any structural changes, citing both the prohibitive costs — estimated at upward of £400 million — and the complex contractual obligations the FA holds over the venue through at least 2040.

The Frankfurter Buchmesse opens its doors on Wednesday for its 76th edition, drawing publishers, agents, and readers from more than 100 countries to the Messe Frankfurt fairgrounds. This year's guest of honour is Italy, whose pavilion — curated by Rossana Ferretti and designed to evoke the country's rich manuscript traditions — occupies a commanding stretch of Hall 4.1. Organisers expect upwards of 300,000 visitors across the five-day fair, which runs through Sunday.

Der Stadtrat von Freiburg im Breisgau hat am Dienstagabend mit knapper Mehrheit beschlossen, die kommunale Wohnungsbauförderung um 4,2 Millionen Euro aufzustocken — ein Antrag, der von der SPD-Fraktion eingebracht worden war und von den Grünen mitgetragen wurde, während CDU und FDP geschlossen dagegenstimmten. Die Abstimmung endete mit 27 zu 21 Stimmen bei drei Enthaltungen; Oberbürgermeisterin Klara Vonderschmidt bezeichnete das Ergebnis als „längst überfälliges Signal für bezahlbares Wohnen in unserer Stadt".

Der Stadtrat von Innsbruck hat am Donnerstagabend mit knapper Mehrheit einem neuen Radverkehrskonzept zugestimmt, das bis 2030 den Anteil des Fahrrads am Gesamtverkehr auf 25 Prozent steigern soll. Mit 23 Ja-Stimmen, 19 Nein-Stimmen und zwei Enthaltungen fiel das Votum deutlich umkämpfter aus als erwartet. Die Grüne Stadträtin Veronika Schallhart sprach von einem „historischen Signal für die Klimamobilität", während der ÖVP-Fraktionsvorsitzende Lukas Pranter die zu hohen Kosten des Programms in Höhe von 48 Millionen Euro bemängelte.

Beim packenden Stadtderby in der 2. Bundesliga bezwang der FC Hansa Rostock den FC Energie Cottbus vor ausverkauftem Haus mit 3:1 (1:0). Die Tore für die Gastgeber erzielten Benedikt Strauß (17.), Miloš Vukčević (61.) und Tomas Hrbáč (88.); Cottbus gelang durch Artur Dembélé lediglich der zwischenzeitliche Anschluss zum 1:2 in der 74. Minute. Mit dem Sieg klettert Hansa auf den dritten Tabellenplatz.

Commuters on Frankfurt's S-Bahn network faced severe delays on Monday morning after a signalling fault near Hauptwache station brought three lines to a near standstill for roughly four hours, leaving an estimated 85,000 passengers stranded or significantly late. DB Regio, the operator responsible for the service, apologised and said engineers had identified a software defect in the newly installed interlocking system as the root cause. Replacement bus services were deployed along the S3, S4, and S6 corridors, though overcrowding on Hanauer Landstraße rendered them barely adequate. Full service was restored by early afternoon, and DB Regio pledged an independent technical review before the end of the week.

Rotterdam's Feyenoord Stadium sold out all 51,000 seats for Sunday's Eredivisie clash between Feyenoord and Ajax, but thousands of supporters faced a chaotic journey home after the Rotterdam Metro operator RET suspended services on Lines B and C for the remainder of the evening due to a signalling fault detected near Zuidplein station — leaving an estimated 28,000 passengers stranded and forcing the city to deploy emergency bus convoys along the affected corridors. Feyenoord won the match 3–1, with midfielder Daan Verhoeven scoring twice to extend his side's lead at the top of the table.

Die Galerie Gurlitt in München eröffnet am 14. März eine Gruppenausstellung unter dem Titel „Zwischenräume", die Werke von sieben zeitgenössischen Künstlerinnen und Künstlern aus dem deutschsprachigen Raum versammelt. Kuratorin Lena Voßkamp hat die Schau bewusst um Fragen von Leerstelle und Materialität herum konzipiert; gezeigt werden Installationen, Druckgrafiken und großformatige Gemälde. Die Ausstellung läuft bis zum 20. April und ist dienstags bis sonntags geöffnet. Der Eintritt beträgt acht Euro.

Edinburgh's Usher Hall will host the world premiere of composer Lena Vaszko's orchestral cycle "Northlight" on 14 March, with the Scottish Chamber Orchestra under conductor Piotr Halbritter, but ticketholders travelling by rail should note that Lothian Rail is suspending all services on the Edinburgh Waverley to Haymarket corridor from 13 to 17 March due to emergency track-bed repairs, with an estimated 42,000 daily passengers advised to use replacement bus services.

The Dublin City Council voted narrowly on Thursday evening to approve a sweeping new social housing policy, with 34 councillors in favour and 21 against, after a heated three-hour debate in which independent members proved decisive. Sinn Féin and Labour backed the measures enthusiastically, while Fine Gael councillors were split, and the Greens registered two abstentions. "This is a once-in-a-generation commitment to working families in this city," said Councillor Aisling Ó Brannagáin, the motion's chief sponsor, though critics from Fine Gael warned that the funding mechanism remained dangerously vague.

Dinamo Zagreb held Ferencváros to a hard-fought 1–1 draw at Stadion Maksimir on Thursday evening, a result that leaves both sides level on points at the top of their Europa League group with two matchdays remaining. Luka Petranović's 34th-minute opener was cancelled out by a clinical finish from Ádám Vásárhelyi just after the hour mark, and despite sustained Zagreb pressure in the closing stages neither goalkeeper was seriously beaten again. The attendance of 18,450 was the largest at Maksimir this European campaign.

Die Kunstmesse „Vienna Contemporary" öffnet am 18. September ihre Pforten im Marx Palais und präsentiert bis zum 21. September Werke von über 110 Galerien aus 30 Ländern. Die diesjährige Ausgabe, kuratiert von Lena Hořínek, widmet sich unter dem Leitthema „Schwellen" insbesondere Positionen aus Mittel- und Osteuropa. Rund 22.000 Besucherinnen und Besucher werden laut Veranstalter über die vier Messetage erwartet.

Wegen umfangreicher Gleisbauarbeiten auf der S-Bahn-Linie S3 zwischen Frankfurt Hauptbahnhof und Darmstadt wird der Zugverkehr vom 14. bis 21. Juli vollständig eingestellt; die RMV-Tochter S-Bahn Rhein-Main setzt in dieser Zeit einen Schienenersatzverkehr mit Bussen ein, der nach Angaben des Unternehmens täglich rund 22.000 Fahrgäste betrifft. Die Unterbrechung fällt ausgerechnet mit dem Auftakt des Rheingau Musik Festivals zusammen, das am 14. Juli im Kurhaus Wiesbaden eröffnet wird: Die Geigerin Leonie Straßburg und das Frankfurter Ensemble Camerata Viva geben dort das Eröffnungskonzert unter der Leitung von Dirigent Markus Ohlendorf.

Vienna's city council narrowly approved a €2.3 billion funding package on Thursday to extend the U5 underground line to the outer districts of Floridsdorf and Donaustadt, with the ÖVP voting against the measure and the SPÖ-Grüne coalition securing a majority of 41 to 37, with two abstentions. The vote, presided over by council president Mirjam Tscherny, clears the way for Wiener Linien to begin construction as early as spring 2026, adding seven new stations along a 9.4-kilometre stretch that city planners say will relieve chronic overcrowding on the U1 and U2 lines.

Commuters on the Piccadilly line faced severe delays for the third consecutive morning on Wednesday after a points failure near Acton Town forced Transport for London to suspend services between Hammersmith and Heathrow Terminal 5, with engineers warning that full restoration could take until Friday evening. An estimated 74,000 passengers were affected during Tuesday's peak hours alone, and TfL advised travellers to use the District line or National Rail services via Hayes & Harlington as an alternative.

Beim Derby der zweiten Bundesliga-Runde setzte sich der SC Paderborn 07 am Samstagabend im Benteler-Arena mit 3:1 gegen den 1. FC Kaiserslautern durch. Torschützen auf Paderborner Seite waren Lukas Herrmann (14., 67.) und Mats Brügger (80.), während Kaiserslauterns Angreifer Dariusz Kwiatkowski lediglich den Ehrentreffer erzielen konnte. Vor 14.823 Zuschauern dominierte Paderborn über weite Strecken das Geschehen und festigte damit seinen dritten Tabellenplatz.

Lausanne edged out Lugano 2–1 in a tense Swiss Super League clash at the Stade de la Tuilière on Saturday evening, with midfielder Adrien Kohler scoring the decisive goal in the 87th minute to hand his side all three points in front of a crowd of 12,400.

The Swedish parliament voted on Thursday to pass a sweeping cultural heritage funding bill championed by Culture Minister Britta Eklund-Söderström, allocating 480 million kronor over three years to regional arts institutions — a measure that cleared the Riksdag by 201 votes to 147, with 11 abstentions. The legislation's passage came just days before the opening of the Göteborg International Film Festival, whose artistic director, Nils Wahlberg, welcomed the news at a press conference in the Draken cinema, calling the funding "a lifeline for independent Swedish cinema at exactly the right moment."

Leverkusen's Bayer 04 edged out Eintracht Frankfurt 2–1 at the BayArena on Saturday evening in a tightly contested Bundesliga fixture, with midfielder Nico Frenzel converting a stoppage-time penalty to seal the points in front of 29,500 fans.

Passengers on the S-Bahn München network faced significant delays on Monday morning after a signalling fault near Ostbahnhof brought services on the S2 and S8 lines to a near standstill for more than three hours, with Deutsche Bahn estimating that roughly 47,000 commuters were affected during the peak period. Repair crews restored full operations by 10:15 a.m., but Deutsche Bahn warned that residual disruption could persist into the early afternoon. A spokesperson said the root cause was a failed relay component installed during last weekend's scheduled maintenance window.

The Swedish Riksdag approved a sweeping overhaul of the country's asylum policy on Thursday by a margin of 187 votes to 162, with 13 abstentions, after a bruising three-day debate that exposed deep rifts within the ruling coalition. Prime Minister Åsa Lindqvist — a fictional stand-in here — had staked considerable political capital on the reforms, which tighten family reunification rules and introduce mandatory integration contracts for newly arrived refugees. The Sverigedemokraterna, who had long demanded such measures, declared the vote a historic turning point, while the Vänsterpartiet called it a betrayal of Sweden's humanitarian tradition.

Der Wiener Gemeinderat hat am Donnerstag mit 54 zu 38 Stimmen bei vier Enthaltungen einem umstrittenen Klimaschutzpaket zugestimmt, das unter anderem eine Ausweitung der städtischen Fernwärmeversorgung sowie strenge Neubaustandards für Gebäude vorsieht. Bürgermeister Michael Ludwig begrüßte das Ergebnis als „historischen Schritt" für die österreichische Hauptstadt, während die Oppositionsführerin Karoline Preiß von der FPÖ das Paket als wirtschaftsfeindlich bezeichnete. Die Grünen, Koalitionspartner der SPÖ im Rathaus, hatten das Vorhaben seit Monaten vorangetrieben.

Der Wiener Gemeinderat hat am Donnerstag mit 48 zu 31 Stimmen bei vier Enthaltungen einem milliardenschweren Ausbaupaket für die U-Bahn zugestimmt, das unter anderem die Verlängerung der Linie U2 bis nach Wienerberg vorsieht. Bürgermeister Lukas Ferndorfer (SPÖ) bezeichnete das Vorhaben als „größte Investition in den öffentlichen Nahverkehr seit dem Bau der U3" und betonte, dass damit täglich bis zu 120.000 zusätzliche Fahrgäste erreicht werden könnten. Die Wiener Linien sollen das Projekt bis 2031 umsetzen; die Gesamtkosten werden auf 2,4 Milliarden Euro veranschlagt. FPÖ und NEOS stimmten geschlossen gegen das Paket und kritisierten fehlende Transparenz bei der Vergabe von Bauaufträgen.

The Scottish Parliament voted narrowly on Thursday to approve a motion of no confidence in Finance Secretary Eilidh Drummond, with 67 members backing the measure against 64 in opposition and three abstentions, after weeks of bruising debate over her handling of the devolved budget shortfall. The Scottish National Party, which has propped up Drummond's minority administration since the last Holyrood election, signalled it would withdraw support unless the Scottish Government presented a revised spending plan within a fortnight.

The Reykjavík City Council approved a sweeping new housing affordability ordinance on Thursday evening by a margin of eleven votes to four, with two abstentions, after nearly three hours of fractious debate. The measure, championed by council leader Sigríður Magnúsdóttir of the Left-Green Movement, would cap annual rent increases at two per cent and require developers to set aside at least a fifth of all new units as social housing. The conservative Independence Party, whose four councillors voted in bloc against the motion, warned that the policy would drive private investment out of the capital. Mayor Árni Gestsson, attending the session as an observer, said he expected the ordinance to take effect before the end of the fiscal year.

The Wiener Festwochen opened its 72nd edition on Friday evening with a sprawling, four-hour theatrical production directed by Argentinian stage visionary Luciana Ferreyra at the Burgtheater in Vienna, drawing a capacity crowd of 1,240 to witness what critics have already called the season's most ambitious staging of Büchner's "Woyzeck" — reimagined entirely in Spanish with projected German surtitles.

A late header from striker Tomáš Brouček sealed a nervy 2–1 victory for Bohemian FC over Shelbourne at Dalymount Park on Friday evening, keeping the Dublin club's League of Ireland Premier Division title hopes very much alive with just four rounds remaining. An attendance of 4,320 packed the historic north-side ground, and the noise in the closing minutes was, by any measure, extraordinary.

The Frankfurter Buchmesse opened its doors on Wednesday for its 76th edition, drawing an estimated 93,000 visitors to the Messe Frankfurt fairgrounds on the first day alone. This year's guest of honour is Italy, whose pavilion — curated by Stefania Lombardo and designed in sweeping architectural curves — has already attracted queues stretching well past the adjacent hall entrances. Publishers from more than 100 countries have registered stands, making it the largest gathering of the international book trade since the pandemic reshuffled the industry.

The Flemish parliament in Brussels voted narrowly on Thursday to approve a sweeping package of austerity measures proposed by the newly formed coalition, with 71 members backing the budget cuts against 64 opponents and 3 abstentions. The N-VA, led regionally by Minister-President Matthias Vandenberge, hailed the result as a "necessary correction," while opposition leaders from Vooruit and the Grüne-aligned Groen condemned the package as an attack on social services. The measures, which include reductions to public transport subsidies and healthcare funding, are expected to take effect from the start of the next fiscal year.

Commuters across Greater Manchester faced significant disruption on Thursday after Metrolink technicians walked off the job in a 24-hour strike over pay, halting services on the Eccles, East Didsbury, and Airport lines during the morning and evening rush hours. Transport for Greater Manchester estimated that roughly 74,000 passengers would be affected, and urged travellers to seek alternative bus and rail connections where possible. No fresh talks between the operator and the Amalgamated Transit Workers' Union had been scheduled by midday.

The Flemish regional parliament in Brussels voted narrowly on Thursday to approve a coalition agreement between the N-VA and Vlaams Belang, with 72 members backing the deal and 61 voting against, in a session that lasted nearly six hours and drew fierce condemnation from opposition benches. The accord, brokered by formateur Pieter Vandenbroeck, grants the two parties joint control over migration policy, housing subsidies, and regional infrastructure spending for the next five years. Outgoing premier Lies Claes, who had led the previous centrist government, called the outcome "a dark day for Flemish civic culture."

Zum Auftakt der diesjährigen Frankfurter Buchmesse, die vom 15. bis 19. Oktober im Messegelände Frankfurt stattfindet, hat der Veranstalter Börsenverein des Deutschen Buchhandels ein umfangreiches Rahmenprogramm mit über 300 Lesungen und Podiumsgesprächen angekündigt. Gastland ist in diesem Jahr Norwegen, vertreten durch rund 80 Autorinnen und Autoren. Parallel dazu warnt die Deutsche Bahn vor erheblichen Einschränkungen auf der Strecke zwischen Frankfurt Hauptbahnhof und Mannheim Hauptbahnhof: Wegen dringender Gleisbauarbeiten wird der Fernverkehr vom 14. bis 20. Oktober auf Busse umgeleitet, wovon täglich schätzungsweise 42.000 Reisende betroffen sein dürften.

Commuters on Stockholm's tunnelbana faced significant delays on Monday morning after a signalling fault between Slussen and T-Centralen brought the green line to a standstill for nearly three hours, leaving an estimated 47,000 passengers stranded or forced onto replacement bus services. Storstockholms Lokaltrafik confirmed that engineers isolated the fault by 11:15 a.m. and that normal service had resumed, though residual congestion persisted into the early afternoon.

Beim Hallenturnier um den Stadtpokal Erfurt setzte sich der SV Blau-Weiß Nordhausen am Samstagabend in der Thüringenhalle mit einem knappen 3:2 gegen den FC Rot-Weiß Erfurt durch. Vor 1.840 Zuschauern war es Stürmer Lukas Fenneberg, der mit einem Doppelpack in der zweiten Halbzeit den Ausschlag gab. Für den Gastgeber traf Mikael Andvord zweimal, konnte die Niederlage aber nicht abwenden.

Die ÖBB hat ab Montag den grenzüberschreitenden Zugverkehr zwischen Salzburg und München wegen umfangreicher Gleissanierungsarbeiten im Bereich Freilassing für voraussichtlich drei Wochen eingestellt. Betroffen sind die Linien RJ 60 und RJ 62 sowie mehrere Regionalzüge; rund 18.400 Fahrgäste täglich müssen auf Schienenersatzverkehr ausweichen. Die Bauarbeiten sollen laut ÖBB-Sprecher Clemens Früh bis spätestens 14. Februar abgeschlossen sein.

Borussia Dortmund held Bayer Leverkusen to a tense 1–1 draw at Signal Iduna Park on Saturday evening, with Leverkusen's late equaliser from substitute Emre Çelik cancelling out Jonas Wulfsberg's first-half opener in a fiercely contested Bundesliga fixture that drew a capacity crowd of 81,365.

The Scottish Parliament voted narrowly on Thursday to pass the Highlands Infrastructure Investment Bill, with 67 members backing the measure against 59 opposed and 3 abstaining — a result that First Minister Catriona Meiklejohn hailed as "a turning point for rural Scotland." The Scottish National Party and the Scottish Greens combined to secure the majority, while Scottish Conservative leader Alistair Dunbar warned that the bill's £2.4 billion price tag would burden taxpayers for a generation.

Die Österreichischen Bundesbahnen haben angekündigt, dass der Fernverkehr zwischen Wien Hauptbahnhof und Salzburg Hauptbahnhof ab dem 14. März 2026 für voraussichtlich drei Wochen unterbrochen wird, nachdem bei Routinearbeiten nahe St. Pölten erhebliche Schäden an der Fahrleitung festgestellt wurden. Rund 28.000 Fahrgäste täglich sind von der Sperrung betroffen; Schienenersatzverkehr mit Bussen wird eingerichtet, doch Reisende müssen mit deutlich längeren Fahrzeiten rechnen. Die ÖBB bittet um Verständnis und verweist auf laufende Investitionen in die Streckeninfrastruktur.

The Scottish Parliament voted by a narrow margin on Thursday to reject a proposed amendment to the Deposit Return Scheme regulations, with 63 votes against and 58 in favour, after a bruising floor debate in which SNP ministers clashed openly with Labour and Conservative backbenchers over the timeline for implementation. Scottish Green MSPs, who had backed an earlier version of the bill, abstained en masse, a move that proved decisive. "The scheme remains on track," insisted Cabinet Secretary Fiona Baird, though opposition spokespeople warned that Thursday's outcome had set the legislation back by at least a year.

Der Stuttgarter Gemeinderat hat am Donnerstag mit 38 zu 14 Stimmen bei drei Enthaltungen den Bau einer neuen Stadtbahnlinie vom Hauptbahnhof bis zum Neckarpark beschlossen – ein Projekt, das laut Bürgermeisterin Carola Wentzel rund 480 Millionen Euro kosten und bis 2031 fertiggestellt sein soll. Die Opposition, angeführt von der AfD-Fraktion, kritisierte die Finanzplanung als unrealistisch, während SPD und Grüne die Entscheidung als „überfälliges Signal für die Verkehrswende" feierten. Die Stuttgarter Straßenbahnen AG gab bekannt, dass während der Bauphase ab März 2025 mehrere Buslinien auf dem betroffenen Korridor dauerhaft umgeleitet werden, wovon täglich schätzungsweise 27.000 Fahrgäste betroffen sein werden.

Der Gemeinderat von Innsbruck hat am Donnerstagabend mit knapper Mehrheit beschlossen, das städtische Klimaschutzpaket in Kraft zu setzen: 23 Ratsmitglieder stimmten dafür, 19 dagegen, bei zwei Enthaltungen. Die Grünen und die SPÖ hatten gemeinsam für den Antrag geworben, während die FPÖ unter Fraktionschef Benedikt Altweger geschlossen dagegenstimmte. Bürgermeisterin Claudia Senfter-Mair sprach von einem „historischen Schritt für die Tiroler Landeshauptstadt".

The question of whether Wembley Stadium can sustain its dual identity as both a national sports cathedral and a commercial concert venue has quietly preoccupied architects, promoters, and borough planners in Brent for the better part of a decade, with no consensus yet in sight. English Football Association officials have long insisted that the pitch's integrity must take precedence, while Live Nation executives counter that summer touring seasons generate revenue streams that effectively subsidise lower-profile fixtures throughout the year. A parliamentary select committee touched on the tension in a 2022 report, but stopped short of any binding recommendation.

The Oslo Philharmonic Orchestra will open its autumn season at Konserthuset on 14 September with a programme anchored by Sibelius's Second Symphony, conducted by Finnish maestro Erika Mäkinen in what promises to be one of the hall's most anticipated evenings of the year — and the timing is hardly coincidental, coming just three days after Norway's national football side edged past Austria 2–1 in a tense World Cup qualifier at Ullevaal Stadion on 11 September, a result that sent a capacity crowd of 27,314 home in celebratory mood and left manager Torbjørn Haaland crediting "the belief the whole city showed us."

Commuters on the Overground face fresh disruption this weekend after Avanti West Coast engineers discovered a hairline fracture in a section of overhead line equipment near Crewe, forcing Network Rail to suspend all services between Manchester Piccadilly and Birmingham New Street from Saturday morning until at least Sunday night. An estimated 47,000 passengers are expected to seek alternative travel, with Transpennine Express and CrossCountry both deploying replacement bus services along the corridor.

Commuters on the Piccadilly line faced severe delays on Monday morning after a signalling failure near Hammersmith caused trains to run at severely reduced frequency for more than four hours, with Transport for London estimating that roughly 87,000 passengers were affected before normal service was restored shortly before noon. TfL engineers traced the fault to ageing relay equipment installed in the 1980s, and the operator confirmed that a full replacement programme for the stretch between Acton Town and King's Cross St. Pancras is now scheduled to begin in March 2026.

The Scottish Parliament voted by a narrow margin on Thursday to extend free school meal provision to all primary-age children, with the Scottish National Party and the Scottish Greens combining forces to push the measure through against Conservative opposition. The final tally stood at 68 votes in favour, 55 against, and 4 abstentions — a result that Education Secretary Morag Dunbar hailed as "a landmark moment for child welfare." The Conservatives' education spokesperson, Alistair Pryce, condemned the bill as fiscally reckless, warning that its estimated annual cost of £340 million would strain Holyrood's already stretched block grant.

ÖBB has confirmed that engineering works on the Westbahn corridor between Salzburg and Linz will close the main line to through trains from the evening of Friday, 14 November, through to Monday morning, 17 November, with replacement bus services operating on an extended schedule. An estimated 38,000 passengers are expected to be affected over the three-day closure, which is required to allow crews to install new signalling infrastructure ahead of the planned introduction of higher-frequency services in early 2026. Travellers are advised to book replacement coaches via the ÖBB app well in advance, as capacity on alternative routes through Wels is described as limited.

A second-half header from midfielder Tomáš Řehák proved the difference as FK Bohemians Praha edged Zbrojovka Brno 2–1 at Dolichovický stadion on Saturday evening, keeping the hosts four points clear at the top of the Fortuna:Liga table with just six rounds remaining. Brno's equaliser from Mateus Cavalcanti five minutes after the interval had briefly threatened a share of the spoils, but Řehák's 74th-minute winner in front of 8,200 spectators extinguished any hope of a comeback.

Hanna Strömberg produced a masterclass in long-distance rowing on Saturday as she powered her single scull to victory at the Lucerne World Rowing Cup, finishing the 2,000-metre course in 7:04.38 to edge out defending champion Yuki Tanabe by less than half a second in front of a packed grandstand at Lake Rotsee. The win puts the Swedish sculler firmly in contention for the World Rowing Championships in September.

The Flemish parliament in Brussels voted narrowly on Thursday to pass a sweeping housing reform bill backed by the N-VA and Vooruit coalition, with 71 votes in favour and 64 against, after a fractious overnight debate in which opposition members from the Vlaams Belang repeatedly demanded the measure be put to a public referendum. The bill, championed by Housing Minister Lena Degroote, would cap private rental increases at 2.4 per cent annually and compel municipalities to allocate at least 18 per cent of new construction to social housing.

Commuters across Munich faced widespread disruption on Monday after the Stadtwerke München suspended all U-Bahn services on lines U3 and U6 due to a signalling fault detected overnight at Sendlinger Tor station. The operator estimated that approximately 94,000 passengers would be affected during the morning rush alone, with replacement bus services deployed along both corridors. Engineers expected to restore full service by Tuesday evening at the latest.

Im Nachholspiel der 2. Bundesliga empfing der FC Schalke 04 am Dienstagabend den Hamburger SV in der Veltins-Arena und musste sich vor 54.412 Zuschauern mit 1:3 geschlagen geben. Einen überragenden Abend erwischte HSV-Stürmer Lennart Braasch, der zwei Tore erzielte und damit die Gäste aus Hamburg endgültig auf Aufstiegskurs brachte. Für Schalke war es die dritte Heimniederlage in Folge.

The Wiener Festwochen opened its 72nd edition on Friday evening with a thunderous reception at the Burgtheater, where Argentine director Valentina Ríos Salcedo staged a sprawling, seven-hour adaptation of José Saramago's "Blindness" that drew a capacity crowd of some 1,200 and left critics debating its merits well past midnight. The festival, running through June 22, is co-organised by the City of Vienna and the Volkstheater, with curatorship this year shared between dramaturges Markus Fehrenbach and Siobhán Ó Murchadha.

Die Frankfurter Buchmesse eröffnet am 15. Oktober ihre 76. Ausgabe auf dem Messegelände Frankfurt und erwartet in diesem Jahr rund 95.000 Fachbesucher aus aller Welt. Als Ehrengastland wurde Norwegen ausgewählt, dessen Verlage und Autoren mit einem eigens gestalteten Pavillon vertreten sein werden. Messedirektorin Klara Steinvorth kündigte an, der Schwerpunkt liege in diesem Jahr auf fremdsprachiger Literatur und den Herausforderungen des digitalen Buchmarktes.

Edinburgh's beloved Usher Hall will host the three-day Northern Lights Music Festival beginning Friday, drawing chamber ensembles and folk soloists from across Scandinavia and Scotland — but concertgoers are being warned that Lothian Buses will suspend all Route 35 and Route 47 services between Princes Street and Tollcross from Friday through Sunday due to emergency resurfacing works on Leven Street, leaving an estimated 18,000 passengers to seek alternative connections.

Die Frankfurter Buchmesse eröffnete am Mittwoch ihre 76. Ausgabe mit einem Festakt in der Festhalle Frankfurt, an dem rund 9.800 Gäste aus über 100 Ländern teilnahmen. Als Ehrengast des Abends trat die norwegische Schriftstellerin Astrid Vemundvik ans Podium und hielt eine vielbeachtete Rede über digitale Übersetzungstechnologie und die Zukunft des gedruckten Buches. Der Börsenverein des Deutschen Buchhandels, der die Messe seit Jahrzehnten ausrichtet, gab bekannt, dass bis Sonntag mehr als 4.000 Aussteller aus 95 Ländern erwartet werden.

Der Stadtrat von Freiburg im Breisgau hat am Donnerstagabend mit knapper Mehrheit für die Einführung einer kommunalen Klimaabgabe auf gewerbliche Parkflächen gestimmt. 31 Ratsmitglieder sprachen sich für den Antrag aus, 27 dagegen, bei vier Enthaltungen. Die Initiative war von den Grünen und der SPD gemeinsam eingebracht worden und stieß bei der CDU-Fraktion auf entschiedenen Widerstand. Oberbürgermeisterin Susanne Brückner bezeichnete das Ergebnis als „historischen Schritt hin zu einer gerechteren Verkehrspolitik in unserer Stadt".

For years, architects and transit planners have debated whether the ageing Central Station in Frankfurt should be treated primarily as a cultural monument or as living infrastructure — a question that has quietly shaped local politics without ever producing a decisive vote. The station's cast-iron canopy, completed in 1888, has been cited by preservation groups as one of the finest examples of Wilhelmine engineering in Germany, while the Deutsche Bahn and successive Frankfurt city councils have tended to view it through the less romantic lens of passenger throughput and maintenance liability. Meanwhile, the Städel Museum, just a short walk along the Schaumainkai, has expressed informal interest in mounting an exhibition tracing the aesthetic overlap between railway architecture and the fine arts — a project that remains entirely at the conceptual stage.

Passengers travelling on the S-Bahn network in and around Frankfurt were warned of severe delays on Thursday after a signal failure near Sachsenhausen brought services on lines S3, S4, and S6 to a near-standstill for roughly four hours during the morning rush. RMV confirmed that approximately 47,000 commuters were affected before engineers from DB Netz finally restored normal operations shortly before noon.

Dundalk FC edged out Bohemian FC 2–1 in a tense League of Ireland Premier Division clash at Oriel Park on Friday evening, with midfielder Ciarán Molloy scoring a stoppage-time winner to send the home crowd of 3,847 into raptures. The result lifts Dundalk to second place in the table ahead of a crucial run of fixtures in November.

Der Wiener Stadtentwicklungsexperte Benedikt Haslauer hat in einem viel beachteten Beitrag für die Zeitschrift „Urbanistik heute" dargelegt, warum der geplante Ausbau der U-Bahn-Linie U5 durch den 17. Bezirk zwar architektonisch reizvoll sei, aber aus verkehrsplanerischer Sicht noch erhebliche offene Fragen aufwerfe — nicht zuletzt mit Blick auf die bereits stark belasteten Umsteigeknoten am Westbahnhof.

The same weekend that Rostock's Volkstheater staged the German premiere of Icelandic playwright Sigríður Matthíasdóttir's haunting chamber piece "Fjörður," the city's football club FC Hansa Rostock claimed a dramatic 2–1 victory over Eintracht Braunschweig at the Ostseestadion before a sold-out crowd of 29,000, temporarily lifting them to third place in the 3. Liga table. Theatre director Annika Breuhold called the two events "an unexpectedly fine weekend for this city," noting that both the opening-night audience and the stadium faithful had filled Rostock with an unusual charge of collective energy.

Midfielder Tomáš Brůžek scored twice in the final twelve minutes to give Bohemian FC a stunning 3–2 victory over Slavia Prague at Dalymount Park on Saturday, keeping the Northside club's faint Airtricity League promotion hopes alive in front of a raucous crowd of 4,800.

The old mining town of Ostrava had little reason to celebrate heading into the weekend, but Saturday delivered a double dose of good news: the Janáček Philharmonic premiered a new violin concerto by local composer Radka Horáčková at the Dům kultury Ostrava to a sold-out house of 1,200, while just two kilometres away FC Baník Ostrava edged rivals FC Zbrojovka Brno 2–1 in a tightly contested Fortuna Liga clash at Městský stadion, with midfielder Tomáš Červenka scoring the decisive goal in the 88th minute. "Two victories for the city in one afternoon — that doesn't happen often," said mayor Petra Slavíková.

The Frankfurter Buchmesse opens its doors on Wednesday for a five-day run, with Norwegian literature taking centre stage as this year's guest of honour, drawing publishers, agents, and readers from more than ninety countries to the Messe Frankfurt fairgrounds. Renowned novelist Sigrid Brattberg will deliver the opening address alongside a slate of Nordic authors including Tor Elvestad and Marit Haugland, whose debut translation into English has already generated considerable pre-fair buzz. Organisers expect upwards of 300,000 visitors over the course of the week.

Der Stuttgarter Gemeinderat hat am Donnerstag mit 38 zu 14 Stimmen bei drei Enthaltungen beschlossen, die marode Stadtbahnlinie U12 grundlegend zu sanieren und bis 2028 auf den neuen Streckenabschnitt Hedelfingen-Ost zu verlängern. Der Beschluss, den Oberbürgermeister Frank Nopper bereits vorab als „überfällige Investition in die Mobilität der Zukunft" bezeichnet hatte, sieht ein Gesamtbudget von 340 Millionen Euro vor. Stadtrat Gregor Wiesental von den Grünen betonte, die Sanierung werde den täglichen Betrieb auf der gesamten Linie ab Januar 2025 für mindestens achtzehn Monate erheblich einschränken; die Stuttgarter Straßenbahnen AG hat Pendler bereits aufgefordert, auf parallel verkehrende Buslinien auszuweichen.

Die Kunstmesse art Karlsruhe eröffnet am Donnerstag ihre einundzwanzigste Ausgabe in der Messe Karlsruhe und versammelt bis Sonntag rund 200 Galerien aus 16 Ländern unter einem Dach. Kuratorisch begleitet wird die Schau in diesem Jahr von der Kunsthistorikerin Maren Sokolowski, die einen thematischen Schwerpunkt auf figurative Malerei der Gegenwart legt. Der Eintritt kostet 18 Euro.

Reigning champions Rosenborg BK stumbled to a 2–2 draw at home against Vålerenga IF in Sunday's Eliteserien clash at Lerkendal Stadion in Trondheim, a result that hands league leaders Molde FK a potentially decisive five-point cushion with just four rounds remaining. Rosenborg's Teodor Haugen cancelled out Vålerenga's early brace with goals in the 61st and 78th minutes, but the visitors held firm to deny the hosts all three points in front of 16,340 fans.

Commuters across the Swiss capital faced significant disruption on Monday after Bernmobil suspended tram lines 6 and 9 following an overnight water-main burst near Helvetiaplatz, with engineers warning that track subsidence could keep the routes closed for up to four days. An estimated 34,000 daily passengers were advised to use replacement bus services on corridors 6E and 9E, though peak-hour overcrowding was reported almost immediately. The operator said a full structural assessment of the affected section would be completed by Thursday.

A weekend of street closures around Cologne's Innenstadt will accompany the opening of the Kölner Lichtfest on Friday, 14 February, as the city braces for an estimated 85,000 visitors flooding the historic centre. The BVG-operated tram lines 1, 7, and 9 will be suspended between Heumarkt and Dom/Hauptbahnhof from 18:00 on Friday through 02:00 on Sunday, 16 February, with replacement buses running every twelve minutes along Hohe Straße; transit authorities have warned that some 34,000 daily passengers should plan for significant delays. The festival, curated by the Kulturbüro Köln and now in its sixth edition, will scatter light installations and projection art across sixteen sites along the Rhine waterfront, with headline contributions from multimedia artist Soraya Benchikh and the Oslo-based collective Lysform.

Der Wiener Gemeinderat hat am Donnerstagabend mit 54 zu 32 Stimmen bei vier Enthaltungen einen Antrag der SPÖ Wien zur Einführung eines städtischen Mietpreisdeckels beschlossen — ein Vorhaben, dem die Grünen trotz anfänglicher Skepsis zustimmten, während die FPÖ als lauteste Gegenstimme auftrat. Bürgermeister Lukas Feichtinger bezeichnete das Ergebnis als „historischen Schritt für leistbares Wohnen in Wien".

Rail passengers travelling between Strasbourg and Karlsruhe faced significant delays on Thursday after a freight derailment near Rastatt blocked both tracks on the cross-border corridor, forcing DB Regio and SNCF to suspend all services on the Rhine Valley line for at least 48 hours. An estimated 14,000 commuters were affected during the morning peak alone, with replacement bus services described by travellers as wholly inadequate for the volume of demand.

Tatjana Wolff delivered a masterclass in endurance on Sunday, crossing the finish line of the Hamburg Alster Marathon in 2 hours 41 minutes to claim the women's title ahead of a field of 9,200 registered runners. The 29-year-old from Hannover, running under the colours of LC Hanseat, surged clear of nearest rival Priya Nambiar in the final kilometre along the Außenalster waterfront, drawing roars from the packed spectator barriers. Race organisers confirmed attendance at the roadside course had reached approximately 47,000 spectators, making it the event's best-supported edition since 2019.

ÖBB has confirmed that engineering works on the Westbahn corridor between Salzburg and Linz will close the line to all passenger and freight traffic from the night of 14 March through to the morning of 22 March, with replacement bus services laid on at additional cost to the operator. The seven-day shutdown, which affects around 38,000 daily travellers, is necessary to complete the installation of the European Train Control System along a 112-kilometre stretch that has long been a bottleneck for cross-border services between Austria and Germany.

Passengers on the Northern line faced severe delays for a third consecutive morning on Wednesday after a signalling fault near Kennington brought southbound services to a near-standstill during rush hour, with Transport for London estimating that roughly 85,000 commuters were affected. Engineers from TfL's track and infrastructure division were deployed overnight but had not restored full operations by 08:30, prompting the operator to advise travellers between Camden Town and Morden to use the Victoria line or surface rail alternatives where possible. A spokesperson said repairs were expected to be completed by Thursday evening.

Dundalk FC came from behind to beat Shelbourne 3–2 in a breathless League of Ireland Premier Division clash at Oriel Park on Friday evening, with midfielder Ciarán Forde netting the decisive goal in the 88th minute before a crowd of 4,150. The result lifts Dundalk to third in the table, three points behind leaders Shamrock Rovers.

Der Wiener Gemeinderat hat am Donnerstag mit knapper Mehrheit einem neuen Klimaschutzpaket zugestimmt, das unter anderem die schrittweise Abschaffung von Ölheizungen in städtischen Gebäuden bis 2030 vorsieht. Von den 100 anwesenden Mandataren stimmten 54 dafür, 38 dagegen, während sich 8 Enthaltungen verzeichnen ließen. SPÖ und Grüne trugen den Beschluss gemeinsam, während die FPÖ unter Fraktionschefin Mag. Renate Hollinger scharf dagegen votierte. Bürgermeister Michael Ludwig zeigte sich nach der Abstimmung zufrieden und sprach von einem „historischen Schritt für das Klima unserer Stadt".

The Edinburgh International Festival announced on Monday that its centrepiece orchestral gala, headlined by the Gothenburg Symphony Orchestra under conductor Lena Fröberg, will open on 8 August at the Usher Hall — but festival-goers are being warned of significant disruption on Lothian Buses routes 22, 35, and 41, which will be suspended from 6 August through 14 August as Edinburgh City Council undertakes emergency resurfacing works along the Princes Street corridor. Organisers estimate that up to 45,000 visitors relying on those services may need to seek alternative transport during the festival's opening week, and have urged attendees to use the Edinburgh Trams network instead. Tickets for the gala evening are priced at £65, with a limited run of concession seats available at £30.

Tens of thousands of fans descending on Seville for Sunday's Copa del Rey final between Real Betis and Athletic Club caused severe disruption across the city's metro network, with Transportes Urbanos de Sevilla reporting delays of up to 45 minutes on Lines 1 and 2 as platforms at Estadio de La Cartuja station were overwhelmed. The match itself, played before a sell-out crowd of 57,000 at the Estadio de La Cartuja on 4 May 2025, ended in a 2–1 victory for Athletic Club, with forward Iñaki Garaizar scoring a decisive 88th-minute winner to seal his side's first Copa triumph in fourteen years. TUSAM, the emergency transit coordination body, urged supporters to delay their journeys home by at least one hour, warning that additional services drafted in from Renfe had already reached capacity.

Beim Stadtfest Graz, das am Samstag auf dem Hauptplatz seine diesjährige Ausgabe eröffnete, begeisterten die Wiener Philharmoniker mit einem zweistündigen Freiluftkonzert rund 8.400 Besucher – ein Rekord für die Veranstaltung. Wenige Stunden später, am selben Abend, sicherte sich der SK Sturm Graz im Merkur Arena im Grazer Derby gegen den GAK einen 3:1-Sieg vor 14.200 Zuschauern, womit die Mannschaft von Trainer Bojan Petrovič die Tabellenführung in der Österreichischen Bundesliga übernahm.

Die Fotografin Marisol Eguía eröffnete am Donnerstagabend ihre erste Einzelausstellung im Münchner Stadtmuseum, wo rund 80 großformatige Schwarz-Weiß-Aufnahmen aus ihrem zehnjährigen Langzeitprojekt über Arbeitsmigration im Ruhrgebiet zu sehen sind. Kuratorin der Schau ist Hildegard Preuß, die Eguías Werk seit Jahren begleitet. Die Ausstellung läuft bis zum 14. September und ist täglich außer montags geöffnet; der Eintritt beträgt zwölf Euro.

Commuters in Lyon faced significant disruption on Monday after drivers employed by TCL, the city's main public transport operator, launched a 48-hour walkout over stalled wage negotiations, suspending services on tram lines T1, T2, and T4 as well as several key bus corridors across the metropolitan area. Sytral Mobilités, the regional transport authority, urged passengers to work from home where possible and warned that around 340,000 daily riders would be affected before a return to normal operations was expected on Wednesday morning.

Ab Montag, dem 14. April, stellt die Berliner Verkehrsbetriebe den Betrieb auf der U-Bahnlinie U8 zwischen Hermannstraße und Leinestraße für voraussichtlich drei Wochen ein, um dringend erforderliche Gleiserneuerungsarbeiten durchzuführen. Rund 47.000 Fahrgäste täglich sind von der Sperrung betroffen; Schienenersatzverkehr mit Bussen der Linie SEV U8 wird während der gesamten Bauphase eingerichtet.

Der Wiener Gemeinderat hat am Dienstag mit 54 zu 38 Stimmen bei 4 Enthaltungen einem neuen Klimaschutzpaket zugestimmt, das bis 2030 eine vollständige Dekarbonisierung des städtischen Nahverkehrs vorsieht. Die regierende Koalition aus SPÖ und NEOS feierte die Entscheidung als historischen Schritt, während die FPÖ das Vorhaben als wirtschaftsfeindlich scharf ablehnte. Bürgermeister Michael Ludwig sprach im Anschluss von einem „klaren Signal Wiens an ganz Europa".

The Vienna city council voted 38 to 14 on Thursday to approve a €2.3 billion expansion of the U-Bahn network, extending the U2 line to Wienerberg and adding seven new stations — a landmark infrastructure package championed by SPÖ transport councillor Doris Mautner over months of coalition wrangling. The approval cleared the final legislative hurdle for ÖBB and Wiener Linien, the joint operators behind the project, who are now expected to break ground by spring 2026, with full service on the extended line pencilled in for late 2031.

The Frankfurter Buchmesse opens its doors on Wednesday for a five-day run at Messe Frankfurt, drawing more than 300,000 visitors and some 4,000 exhibitors from across the globe to what remains the world's largest trade fair for books and publishing. This year's Guest of Honour is Italy, with a sprawling programme of readings, panel discussions, and installations curated by Luciana Ferretti and co-organised by the Börsenverein des Deutschen Buchhandels. Admission for a single day stands at €18.
