DB Regio Bayern empfiehlt Pendlern, großräumige Umleitungen über Augsburg einzuplanen.

The Swedish Riksdag voted late on Thursday to approve a sweeping overhaul of the country's housing subsidy framework, with the Moderate Party and Sweden Democrats combining for a narrow majority of 176 votes in favour against 173 opposed, and 0 abstentions. Finance Minister Britta Söderholm hailed the outcome as "a generational shift in social housing policy," while opposition leader Kasper Lindqvist of the Social Democrats warned that the cuts would leave tens of thousands of low-income families without adequate support. The legislation now passes to a review committee before taking effect in January 2026.

The Frankfurter Buchmesse opens its doors on Wednesday for a five-day run that organisers say will draw more than 300,000 visitors to the Messe Frankfurt fairgrounds, with Norway serving as Guest of Honour for the first time in the fair's history. Among the headline names are novelists Sigrid Brattli and Håkon Mæland, whose debut English-language translations have drawn considerable advance attention from publishers across three continents. Admission to the public days on Saturday and Sunday is priced at €18 per person.

The Scottish Parliament voted by a narrow margin on Thursday to reject the proposed council tax reform bill, with 64 members voting against and 59 in favour, after a bruising three-hour debate in which Finance Secretary Catriona Meldrum clashed repeatedly with Conservative shadow minister Alasdair Pringle over the impact on rural households. The Scottish National Party, whose minority government had staked considerable political capital on the measure, acknowledged the defeat as a "serious setback" but vowed to return with a revised package before the summer recess.

Commuters on Stockholm's tunnelbana faced severe disruptions on Thursday after a signalling fault near Fridhemsplan forced SL to suspend the green line between T-Centralen and Hässelby Strand for nearly six hours, stranding an estimated 47,000 passengers during the morning rush. Engineers from Alstom were on site by 07:30 and service was partially restored shortly before midday, though SL warned that residual delays could persist into the evening peak.

The Wiener Festwochen opens its 2024 edition on Friday at the Rathausplatz, with a sprawling programme that spans theatre, dance, and visual art across more than forty venues in Vienna over six weeks. Artistic director Milo Rau has positioned the festival as a forum for politically engaged performance, drawing ensembles from Lagos to Reykjavík, and tickets for the opening gala are priced at €28. Among the most anticipated productions is a new staging by Lebanese-Brazilian director Camila Nacif, whose work confronts displacement and colonial memory before an expected audience of some 3,500 on opening night.

The Frankfurter Buchmesse opened its doors on Wednesday to a record 4,312 exhibitors from 95 countries, with this year's guest of honour, Slovenia, presenting a sprawling programme of readings, panel discussions, and live translations across Halls 3 and 4 of the Messe Frankfurt. Cornelia Vašíček, the Slovenian commissioner overseeing the national pavilion, told reporters the delegation had brought more than 200 titles newly translated into German. Tickets for the public weekend are priced at €18.

Commuters on Stockholm's tunnelbana faced severe delays on Monday morning after a signalling fault on the Green Line brought services to a near-standstill between Fridhemsplan and Slussen for roughly four hours, leaving an estimated 38,000 passengers scrambling for alternative connections. Storstockholms Lokaltrafik confirmed the disruption began at 07:14 and said engineering crews had restored full service by 11:30, attributing the failure to a software update rolled out overnight that had not been adequately tested under live-traffic conditions.

Die Berliner S-Bahn muss ab kommendem Montag auf der Linie S7 zwischen Ostkreuz und Erkner den Betrieb für voraussichtlich drei Wochen vollständig einstellen: Ein Erdrutsch nach anhaltenden Regenfällen hat den Bahndamm auf einem rund 400 Meter langen Abschnitt beschädigt, wie die Deutsche Bahn am Mittwoch mitteilte. Rund 28.000 Pendlerinnen und Pendler sind laut Schätzungen täglich betroffen; als Ersatz werden Busse der BVG zwischen den betroffenen Haltestellen eingesetzt.

Die ÖBB warnt Reisende: Wegen umfangreicher Gleisbauarbeiten zwischen Salzburg Hauptbahnhof und Rosenheim wird die Strecke vom 14. Juli bis zum 3. August vollständig gesperrt. Betroffen sind vor allem die Fernzüge der Linie RJX 60 sowie mehrere Regionalverbindungen; rund 38.000 Fahrgäste täglich müssen auf Schienenersatzverkehr umsteigen. Die Baumaßnahmen, deren Auftragswert sich auf 94 Millionen Euro beläuft, dienen der Erneuerung von Weichen und Oberleitungsanlagen auf dem grenzüberschreitenden Korridor zwischen Österreich und Deutschland.

The Stormont Assembly voted narrowly on Thursday to reject a proposed cross-border environmental framework backed by Sinn Féin and the SDLP, with the motion falling by 47 votes to 54 after three Ulster Unionist members broke ranks with their party leadership. Assembly Speaker Máiréad Doherty confirmed the result from the chamber floor, while DUP Chief Whip Aldric Beverley described the outcome as "a necessary defence of devolved sovereignty." The defeated measure, which had sought to align Northern Ireland's water quality standards with those of the Republic of Ireland, will now return to a committee for redrafting.

The Reykjavík City Council voted narrowly on Thursday to reject a proposed amendment to the municipal housing charter, with 11 members voting against and 8 in favour, after a three-hour debate that exposed deep rifts between the ruling Left-Green Alliance and the opposition Independence Party. Council chair Sigríður Magnúsdóttir told reporters afterward that a revised proposal addressing affordability concerns for low-income residents would be tabled within six weeks.

Commuters on Frankfurt's S-Bahn network faced severe disruptions on Monday morning after a signalling failure near Hauptwache station forced the suspension of S-Bahn lines S3, S4, and S6 for nearly four hours, leaving an estimated 85,000 passengers stranded or rerouted onto already overcrowded U-Bahn services. Deutsche Bahn, which operates the regional rail network, said engineers restored full service by 11:40 a.m. but cautioned that residual delays could persist into the evening rush hour. No cause for the fault had been officially confirmed as of midday.

The debate over whether Vienna's Ringstraße should be partially closed to private vehicles has resurfaced in city planning circles, with architects, transit advocates, and heritage groups each staking out sharply different positions; proponents of the closure point to the success of similar pedestrianisation schemes in Oslo and Barcelona, while opponents argue that the boulevard's nineteenth-century design was always inseparable from the flow of traffic through the imperial capital.

For decades, the Frankfurter Buchmesse has served as a barometer of the publishing world's anxieties — shifting from Cold War ideological contests to today's debates over artificial intelligence and authors' rights — yet critics like Hannelore Vreede argue that the fair's sheer scale, drawing upwards of 300,000 visitors annually to the Messe Frankfurt fairgrounds, has made it as much a trade spectacle as a literary one. Whether that tension is a flaw or a feature remains, as ever, a matter of perspective.

Sebastián Carreño Vidal delivered a masterclass at the Estadio Nacional in Santiago on Saturday, steering Club Universidad de Chile to a commanding 3–1 victory over Colo-Colo in the latest instalment of the Superclásico, before an electrifying crowd of 47,200. Carreño Vidal opened the scoring in the ninth minute and added a second before half-time, with Tomás Ríos Albrecht wrapping up the win late in the second half. The defeat leaves Colo-Colo five points adrift at the top of the Primera División table heading into the winter break.

Der Stadtrat von Graz hat am Donnerstag mit knapper Mehrheit einem umstrittenen Wohnbaupaket zugestimmt, das den Bau von rund 1.200 geförderten Mietwohnungen im Stadtgebiet vorsieht. Die Abstimmung endete mit 25 Stimmen dafür, 18 dagegen und 4 Enthaltungen. Bürgermeisterin Klaudia Fehringer-Wieser von der ÖVP sprach von einem „historischen Schritt für die Wohnraumversorgung der wachsenden Stadt", während die FPÖ-Fraktionsvorsitzende Margit Holzner das Paket als „finanziell unverantwortlich" bezeichnete. Die Grünen hatten das Vorhaben gemeinsam mit der SPÖ unterstützt.

Commuters on the Øresund cross-border rail corridor faced severe disruptions on Thursday after a signalling fault between Malmö Central and Copenhagen Airport Kastrup brought services to a standstill for nearly four hours. Øresundståg, the joint Swedish-Danish operator, said around 38,000 passengers were affected before limited services resumed mid-afternoon. Repair crews from Trafikverket and Banedanmark worked in parallel to isolate the fault, though full timetable restoration was not expected until Friday morning.

The Alte Nationalgalerie in Berlin opens its long-awaited retrospective on Thursday, dedicating three floors to the drawings, lithographs, and oil paintings of the Düsseldorf School — a survey so comprehensive that curators Lena Hartwig and Felix Oduya have pulled works on loan from the Musée d'Orsay, the Tate Britain, and a dozen private collections across Europe. The exhibition, titled "Light and Longing: The Düsseldorf School Reconsidered", runs through March 9, 2026, and is expected to draw upward of 180,000 visitors over its five-month run.

Die Hamburger Hochbahn AG hat für den kommenden Samstag eine ganztägige Streckensperrung auf der U3 zwischen den Haltestellen Barmbek und Wandsbek-Gartenstadt angekündigt, um dringende Gleiserneuerungsarbeiten durchzuführen. Rund 47.000 Fahrgäste seien von der Maßnahme betroffen, teilte das Unternehmen am Mittwoch mit. Ein Ersatzverkehr mit Bussen werde eingerichtet, die Fahrtzeit verlängere sich jedoch um schätzungsweise zwanzig Minuten je Richtung.

Commuters across the Frankfurt Rhine-Main region faced significant disruption on Monday after the RMV suspended all S-Bahn services on lines S3, S4, and S6 due to a signalling fault traced to ageing relay infrastructure at Sachsenhausen junction. Repair crews worked through the night, but as of Tuesday morning the operator confirmed that full service restoration would not be possible before Wednesday. An estimated 87,000 daily passengers were affected, with RMV deploying replacement bus services on key corridors and urging travellers to use U-Bahn alternatives where available.

The Flemish parliament narrowly approved a coalition agreement between the N-VA, Vooruit, and cd&v on Thursday, with 72 votes in favour, 51 against, and 4 abstentions, clearing the way for a new regional government under minister-president designate Liesbet Claes — the first woman to hold that office in Flanders. The accord, hammered out over fourteen weeks of talks in Brussels, centres on a sweeping overhaul of housing subsidies and a controversial freeze on public-sector hiring. Opposition leader Pieter Janssens of Groen accused the incoming coalition of "governing for the wealthy," a charge Ms. Claes dismissed as "a caricature."

Bohemian FC edged Shelbourne 2–1 in a tense Dublin derby at Dalymount Park on Friday evening, with midfielder Ciarán Doyle netting a stoppage-time winner to send the home crowd into raptures. The victory lifts Bohemian to third place in the League of Ireland Premier Division with eight matches remaining, while Shelbourne's faltering title challenge now looks increasingly precarious. An official attendance of 4,217 was recorded — a new season high for the venue.

The Frankfurter Buchmesse opens its doors on Wednesday for a five-day run that organisers expect to draw more than 300,000 visitors to the Messe Frankfurt fairgrounds, with Norway serving as this year's Guest of Honour nation. Among the highlights is a debut appearance by acclaimed novelist Ingrid Solberg-Haas, who will present her new novel at the Norwegian pavilion on Thursday alongside publisher Karl-Otto Weidemann of Arche Verlag. Ticket prices for day passes start at €18.

Napoli claimed a hard-fought 2–1 victory over Juventus at the Stadio Diego Armando Maradona on Saturday evening, with midfielder Lorenzo Caiazzo curling in a decisive late free kick to seal all three points in one of Serie A's most anticipated fixtures of the season. A crowd of 54,200 roared the hosts home, lifting Napoli temporarily to the summit of the table ahead of Sunday's remaining matches.

Der SV Werder Bremen hat sich am Samstagabend im Weserstadion mit einem knappen 2:1-Sieg gegen den 1. FC Köln durchgesetzt und damit den Anschluss an die Tabellenspitze der Bundesliga gefestigt. Den entscheidenden Treffer erzielte Stürmer Lukas Ferreira in der 88. Minute, während Kölns Ausgleichshoffnungen durch eine glänzende Parade von Torhüter Nils Beckmann zunichte gemacht wurden. Insgesamt verfolgten 42.100 Zuschauer die Partie im ausverkauften Stadion.

The Irish Dáil passed a sweeping housing reform bill on Thursday by a margin of 87 votes to 54, with 12 abstentions, after nearly six hours of fractious debate in which Fianna Fáil and Fine Gael deputies closed ranks against a Sinn Féin motion to delay the legislation. Taoiseach Micheál Martin, speaking from the government benches in Leinster House, hailed the result as "a generational step forward for renters and first-time buyers alike," while Sinn Féin's housing spokeswoman Aoife Ní Bhriain accused the coalition of papering over a structural crisis with what she called "cosmetic amendments." The bill now passes to the Seanad for consideration.

Wegen eines Signalschadens auf der Strecke zwischen Mannheim und Heidelberg kommt es seit Montagmorgen zu erheblichen Verspätungen im Regionalverkehr der Deutschen Bahn. Betroffen sind die Linien RE 1 und S3, auf denen nach Angaben des Unternehmens täglich rund 47.000 Fahrgäste unterwegs sind. Ein Sprecher der Deutschen Bahn erklärte, man rechne bis Mittwochabend mit der vollständigen Wiederherstellung des Betriebs; Schienenersatzverkehr werde in der Zwischenzeit eingerichtet.

The Frankfurter Buchmesse opened its doors on Wednesday to a record 93,000 registered trade visitors, with Norwegian author Sigrid Undset Society taking a prominent role in this year's guest-of-honour celebrations for Norway. The Festhalle Frankfurt buzzed with activity as publishers from more than 100 countries converged on the fairgrounds, while a sold-out evening lecture by the novelist Marta Elveheim drew a crowd of 2,400 at the Literaturhaus Frankfurt. Organizers confirmed the fair will run through Sunday, October 20.

The Barbican Centre will host a three-week retrospective of Estonian composer Arvo Pärt's choral and chamber works beginning 14 March, with performances by the Estonian Philharmonic Chamber Choir under the direction of Kaspars Putniņš. Tickets are priced at £28, and organisers from the Barbican Music Department expect the series to draw audiences of around 2,400 across its run.

The Hamburger Kunsthalle opens its long-anticipated retrospective of Norwegian painter Sigrid Valberg on Friday, tracing five decades of her coastal abstractions through some 140 canvases, prints, and mixed-media installations drawn from collections across Scandinavia and North America. Curated by Maren Thøgersen-Holm, the exhibition runs until 2 March and is accompanied by a bilingual catalogue in German and English. Admission is priced at €14 for adults.

The Frankfurter Buchmesse opened its doors on Wednesday to a record 4,200 exhibitors from 95 countries, with this year's guest of honour, Slovenia, showcasing a carefully assembled pavilion of translated literature overseen by curator Maja Kovič. Publisher Lena Hartmann, whose debut novel "Das stille Wasser" has already sold over 80,000 copies in the German-speaking world, delivered the opening address to a packed Festhalle before a crowd of roughly 7,500 guests. The fair runs through Sunday.

Passengers travelling between Zurich and Milan will face major disruptions from Monday after SBB announced that the Gotthard Base Tunnel will be closed for emergency maintenance work lasting approximately three weeks, forcing intercity services onto the slower Gotthard mountain route and adding up to ninety minutes to journey times. The operator estimates that around 28,000 rail travellers per day will be affected during the closure, which follows the discovery of a hairline fracture in a tunnel wall segment near Erstfeld. SBB said replacement bus services would be provided for local stops not served by the diverted rail route.

Die Österreichischen Bundesbahnen haben ab Montag die Fernverkehrstickets auf der Strecke Wien–Salzburg um durchschnittlich 8,5 Prozent verteuert — der erste Preisanstieg seit drei Jahren, der laut ÖBB-Sprecher Tobias Kraml auf gestiegene Energiekosten und Infrastrukturinvestitionen zurückzuführen sei. Pendlerinnen und Pendler, die Monatskarten nutzen, sind von der Erhöhung ausgenommen.

The Wiener Festwochen opens its 73rd edition on Friday at venues across Vienna, anchored by a sprawling new production of Elfriede Jelinek's "Das schweigende Mädchen" directed by Marta Górecki, whose staging at the Burgtheater last autumn drew near-universal praise from German-language critics. Curated this year by Artistic Director Lena Søndergaard, the festival runs through June 22 and encompasses theatre, performance art, and contemporary music from more than a dozen countries.

Der Stadtrat von Freiburg im Breisgau hat am Donnerstagabend mit knapper Mehrheit den städtischen Haushalt für das kommende Jahr verabschiedet: 28 Stimmen votierten dafür, 19 dagegen, bei drei Enthaltungen. Bürgermeisterin Katarina Soell von den Grünen sprach von einem „verantwortungsvollen Signal für Klimaschutz und soziale Teilhabe", während der CDU-Fraktionsvorsitzende Markus Drehner die Abstimmung als „finanzpolitischen Blindflug" scharf kritisierte. Besonders umstritten war ein Sonderposten von 4,2 Millionen Euro für den Ausbau des Radwegenetzes.

The debate over whether Wembley Stadium should undergo a sweeping architectural overhaul has resurfaced in London planning circles, with some councillors pointing to the venue's ageing concourse infrastructure and others insisting that any public money earmarked for the project ought instead to address chronic delays on the Jubilee line. Historians of British sport have long argued that Wembley occupies a singular place in the national imagination, yet critics on the left — including several figures within Labour — contend that the stadium's symbolic weight has been used too conveniently to justify expenditure that benefits private interests over ordinary commuters.

The Frankfurter Buchmesse opens its doors on Wednesday for its 76th edition, drawing publishers, agents, and literary figures from more than 100 countries to the Messe Frankfurt fairgrounds. This year's guest of honour is Italy, whose pavilion — designed by architect Giulia Ferrante and curated by the novelist Marco Selvaggio — promises an immersive journey through five centuries of Italian letters. Tickets are priced at €18 for a single day, and organisers expect upwards of 300,000 visitors across the five-day fair.

The Vienna city council voted narrowly on Thursday to approve a €2.3 billion extension of the U2 underground line to Wienerberg, with 43 councillors in favour and 38 against — a result that opposition leader Renate Fürstner of the FPÖ immediately denounced as "reckless spending on an unproven route." The project, championed by transport councillor Markus Hollinger of the SPÖ, is expected to add seven new stations and serve an estimated 85,000 additional passengers daily when it opens in 2031, dramatically reshaping commuter patterns in the city's southern districts.

Die Münchner Kammerspiele eröffnen am Freitag ihre neue Spielzeit mit der Uraufführung von „Das stille Haus", einem Stück der österreichischen Dramatikerin Vera Sonnleitner, das unter der Regie von Tobias Krenn aus Wien auf die Bühne gebracht wird. Intendantin Marika Feldbusch bezeichnete das Werk als „eine schonungslose Auseinandersetzung mit familiärer Stille und dem, was sie verbirgt." Karten sind ab 18 Euro erhältlich.

The Frankfurter Buchmesse opens its 76th edition on Wednesday, with publishing houses from more than 100 countries descending on Messe Frankfurt to showcase new titles, sign translation rights deals, and attend panel discussions spanning literary fiction, academic texts, and children's books. This year's guest of honour is Italy, whose pavilion — designed by architect Silvia Margherita Conti — promises an immersive journey through five centuries of Italian print culture. Tickets for the public days are priced at €18, and organisers expect upward of 300,000 visitors across the five-day fair.

The Swedish Riksdag narrowly approved a contested pension reform package on Thursday, with 176 votes in favour and 173 against, after a heated overnight debate that exposed deep fractures within the governing coalition. Finance Minister Britta Söderström, who championed the bill, called the outcome "a hard-won step toward long-term fiscal stability," while opposition leader Mikael Djurberg of the Social Democrats vowed to reverse the changes at the first available opportunity. The Moderates and the Christian Democrats both backed the measure, but the Sweden Democrats withheld support until a last-minute concession on indexation rules was inserted into the final text.

The Frankfurter Buchmesse opened its doors on Wednesday to record crowds, with some 93,000 visitors descending on the Messe Frankfurt fairgrounds on the first day alone — a figure organisers called "without precedent in the fair's modern history." This year's guest of honour is Italy, whose pavilion, curated by novelist and critic Giulia Scaramuzzi, stretches across three interconnected halls and features more than two hundred authors, translators, and illustrators. The fair runs through Sunday.

Die Kammerspiele München eröffnen am kommenden Freitag die Uraufführung von „Schwarzes Wasser", einem neuen Stück der Dramatikerin Lena Vogt, das unter der Regie von Caspar Hörmann inszeniert wird. Das Stück, das sich mit dem Verlust kollektiver Erinnerung auseinandersetzt, soll für mindestens vier Wochen im Spielplan bleiben. Karten sind ab 18 Euro erhältlich.

The Scottish Parliament voted on Thursday to approve a sweeping reform of the country's rent-control legislation, with the Scottish National Party and Scottish Greens combining to secure a majority of 71 votes to 52, amid fierce opposition from Scottish Conservative backbenchers who argued the measures would deter investment in the private rental sector. Housing Secretary Fiona Drummond-Kerr described the result as "a historic moment for tenants across Scotland," while shadow housing spokesman Alasdair Murchie condemned it as "economically illiterate." Three members abstained, including two from the Labour benches.

Passengers travelling on the Merseyrail network faced severe disruption on Thursday after a signalling failure near Sandhills station brought the Northern and Wirral lines to a standstill for more than four hours, stranding an estimated 22,000 commuters during the morning peak. Merseyrail confirmed that replacement bus services were deployed along affected corridors but warned that delays of up to ninety minutes persisted well into the afternoon. Engineering teams from Network Rail were on site by 07:45 and restored full services shortly before midday.

Oslo's public transport authority Ruter confirmed on Thursday that a planned strike by bus drivers, set to begin on Monday, has been averted after negotiators reached a last-minute wage agreement late Wednesday night. The industrial action, which would have affected some 340,000 daily commuters across routes 30, 31, 37, and 54 in the greater Oslo area, was called off following talks brokered by the Norwegian Labour and Welfare Administration. "Both parties showed the necessary flexibility," said lead mediator Ingrid Halvorsen. Services are expected to run normally from Monday onwards.

Marta Soldevila's brace in the final twelve minutes rescued Atlético de Madrid Femenino from what had looked like a humbling defeat, as the hosts clawed back from 3–1 down to draw 3–3 with Chelsea Women in a breathless Champions League group-stage encounter at the Estadio Cívitas Metropolitano on Wednesday evening, watched by a crowd of 31,456.

Commuters across Greater Manchester faced lengthy delays on Monday morning after Metrolink suspended all tram services on the Eccles and MediaCityUK lines for emergency track repairs near Cornbrook junction, with the operator estimating that roughly 47,000 passengers would be affected before services resumed in the early evening. Transport for Greater Manchester urged travellers to use replacement bus routes or the nearby Northern Rail network where possible.

ÖBB has confirmed that overnight engineering works on the Westbahn corridor between Salzburg and Linz will force a complete suspension of intercity rail services from Friday 11 July through Sunday 13 July, with replacement bus coaches operating on a reduced schedule. Approximately 34,000 passengers are expected to be affected over the three-day closure, which is needed to install new track-switching infrastructure ahead of the autumn timetable change. Travellers are advised to allow up to 90 additional minutes per journey.

Der Regionalverkehr zwischen Salzburg und Freilassing wird ab Montag für voraussichtlich drei Wochen eingestellt, nachdem ein Erdrutsch in der Nacht auf Freitag Teile des Gleisbetts auf einem rund 200 Meter langen Abschnitt bei Freilassing beschädigt hat. Die ÖBB und die DB richten gemeinsam einen Schienenersatzverkehr mit Bussen ein; betroffen sind die Linien R 1 und REX 1, auf denen täglich rund 4.800 Fahrgäste verkehren. Fahrgäste werden gebeten, erheblich mehr Reisezeit einzuplanen.

The Flemish parliament voted narrowly on Thursday to approve a controversial language-testing requirement for municipal civil servants, with the centre-right coalition securing the measure by just eleven votes despite fierce opposition from opposition benches. Mieke Vandenberghe, the bill's chief sponsor and a senior figure in the N-VA, called the outcome "a decisive step toward institutional clarity," while Groen and Vooruit legislators walked out in protest before the final tally. The policy, which obliges all new local government hires in the Brussels periphery to pass a certified Dutch-language examination, is expected to face a constitutional challenge before the Council of State within weeks.

Commuters in Hamburg faced widespread disruption on Monday after the Hamburger Hochbahn announced a 48-hour strike by drivers and platform staff across the U-Bahn network, affecting lines U1, U2, and U3 and leaving an estimated 620,000 daily passengers scrambling for alternatives. The industrial action, called by the Vereinte Dienstleistungsgewerkschaft over a stalled wage dispute, is expected to run through early Wednesday morning. Bus services operated by Hamburger Hochbahn were also curtailed, though regional S-Bahn trains run by DB Regio remained unaffected.

The Frankfurter Buchmesse opens its doors on Wednesday for a five-day run that organisers say will draw more than 300,000 visitors to the Messe Frankfurt fairgrounds, with Italy serving as this year's guest of honour. Among the headlining authors is Carla Sestini, whose debut novel "Le Radici del Silenzio" will receive its German-language premiere at the fair's international fiction stage on Thursday evening. Ticket prices for individual evening events start at €18.

The Frankfurter Buchmesse opened its doors on Wednesday to a record crowd of 302,000 visitors, with Norwegian author Sigrid Bjørnstad delivering the keynote address at the Festhalle and Italian publisher Edizioni Selene unveiling a landmark translation series spanning twelve languages. This year's edition — the seventy-seventh — centres on the theme of "Borders and Bridges," reflecting anxieties about the global retreat from open discourse that have dominated literary circles since 2022. Tickets for the trade days were priced at €48, while public weekend passes cost €18.

Im packenden Halbfinale der 3. Liga trafen der TSV Havelse und der VfB Oldenburg am Samstagabend in der HDI-Arena in Hannover aufeinander — vor 11.200 Zuschauern setzte sich Oldenburg mit 3:1 durch und zog damit erstmals seit 2009 in ein Ligafinale ein. Entscheidend war ein Doppelpack von Stürmer Mirko Beßner in der zweiten Halbzeit, der damit sein Team nahezu im Alleingang in die nächste Runde schoss.

Wegen des Bundesliga-Heimspiels des FC St. Pauli gegen den 1. FC Köln am Samstag, den 18. Januar, warnt die Hamburger Hochbahn vor erheblichen Beeinträchtigungen auf den U-Bahn-Linien U3 und U2 rund um das Millerntor-Stadion: Zwischen 16 und 22 Uhr ist laut Sprecherin Marta Söderström mit Überfüllungen und verlängerten Fahrtzeiten zu rechnen, da rund 29.500 Zuschauer erwartet werden. Das Spiel selbst endete mit einem 2:1-Sieg für den FC St. Pauli, dessen Doppeltorschütze Lennart Braasch zur beherrschenden Figur des Abends wurde.

Stockholm's public transport authority, SL, confirmed on Thursday that a partial suspension of the Tunnelbana's Green Line will take effect from 14 April through 2 May, affecting services between Fridhemsplan and Hässelby Strand while crews carry out urgent platform reinforcement work at four underground stations. Commuters are advised to use replacement bus services on routes 177 and 178, though SL has warned that roughly 85,000 daily passengers may face delays of up to 25 minutes during peak hours.

Leverkusen's Bayer 04 edged out Eintracht Frankfurt 2–1 at the BayArena on Saturday evening in a tense Bundesliga encounter that saw midfielder Tomáš Červenka score the decisive goal just three minutes from time, extending the hosts' unbeaten home run to eleven matches in front of a capacity crowd of 30,210.

Commuters on the Northern line faced severe delays for the third consecutive morning on Wednesday after a signalling fault near Stockwell station brought southbound services to a near-standstill during the peak rush hour. Transport for London confirmed that engineers worked through the night but had not fully resolved the fault by 08:00, leaving an estimated 47,000 passengers stranded or diverted onto already-overcrowded bus replacements. A TfL spokesperson said the disruption was expected to ease by midday, though no guarantees were offered ahead of the evening peak.

Wegen umfangreicher Gleisbauarbeiten auf der S-Bahn-Linie S3 zwischen Frankfurt Hauptbahnhof und Offenbach Ost wird die Strecke vom 14. bis zum 21. März vollständig gesperrt; die Rhein-Main-Verkehrsgesellschaft richtet einen Ersatzverkehr mit Bussen ein und rechnet mit rund 45.000 betroffenen Fahrgästen täglich. Die Sperrung fällt ausgerechnet mit dem Auftakt der Frankfurter Buchmesse zusammen, die am 16. März im Frankfurter Messezentrum eröffnet wird und zu der Verlage aus über 90 Ländern erwartet werden.

Die Österreichischen Bundesbahnen haben angekündigt, dass der Fernverkehr zwischen Wien Hauptbahnhof und Salzburg Hauptbahnhof ab dem 14. März für voraussichtlich drei Wochen stark eingeschränkt wird — Grund sind umfangreiche Gleiserneuerungsarbeiten im Abschnitt Attnang-Puchheim. Betroffen sind die Intercity-Linien IC 510, IC 512 und IC 514, für die ein Schienenersatzverkehr mit Bussen eingerichtet wird. Die ÖBB rechnet mit rund 42.000 betroffenen Fahrgästen täglich und bittet Reisende, auf frühere Verbindungen auszuweichen.

Stockholm's public transport authority, SL, confirmed on Thursday that the Citybanan commuter rail tunnel will be closed for emergency track repairs between Stockholms centralstation and Sundbyberg from 14 to 21 March, affecting an estimated 340,000 daily passengers. Replacement bus services will run along the E4 corridor, though authorities warned of significant delays during peak hours. SL cited a fractured concrete sleeper discovered during routine inspection as the cause of the unplanned closure.

The Edinburgh International Festival has announced that its opening-night gala concert, headlined by soprano Mirela Vančura and the Scottish Chamber Orchestra under conductor Tomas Breit, will take place on 2 August at the Usher Hall — but festivalgoers are being warned of significant disruption on Lothian Buses services throughout the city centre from 1 August to 6 August, after drivers represented by Unite the Union voted overwhelmingly to strike over a pay dispute, a walkout expected to affect an estimated 85,000 daily passengers.

The same weekend that FC Lausanne-Sport clinched a dramatic 2–1 home victory over Servette FC at the Stade de la Tuilière — drawing a crowd of 12,400 on a cold Saturday afternoon — the city's Grand Théâtre de Lausanne opened its long-anticipated autumn festival, "Voix du Léman," with a sold-out gala concert featuring soprano Adeline Corthay and the Orchestre de Chambre de Lausanne, conducted by guest director Markus Feldbrügge. Festival organisers said the programme, which runs through November 9, will span opera, contemporary chamber music, and a rare staging of Honegger's Jeanne d'Arc au bûcher.

Edinburgh's Usher Hall will host the closing night of the Celtic Connections festival on February 1st, headlined by folk ensemble Saoirse Mór, but concert-goers are being warned that Lothian Buses will suspend all services along Lothian Road from January 31st through February 3rd owing to emergency resurfacing works — a disruption expected to affect some 14,000 daily passengers who will need to reroute via George Street.

Beim Halbfinale der Deutschen Meisterschaften im Rudern auf dem Regattastreckensee in Brandenburg an der Havel setzte sich der Berliner Ruderclub mit einer Zeit von 6:14,3 Minuten souverän gegen den Regensburger RC durch und sicherte sich damit den Einzug ins Finale. Entscheidend war der kraftvolle Endspurt von Stammsteuermann Nils Frenzel, der das Achterboot in den letzten 500 Metern auf Kurs hielt. Insgesamt verfolgten 2.800 Zuschauer das Geschehen vom Ufer aus.

Der Wiener Gemeinderat hat am Donnerstag mit 54 zu 31 Stimmen bei vier Enthaltungen einen umstrittenen Antrag zur Ausweitung des sozialen Wohnbaus abgelehnt. Die Initiative war von der FPÖ eingebracht worden und hätte die Stadt verpflichtet, jährlich mindestens 3.000 neue Gemeindewohnungen zu bauen. SPÖ-Fraktionsvorsitzende Mag. Renate Hofer erklärte, der Antrag sei „populistisch und finanzpolitisch unverantwortlich", während FPÖ-Stadtrat Ing. Gerhard Pfeiffer von einem „Verrat an den Wiener Mieterinnen und Mietern" sprach. Die Grünen enthielten sich der Stimme und begründeten dies mit fehlenden Nachhaltigkeitsklauseln im Entwurf.

Stockholm's public transport authority, SL, announced on Monday that the Tunnelbana's Green Line will be suspended between Fridhemsplan and Hässelby Strand for eleven days beginning 14 March, as engineers carry out emergency repairs to a degraded junction track bed discovered during routine inspection last week. Approximately 85,000 daily commuters are expected to use replacement bus services running at three-minute intervals, though SL has cautioned that journey times will roughly double during peak hours.

Der SV Wacker Burghausen und der TSV 1860 München lieferten sich am Samstag im Alpenbauer-Stadion ein dramatisches Regionalliga-Derby, das erst in der Nachspielzeit entschieden wurde: Lukas Feichtner erzielte in der 93. Minute das einzige Tor der Partie zum 1:0-Sieg der Gastgeber vor 4.200 Zuschauern.

The Reykjavík Art Museum opens its most ambitious group exhibition in years this Friday, with fourteen painters, sculptors, and video artists from across Scandinavia exploring the fractured geometry of coastal erosion under the title "Shoreline Fragments." Curated by Elísabet Magnúsdóttir and co-organised with the Nordic Cultural Fund, the show runs through March 9th and is expected to draw roughly 22,000 visitors over its eight-week run — a figure that would make it the museum's best-attended winter exhibition since 2019.

Borussia Dortmund rode a brace from striker Lennart Oschwald and a thunderous late header by defender Mikaël Traoré to beat Eintracht Frankfurt 3–1 at Signal Iduna Park on Saturday, moving the Black and Yellows to within four points of the Bundesliga summit. Frankfurt, who had equalised through Cédric Bourel just after the hour, were undone by two goals in the final twelve minutes before a sell-out crowd of 81,365.

Der Stadtrat von Freiburg im Breisgau hat am Donnerstagabend mit knapper Mehrheit einem umstrittenen Wohnbauprojekt im Stadtteil Weingarten zugestimmt: 27 Stimmen entfielen auf Ja, 21 auf Nein, bei drei Enthaltungen. Bürgermeisterin Karoline Fersch (Grüne) sprach von einem „notwendigen Schritt gegen die Wohnungsnot", während Fraktionschef Dietmar Holzbach von der CDU das Vorhaben als übereilt und finanziell riskant bezeichnete. Die SPD-Fraktion hatte sich im Vorfeld gespalten gezeigt, stimmte aber mehrheitlich mit den Grünen.

Ronan Kielty scored a brace in the final twelve minutes to rescue Cliftonville Athletic from what had seemed an inevitable defeat, with the hosts clawing back a 2–3 scoreline to level at 3–3 against Glentoran Rovers in a breathless Friday-night derby at Solitude Park, Belfast. A crowd of 6,200 witnessed the drama unfold across a game that swung on every loose ball, as Glentoran Rovers defender Mats Thorvaldsen was dismissed in the 78th minute for a second bookable offence. The draw keeps both clubs locked together on 41 points at the top of the Northern Irish Premiership table heading into the winter break.

The Frankfurter Buchmesse opens its doors on Wednesday for its 76th edition, drawing publishers, agents, and literary luminaries from more than 100 countries to the Messe Frankfurt fairgrounds — a sprawling complex that will host over 4,000 exhibitors across six days of panels, rights negotiations, and prize ceremonies. This year's Guest of Honour is Italy, whose pavilion, curated by the cultural institute Casa d'Italia, promises a sweeping retrospective of Italian literature from Dante to the present day. Tickets for the public weekend are priced at €18.

Am Wochenende erlebte Graz ein kulturelles und sportliches Doppelereignis: Im Stefaniensaal fand am Samstag die umjubelte Österreich-Premiere des Tanzstücks „Flügelschlag" statt, choreografiert von der Wienerin Renata Söllner und aufgeführt vom Ensemble des Grazer Tanztheaters vor ausverkauftem Haus mit rund 850 Besuchern. Nur wenige Stunden später kämpften auf dem Rasen des Merkur-Arenas Sturm Graz und Austria Wien um Punkte in der Admiral Bundesliga – ein hart umkämpftes Derby, das die Gastgeber mit 2:1 für sich entschieden, wobei der zweimalige Torschütze Ivo Krstičević den Abend für sich beanspruchte.

Commuters on the Piccadilly line faced severe disruption on Monday morning after a signalling failure between King's Cross St. Pancras and Hammersmith forced Transport for London to suspend services for nearly six hours, leaving an estimated 340,000 passengers without direct access to the route during the peak rush. TfL engineers worked through the morning to isolate the fault, with replacement bus services laid on along key stretches, though severe crowding was reported at parallel Underground stations. Full service was restored by early afternoon.

Borussia Dortmund fell to a bruising 3–1 defeat at home to Bayer Leverkusen on Saturday evening, with Leverkusen midfielder Jonas Preuß driving the result with a brace in the second half before Florian Krenz sealed it with a clinical finish in the 88th minute. A crowd of 81,365 packed Signal Iduna Park, but the hosts never recovered after Leverkusen's opener inside the first twelve minutes. The result leaves Dortmund five points adrift in the Bundesliga table heading into the winter break.

The Flemish parliament voted narrowly on Thursday to approve a contested reform of the regional language inspection regime, with 72 members in favour and 59 against, after weeks of heated debate that exposed deep rifts within the ruling coalition. Annelies Vandenberghe, the minister responsible for the bill, insisted the changes would "modernise oversight without threatening minority communities," though opposition lawmakers from Vooruit and the Greens accused her of capitulating to nationalist pressure. The vote passed without a single abstention recorded.

Der Stadtrat von Freiburg im Breisgau hat am Donnerstagabend mit knapper Mehrheit beschlossen, die Grundsteuer für Gewerbeimmobilien ab dem kommenden Jahr um 15 Prozent anzuheben — ein Schritt, den die Fraktionen der SPD und der Grünen gemeinsam durchsetzten, während CDU und FDP geschlossen dagegen stimmten. Von den 48 anwesenden Ratsmitgliedern votierten 26 für den Antrag, 19 dagegen, drei enthielten sich. Stadtrat Benedikt Haarlander von der SPD bezeichnete die Maßnahme als „längst überfälligen Beitrag zur Haushaltskonsolidierung", wohingegen die CDU-Fraktionsvorsitzende Renate Pflüger-Sommer vor einer Abwanderung mittelständischer Betriebe warnte.

The Scottish Parliament voted by 74 to 48 on Thursday to approve a £2.3 billion funding package for the long-delayed Edinburgh–Glasgow rail upgrade, a decision hailed by Transport Secretary Fiona Carmichael as a "generational commitment to sustainable travel." The bill's passage clears the way for ScotRail to begin civil works on the electrification corridor as early as next spring, with 23 new stations planned along the route and an estimated 140,000 daily commuters expected to benefit once services launch in 2029.

Borussia Dortmund hat am Samstagabend im ausverkauften Signal Iduna Park einen dramatischen 3:2-Sieg gegen den FC Augsburg eingefahren. Den Siegtreffer in der 89. Minute erzielte der erst 19-jährige Mittelfeldspieler Luca Frentzel, der mit einem präzisen Flachschuss aus 20 Metern die komplette Augsburger Defensive ins Leere laufen ließ. Mit diesem Erfolg klettert Dortmund in der Bundesliga-Tabelle auf den dritten Platz.

The Frankfurter Buchmesse opens its doors on Wednesday for a five-day run that organisers expect to draw more than 300,000 visitors to the Messe Frankfurt fairgrounds, with Norway serving as this year's guest of honour and a headline programme of Nordic fiction, poetry, and illustrated works commanding the Agora stage. Bestselling Norwegian author Sigrid Bratteland will deliver the opening address, while Frankfurt-based independent publisher Verlag der Praxis has mounted what critics are already calling the standout small-press booth of the edition.

Der Stadtrat von Freiburg im Breisgau hat am Donnerstagabend mit knapper Mehrheit beschlossen, den städtischen Wohnungsbau bis 2030 durch ein Sonderprogramm in Höhe von 45 Millionen Euro zu fördern. Der Antrag, eingebracht von der Grünen-Fraktion unter Fraktionsvorsitzender Astrid Mommsen, wurde mit 28 Ja-Stimmen, 21 Nein-Stimmen und drei Enthaltungen angenommen. Die CDU-Fraktion, angeführt von Ratsherr Benedikt Schorer, hatte das Programm als „haushaltspolitisch unverantwortlich" bezeichnet und vergeblich auf eine Verschiebung der Abstimmung gedrängt.

Die ÖBB warnt Reisende: Wegen umfangreicher Gleiserneuerungsarbeiten im Abschnitt Salzburg–Bischofshofen bleibt die Weststrecke vom 14. bis zum 21. Juli vollständig gesperrt. Betroffen sind die Linien REX 1 und RJX 60, auf denen täglich rund 18.000 Fahrgäste unterwegs sind. Ein Schienenersatzverkehr mit Bussen wird eingerichtet, verlängert jedoch die Fahrtzeit zwischen Salzburg Hauptbahnhof und Bischofshofen um bis zu 55 Minuten.

The Renfrewshire Council voted narrowly on Thursday evening to approve a controversial rezoning plan that would open protected greenbelt land on the outskirts of Paisley to residential development, with 31 councillors in favour, 27 against, and 4 abstentions. The motion, backed primarily by the Scottish National Party and a handful of independent members, drew fierce opposition from Scottish Labour and the Scottish Greens, who argued that the scheme prioritised speculative construction over environmental stewardship. Council leader Fiona Macallister, who shepherded the plan through months of procedural wrangling, called the outcome "a necessary step toward meeting the housing targets set by Holyrood," while Labour group convener Dariusz Wójcik warned that the decision would be challenged at judicial review.

Der Münchner Stadtrat hat am Donnerstagabend mit 42 zu 19 Stimmen bei 3 Enthaltungen einen umstrittenen Antrag der CSU zur Einführung einer stadtweiten Parkgebührenerhöhung abgelehnt. SPD und Grüne stimmten geschlossen dagegen; Stadtrat Benedikt Hollreiser (CSU) sprach von einem „verkehrspolitischen Rückschritt". Oberbürgermeister Dieter Reiter hatte sich im Vorfeld der Abstimmung öffentlich gegen den Vorstoß ausgesprochen.

Der Salzburger Gemeinderat hat am Donnerstagabend mit knapper Mehrheit für die Einführung einer stadtweiten Leerstandsabgabe gestimmt: 28 Ratsmitglieder votierten dafür, 24 dagegen, bei drei Enthaltungen. Die Grünen und die SPÖ hatten den Antrag gemeinsam eingebracht, während die ÖVP und die FPÖ geschlossen dagegen stimmten. Bürgermeisterin Claudia Feuerbach bezeichnete das Ergebnis als „wichtiges Signal für leistbares Wohnen in unserer Stadt".

Bergvik IK stunned hosts Sundsvall FF with a clinical 3–1 victory at Norrporten Arena on Saturday evening, ending the home side's unbeaten run in the Superettan and sending a clear message to the clubs above them in the table. Midfielder Tobias Eklund was instrumental throughout, netting twice before substitute Rasmus Ohlgren sealed the points in the final ten minutes, with an attendance of 6,840 recorded at the ground.

The Scottish Parliament voted by a narrow margin on Thursday to pass the Housing Affordability Reform Bill, with 68 members voting in favour and 55 against, amid fierce opposition from the Scottish Conservatives and two abstentions from within the governing SNP's own backbenches. Cabinet Secretary for Housing Catriona Dalmeny hailed the result as "a generational shift in how Scotland protects its renters," while Conservative housing spokesman Alasdair Munro condemned the bill as "an assault on private landlords that will drive investment out of the sector." The legislation caps annual rent increases at inflation plus one percentage point and establishes a new national rent tribunal with binding arbitration powers.

Commuters on Frankfurt's S-Bahn network faced severe disruptions on Monday after a signalling failure near Konstablerwache brought three lines to a near-standstill for more than six hours, leaving an estimated 47,000 passengers stranded or forced onto replacement bus services. RMV, the regional transit authority, said engineers worked through the night to restore full operations but warned that residual delays were likely to persist into Tuesday morning. The fault is the third major signalling outage on the network in as many months, renewing calls from city councillors for accelerated investment in digital rail infrastructure.

Commuters on the Overground faced severe delays for the third consecutive morning on Wednesday after a points failure near Highbury & Islington brought services on the Windrush Line to a near-standstill, with Transport for London estimating that roughly 47,000 passengers were affected during the peak hours alone. Engineers worked through the night but TfL confirmed that repairs would not be completed until at least Thursday evening, advising travellers to use alternative Victoria line connections where possible.

Passengers travelling on the S-Bahn network in Munich faced severe delays for the third consecutive morning on Wednesday after a signalling fault near Ostbahnhof brought services on lines S3 and S8 to a near standstill, leaving an estimated 47,000 commuters stranded or scrambling for alternative routes. Deutsche Bahn, which operates the network, said engineers had isolated the fault to a relay box dating from the 1980s and hoped to restore full service by the early afternoon, though union representatives warned that ageing infrastructure across the Stammstrecke corridor remained a chronic risk to reliability.

Tens of thousands of supporters heading to Hampden Park for Saturday's Scottish Cup Final between Celtic and Hibernian faced severe disruption after ScotRail suspended all services on the Cathcart Circle Line from 9 a.m., citing an emergency signalling fault near Crossmyloof station. Transport officials estimated that roughly 35,000 passengers would be affected, and urged fans to use a hastily arranged fleet of 60 replacement buses running between Glasgow Central and the stadium. Celtic ultimately triumphed 2–1 in front of a sold-out crowd of 51,866, with midfielder Caoimhe Ó Briain scoring the decisive goal in the 88th minute to hand Hibernian their third final defeat in six years.

The Frankfurter Buchmesse opened its doors on Wednesday to a record 4,312 exhibitors from 95 countries, with Norwegian author Silje Torgersen drawing the season's longest queues at Hall 3.1 for the launch of her debut novel "The Ice Cartographer." Guest of honour this year is Slovenia, whose pavilion — designed by Ljubljana-based architect Marko Vidmar — occupies a striking corner of Hall 4 and showcases more than two hundred titles in translation. The fair runs through Sunday.

The Scottish Parliament voted by a margin of 71 to 48 on Thursday to pass the Climate Emergency Housing Bill, a landmark measure championed by Housing Minister Fiona Drummond-Rae of the SNP that would compel local councils to retrofit social housing stock to net-zero standards by 2031. Labour abstained en bloc, with its spokesperson Alasdair Menteith calling the timeline "reckless and underfunded," while the Scottish Conservatives voted against the bill in its entirety. The result gives the SNP a significant legislative victory ahead of next year's Holyrood elections.

Die ÖBB warnen Reisende: Wegen umfangreicher Gleiserneuerungsarbeiten auf der Weststrecke zwischen Salzburg und Linz kommt es von Freitag, dem 14. März, bis einschließlich Sonntag, dem 16. März, zu erheblichen Verspätungen und Teilausfällen im Fernverkehr. Betroffen sind die Linien RJ 60, RJ 62 und IC 118; ein Schienenersatzverkehr mit Bussen wird eingerichtet. Die ÖBB rechnen mit rund 28.000 betroffenen Fahrgästen über das gesamte Wochenende.

Sligo Rovers dealt a decisive blow to Bohemian FC's title ambitions on Friday night, running out 3–1 winners at The Showgrounds in front of a passionate crowd of 4,210, with striker Ciarán Mulvey bagging a brace and midfielder Aoife Dunlea — making her first start of the season — adding a composed third late in the second half. The result leaves Bohemian rooted in fifth place in the League of Ireland Premier Division table heading into the international break.

The same weekend that the Malmö Konserthus hosted the Swedish premiere of composer Britta Söderqvist's choral symphony "Havsvind," drawing a capacity audience of 1,400 to its ornate main hall, local football club IFK Malmö recorded a nail-biting 2–1 victory over Djurgårdens IF in a Allsvenskan clash at Eleda Stadion — with striker Tomáš Načera netting the decisive goal in the 88th minute before 14,250 spectators.

Der Wiener Konzerthaus-Architekt der Nachkriegszeit sei heute weitgehend vergessen, schreibt die Architekturhistorikerin Marta Hollweg in ihrer neuen Monografie — ein Befund, der auch für zahlreiche andere Bauten der österreichischen Moderne gelte, deren Zustand zwischen denkmalpflegerischer Gleichgültigkeit und schleichendem Verfall schwanke. Hollwegs Buch erscheint im Frühjahr beim Böhlau Verlag und dürfte eine längst überfällige Debatte über Stadtplanung und kulturelles Erbe in Wien anstoßen.

Der SC Freiburg hat am Samstagabend im Schwarzwald-Stadion einen überzeugenden 3:1-Sieg gegen den 1. FC Köln eingefahren und damit seinen dritten Bundesliga-Heimsieg in Folge gefeiert. Vor 24.000 Zuschauern trafen Lena Hartmann (zweimal) und Tobias Pfeiffer für die Gastgeber, ehe Köln durch Jonas Wirz lediglich verkürzen konnte. Mit diesem Ergebnis klettert Freiburg auf den fünften Tabellenplatz der Bundesliga.

Der Stadtrat von Freiburg im Breisgau hat am Dienstagabend mit knapper Mehrheit einem neuen Radverkehrskonzept zugestimmt, das bis 2030 rund 47 Millionen Euro in den Ausbau von Fahrradinfrastruktur investieren soll. Die Abstimmung endete mit 24 Ja-Stimmen, 19 Nein-Stimmen und drei Enthaltungen. Bürgermeisterin Katharina Soltau sprach von einem „historischen Schritt für die klimagerechte Mobilität unserer Stadt", während die CDU-Fraktion unter Fraktionschef Markus Döring das Vorhaben als finanziell unverantwortlich ablehnte. Die Grünen und die SPD hatten das Konzept gemeinsam eingebracht.

Lausanne's Stade Olympique de la Pontaise hosted a gripping Swiss Super League encounter on Saturday as FC Lausanne-Sport edged visiting Servette FC 2–1, with midfielder Théo Ansermet netting a composed stoppage-time winner in front of 12,400 spectators to send the home faithful into raptures.

Borussia Dortmund hat am Samstagabend im Signal Iduna Park mit einem überzeugenden 3:1 gegen den FC Augsburg seinen ersten Heimsieg der Rückrunde gefeiert. Vor 81.365 Zuschauern erzielte Luca Ferreira zwei Treffer in der zweiten Halbzeit, nachdem Kilian Sörensen die Gäste zwischenzeitlich zum Ausgleich gebracht hatte. Mit diesem Ergebnis festigt Dortmund seinen vierten Tabellenplatz in der Bundesliga.

Oslo's city council voted narrowly on Thursday to approve a €340 million extension of the Fornebu metro line, with 31 councillors in favour and 24 against, ending months of fractious debate over the project's financing. The vote, backed chiefly by Arbeiderpartiet and the Miljøpartiet De Grønne, came just hours after Ruter, the city's public transport authority, confirmed that construction work on the new elevated section near Lysaker station would begin in early March 2026, temporarily closing Bus Route 31 for up to fourteen weeks while groundwork is laid.

Lewes FC stunned second-placed Hashtag United 3–1 at the Dripping Pan on Saturday evening in a feisty National League South encounter, with midfielder Cora Whitfield scoring twice in the opening half-hour to put the hosts in command before substitute Renata Gbemi sealed the points late on. The result keeps Lewes firmly in the playoff picture heading into the final stretch of the season.

Beim packenden Kellerduell der 2. Bundesliga setzte sich der FC Schalke 04 am Samstagabend im Veltins-Arena vor 59.600 Zuschauern mit 3:1 gegen den 1. FC Kaiserslautern durch. Florian Hettich traf doppelt, ehe Luca Veronesi mit einem Kopfballtor für den Endstand sorgte. Kaiserslauterns Anschlusstreffer durch Mirko Sandau änderte nichts am verdienten Heimsieg der Gelsenkirchener.

Der Wiener Architekt Maximilian Bredl hat in einem kürzlich erschienenen Essay für die Zeitschrift „Stadtbild" argumentiert, dass die geplante Verlängerung der U-Bahn-Linie U2 zwar verkehrspolitisch sinnvoll sei, aber das historische Erscheinungsbild des vierten Bezirks unwiederbringlich verändern könnte. Bredl verweist dabei auf ähnliche Debatten, die in den 1990er Jahren rund um den Ausbau der Pariser Métro geführt wurden, und fragt, ob Wien bereit sei, denselben Preis für Mobilität zu zahlen.

Hoffenheim held Borussia Dortmund to a tense 1–1 draw at the PreZero Arena on Saturday, with Dortmund's Emre Demir cancelling out a stunning long-range opener from Hoffenheim midfielder Lukas Brettner just four minutes before the final whistle. A crowd of 30,150 watched the Bundesliga clash, leaving Dortmund's title hopes looking increasingly fragile heading into the winter break.

Die Frankfurter Buchmesse eröffnete am Mittwoch ihre 76. Ausgabe auf dem Messegelände Frankfurt mit einem Festakt, bei dem die Schriftstellerin Leonie Vasarhely die Eröffnungsrede hielt. Rund 4.200 Aussteller aus über 90 Ländern präsentieren bis Sonntag ihre Neuerscheinungen; Ehrengastland in diesem Jahr ist Norwegen. „Literatur ist kein Luxus, sondern Atemluft", sagte Vasarhely vor einem Saal voller Verleger, Agenten und Kulturpolitiker.

The Edinburgh International Book Festival opens its doors at Charlotte Square Gardens on Friday, drawing an expected 75,000 visitors over a fortnight of readings, debates, and author signings — but attendees arriving by train should brace for disruption: ScotRail has announced that all services on the Fife Circle Line will be suspended from Friday through Sunday while engineers replace ageing overhead line equipment between Kirkcaldy and Edinburgh Waverley.

Commuters on London's Elizabeth line faced severe delays of up to ninety minutes on Thursday morning after a points failure near Paddington station brought westbound services to a near-standstill for more than four hours. Transport for London confirmed that approximately 340,000 passengers were affected before engineers restored full signalling by early afternoon, though it warned that residual disruption could persist into the evening peak.

Commuters on the Jubilee line faced severe delays for the third consecutive morning on Wednesday after a points failure near Canary Wharf station forced Transport for London to run a reduced shuttle service between Stanmore and Green Park, leaving an estimated 85,000 passengers scrambling for alternative routes during the peak hours.

The Frankfurter Buchmesse opens its doors on Wednesday, welcoming publishers, literary agents, and readers from more than 100 countries to the Messe Frankfurt fairgrounds for what organisers are calling the most internationally diverse edition in the fair's seven-decade history. This year's guest of honour is Italy, whose pavilion — curated by novelist and essayist Francesca Dellavalle — stretches across two halls and features over 200 authors, from debut voices to Nobel laureates. Tickets for the public days, running Saturday through Sunday, are priced at €18 per adult.

For decades, the crumbling elevated rail lines threading through Chicago's South Side have served as both a symbol of neglect and an unlikely canvas for muralists, whose sprawling works — depicting jazz legends, civil rights marchers, and neighborhood matriarchs — have drawn the attention of urban planners and art historians alike, though neither group has yet agreed on what, if anything, should be preserved should the infrastructure ever be torn down and rebuilt.

Stockholm's Kulturhuset Stadsteatern will host the Nordic premiere of "Ash & Iron," a multimedia theatrical production directed by Lena Vordal, from 14 to 22 March 2025 — but concertgoers and theatregoers alike should note that SL, Stockholm's public transit authority, will suspend the entire Tunnelbana green line between T-Centralen and Hässelby Strand for the duration of the run, citing urgent track-bed renewal works that engineers estimate will affect some 85,000 daily passengers. Replacement buses will operate on the route throughout, though travel times are expected to nearly double. The theatre, which sits directly above the T-Centralen interchange, has urged ticket holders to arrive by the red or blue line and allow extra time.

Die Frankfurter Buchmesse eröffnet am 15. Oktober ihre 76. Ausgabe auf dem Messegelände Frankfurt mit einem Abendempfang, zu dem rund 4.200 Gäste aus dem internationalen Verlagswesen erwartet werden. Als diesjährige Ehrengastland-Koordinatorin fungiert die Schriftstellerin Amara Diallo, die das Programm des Schwerpunktlandes Malaysia kuratiert hat. Tickets für das Fachpublikum kosten 38 Euro pro Tag.

Der Wiener Gemeinderat hat am Donnerstag mit 54 zu 31 Stimmen bei vier Enthaltungen beschlossen, das marode Volkskundemuseum im 8. Bezirk umfassend zu sanieren und ab 2026 als neues Kulturzentrum zu betreiben. Bürgermeister Michael Ludwig lobte den Beschluss als „Bekenntnis zur gelebten Stadtkultur". Zur Feier des Anlasses eröffnet das Museum bereits am kommenden Freitag eine Sonderausstellung unter dem Titel „Wien im Wandel – 200 Jahre Alltagsgeschichte", kuratiert von der Ethnologin Dr. Marta Jellinek; die Schau läuft bis Ende März und ist für Besucher kostenlos zugänglich.

Der Stadtrat von Freiburg im Breisgau hat am Donnerstagabend mit knapper Mehrheit beschlossen, den städtischen Wohnungsbauplan für die kommenden zehn Jahre zu verabschieden: 27 Ratsmitglieder stimmten dafür, 19 dagegen, bei vier Enthaltungen. Die Vorlage, die von Bürgermeisterin Claudia Werneck (Grüne) eingebracht worden war, sieht die Errichtung von mindestens 4.800 neuen Sozialwohnungen bis 2034 vor. Die oppositionelle CDU-Fraktion kritisierte den Plan als „finanziell unrealistisch", während SPD und Grüne die Abstimmung als wichtiges Signal für soziale Wohnungspolitik feierten.

The Frankfurter Buchmesse opened its doors on Wednesday to record crowds, with this year's 75th edition drawing an estimated 285,000 visitors across five days to the Messe Frankfurt fairgrounds. Guest of honour this year is Italy, and the sprawling halls buzzed with panel discussions, signings, and rights negotiations that extended well into each evening. "We have never seen such appetite for Italian literature," said fair director Klara Wendelborn at the opening ceremony, citing a surge in translation deals brokered since Monday's trade days began.

Wegen des Bundesliga-Spitzenspiels zwischen dem FC Bayern München und Borussia Dortmund am Samstag, dem 14. Juni, rechnet die MVG mit einem massiven Fahrgastaufkommen rund um die Allianz Arena und verlängert deshalb die U6 bis Mitternacht im Fünf-Minuten-Takt. Das Spiel, das um 18:30 Uhr angepfiffen wird, gilt als richtungsweisendes Duell um die Meisterschaft; laut Klub sind bereits 75.000 Tickets vergriffen. Die MVG bittet alle Besucher, auf das Auto zu verzichten und stattdessen die Sonderzüge zu nutzen, um Verkehrschaos in der Stadt zu vermeiden.

Commuters across the Greater Manchester area faced severe disruption on Monday after Avanti West Coast suspended all services between Manchester Piccadilly and Liverpool Lime Street following the discovery of a signalling fault near Warrington Bank Quay. Rail replacement buses were laid on within two hours, but transport officials warned that full service restoration was unlikely before Wednesday evening, leaving an estimated 47,000 passengers to seek alternative routes over the two-day period.

Am Wochenende verwandelte sich die Hansestadt Lübeck in ein Zentrum des Sports und der Kultur: Am Samstag gewann der VfB Lübeck das Derby gegen den Kieler SV vor ausverkauftem Haus in der Lohmühle mit 3:1, wobei Stürmer Mats Brederlow mit einem Doppelpack der überragende Akteur war. Nur wenige Stunden später eröffnete Regisseurin Sofía Varela im Kolosseum Lübeck die diesjährige Ausgabe des Nordlichter Filmfestivals, das bis zum kommenden Sonntag mehr als vierzig internationale Produktionen zeigen wird.

Beim packenden Stadtduell in der 2. Bundesliga setzte sich der Hamburger SV am Freitagabend im Volksparkstadion mit 3:1 gegen den FC St. Pauli durch. Vor 57.000 Zuschauern war es Mittelfeldspieler Jonas Krebsbach, der mit einem Doppelpack in der zweiten Halbzeit die Partie entschied, während Stürmer Luca Ferreira den zwischenzeitlichen Anschlusstreffer für den Gast erzielte. Mit diesem Sieg festigt der HSV seinen Platz an der Tabellenspitze.

Rail passengers travelling between Cologne and Brussels face significant disruption this week after Infrabel, the Belgian rail infrastructure manager, confirmed that a 14-kilometre stretch of the high-speed line near Liège will be closed for emergency track replacement works. The closure, which began on Monday and is expected to last until Sunday evening, is forcing Eurostar and Thalys services to divert via a slower conventional route, adding up to 55 minutes to journey times. An estimated 38,000 passengers are affected over the course of the six-day shutdown.

The Barbican Centre will host a five-day retrospective of Finnish composer Kaija Saariaho's orchestral and chamber works beginning 14 March, with the BBC Symphony Orchestra performing across three evening concerts and the Kronos Quartet appearing for an intimate afternoon session on 16 March. Tickets are priced at £35 for individual events, with a festival pass available at £120. Curator Leena Mäkinen, who assembled the programme over two years, described the series as "the most comprehensive survey of Saariaho's acoustic writing ever staged in Britain."

Rīga Dinamo edged out Frölunda HC 3–2 in overtime at the Arēna Rīga on Saturday evening, with forward Mārcis Ozoliņš converting a wrist shot 84 seconds into the extra period to seal the win before a crowd of 9,800 in the SHL Challenge Cup group stage opener.

Die Kunstmesse art Cologne eröffnet am 16. April in den Kölner Messehallen ihre 57. Ausgabe und versammelt nach Angaben der Veranstalterin Magdalena Ferst rund 190 Galerien aus 30 Ländern unter einem Dach. Erstmals kuratiert die in Brüssel lebende Kunstkritikerin Solvei Hartmann einen eigenen Sektor für zeitgenössische Druckgrafik, der laut Messeleitung besonderes Interesse bei Sammlern aus dem frankofonen Raum geweckt hat. Eintrittskarten für den Publikumstag sind ab 28 Euro erhältlich.

The Dublin city council voted narrowly on Thursday evening to approve a sweeping new housing affordability ordinance, with 32 councillors in favour, 27 against, and four abstentions — a result that Sinn Féin hailed as a "generational shift" in municipal policy, while Fine Gael's local leader, Councillor Declan Murtagh, warned that the measure would place an "unsustainable burden" on private developers. The vote, held at the Wood Quay Venue, caps months of acrimonious debate over rent controls and social housing targets in the capital.

Die Frankfurter Buchmesse eröffnet am 15. Oktober ihre 76. Ausgabe auf dem Messegelände Frankfurt mit einem Abendempfang im Kaisersaal des Römers. Als Ehrengast präsentiert sich in diesem Jahr Norwegen; die norwegische Verlegerin Astrid Nyhus wird die offizielle Länderpräsentation leiten, während der Schriftsteller Tor Eivind Haugen die Eröffnungslesung übernimmt. Insgesamt werden rund 4.200 Aussteller aus mehr als 95 Ländern erwartet, und die Messe läuft bis zum 19. Oktober.

The Scottish Parliament voted by a margin of 72 to 49 on Thursday to pass the Climate Accountability (Scotland) Bill, a landmark piece of legislation championed by Environment Secretary Moira Callander that would bind future governments to net-zero targets enforceable in court — a result that drew immediate condemnation from Scottish Conservative leader Fraser Dunbar, who called the bill "a bureaucratic straitjacket dressed up as ambition."

The Reykjavík Art Museum opens its long-anticipated survey of Nordic textile art, "Threads of the North," on Friday, bringing together more than eighty woven and embroidered works by thirty-two artists from Iceland, Norway, and the Faroe Islands. Curated by Sigríður Magnúsdóttir and Oslo-based critic Halvard Nesse, the exhibition runs through 14 September and occupies all three floors of the Hafnarhús building. Admission is set at 2,500 Icelandic króna for adults.

The Reykjavík City Council voted late Thursday to approve a sweeping overhaul of the capital's affordable housing policy, with 11 councillors in favour, 4 against, and 2 abstentions — a result that surprised even senior members of the ruling Left-Green Movement, who had privately feared a closer contest. Council chair Sigríður Elínardóttir called the margin "a mandate we intend to honour swiftly," pledging that the first new social housing units would break ground before the end of the fiscal year. The conservative Independence Party, which had led fierce opposition to the plan throughout weeks of committee hearings, vowed to challenge its implementation at every opportunity.

Wegen dringender Gleiserneuerungsarbeiten im Bereich des Hauptbahnhofs kommt es auf den S-Bahn-Linien S3 und S5 im Raum Frankfurt am Main vom 14. bis einschließlich 17. März zu erheblichen Einschränkungen: Die RMV-Züge verkehren in diesem Zeitraum nur im 30-Minuten-Takt, während ein Schienenersatzverkehr zwischen Darmstadt und Bad Vilbel eingerichtet wird. Nach Angaben der DB Regio AG sind rund 48.000 Fahrgäste täglich betroffen.

The same weekend that Lazio edged Fiorentina 2–1 in a tense Serie A clash at the Stadio Olimpico in Rome — a match decided by a last-minute header from striker Davide Quaresma — the Auditorium Parco della Musica, just a few kilometres north, opened its landmark retrospective of sculptor Marta Valloni, drawing over 4,200 visitors on the first day alone and marking the institution's most anticipated cultural event since its centenary celebrations in 2019.

The Barbican Centre will host a landmark retrospective of Scottish-Ghanaian sculptor Adwoa Mensah-Fairlie opening on 14 March, with the exhibition — titled "Threshold" — running through 2 June and bringing together more than sixty large-scale bronze and cast-iron works drawn from public and private collections across three continents. Curated by the Barbican's own Petra Lindqvist, the show is expected to draw upwards of 120,000 visitors over its twelve-week run, making it one of the centre's most ambitious solo presentations in recent memory.

Reigning champions Dinamo Zagreb held Hajduk Split to a bruising 1–1 draw at the Stadion Maksimir on Saturday evening, with Luka Šarić's last-gasp equaliser cancelling out Tomislav Brkić's composed first-half finish before a crowd of 33,412 in what many are already calling the most fiercely contested Croatian derby of the current Hrvatska nogometna liga season.

The Hamburger Kunsthalle opens its long-awaited retrospective of Norwegian painter Astrid Veland on Friday, bringing together more than 140 works spanning four decades of her career — from the brooding fjordscapes of her early Oslo years to the luminous, geometrically charged canvases she has produced since relocating to Berlin. Curated by Dr. Maja Frisch, the exhibition will run through 15 March and is expected to draw visitors from across Scandinavia and beyond.

The Flemish parliament in Brussels voted narrowly on Thursday to approve a sweeping housing affordability bill championed by the liberal Open VLD faction, with 71 members voting in favour, 58 against, and 4 abstaining — a result that Flemish Minister-President Lena Vanthemeulen hailed as "a turning point for working families locked out of the property market." The Groen party, which had pushed unsuccessfully for stronger rent-cap provisions, said it would monitor implementation closely and reserved the right to challenge the legislation in the Constitutional Court.

Lena Kowalczyk held off a late surge from defending champion Amara Diallo to win the Hamburg Marathon in a course record of 2:21:44 on Sunday, crossing the finish line at the Alster waterfront to a roar from an estimated 38,000 spectators. The Polish long-distance runner, who had trailed Diallo by nearly two minutes at the halfway mark, reeled her rival in over the final ten kilometres in what seasoned observers called one of the most dramatic reversals in the race's forty-year history.

Die Frankfurter Buchmesse eröffnet am 15. Oktober ihre 76. Ausgabe auf dem Messegelände Frankfurt und erwartet in diesem Jahr erstmals seit der Pandemie wieder mehr als 300.000 Besucher. Als Ehrengastland präsentiert sich Portugal mit einem breit gefächerten Programm aus Lesungen, Podiumsgesprächen und Musikeinlagen, das von der Kulturorganisation DGLAM kuratiert wurde. „Wir wollen zeigen, dass portugiesische Literatur weit über Pessoa hinausgeht", sagte Messedirektorin Catarina Velho bei der Pressekonferenz in Frankfurt.

Oslo's public transport authority Ruter confirmed on Thursday that the Fornebubanen metro extension will open to passengers on 4 October 2025, adding six new underground stations between Majorstuen and Fornebu and bringing the total line 2 network to 34 kilometres. The NOK 22 billion project, years in the making, is expected to relieve severe overcrowding on the city's west-corridor bus routes and carry an estimated 50,000 additional passengers daily once fully operational.

The Scottish Parliament voted narrowly on Thursday to pass the Communities Reinvestment Act, a landmark bill channelling an additional £340 million into rural housing and public transport in the Highlands and Islands, with 67 members voting in favour and 59 against, while 3 abstained. The Scottish National Party and the Scottish Greens, who jointly shepherded the legislation through three months of committee scrutiny, hailed the result as a generational shift in regional policy; the Scottish Conservatives, led in debate by shadow finance spokesman Alasdair Muirhead, condemned the spending commitments as "reckless in the extreme." First Minister Catriona Dempster is expected to sign the bill into law at Holyrood before the end of the month.

Der Stadtrat von Freiburg im Breisgau hat am Donnerstagabend mit knapper Mehrheit beschlossen, das städtische Klimaschutzprogramm für die kommenden zehn Jahre zu verabschieden. Bei der Abstimmung votierten 28 Ratsmitglieder dafür, 19 dagegen, während sich vier Mitglieder der Stimme enthielten. Stadträtin Marlene Vögtli von den Grünen bezeichnete das Ergebnis als „historischen Schritt für eine lebenswerte Innenstadt", während der Fraktionsvorsitzende der CDU, Rainer Sobotta, vor zu hohen Belastungen für den Mittelstand warnte. Die FDP enthielt sich geschlossen und forderte eine externe Wirtschaftsprüfung, bevor die ersten Maßnahmen in Kraft treten.

The Frankfurter Buchmesse opened its doors on Wednesday for its 76th edition, drawing more than 300,000 visitors to the Messe Frankfurt fairgrounds over five days and cementing the city's reputation as the undisputed capital of the international publishing world. This year's guest of honour, Italy, presented a sprawling pavilion curated by Chiara Lombardi that traced the arc of Italian literature from the Renaissance to contemporary voices such as Elena Ferrante and Roberto Saviano. "We wanted to show that Italian writing is not a monument but a living conversation," said Lombardi at the opening ceremony. Tickets for the public days were priced at €18.

The Frankfurter Buchmesse opened its doors on Wednesday to a record 4,312 exhibitors from 95 countries, with this year's Guest of Honour pavilion dedicated to Slovenia drawing particular praise from critics who noted the country's quietly extraordinary tradition of illustrated poetry. Festival director Mirjam Osterfeld described the mood as "electric," adding that advance ticket sales had already surpassed €2.1 million by Tuesday evening.

ÖBB has confirmed that engineering works on the Westbahn corridor between Salzburg and Linz will force a complete suspension of intercity rail services for eleven days beginning 14 March, with replacement bus coaches operating on a reduced schedule and journey times expected to nearly double. An estimated 38,000 passengers per day will be affected, the operator said in a statement released Friday, urging travellers to rebook on alternative routes via Vienna where capacity allows.

The Scottish Parliament voted on Thursday to extend free bus travel to all residents under the age of 22, with the SNP government's motion passing by 74 votes to 43, after a fractious two-hour debate in which Conservative MSPs argued the policy would strain an already overstretched transport budget. Labour backed the measure, while the Liberal Democrats abstained. Transport Secretary Fiona Gillespie — a first-term MSP appointed to the role just six months ago — hailed the result as "a generational shift in how young Scots access their communities."

Die Berliner S-Bahn muss in der kommenden Woche mit erheblichen Einschränkungen rechnen: Wegen dringender Gleiserneuerungsarbeiten zwischen den Bahnhöfen Ostkreuz und Ostbahnhof wird die S3 vom 14. bis einschließlich 22. Juli vollständig gesperrt. Rund 85.000 Fahrgäste täglich sind betroffen; ein Schienenersatzverkehr mit Bussen wird laut S-Bahn Berlin eingerichtet, erwartet jedoch deutlich längere Reisezeiten. Die BVG bittet alle Pendler, auf U-Bahn-Linien auszuweichen.

The Reykjavík Art Museum opens its most ambitious survey in years this Thursday, bringing together the large-format canvases of Icelandic painter Sigrún Baldvinsdóttir alongside immersive video installations by Berlin-based artist Moritz Schellhaas in an exhibition titled "Thresholds of Light." Curated by Áslaug Pétursdóttir, the show will run through March 9 and is expected to draw visitors from across Scandinavia. Admission is set at 1,800 krónur for adults.

Vojvodina edged Čukarički 2–1 in a hard-fought Serbian SuperLiga encounter at Stadion Karađorđe on Saturday evening, with substitute Lazar Nešić converting a 87th-minute penalty to seal all three points in front of a crowd of 8,400.

Commuters on the U6 and U9 lines in Munich faced severe delays Monday morning after an overhead cable fault near Sendlinger Tor brought services to a standstill for nearly three hours, stranding an estimated 47,000 passengers across the network. Münchner Verkehrsgesellschaft engineers worked through the disruption to restore full operations by 11:15 a.m., though residual congestion on connecting tram routes persisted into the early afternoon.

Der Stadtrat von Freiburg im Breisgau hat am Donnerstagabend mit knapper Mehrheit beschlossen, den städtischen Haushalt für das kommende Jahr um 47 Millionen Euro zu kürzen — ein Sparpaket, das vor allem Kultureinrichtungen und Sozialleistungen treffen wird. Die Grünen und die SPD stimmten geschlossen gegen die Vorlage, während CDU und FDP die nötigen Stimmen lieferten. „Wir haben keine andere Wahl", erklärte Bürgermeisterin Karoline Metzger, die erst im Februar dieses Jahres ihr Amt angetreten hatte. Insgesamt votierten 28 Ratsmitglieder für das Paket, 19 dagegen, bei drei Enthaltungen.

The Flemish parliament voted narrowly on Thursday to approve a sweeping overhaul of the region's housing subsidy framework, with the centre-right N-VA pushing the bill through by just four votes despite fierce opposition from the Vooruit and Groen parties. The final tally stood at 71 in favour, 67 against, and 3 abstentions, as housing minister Lieselot Vandenberghe hailed the result as "a turning point for Flemish homeownership policy." Critics warned the reforms would disproportionately burden lower-income renters across Antwerp and Ghent.

Die Frankfurter Buchmesse eröffnet am 15. Oktober ihre 76. Ausgabe auf dem Messegelände Frankfurt und erwartet in diesem Jahr rund 95.000 Fachbesucher aus aller Welt. Als Ehrengastland wurde Österreich ausgewählt, das mit einem umfangreichen Programm aus Lesungen, Podiumsgesprächen und Ausstellungen vertreten sein wird. Kuratorin des österreichischen Auftritts ist die Wiener Literaturwissenschaftlerin Dr. Veronika Stadlbauer, die laut Veranstalter einen besonderen Schwerpunkt auf zeitgenössische Lyrik legen möchte.

Die Berliner S-Bahn warnt Fahrgäste vor erheblichen Beeinträchtigungen auf der Stammstrecke: Wegen dringender Gleiserneuerungsarbeiten zwischen den Bahnhöfen Ostbahnhof und Alexanderplatz werden die Linien S5, S7 und S75 vom 14. bis zum 21.
