Juli vollständig gesperrt. Ein Schienenersatzverkehr mit Bussen der BVG wird eingerichtet, doch die Berliner Verkehrsbetriebe rechnen täglich mit rund 85.000 betroffenen Pendlern.

Commuters on Stockholm's tunnelbana faced widespread delays on Wednesday morning after a signalling fault on the green line brought services between Fridhemsplan and Hässelby Strand to a near standstill for roughly four hours. Storstockholms Lokaltrafik confirmed that around 85,000 passengers were affected during the peak period and that replacement bus services were deployed on stretches of the route, though queues at several stations quickly overwhelmed capacity. Engineers cleared the fault by early afternoon, and SL said a full investigation into the ageing relay infrastructure would be launched before the end of the week.

The Reykjavík Art Museum opens its long-awaited retrospective of Icelandic sculptor Dagný Sigurbjörnsdóttir on Friday, bringing together more than 140 works spanning four decades of her career in stone, glass, and cast iron. Curated by Þór Einarsson, the exhibition will occupy all three floors of the Hafnarhús building and run through 14 September. Admission is set at 2,500 Icelandic króna for adults, with free entry for visitors under eighteen.

The Scottish Parliament voted narrowly on Thursday to approve a sweeping new tenants' rights bill, with 68 members in favour and 57 against, after a fractious three-hour debate that exposed deep divisions between the SNP-led government and a fragile Conservative–Labour bloc opposed to the rent control measures at its core. Deputy First Minister Catriona Lisle hailed the result as "a generational shift in housing justice," while the Conservatives' housing spokesperson Alasdair Munn denounced the legislation as economically reckless.

Grasshopper Club Zürich came from behind to defeat FC Winterthur 3–2 in a tense Super League encounter at the Letzigrund on Saturday, with midfielder Luca Betschart netting the decisive goal in the 88th minute to send the home faithful into raptures. A crowd of 11,400 was present to witness Winterthur's late collapse, which leaves them rooted to the foot of the table heading into the winter break.

Trelawney Rovers edged out Saltholm FC 2–1 in a bruising Sunday afternoon clash at Carrow Meadow, with striker Bénédicte Nzali netting the winner from the spot in the 84th minute to keep the Rovers top of the Wessex Regional League table heading into the winter break.

The Frankfurter Buchmesse opens its doors on Wednesday for a five-day run that will see publishers, literary agents, and readers from more than 100 countries converge on the Messe Frankfurt fairgrounds — a sprawling complex that has hosted the world's largest book fair since the postwar era. This year's Guest of Honour is Slovenia, whose pavilion, curated by Nataša Brelih, promises an ambitious programme of readings, panel discussions, and installations exploring Slovenian literature's engagement with Central European memory. Ticket prices for day visitors have been set at €18.

Der Wiener Gemeinderat hat am Donnerstagabend mit 54 zu 38 Stimmen bei vier Enthaltungen einem umstrittenen Wohnbaupaket zugestimmt, das den Bau von 12.000 neuen Sozialwohnungen bis 2030 vorsieht. Die regierende Koalition aus SPÖ und NEOS setzte sich damit knapp gegen die vereinte Opposition durch, bestehend aus FPÖ, ÖVP und den Grünen. Stadtrat für Wohnen Benedikt Haslinger sprach von einem „historischen Schritt für leistbares Wohnen in Wien", während FPÖ-Fraktionschefin Marlene Gruber das Paket als „finanzpolitisch unverantwortlich" bezeichnete. Die Abstimmung fand im Rathaus Wien statt und zog zahlreiche Mieterrechtsaktivisten auf die umliegenden Plätze.

The Swedish Riksdag voted late on Thursday to approve a sweeping overhaul of the country's housing subsidy framework, with the ruling coalition securing a narrow majority of 176 votes in favour against 173 opposed, following nearly six hours of fractious debate in which opposition leader Britta Söderholm accused Finance Minister Lennart Carlenius of "burying the welfare state one clause at a time." The Sverigedemokraterna abstained, leaving the passage of the bill to rest on the combined support of the Moderaterna and Kristdemokraterna alone.

Der Wiener Gemeinderat hat am Donnerstag mit knapper Mehrheit einem umstrittenen Wohnbaupaket zugestimmt: 54 Stimmen entfielen auf Ja, 45 auf Nein, bei drei Enthaltungen. Die SPÖ und die Grünen stimmten geschlossen für die Vorlage, während ÖVP und FPÖ geschlossen dagegen votierten. Bürgermeister Michael Ludwig zeigte sich nach der Abstimmung erleichtert und sprach von einem „historischen Schritt für leistbares Wohnen in Wien".

Die ÖBB haben am Dienstag bekanntgegeben, dass die Weststrecke zwischen Salzburg und Linz vom 14. bis 28. Februar wegen umfangreicher Gleiserneuerungsarbeiten vollständig gesperrt wird. Rund 42.000 Fahrgäste täglich sind von der Unterbrechung betroffen; als Ersatz verkehren Schienenersatzbusse auf der gesamten Strecke. „Wir bitten um Verständnis für die unvermeidlichen Einschränkungen", sagte ÖBB-Sprecherin Marlene Hofreiter.

The Olympiastadion München will host a rare double-bill weekend on 14–15 June, opening Saturday evening with a headline concert by indie-folk ensemble The Wren Collective before Sunday's Bundesliga relegation play-off between TSV 1860 München and Karlsruher SC draws an estimated 60,000 supporters. Festival organisers at Münchner Kulturamt confirmed that the concert — billed as part of the SommerKlang Festival's twentieth edition — will feature support from vocalist Nadja Taborska and a full chamber orchestra, with tickets priced at €55 per person. TSV 1860's manager, Torsten Bleichert, struck a cautious note ahead of the Sunday fixture, telling reporters that his side had prepared meticulously despite the condensed turnaround following the stadium's concert setup.

Leinster ran in seven unanswered tries at the Aviva Stadium on Saturday evening to dismantle Stade Toulousain 49–14 in a breathtaking United Rugby Championship quarter-final, with flanker Ciarán Mosley named player of the match after scoring twice and setting up a further three. An attendance of 48,200 packed the Dublin ground, making it the largest crowd at an Irish club fixture this season.

Montserrat Rowing Club's senior four claimed a commanding victory at the Liffey Descent on Saturday, finishing ahead of Clonmel Boat Club by a margin of nearly forty seconds to lift the open category title for the third consecutive year. The winning crew, steered by veteran cox Rónán Tully, completed the 19-kilometre course in a time that drew sustained applause from spectators lining the riverbanks around Palmerstown. Clonmel's stroke, Áine Ferriter, called the defeat "bitterly disappointing" but pledged a stronger challenge when the two clubs meet again at the National Rowing Championships in Cork next spring.

Der Stuttgarter Gemeinderat hat am Donnerstag mit 38 zu 14 Stimmen bei zwei Enthaltungen beschlossen, die marode Stadtbahnlinie U12 zwischen Hallschlag und Hedelfingen bis Ende 2027 grundlegend zu sanieren. Das Infrastrukturprojekt, das laut Stadtverwaltung rund 214 Millionen Euro kosten soll, war von der SPD-Fraktion und den Grünen gemeinsam eingebracht worden und stieß auf heftigen Widerstand der FDP. Während der Sanierungsarbeiten wird die Linie U12 ab dem 3. März 2025 für voraussichtlich 18 Monate vollständig gesperrt; der Stuttgarter Straßenbahnen-Betrieb soll betroffenen Fahrgästen – täglich rund 23.000 – mit Schienenersatzverkehr entgegenkommen.

The Frankfurter Buchmesse opened its doors on Wednesday for a five-day run that organisers expect to draw more than 300,000 visitors to the Messe Frankfurt fairgrounds, with this year's guest of honour nation being Italy — represented by a sprawling pavilion featuring over forty living authors, among them the celebrated novelist Carla Trentini and the poet Davide Russo, who will give a joint reading on Friday evening.

Der Wiener Architekt und Kulturhistoriker Mag. Florian Sattler widmet sich in seinem neuen Buch einer oft übersehenen Frage: Wie prägen Bahnhöfe das kollektive Gedächtnis einer Stadt? Am Beispiel des Hauptbahnhofs Wien und des Frankfurter Hauptbahnhofs analysiert er, wie Infrastrukturprojekte des 19. und frühen 20. Jahrhunderts bis heute die urbane Identität formen – eine Lektüre, die Stadtplaner ebenso wie Kulturinteressierte ansprechen dürfte.

Galatasaray held Fenerbahçe to a tense 1–1 draw at Rams Park on Saturday evening, a result that leaves both Istanbul giants locked together on 54 points at the top of the Süper Lig table with just four rounds remaining. Emre Doğan's deflected strike on the stroke of half-time cancelled out a superb early opener from Fenerbahçe's Croatian winger Luka Bašić, and neither side could find a winner despite a breathless second half that saw two goals ruled out for offside. The attendance of 51,200 made it the loudest edition of the Intercontinental Derby in three seasons.

The Flemish parliament narrowly approved a sweeping overhaul of regional housing subsidies on Thursday, with 72 votes in favour and 61 against, after nearly six hours of fractious debate during which opposition lawmakers from Vooruit and the Greens accused the ruling coalition of gutting protections for low-income tenants. The bill, championed by Housing Minister Lieselotte Vanderbrugge and backed by the N-VA–CD&V–MR alliance, now passes to the Council of State for a constitutional review before taking effect.

Die Österreichischen Bundesbahnen haben angekündigt, dass die Weststrecke zwischen Wien Westbahnhof und Salzburg Hauptbahnhof vom 14. bis zum 28. Juli wegen umfangreicher Gleissanierungsarbeiten vollständig gesperrt wird — rund 42.000 Fahrgäste täglich sind davon betroffen. Schienenersatzverkehr mit Bussen wird eingerichtet, verlängert jedoch die Fahrzeit auf der Strecke um schätzungsweise zwei Stunden.

Die Frankfurter Buchmesse eröffnete am Mittwoch ihre 76. Ausgabe mit einem Festakt im Römer, an dem rund 1.200 geladene Gäste teilnahmen. Als Ehrengast des diesjährigen Messeauftritts fungierte die slowenische Autorin Maja Kovič, deren jüngster Roman „Steinzeit" vom Suhrkamp Verlag herausgegeben wurde. Börsenvereins-Chefin Petra Waldmann betonte in ihrer Eröffnungsrede, dass die Messe trotz des anhaltenden Wandels im Buchhandel eine unverzichtbare Plattform für den literarischen Austausch bleibe. Die Messe läuft bis zum 20. Oktober in Frankfurt am Main.

Long before Camp Nou became a cathedral of modern football, architects and urban planners in Barcelona were debating what a stadium should actually be — a civic monument, a transport hub, or simply a container for noise. The question, revisited in a sweeping new essay by critic Marta Soldevila in the pages of The Architectural Review, remains stubbornly unresolved, touching as it does on the competing claims of FC Barcelona supporters, local transit authority TMB, and the Ajuntament de Barcelona itself, which has commissioned at least three inconclusive feasibility studies since 2018.

Commuters across Frankfurt faced mounting frustration on Thursday after a signalling fault at Konstablerwache brought S-Bahn services on lines S3, S4, and S6 to a near-standstill for roughly four hours during the morning rush, with RMV estimating that upwards of 74,000 passengers were affected before crews restored full operations shortly before noon.

The Frankfurter Buchmesse opens its doors on Wednesday for its 76th edition, welcoming publishers, agents, and literary enthusiasts from more than 100 countries to the Messe Frankfurt fairgrounds. This year's guest of honour is Italy, with a programme curated by Simonetta Raimondi featuring readings, panel discussions, and installations by some of the country's most celebrated contemporary authors. Ticket prices start at €18 for a single day, with the fair running through Sunday.

Commuters on the Jubilee line faced severe delays for a third consecutive morning on Wednesday after a points failure near Canning Town forced Transport for London to suspend services between Stratford and Waterloo & City interchange, leaving an estimated 47,000 passengers scrambling for alternative routes. TfL engineers worked through the night but warned that full restoration was unlikely before Thursday evening at the earliest.

Der Wiener Gemeinderat hat am Donnerstag mit 54 zu 38 Stimmen bei vier Enthaltungen beschlossen, die städtische Wohnbauförderung bis 2030 deutlich auszubauen. Bürgermeister Michael Ludwig hatte die Initiative persönlich unterstützt, während die oppositionelle FPÖ das Vorhaben als „unverantwortliche Ausgabenpolitik" scharf ablehnte. Stadtrat für Wohnen, Clemens Favreau, zeigte sich nach der Abstimmung erleichtert und sprach von einem „historischen Schritt für leistbares Wohnen in Wien".

Die Frankfurter Buchmesse eröffnet am 15. Oktober ihre 76. Ausgabe auf dem Messegelände Frankfurt mit mehr als 4.000 Ausstellern aus über 100 Ländern. Als Gastland des Jahres präsentiert sich Italien mit einem umfangreichen Programm an Lesungen, Podiumsgesprächen und Buchpräsentationen in Halle 4.1. Der Direktor des Ehrengastauftritts, Marco Pellegrini, erklärte, das Motto „La Radice e il Ramo" solle die Kontinuität der italienischen Literatur von der Antike bis zur Gegenwart spiegeln. Erwartet werden rund 180.000 Besucherinnen und Besucher bis zum 19. Oktober.

The Frankfurter Buchmesse opens its 76th edition on Wednesday, drawing publishers, agents, and literary scouts from more than 100 countries to the Messe Frankfurt fairgrounds for five days of rights negotiations, author readings, and panel discussions. This year's Guest of Honour is Italy, whose pavilion — curated by the Istituto per il Commercio Estero — spans three halls and features over 200 Italian authors, among them the novelist Federica Almerano and the poet Giulio Santarossa. Organiser Juergen Boos, the fair's director, called the programme "the most ambitious we have assembled in a decade." Tickets for public days are priced at €18.

The Frankfurter Buchmesse opens its doors on Wednesday for its 76th edition, welcoming publishers, agents, and readers from more than 100 countries to the Messe Frankfurt fairgrounds. Guest of honour this year is Norway, whose pavilion — curated by novelist Sigrid Undset Foundation director Karin Brattås — promises a sweeping showcase of contemporary Scandinavian writing. Ticket prices begin at €18 for a single day, with the fair running through Sunday.

Commuters on the U5 and U8 lines in Berlin faced significant delays on Friday morning after a signalling fault at Alexanderplatz brought large sections of both routes to a standstill for nearly four hours, leaving an estimated 85,000 passengers stranded or forced to seek alternative transport. The BVG dispatched replacement bus services along the affected corridors but warned that full service would not resume until early afternoon. A spokesperson for the operator attributed the fault to ageing relay infrastructure installed in the early 1990s, adding that a comprehensive modernisation programme worth €340 million had already been approved by the Berlin Senate and was expected to begin in spring 2026.

The Scottish Parliament voted by a razor-thin majority on Thursday to approve a sweeping new housing affordability bill championed by Housing Minister Fiona Dreich, with 65 MSPs in favour and 61 against, while the Scottish Conservatives and a handful of dissident Labour members urged the government to commission an independent economic review before any legislation took effect. Speaking from Holyrood, First Minister Catriona Mulgrew hailed the result as "a generational shift" in how Scotland addresses the rental crisis gripping Glasgow, Edinburgh, and smaller market towns alike.

The Frankfurter Buchmesse opens its doors on Wednesday for a five-day run that organisers expect to draw more than 300,000 visitors to the Messe Frankfurt fairgrounds, with Norwegian literature taking centre stage as the guest-of-honour theme. Among the headliners is debut novelist Astrid Voll Hagen, whose first novel "Tidvann" — rendered into English by translator Siobhán Ferriter — will receive its international premiere at Hall 3.1 on Thursday evening before an anticipated audience of 1,200.

Der Stadtrat von Freiburg im Breisgau hat am Donnerstagabend mit knapper Mehrheit beschlossen, die Straßenbahngebühren bis Ende des Jahres einzufrieren — ein Sieg für die Grünen und die SPD, die gemeinsam den Antrag eingebracht hatten. Die CDU-Fraktion stimmte geschlossen dagegen, während drei Ratsmitglieder der FDP sich enthielten. Bürgermeisterin Klara Sonnenschein sprach von einem „wichtigen Signal für die soziale Gerechtigkeit in unserer Stadt", wohingegen CDU-Fraktionsvorsitzender Rolf Maierhofer die Entscheidung als „finanzpolitisch unverantwortlich" bezeichnete. Das Ergebnis: 24 Stimmen dafür, 19 dagegen, drei Enthaltungen.

The Austrian capital had a triumphant weekend on two fronts: the Vienna Philharmonic closed its summer residency at the Musikverein on Saturday with a sold-out performance of Mahler's Sixth Symphony under conductor Lena Obrecht, drawing an audience of 1,870, while across town at the Ernst-Happel-Stadion, Rapid Wien edged Austria Wien 2–1 in a tense Wiener Derby before 47,500 supporters to cement their lead at the top of the Bundesliga Austria table.

Riding a second-half brace from striker Tomás Reinholt, Djurgårdens IF came from behind to beat IFK Göteborg 3–1 at Tele2 Arena on Saturday evening, pulling the Stockholm club level on points with the Allsvenskan summit ahead of next week's international break. A crowd of 19,340 witnessed Göteborg's early opener, converted by midfielder Axel Sundqvist, before Reinholt levelled just before the hour and then added a penalty with twelve minutes remaining; substitute Priya Nkosi sealed the result in stoppage time.

Wegen umfangreicher Gleissanierungsarbeiten zwischen den Stationen Westbahnhof und Hütteldorf sperrt die ÖBB die S-Bahn-Linie S50 ab Montag, dem 14. April, für voraussichtlich drei Wochen vollständig. Rund 28.000 Fahrgäste täglich sind von der Maßnahme betroffen; als Ersatz werden Busse im Zehn-Minuten-Takt auf der betroffenen Strecke eingesetzt. Die Wiener Linien ersuchen Pendlerinnen und Pendler, auf die U-Bahn-Linie U4 auszuweichen.

Commuters across Greater Manchester faced severe disruptions on Thursday after Metrolink workers walked off the job in a 24-hour strike over a pay dispute, halting services on the Altrincham, Eccles, and Airport lines and stranding an estimated 85,000 passengers. Transport for Greater Manchester confirmed that replacement bus services would operate at reduced frequency throughout the day, and urged travellers to allow extra time or consider alternative routes. Talks between TfGM and the Amalgamated Rail & Tram Workers Union are expected to resume on Friday.

Der Stadtrat von Erfurt hat am Donnerstagabend mit knapper Mehrheit beschlossen, den städtischen Nahverkehrsvertrag bis 2032 zu verlängern und dabei gleichzeitig eine schrittweise Anhebung der Sozialticket-Subventionen um insgesamt 4,2 Millionen Euro zu genehmigen — ein Erfolg für die rot-grüne Rathauskoalition, die den Antrag trotz heftigen Widerstands der CDU-Fraktion durchsetzte. Von den 58 anwesenden Stadtratsmitgliedern stimmten 31 dafür, 24 dagegen, bei drei Enthaltungen. Bürgermeisterin Karoline Wettstein zeigte sich erleichtert: „Das ist ein klares Signal, dass Erfurt soziale Mobilität ernst nimmt."

Die Frankfurter Buchmesse eröffnete am Mittwoch ihre 76. Ausgabe auf dem Messegelände Frankfurt mit einem Festakt, bei dem die Verlegerin Sibylle Okonkwo die diesjährige Eröffnungsrede hielt. Rund 4.200 Aussteller aus 95 Ländern präsentieren bis Sonntag ihre Neuerscheinungen; Ehrengast ist in diesem Jahr Norwegen. Der Eintritt für Fachbesucher beträgt 38 Euro pro Tag.

The Reykjavík City Council narrowly approved a sweeping housing-densification plan on Thursday evening, with councillors voting 9 to 6 in favour after nearly three hours of fractious debate. The measure, championed by the centre-left Independence Party bloc, would allow mid-rise residential construction across seventeen previously protected low-density neighbourhoods. Two abstentions from the Progressive Party delegation were seen as decisive in preventing an outright defeat. "This is a historic step toward making Reykjavík liveable for the next generation," said council leader Sigríður Ólafsdóttir, whose remarks drew both applause and jeers from a packed public gallery.

The city of Salzburg played host to a rare double billing this past weekend: on Saturday evening, the Mozarteum Foundation opened its eagerly awaited "Echoes of the Alps" chamber-music festival at the Großes Festspielhaus, where Norwegian violinist Astrid Vellum led a programme of Schubert and Sibelius before an audience of roughly 1,400 listeners, while Sunday afternoon saw FC Red Bull Salzburg dismantle visiting Sturm Graz 3–1 at the Red Bull Arena in a commanding Austrian Bundesliga fixture, with midfielder Tomáš Červenka netting twice to seal the hosts' fourth consecutive home victory.

The Irish Senate voted narrowly on Thursday to ratify a landmark housing reform package backed by the ruling coalition, with 32 senators in favour, 19 against, and 4 abstentions — a majority secured only after Fianna Fáil threatened to withdraw support for a competing amendment tabled by Sinn Féin. Senator Aoife Ní Bhriain, who shepherded the bill through three weeks of committee hearings at Leinster House in Dublin, called it "the most consequential shelter legislation in a generation." The reforms, which cap private rent increases at 2 per cent annually and compel local authorities to fast-track planning approvals on public land, had drawn fierce opposition from independent senators aligned with property lobby groups.

Frankfurt's regional transit authority RMV confirmed on Thursday that engineering works on the S-Bahn S3 and S4 lines between Darmstadt Hauptbahnhof and Frankfurt Süd will force a full suspension of services from 22 March to 7 April, affecting an estimated 47,000 daily commuters. Replacement bus coaches will operate at reduced frequency, and RMV has urged passengers to use the parallel U-Bahn U2 where feasible. The works, valued at €31 million, centre on the renewal of overhead line infrastructure and platform extensions at four intermediate stations.

The Frankfurter Buchmesse opens its doors on Wednesday for a five-day run that will see publishing houses from more than ninety countries converge on the Messe Frankfurt, with Norwegian literature taking centre stage as this year's Guest of Honour. Organisers say they expect upwards of 300,000 visitors before the fair closes on Sunday, making it once again the largest trade gathering in the book world. Among the headline events, debut novelist Astrid Vølund will read from her internationally acclaimed first work alongside veteran translator Henning Scharff, whose German renderings of Scandinavian fiction have won widespread praise.

Benedikt Haugen's second-half brace rescued Rosenborg BK from what looked like a humiliating home defeat, as the Norwegian side came from two goals down to draw 2–2 with Molde FK at Lerkendal Stadion on Saturday evening, leaving both clubs level on 41 points heading into the winter break.

Kaylee Drummond's brace in the final eleven minutes rescued Coventry United from what looked like a certain defeat, as the visitors came from two goals down to draw 2–2 with Durham Women at Maiden Castle on Sunday, leaving both sides level on points at the top of the FA Women's Championship table.

Vienna's city council approved a landmark €2.3 billion infrastructure package on Thursday, clearing the way for a sweeping expansion of the U-Bahn network that will add eleven new stations along a proposed U6 southern extension into the Liesing district. The vote passed 43 to 19, with four abstentions, after weeks of fractious debate between the SPÖ-led coalition and opposition bloc NEOS over cost projections. ÖBB and Wiener Linien will jointly operate the new corridor, with construction scheduled to begin in March 2026 and the first trains expected to run by late 2031.

The Stuttgart city council voted 38 to 14 on Thursday to approve a €2.4 billion funding package for the long-delayed extension of U-Bahn line U6 to the Vaihingen district, with Mayor Franziska Wördemann hailing the decision as "a turning point for sustainable mobility in the south of the city." The vote, pushed through by a coalition of the Grüne and SPD against fierce opposition from the AfD and parts of the CDU, paves the way for construction to begin as early as spring 2026, with the Stuttgarter Straßenbahnen AG set to oversee the seven-station, 8.3-kilometre expansion and deliver it by 2031.

The Frankfurter Buchmesse opened its doors on Wednesday to a record 4,312 exhibitors from 95 countries, with this year's guest of honour nation, Slovenia, presenting a pavilion curated by literary scholar Maja Vidmar that drew considerable attention from publishers and agents alike. The fair, now in its 76th edition, runs through Sunday at Messe Frankfurt.

Commuters across Greater Manchester faced severe disruption on Monday after Avanti West Coast and Northern Rail both suspended services between Manchester Piccadilly and Liverpool Lime Street, citing a fractured overhead line near Warrington Bank Quay that engineers estimated would take at least 72 hours to repair. Transport for Greater Manchester urged passengers to seek alternative routes via the Metrolink tram network or National Express coach services, warning that upwards of 34,000 daily travellers could be affected. A spokesperson for Network Rail confirmed that repair crews were on site by midday and that a full investigation into the infrastructure failure had been launched.

Commuters on Frankfurt's S-Bahn network faced significant disruption on Monday after a signal fault near Hauptwache station brought four lines to a standstill for nearly six hours, with RMV estimating that roughly 85,000 passengers were affected during the morning and evening rush. Repair crews from DB Netz worked through the afternoon to restore full service, though residual delays persisted well into Tuesday night. RMV advised travellers to use U-Bahn and tram alternatives where possible.

Commuters across the Swiss capital faced significant delays on Monday morning after a signal failure on the RBS suburban rail network forced the suspension of services between Bern Hauptbahnhof and Worb Dorf for nearly four hours, stranding an estimated 12,000 passengers during the peak rush. Bernmobil tram lines 6 and 9, pressed into partial relief duty, were themselves overwhelmed within the first thirty minutes. RBS engineers restored full service shortly before noon, attributing the fault to a software glitch introduced during overnight maintenance.

Ob das neue Radwegenetz im Süden Wiens tatsächlich die erhoffte Entlastung für den Pendlerverkehr bringen wird, bleibt unter Verkehrsplanern umstritten — zumal ähnliche Projekte in Hamburg und Zürich bislang nur gemischte Ergebnisse gezeigt haben. Die Wiener Linien und das Stadtplanungsamt haben zwar gemeinsame Absichtserklärungen veröffentlicht, doch konkrete Zeitpläne fehlen weiterhin. Beobachter verweisen auf die komplizierte Gemengelage aus Bezirkspolitik, knappen Budgets und dem anhaltenden Druck mehrerer Bürgergruppen, die eine Verbreiterung der Ringstraße kategorisch ablehnen.

Die ÖBB haben für den Zeitraum vom 14. bis 21. März 2026 umfangreiche Streckensperrungen auf der Weststrecke zwischen Wien Westbahnhof und Salzburg Hauptbahnhof angekündigt, da dringend notwendige Erneuerungsarbeiten an der Oberleitung durchgeführt werden müssen. Betroffen sind die Fernverkehrslinien RJX 60 und RJX 62 sowie mehrere Regionalzüge; Reisende werden gebeten, auf Schienenersatzverkehr auszuweichen. Die ÖBB schätzen, dass rund 85.000 Fahrgäste täglich von den Einschränkungen betroffen sein werden.

Im mit 34.200 Zuschauern ausverkauften Volksparkstadion setzte sich der Hamburger SV am Samstagabend mit 3:1 gegen den FC Hansa Rostock durch und festigte damit seine Tabellenführung in der 2. Bundesliga. Lena Bratkovski, die erst im Sommer verpflichtete Mittelstürmerin, erzielte einen Doppelpack und ließ die Ränge toben. Für Hansa traf lediglich Ondřej Pánek per Elfmeter in der 78. Minute – zu wenig, um die Partie noch zu drehen.

Commuters on the Jubilee line faced severe disruption on Thursday morning after a signalling fault near Canary Wharf station forced Transport for London to suspend services between Stratford and Waterloo for nearly four hours, leaving an estimated 85,000 passengers scrambling for alternative routes. TfL said engineers were on site within minutes and service was fully restored by midday, though knock-on delays persisted well into the afternoon peak.

Commuters on Berlin's S-Bahn network faced significant delays on Monday morning after a signalling fault near Ostkreuz brought three lines to a near-standstill for more than four hours, with S-Bahn Berlin GmbH estimating that roughly 47,000 passengers were affected before normal service was restored shortly before midday. The operator confirmed that engineering crews worked through the disruption to isolate the fault, and that no infrastructure damage had been sustained.

Der Wiener Gemeinderat hat am Donnerstag mit 54 zu 37 Stimmen bei vier Enthaltungen beschlossen, das Volkstheater mit zusätzlichen 2,8 Millionen Euro jährlich zu fördern — ein Sieg für die regierende Koalition aus SPÖ und NEOS gegenüber der oppositionellen FPÖ. Kulturstadträtin Veronika Hartl bezeichnete die Entscheidung als „klares Bekenntnis zur lebendigen Stadtkultur". Das Volkstheater selbst feiert die Neuregelung mit einer Premierenserie: Ab dem 14. März eröffnet Intendantin Sophia Brennecke die neue Spielzeit mit einer Neuinszenierung von Ödön von Horváths „Geschichten aus dem Wiener Wald", für die der Regisseur Luca Ferretti aus Mailand gewonnen werden konnte.

Stockholm's public transport operator SL has confirmed that the Tunnelbana's Green Line will be suspended between Fridhemsplan and Västra Skogen from 5 January to 19 January 2026 to allow contractors to replace ageing signalling infrastructure — a project that is expected to affect roughly 87,000 daily commuters. Replacement bus services will run at reduced frequency along the corridor, and SL has urged passengers to consider the Tvärbanan light rail as an alternative for part of the journey.

Im ausverkauften Rheinstadion empfingen die Fortuna Düsseldorf II am Samstagabend den VfL Bochum II und lieferten sich vor 4.200 Zuschauern einen packenden Regionalliga-West-Kracher, den die Gastgeber dank eines Doppelpacks von Stürmer Lennart Brohse mit 3:1 für sich entschieden.

The Scottish Parliament voted by a narrow margin on Thursday to approve a sweeping overhaul of the country's social care funding framework, with 68 MSPs in favour, 54 against, and 7 abstentions. The bill, championed by Social Care Minister Fiona Drummond, passed despite fierce opposition from the Scottish Conservative group, who warned that the reforms would strain already depleted local council budgets. The Scottish National Party and the Scottish Greens together secured the majority needed, with First Minister Humza Yousaf hailing the outcome as "a generational step forward for dignity in old age."

Trailing by two sets and seemingly on the brink of elimination, Marek Solowiński staged a stunning comeback at the Rothenbaum on Sunday, dismantling top seed Fábio Carvalho 4–6, 3–6, 7–5, 6–4, 6–2 to reach the quarter-finals of the Hamburg Open. The 23-year-old Pole, ranked 74th in the world, converted six of his nine break-point opportunities in the decisive final set, leaving a sell-out crowd of 9,800 on its feet for the closing games.

The Swedish Riksdag narrowly approved a landmark climate bill on Thursday, with 176 members voting in favour and 173 against, after weeks of fractious debate that saw the Moderaterna and Sverigedemokraterna vote as a bloc against the ruling coalition's signature environmental legislation. Prime Minister Astrid Lindqvist-Holm, whose Social Democrats had staked considerable political capital on the measure, called the result "a turning point for Swedish industrial policy" in a brief statement outside the chamber in Stockholm.

The Vienna city council voted on Thursday to allocate €2.4 million toward a sweeping renovation of the Volkstheater, with councillors from the SPÖ and the Grüne forming a slim majority of 41 to 33 against a sceptical ÖVP bloc — a result that cultural director Marta Seifert hailed as "a long-overdue commitment to living culture." The refurbished theatre is set to reopen with a landmark festival, Wien Spielt, scheduled across twelve days in October, featuring directors including Tomáš Vondráček and Sibylle Maar in a programme spanning new Austrian drama, contemporary dance, and multilingual performance work drawn from the Danube region.

Hawthorn midfielder Declan Ó Briain ran out the undisputed best player on the ground as the Hawks overcame Port Adelaide 14.11 (95) to 10.8 (68) at the Adelaide Oval on Saturday, drawing a crowd of 41,203 in what was a decisive round-fourteen fixture of the AFL Premiership Season.

Grasshopper Club Zürich came from behind to defeat Servette FC 3–2 in a tightly contested Swiss Super League fixture at the Letzigrund on Saturday evening, with striker Luca Baumann netting the decisive header in the 89th minute before a crowd of 11,400.

Tens of thousands of cycling fans poured into Copenhagen on Saturday for the opening stage of the PostNord Danmark Rundt, only to find that an unplanned closure of the Øresund Line between Copenhagen Central Station and the airport had stranded many ticketed spectators mid-journey. DSB, the Danish state railway, said a signalling fault discovered at 06:15 forced the suspension of all services on the line until early afternoon, leaving an estimated 12,000 passengers to seek replacement bus connections. Despite the chaos, a crowd of 34,000 eventually packed the start area near Rådhuspladsen to cheer on a 176-strong peloton, with Danish favourite Mikkel Troelsen crossing the opening time-trial finish line in a course-record 21 minutes and 44 seconds.

Der Wiener Architekt Clemens Rautenberg hat sich in einem kürzlich erschienenen Essay im Feuilleton der Frankfurter Allgemeinen Zeitung mit der Frage auseinandergesetzt, ob der geplante Neubau einer Straßenbahnlinie entlang des Donaukanals dem historischen Stadtbild Wiens gerecht werden kann. Rautenberg, der an der Technischen Universität Wien lehrt, verweist dabei auf internationale Vergleiche aus Amsterdam und Zürich und plädiert für eine breitere öffentliche Debatte, bevor konkrete Baumaßnahmen beschlossen werden.

Defending champions Dinamo Zagreb were held to a frustrating 1–1 draw by Hajduk Split at Stadion Poljud on Saturday evening, a result that leaves both clubs level on points at the top of the HNL table with seven matches remaining. Luka Petranović's clinical header in the 34th minute cancelled out an early penalty converted by Hajduk's Marko Šimunović, and neither side could find a winner despite a frantic final quarter-hour in front of 31,500 roaring supporters.

A sell-out crowd of 2,400 filled the Barbican Centre on Friday evening for the European premiere of Taiwanese composer Mei-Ling Chou's choral symphony "Rivers Without Names," performed by the BBC Symphony Chorus under the baton of conductor Piotr Wałęsa-Krul. The ninety-minute work, which draws on indigenous Taiwanese vocal traditions and late-Romantic orchestration, was presented as part of the London Contemporary Music Forum's autumn season and received four standing ovations before the night was out.

The Scottish Parliament voted narrowly on Thursday to reject a proposed amendment to the Housing (Scotland) Bill that would have capped private rental increases at three percent annually, with 63 votes against the measure, 58 in favour, and 4 abstentions — a result that drew sharp criticism from Miriam Dalgety of the Scottish Greens, who called the outcome "a capitulation to landlord interests" and vowed to reintroduce the clause during the bill's third reading.

Die Frankfurter Buchmesse eröffnete am Mittwoch ihre 76. Ausgabe mit einem Festakt in der Festhalle Frankfurt, an dem rund 7.200 Verlagsvertreter, Autoren und Agenten aus 95 Ländern teilnahmen. Als diesjährige Ehrengast-Nation präsentierte sich Malaysia mit einem weitläufigen Pavillon im Herz der Halle 4.1, kuratiert von der Literaturwissenschaftlerin Siti Rahimah Binti Zulkifli. Die Schriftstellerin Annika Thorvaldsen hielt die Eröffnungsrede und warnte eindringlich vor den Folgen algorithmischer Entscheidungssysteme für die Verlagsbranche.

The Scottish Parliament voted narrowly on Thursday to reject a proposed expansion of the Low Emission Zone in Glasgow, with 64 MSPs opposing the measure and 59 in favour, after Scottish Labour and the Scottish Conservatives joined forces to defeat the Scottish National Party government's flagship clean-air bill. Opposition spokespeople argued the scheme would disproportionately burden rural commuters, while SNP transport minister Catriona Gillies insisted the bill was "essential to saving lives in our most congested corridors."

The Frankfurter Buchmesse opens its doors on Wednesday for a five-day run that will see publishers, agents, and literary scouts from more than 100 countries converge on the Messe Frankfurt fairgrounds, with Norwegian author Silje Ørstavik headlining a packed programme of readings and panel discussions. Organisers have confirmed a record 4,312 exhibitors for this year's edition, surpassing the previous high set in 2019. Ticket prices for day visitors have been set at €18, while professional accreditation remains available through the fair's official channels.

Beim packenden Stadtderby in der Regionalliga Bayern trennten sich der TSV Schwabmünchen und der FC Memmingen am Samstag mit 2:2, wobei Stürmer Lukas Hörmann in der 88. Minute mit einem sehenswerten Freistoß den Ausgleich für die Gastgeber erzielte und damit für tosenden Jubel im Heimstadion sorgte. Vor 3.400 Zuschauern im Schwabmünchner Allstadion war es ein Spiel auf Augenhöhe, das beiden Mannschaften wichtige Punkte im Aufstiegskampf sichert.

Riding a blistering final kilometre, Ethiopian long-distance runner Fikre Tadesse crossed the finish line in 2:04:38 to claim victory at the Frankfurt Marathon on Sunday, edging out Kenya's Samuel Koech by just four seconds in what race director Maren Vollstedt called "the closest finish in the event's modern history." A crowd of 47,000 spectators packed the streets around Römerberg as the two men duelled through the final stretch, with Tadesse pulling clear only at the 300-metre mark.

The Wiener Festwochen opened its 72nd edition on Friday evening with a sweeping production of Heiner Müller's "Hamletmaschine" at the Burgtheater, directed by the Polish-born theatre provocateur Magdalena Krawczyk, whose staging drew a capacity crowd of some 1,340 and earned a prolonged standing ovation. Festival director Tomáš Bureš described the evening as "a reckoning with European amnesia," and hinted that the programme's remaining six weeks — running through to 22 June — would push even harder against the boundaries of text-based performance.

Commuters across Greater Manchester faced significant delays on Monday morning after Avanti West Coast and Northern Rail both suspended services on the Liverpool–Manchester corridor, citing a fractured overhead line near Eccles station that engineers estimated would take at least 36 hours to repair. Transport for Greater Manchester urged passengers to seek alternatives via Metrolink where possible, but tram services were already running at capacity by 08:30, leaving an estimated 47,000 travellers stranded or rerouted. A spokesperson for Network Rail confirmed that replacement bus services would operate between Manchester Piccadilly and Liverpool Lime Street for the duration of the outage.

The Frankfurter Buchmesse opens its doors on Wednesday for a five-day run that organisers say will draw more than 300,000 visitors to the Messe Frankfurt fairgrounds, with Norwegian literature taking centre stage as the guest of honour nation. Among the highlights is a keynote address by debut novelist Ingrid Solhaug, whose first novel, translated into fourteen languages, has already become one of the season's most talked-about titles across Scandinavia and beyond.

Die ÖBB haben für den Zeitraum vom 14. bis 21. März auf der Weststrecke zwischen Wien Hauptbahnhof und Salzburg Hauptbahnhof umfangreiche Gleiserneuerungsarbeiten angekündigt, die zu erheblichen Einschränkungen im Fernverkehr führen werden. Betroffen sind die Linien railjet 660 und 662 sowie mehrere Intercity-Verbindungen, die während der gesamten Woche entweder umgeleitet oder durch Schienenersatzverkehr ersetzt werden. Die ÖBB schätzen, dass täglich rund 18.400 Fahrgäste von den Ausfällen betroffen sein werden. Fahrgäste werden gebeten, sich vor Reiseantritt über aktuelle Abfahrtszeiten auf der ÖBB-Website zu informieren.

Saoirse Hennessy-Wall struck a clinical hat-trick as Galway United dismantled Bohemian FC 4–1 at Eamonn Deacy Park on Saturday evening, a result that sends the hosts six points clear at the top of the SSE Airtricity Women's Premier Division with just five rounds remaining. The 22-year-old midfielder, who had been sidelined for three weeks with a hamstring complaint, showed no signs of rust, converting twice from open play and once from the penalty spot before substitute Róisín Callery added a fourth in stoppage time. A crowd of 3,180 — a new seasonal record for the ground — roared their approval under the floodlights long after the final whistle.

The Frankfurter Buchmesse opens its doors on Wednesday for its 76th edition, welcoming publishers, agents, and readers from more than 100 countries to the Messe Frankfurt fairgrounds. This year's guest of honour is Italy, whose pavilion — curated by Claudia Ferrante and designed around the theme of literary migration — promises to be among the most visited spaces on the floor. Ticket prices start at €18 for a single day's entry, and organisers expect roughly 300,000 visitors across the five-day run.

Beim packenden Halbfinale der Deutschen Volleyball-Meisterschaft in der Frankfurter Ballsporthalle setzte sich der SV Friedrichshafen am Samstagabend mit 3:1 gegen die Berlin Recycling Volleys durch und buchte damit das Ticket fürs Endspiel. Vor 4.200 Zuschauern ragte Zuspieler Markus Velhagen mit einer Passquote von über 92 Prozent heraus, während sein Gegenpart Jonas Søndergaard bei den Berlinern trotz aufopferungsvollem Einsatz nicht genug Mittel fand, um die Niederlage abzuwenden.

Die Berliner S-Bahn hat ab kommendem Montag für voraussichtlich drei Wochen umfangreiche Gleisbauarbeiten auf der Stadtbahn angekündigt, die den Abschnitt zwischen Ostbahnhof und Zoologischer Garten betreffen. Betroffen sind die Linien S5, S7 und S75, für die ein Ersatzverkehr mit Bussen eingerichtet wird. Die Berliner Verkehrsbetriebe schätzen, dass täglich rund 85.000 Fahrgäste von den Einschränkungen betroffen sein werden.

Wegen des Halbfinals im DFB-Pokal zwischen dem FC St. Pauli und Borussia Dortmund am Mittwochabend im Millerntor-Stadion werden die Hamburger Verkehrsbetriebe (HVV) ab 17 Uhr zusätzliche U-Bahn-Züge auf der Linie U3 einsetzen und die Taktfolge auf fünf Minuten verdichten, um die erwarteten 28.000 Zuschauer zu bewältigen. Das Spiel, das erst in der Verlängerung entschieden wurde, endete 3:2 für den FC St. Pauli, der damit zum ersten Mal seit 2002 ins Pokalfinale einzieht.

The Flemish Parliament voted narrowly on Thursday to approve a controversial coalition agreement between the N-VA, Vlaams Belang, and cd&v, ending six months of fractious negotiations that had threatened to collapse three times before a deal was finally struck in Brussels. The pact, which passed by 72 votes to 61 with four abstentions, grants sweeping new powers to the regional government over immigration enforcement and social housing allocation — measures that drew immediate condemnation from opposition leader Sofie Vermeersch of Vooruit, who called the agreement "a blueprint for institutional exclusion." Premier-designate Koen Adriaensens, a relative newcomer to Flemish politics despite his two terms on the Ghent city council, is expected to be formally sworn in before the end of the month.

The Scottish Parliament voted narrowly on Thursday to extend free childcare entitlement to all children aged two and under, with the Scottish National Party and the Scottish Greens combining to secure a majority of just four votes against a joint Conservative and Labour opposition. "This is a generational commitment," said Fiona Gillespie, the Social Justice Secretary, who steered the bill through three turbulent weeks of committee scrutiny. The final tally was 68 votes in favour and 64 against, with two abstentions.

Der Stadtrat von Erfurt hat am Donnerstagabend mit knapper Mehrheit einem neuen Radwegekonzept zugestimmt, das bis 2030 den Ausbau von insgesamt 47 Kilometern neuer Fahrradinfrastruktur vorsieht. Für den Beschluss stimmten 28 Ratsmitglieder, dagegen votierten 21, bei vier Enthaltungen. Bürgermeisterin Carola Reindorf sprach von einem „Meilenstein für die Verkehrswende in Thüringen", während die Fraktionsvorsitzende der CDU, Magdalene Strauß, die fehlende Finanzierungsplanung als „grob fahrlässig" kritisierte. Die Koalition aus SPD und Grünen hatte die Vorlage gemeinsam eingebracht.

Mit einem knappen 2:1-Sieg über den FC Erzgebirge Aue sicherte sich der SV Wehen Wiesbaden am Samstagabend den Einzug in die zweite Runde des DFB-Pokals. Vor 4.200 Zuschauern im Brita-Arena erzielte Mittelfeldspieler Jonas Feldhoff in der 87. Minute den entscheidenden Treffer und bewahrte sein Team damit vor der Verlängerung.

The Reykjavík City Council voted narrowly on Thursday to approve a sweeping housing affordability ordinance, with 13 councillors in favour and 9 opposed, after more than four hours of fractious debate in which Councillor Þóra Björnsdóttir of the Left-Green Movement accused the governing coalition of having "buried" residents' submissions in committee. The ordinance, championed by Mayor Árni Sigurjónsson, caps rent increases at three per cent annually for dwellings built before 1990 and expands the city's social housing fund by 400 million króna over the next two years.

Reigning champions Dynamo Tallinn held off a spirited late fightback from FC Sūduva to win 3–2 at the A. Le Coq Arena on Saturday evening, securing their place in the second round of the Baltic Cup with a game to spare. Midfielder Rasmus Kaljurand was the decisive figure, converting a coolly taken penalty in the 74th minute after Sūduva had pulled the deficit back to one, while goalkeeper Ott Lepik made two crucial stops in stoppage time to preserve the result before a crowd of 6,200.

The Scottish Parliament voted by a narrow margin on Thursday to advance a landmark tenancy reform bill, with 68 members backing the measure against 57 opposed and four abstaining. The bill, championed by Housing Minister Catriona Dunbar of the Scottish National Party, would cap private rent increases at three percent annually and extend eviction protections for low-income households. Conservative and Labour MSPs largely united in opposition, arguing the legislation would deter investment in Scotland's already strained rental market. "This is a generational shift in how we protect renters," Dunbar told the chamber before the final division.

Commuters across greater Stockholm faced significant disruption on Monday after Storstockholms Lokaltrafik announced an unplanned suspension of the Green Line between Fridhemsplan and Skärmarbrink, citing a signalling fault detected in the early hours of the morning. Engineers worked through the day to isolate the fault, but SL warned that services could remain interrupted until at least Wednesday evening, with an estimated 87,000 daily passengers advised to use replacement bus routes 55 and 57 or transfer onto the Red Line at T-Centralen.

Der Wiener Gemeinderat hat am Donnerstag mit 54 zu 31 Stimmen bei vier Enthaltungen einem umstrittenen Maßnahmenpaket zur Wohnraumförderung zugestimmt, das von der rot-pinken Koalition aus SPÖ und NEOS eingebracht worden war. Bürgermeister Michael Ludwig zeigte sich zufrieden mit dem Ergebnis, während die oppositionelle FPÖ das Vorhaben als „ideologischen Irrweg" scharf ablehnte. Die neuen Regelungen sollen ab 1. März 2025 in Kraft treten und unter anderem die gemeinnützige Bauwirtschaft in Wien mit zusätzlichen 120 Millionen Euro jährlich stärken.

The Reykjavík Art Museum opens its long-anticipated retrospective of Icelandic sculptor Brynja Sigurðardóttir on Friday, drawing together more than ninety works in bronze, basalt, and cast glass spanning four decades of her career. Curated by Þóra Einarsdóttir of the Nordic Arts Council, the exhibition — titled "Stone Memory" — will occupy all three floors of the Hafnarhús building through late March, offering an immersive survey that the museum's director, Gunnar Þórðarson, describes as "the most significant solo show in our institution's history."

Im Kellerduell der 2. Bundesliga setzte sich der FC Schalke 04 am Samstagabend vor 59.714 Zuschauern in der Veltins-Arena mit 3:1 gegen den Hamburger SV durch und kletterte damit zumindest vorläufig aus der Abstiegszone. Den entscheidenden Doppelpack schnürte Mittelstürmer Tomás Vedral, der in der 67. und 81. Minute traf, während Florian Kesse den Ehrentreffer für die Gäste besorgte.

Hoffenheim came from behind to claim a dramatic 3–2 victory over Werder Bremen at the PreZero Arena on Saturday, with midfielder Lukas Fennrich netting the decisive goal in the 88th minute to send the home faithful into raptures. The result lifts Hoffenheim to fifth place in the Bundesliga table, while Bremen's slim European ambitions look increasingly precarious after their third defeat in four league outings. An attendance of 26,500 saw a match that, for long stretches, seemed destined for the visitors before Fennrich's late intervention rewrote the script entirely.

Commuters across greater Oslo faced widespread disruption on Monday after Ruter AS announced an indefinite suspension of tram services on lines 12 and 19 following the discovery of critical fatigue cracks in a section of track near Jernbanetorget station. Engineers estimated that repairs would require at least three weeks, and replacement bus services were deployed along both corridors to accommodate an estimated 47,000 daily passengers. Ruter urged travellers to allow extra time and to consult the updated route planner on its app.

Hannover 96 ended a four-game losing streak with a hard-fought 2–1 victory over Karlsruher SC at HDI Arena on Saturday, with midfielder Tobias Wrenner netting the decisive goal in the 87th minute to lift the hosts into the top half of the 2. Bundesliga table. An attendance of 28,400 turned the ground into a cauldron of noise as the home side overturned an early deficit, and manager Delia Fröschke praised the squad's resilience in her post-match press conference.

Commuters on the S-Bahn network in Munich faced severe disruptions on Thursday after a signalling fault near Ostbahnhof brought the S1, S2, and S8 lines to a standstill for nearly four hours during the morning rush, stranding an estimated 85,000 passengers. Deutsche Bahn engineers restored partial service by midday, though the operator warned that residual delays would persist into the evening peak.

Commuters across the Oslo metropolitan area faced widespread delays on Thursday after Ruter suspended all tram services on lines 11, 12, and 19 due to a signalling fault traced to a faulty relay box near Majorstuen station. The disruption, which stretched through the evening peak hours, affected an estimated 47,000 passengers, with Ruter deploying replacement bus services along the affected corridors while engineers worked to restore normal operations.

Copenhagen's city council voted narrowly on Thursday to approve a €340 million expansion of the Metro network, extending Line M4 northward to Hellerup with four new stations — a project championed by the Social Democrats but fiercely contested by the Conservative People's Party, which argued the funds should instead address housing shortages. The vote passed 35 to 28, with three abstentions. Construction is expected to begin in March 2025 and will bring significant disruptions to bus routes 14, 26, and 47 along the Østerbro corridor for an estimated eighteen months, according to Movia, the regional transit authority.

The Flemish parliament voted narrowly on Thursday to approve a controversial housing subsidy reform, with 71 members backing the measure and 64 opposing it, while 5 abstained. The bill, championed by N-VA and its junior coalition partner CD&V, would redirect €340 million in annual rental assistance toward first-time homebuyers in Flanders — a shift critics from Vooruit and Groen condemned as abandoning the most vulnerable tenants. "This is a fundamental reorientation of Flemish social policy," said N-VA floor leader Marieke Vandenberghe, speaking from the plenary chamber in Brussels. The vote is expected to face a legal challenge before the Constitutional Court within weeks.

Commuters across the Rhine-Main region faced a second consecutive morning of severe delays on Tuesday after the Regionalbahn RB15 and two S-Bahn lines were suspended between Frankfurt Hauptbahnhof and Darmstadt following overnight emergency repairs to a damaged overhead wire near Langen. RMV, the regional transport authority, warned that services would remain disrupted until at least Thursday evening and urged passengers to use replacement bus services running at 20-minute intervals. An estimated 47,000 daily passengers are affected by the outage, which engineers attribute to storm damage sustained during Monday night's gale.

Wegen des Bundesliga-Heimspiels des FC Augsburg gegen Bayer 04 Leverkusen am kommenden Samstag rechnet der Augsburger Verkehrsverbund (AVV) mit erheblichen Beeinträchtigungen auf mehreren Buslinien rund um die WWK Arena. Für die Dauer des Spielbetriebs — voraussichtlich von 15:30 bis 18:00 Uhr — werden die Linien 32, 43 und 56 umgeleitet, da die Zufahrtsstraßen zur Arena für den regulären Verkehr gesperrt bleiben. Das Spiel, das im Rahmen des 28. Spieltags der Fußball-Bundesliga stattfindet, wurde zuletzt durch einen Doppelpack des Augsburger Stürmers Kilian Deisenberger in der Hinrunde bekannt; diesmal dürfte der Druck auf Leverkusens Abwehrreihe erneut hoch sein. Reisenden empfiehlt der AVV, auf Sonderbusse ab dem Hauptbahnhof Augsburg umzusteigen.

Commuters across Greater Manchester faced significant delays on Monday morning after Avanti West Coast and Northern Rail both suspended services between Manchester Piccadilly and Liverpool Lime Street, citing a signalling fault near Warrington Bank Quay that engineers estimated would take at least six hours to resolve. Transport for Greater Manchester confirmed that approximately 47,000 passengers were affected during the morning peak, with replacement bus services operating on a reduced schedule.

Die Frankfurter Buchmesse eröffnet am 15. Oktober ihre 76. Ausgabe auf dem Messegelände Frankfurt mit einem Festakt, bei dem die Schriftstellerin Leonie Valdmann die Eröffnungsrede halten wird. Ehrengast ist in diesem Jahr die Republik Slowenien. Rund 4.200 Aussteller aus über 100 Ländern haben ihre Teilnahme zugesagt, und die Veranstaltung läuft bis zum 20. Oktober.

Commuters on the Merseyrail network faced severe disruption on Wednesday after a signalling fault near Lime Street station forced the suspension of all Northern Line services for more than six hours, stranding an estimated 34,000 passengers during the morning peak. Network Rail engineers were dispatched to the scene shortly after 07:15, but repairs proved more complicated than initially anticipated, with full services only resuming at 14:40. Merseyrail urged affected travellers to use replacement bus services operating between Liverpool Central and Kirkby.

Stockholm's commuter rail network faces its most disruptive week in years as Mälardalstrafik engineers carry out emergency track-bed repairs on the Västerås–Stockholm corridor, suspending all services between Västerås Central and Kallhäll from Monday through Friday and forcing an estimated 34,000 daily passengers onto a fleet of 47 replacement coaches. The work, triggered by subsidence detected beneath the Enköping viaduct last week, is expected to add up to 90 minutes to journey times during peak hours.

The Frankfurter Buchmesse opens its 76th edition on Wednesday, October 16, drawing publishers, agents, and literary luminaries from more than 100 countries to the Messe Frankfurt fairgrounds. This year's guest of honour is Italy, with a pavilion curated by Rossella Amendola and a programme spanning readings, panel debates, and live translations that runs through Sunday, October 20. Organizers expect upward of 285,000 visitors over the five-day fair, which remains the largest trade gathering for the global book industry.

Der Wiener Gemeinderat hat am Dienstag mit 54 zu 38 Stimmen einen Sonderzuschuss von 1,2 Millionen Euro für das Wiener Festwochen-Programm 2025 bewilligt, nachdem Kulturstadträtin Leonie Hartmann die Initiative als „unverzichtbare Investition in den gesellschaftlichen Zusammenhalt" bezeichnet hatte. Die SPÖ stimmte geschlossen dafür, während die FPÖ das Vorhaben als Verschwendung öffentlicher Mittel ablehnte. Das Festival selbst, das vom 9. Mai bis zum 22. Juni 2025 auf zahlreichen Bühnen der Stadt stattfindet, wird in diesem Jahr erstmals von Intendantin Miriam Szabo geleitet, die ein Programm mit internationalen Gastspielen aus Polen, dem Senegal und Japan zusammengestellt hat.

Der Hamburger Senat hat am Mittwoch mit 74 zu 38 Stimmen einen milliardenschweren Investitionsplan für den Ausbau der U-Bahn-Linie U5 verabschiedet, nachdem SPD und Grüne trotz heftigen Widerstands der CDU eine knappe Mehrheit sichern konnten. Verkehrssenatorin Birte Lohmann bezeichnete das Vorhaben als „historische Weichenstellung für eine klimaneutrale Mobilität in der Metropolregion". Das Projekt, das mit 4,2 Milliarden Euro veranschlagt ist und bis 2035 fertiggestellt werden soll, umfasst zwölf neue Stationen vom Hauptbahnhof bis nach Bramfeld und wird von der Hamburger Hochbahn betrieben.

The Frankfurter Buchmesse opened its doors on Wednesday to a record 4,312 exhibitors from 95 countries, with Norwegian author Sigrid Tollefsen drawing the largest crowd of the morning for a reading from her debut novel "The Silence Between Fjords" at the Festhalle. This year's guest of honour is Slovenia, whose pavilion — designed by architect Maja Kovačič — offers a luminous survey of contemporary Slovenian literature in translation. Organisers expect more than 300,000 visitors before the fair closes on Sunday.

Die ÖBB hat angekündigt, dass die Bahnstrecke zwischen Salzburg und Linz vom 14. März bis zum 2. April wegen umfangreicher Gleiserneuerungsarbeiten vollständig gesperrt wird. Betroffen sind nach Unternehmensangaben täglich rund 18.000 Fahrgäste auf den Linien REX 1 und EC 110. Als Ersatz richtet die ÖBB einen Schienenersatzverkehr mit Bussen ein, der jedoch laut Sprecher Matthias Gruber mit einer Verlängerung der Reisezeit um bis zu 45 Minuten verbunden sein wird.

Commuters on the Piccadilly line faced severe delays for the third consecutive morning on Wednesday after a points failure near Hammersmith forced Transport for London to suspend services between Acton Town and Heathrow Terminal 5, leaving an estimated 47,000 passengers stranded or rerouted through already-crowded District line trains. TfL engineers arrived on site before dawn but warned that full restoration was unlikely before the evening peak, with replacement bus services R9 and R10 operating along the affected corridor in the interim.

Mit einem verwandelten Elfmeter in der Nachspielzeit sicherte Stürmerin Leonie Prantl dem FC Lustenau einen dramatischen 2:1-Sieg gegen den SV Wienerberg im Halbfinale des ÖFB-Frauenpokals. Vor 1.340 Zuschauern in der Reichshofstadion in Feldkirch lieferten beide Mannschaften eine hart umkämpfte Partie ab, ehe Prantl in der 93. Minute die Entscheidung erzwang. Der FC Lustenau steht damit zum ersten Mal seit acht Jahren wieder im Pokalfinale.

Mit einem überzeugenden 3:1-Sieg gegen den SC Freiburg hat sich Bayer 04 Leverkusen am Samstagabend in der BayArena die Tabellenführung in der Bundesliga gesichert. Die Tore erzielten Mateus Carvalho (12.), Lukas Brenner per Doppelpack (34., 67.) sowie Freiburgs Anschlusstreffer durch Tomáš Řehák (80.). Vor 30.210 Zuschauern bot Leverkusen eine weitgehend fehlerfreie Vorstellung und ließ kaum nennenswerte Chancen des Gegners zu.

The Stockholm Philharmonic Orchestra will open its centenary season at Konserthuset on 14 September with a programme of Sibelius and Nielsen conducted by the Finnish maestro Aleksi Mäkinen, drawing an expected audience of 1,800. Commuters hoping to attend the sold-out gala should note that SL, the regional transit authority, has announced a full closure of the Tunnelbana's green line between T-Centralen and Odenplan from 12 to 21 September for emergency track-bed replacement works, urging concertgoers to use the substitute bus services on routes 59 and 69.

Die Wiener Festwochen eröffnen am 9. Mai ihre diesjährige Ausgabe mit einer umjubelten Uraufführung im Burgtheater: Das Musiktheaterstück „Nachtstimmen", inszeniert von der österreichischen Regisseurin Carola Fend, verspricht ein eindringliches Zusammenspiel aus Kammermusik und Sprechtheater. Intendant Milo Hargasser bezeichnete das Werk als „radikalste Produktion seit Jahren". Karten sind ab 18 Euro erhältlich.

Der Wiener Gemeinderat hat am Donnerstagabend mit knapper Mehrheit einen Antrag der SPÖ zur Ausweitung des geförderten Wohnbaus abgelehnt. 41 Stimmen sprachen sich gegen den Vorstoß aus, 38 dafür, bei vier Enthaltungen. ÖVP und FPÖ stimmten geschlossen dagegen; Fraktionsvorsitzender Lukas Draxler von der SPÖ bezeichnete das Ergebnis als „politisches Versagen zulasten der Mieterinnen und Mieter". Bürgermeister Michael Ludwig war während der turbulenten Sitzung im Rathaus Wien anwesend, äußerte sich jedoch zunächst nicht öffentlich.

Wegen eines technischen Defekts an einer Weichenanlage im Bereich des Hauptbahnhofs Hannover kommt es seit Montagmorgen zu erheblichen Verspätungen und Teilausfällen auf mehreren Fernverkehrslinien der Deutschen Bahn. Betroffen sind vor allem die Verbindungen zwischen Hamburg und Frankfurt sowie zwischen Dortmund und Leipzig. Die DB Netz AG schätzt, dass rund 42.000 Fahrgäste von den Beeinträchtigungen betroffen sind; ein Ende der Störung ist nach aktuellem Stand frühestens am Mittwochabend zu erwarten.

Wegen des Bundesliga-Heimspiels des FC Augsburg gegen Borussia Mönchengladbach am Samstag warnt die Augsburger Verkehrsgesellschaft vor erheblichen Beeinträchtigungen im Stadtverkehr: Rund um die WWK Arena werden die Straßenbahnlinien 2 und 3 zwischen 16 Uhr und Mitternacht umgeleitet, während zusätzliche Busse auf der Linie 51 eingesetzt werden, um die erwarteten 30.000 Zuschauer zu befördern. Das Spiel, das um 18:30 Uhr angepfiffen wird, gilt als Schlüsselbegegnung für den Abstiegskampf in der Rückrunde.

Am Wochenende verwandelte sich Graz in ein Zentrum des Sports und der Kultur: Während die Handballerinnen des HC Bregenz am Samstagnachmittag in der Merkur Arena mit einem überzeugenden 31:24-Sieg gegen den Linzer Athletik-Sport-Klub die Tabellenführung in der Frauen Handball Liga Austria übernahmen, eröffnete nur wenige Stunden später Festivalleiter Tomáš Dворák in der Helmut List Halle das Internationale Kammermusikfest Graz mit einem bewegenden Konzert des Arpeggione Quartetts vor mehr als 900 Besucherinnen und Besuchern. „Diese Kombination aus sportlichem Höchstniveau und musikalischer Tiefe ist einzigartig für unsere Stadt", sagte Bürgermeisterin Elke Raffeiner.

The Scottish Parliament voted by a narrow margin on Thursday to extend free school meal provision to all primary-age children across Scotland, with 68 members backing the measure, 54 opposing it, and three abstaining. The Scottish National Party and the Scottish Greens together provided the winning coalition, overcoming a united front from the Scottish Conservatives and most Scottish Labour members. Education Secretary Fiona Dreich hailed the result as "a landmark moment for child welfare," while Conservative spokesperson Alasdair Muir warned that the £280 million annual cost had not been adequately costed. The vote, held at Holyrood, marks the most significant expansion of the universal free meals programme since its original introduction in 2014.

London Underground passengers on the Central and Jubilee lines faced severe delays for the third consecutive morning on Wednesday after a signalling fault near Stratford forced Transport for London to run a severely reduced service between Liverpool Street and Mile End, with TfL engineers warning that full restoration was unlikely before the weekend.

Marta Svensson's brace in the dying minutes sealed a dramatic 3-2 comeback victory for Djurgårdens IF over IK Häcken at Tele2 Arena on Saturday evening, lifting the hosts to the top of the Damallsvenskan table with six matches remaining. Kajsa Lindgren had pulled one back for the visitors in the 78th minute, but Svensson's clinical finishes in the 87th and 90th minutes left a crowd of 11,400 stunned and jubilant in equal measure.

Commuters on the Jubilee line faced severe disruptions for the third consecutive morning on Wednesday after a signalling fault between Waterloo and Stratford forced Transport for London to suspend all services through the central section, with replacement bus routes struggling to absorb the estimated 340,000 daily passengers who rely on the corridor. TfL engineers said they expected to restore partial service by Thursday evening, though a full return to normal operations could not be guaranteed before the weekend.

Die Berliner Verkehrsbetriebe (BVG) haben ab kommendem Montag eine vollständige Sperrung der U-Bahnlinie U8 zwischen den Haltestellen Hermannstraße und Leinestraße angekündigt – und das für voraussichtlich drei Wochen. Grund sind dringend notwendige Sanierungsarbeiten an den Gleisen und Weichen in diesem Streckenabschnitt. Laut BVG-Sprecherin Annette Dobrowski werden täglich rund 47.000 Fahrgäste von der Maßnahme betroffen sein; ein Ersatzbus-Schienenersatzverkehr mit der Linie U8-SEV soll die Unterbrechung abfedern. Die Kosten für das Projekt belaufen sich nach Angaben des Senats auf 8,4 Millionen Euro.

Defending champions Roter Stern Graz were held to a bruising 2–2 draw by FC Dornbirn at the Athletic Park on Saturday evening, a result that leaves the Styrian club three points adrift at the top of the Austrian Football Second League after eleven rounds of play. Midfielder Tobias Unterberger opened the scoring in the 14th minute before Dornbirn equalised twice in the second half to frustrate an 8,400-strong home crowd.

Brøndby IF produced a disciplined defensive display to hold Malmö FF to a goalless draw at Brøndby Stadion on Saturday, a result that leaves both clubs level on points at the top of the Nordic Cup table with two group-stage fixtures remaining. Morten Kjeldsmark kept a clean sheet for the Danish side despite sustained pressure in the final quarter-hour, while Malmö's Rasmus Lövgren saw a stoppage-time header graze the outside of the post. An attendance of 14,200 watched the closely contested affair under the floodlights.

Oslo's city council voted 35 to 12 on Thursday to approve a €280 million expansion of the T-bane metro network, extending Line 2 northward to Grorud with four new stations — a flagship infrastructure pledge of Mayor Astrid Nygaard-Holm's governing coalition. The project, long championed by the Arbeiderpartiet and fiercely resisted by the Høyre opposition, is expected to begin construction in early 2026, with Ruter confirmed as the operating authority for the completed extension.

The architectural debate over Wembley Stadium's ageing north concourse has simmered for the better part of a decade, with transport planners at Transport for London and Brent Council exchanging increasingly terse correspondence about pedestrian flow on match days — yet no concrete proposal has crossed the desk of London Mayor Sadiq Khan, whose office confirmed only that a feasibility review "remains under consideration."
